jobs.title: Bioinformatics Associate, Prenatal
jobs.description:
A Rare Opportunity to Shape the Future of Genomics

Join a team of brilliant, passionate innovators determined to transform healthcare. At BillionToOne, we've built a category-defining, publicly traded company on Nasdaq where transparency fuels trust, collaboration drives breakthroughs, and every contribution moves the needle on our mission to make life-changing diagnostics accessible to all. We don't just aim for incremental improvements; we build products that are 10x better than anything that exists today.

Our scientists, engineers, sales executives, and visionaries are united by an unwavering commitment to changing the standard of care in prenatal and cancer diagnostics. This is where cutting-edge science meets human compassion, and every innovation you contribute helps remove the fear of the unknown from some of life's most critical medical moments.

If you're driven by purpose, energized by innovation, and ready to help shape the future of precision medicine at scale, this is where you belong.

We are looking for a Bioinformatics Associate, Prenatal to join our Clinical Operations team to create computational tools to analyze groundbreaking molecule diagnostics. This person will be responsible for developing bioinformatics pipelines and analyzing next-generation DNA sequencing data under the guidance of bioinformatics scientists.

This is a dynamic, start-up environment that requires adaptability and the ability to quickly learn and apply new concepts. The Bioinformatics Associate role is a full-time onsite position in Menlo Park, CA and reports to the Senior Bioinformatics Scientist.

Responsibilities:

• Develop sophisticated and robust next-generation sequencing analysis pipelines under the guidance of a senior scientist

• Perform analysis of clinical bioinformatics data

• Assemble and analyze quality metrics from the clinical laboratory

• Maintain analysis pipeline and operational tools using DevOps practices

• Collaborate with scientists and support new scientific insights

Qualifications:

• BS or MS in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Bioengineering, Physics or related field

• 1-2 years of biology research experience (either during BS/MS or afterwards)

• Strong programming skills in Python, R or a similar language, especially with application to complex data processing and transformation

• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with interdisciplinary teams

• Coursework or experience with molecular biology laboratory techniques and human genetics

• High mathematical and statistical aptitude

• Great attention to detail

Nice-To-Haves:

• Software Engineering experience, particularly with DevOps best practices

• Experience with clinical laboratory operations

• 1-2 years of research experience

• Molecular biology (DNA purification, PCR, electrophoresis) or next-generation DNA sequencing laboratory experience

Benefits And Perks:

• Working alongside brilliant, kind, passionate and dedicated colleagues, in an empowering environment, toward a global vision, striving for a future in which transformative molecular diagnostics can help millions of patients

• Open, transparent culture that includes weekly Town Hall meetings

• The ability to indirectly or directly change the lives of hundreds of thousands patients

• Multiple medical benefit options; employee premiums paid 100% of select plans, dependents covered up to 80%

• Extremely generous Family Bonding Leave for eligible employees (16 weeks, paid at 100%)

• Supplemental fertility benefits coverage

• Retirement savings program including a 4% Company match

• Increase paid time off with increased tenure

• Latest and greatest hardware (laptop, lab equipment, facilities)

• Daily on-site lunches provided from top eateries

• A variety of perks on campus (state of the art gym, restaurant)

• Free on-site EV charging (compatible with all EVs, including Tesla)

At BillionToOne, we are proud to offer a combination of a (1) base pay range (actual amount offered is based on experience and salary/equity options split that the candidate chooses), (2) generous equity options offering, (3) corporate bonus program, on top of (4) industry leading company benefits (free healthcare options, 401k match, very generous fully paid parental leave, etc.).

The base salary range for this role is $86,611 - $97,491. This position is eligible for an annual bonus and receives a new hire equity grant of up to $20,000 at grant value, vesting over four years, plus annual equity refresh grants equal in value to the new hire grant. Together, the total four-year value of base, target bonus, and equity is up to approximately $479,000. We also offer competitive medical and dental coverage and a 401(k) with company match.

BillionToOne is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For more information about how we protect your information, we encourage you to review our Privacy Policy.

BillionToOne is a next-generation molecular diagnostics company on a mission to make powerful, accurate diagnostic tests accessible to everyone. Our revolutionary QCT molecular counting technology enhances disease detection resolution by over a thousandfold using cell-free DNA,a breakthrough that has already transformed the lives of over half a million patients worldwide.

Our Impact

Unity Complete™ is the only non-invasive prenatal screen capable of assessing fetal risk for both common recessive conditions and aneuploidies from a single maternal blood sample.
Unity Confirm™ enables non-invasive confirmation for high-risk screening results through the capture of intact circulating fetal cells using BillionToOne’s Fetal Cell Capture™ Technology.
Our Northstar® liquid biopsy test uniquely combines treatment selection with real-time monitoring, giving oncologists unprecedented precision in cancer care.

Our Growth

From $0 to $400M+ annualized revenue run-rate in just 6 years. In 2025, we completed one of the most successful IPOs for a medical diagnostics company, building on nearly $400M in private funding,including our $130M Series D in 2024 and backed by world-class investors including Hummingbird, Adams Street Partners, Neuberger Berman, Baillie Gifford, and Premji Invest.

Our Recognition

Forbes named us one of America's Best Startup Employers for 2025 and we're Great Place to Work certified, with 100% of our people willing to go the extra mile, even as we've scaled to over 700 employees.

Our Future

Headquartered in Menlo Park with facilities in Union City, CA, and a new lab opening in Austin, TX in 2027, we're continuing to push the boundaries of what's possible in molecular diagnostics. We're just getting started.

Ready to help us change the world, one molecule at a time? Learn more at billiontoone.com

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description:
JOIN THE TILT TEAM

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.


THE OPPORTUNITY: STAFF PRODUCT DESIGNER

We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer to lead design for our cash products, the fast, affordable liquidity at the heart of the Tilt user’s financial lives. They help members cover the gap between paychecks, and you’ll own the experience end to end: how members understand their offer, take an advance, and repay.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a designer who has owned the design of a whole product or product area before, not only individual features, and is ready to do the same here. You’ll pair strong product thinking with exceptional craft, and you’ll be accountable for outcomes: the customer and business results the experience drives. You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, and other partners to set direction for the product and raise the quality bar across it.




HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT

 - Lead design for our cash products end to end, from setting the experience direction for the product through launch and iteration.

 - Own outcomes alongside your product and engineering partners: define what success looks like, connect design decisions to measurable customer and business results, and follow the work after launch to see whether it delivered.

 - Set and hold a high bar for interaction design, visual design, and overall product quality, and raise the bar for the wider design team through critique and example.

 - Translate complex financial concepts and flows, such as offers, advances, and repayment timing, into clear, trustworthy experiences.

 - Shape product strategy with your partners: identify the problems that matter most, frame them well, and make tradeoffs explicit.

 - Partner with compliance and legal early, so clarity and trust are built into the experience from the start.

 - Use AI throughout your workflow, from research synthesis and exploration to prototyping and building, and help the team adopt the approaches that work.

 - Help shape the design system and the broader UI patterns that our cash products and the rest of the app rely on.

 - Present work clearly and build alignment among partners and senior leaders with different perspectives and priorities.

 - Mentor other designers and help shape how design operates across product pods.


WHY YOU'RE A GREAT FIT

 - Significant experience designing and shipping complex consumer digital products, ideally within fintech, financial services, commerce, transportation, or another multi-stakeholder environment.

 - Experience as the design owner for a whole product or major product area: you set its design direction and were accountable for the result, beyond designing individual features.

 - A portfolio that shows exceptional visual and UI craft alongside strong UX thinking, at a level that raises the bar for the team around you.

 - A track record of outcomes: examples where your design work measurably moved customer or business results, and how you knew.

 - Comfort setting direction in ambiguous product areas without a fully defined path.

 - Strong interaction-design fundamentals and exceptional attention to detail.

 - Experience working closely with product management and engineering throughout development, and influencing decisions beyond your own team.

 - Strong communication and storytelling skills, including presenting to senior leaders and bringing partners along.

 - Good judgment about when to challenge assumptions, when to seek more context, and when to make a decision.

 - Consistent use of AI tools in your day-to-day design workflow (strongly preferred), with an informed point of view on where they help and where they don’t.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience designing consumer financial products, such as cash advance, banking, payments, or lending

 - Experience prototyping or building in code, including with AI coding tools.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first few months, you’ll build a deep understanding of our customers, cash products, and business through shipping; build trusted relationships with your design and cross-functional partners; and form a clear point of view on where the experience should go.




WHY JOIN US

 - Lead design for the products at the center of Tilt’s business, with meaningful customer and business impact.

 - Set both the experience and the visual direction for a critical financial product.

 - Join a team that values strong design judgment, constructive debate, and thoughtful collaboration.

 - Work directly with product-minded partners who care deeply about customers and shipping useful products.

 - Shape how design operates, including how the team builds with AI, as the product organization evolves.





Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.





WHAT YOU'LL GET AT TILT

 - Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

 - Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

 - Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

 - Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

 - Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

 - Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.


THE TILT WAY

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.



You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

jobs.title: New Graduate Engineer, Propulsion (Raptor)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

NEW GRADUATE PROPULSION ENGINEER, RAPTOR

Join the forefront of space exploration at SpaceX as a member of the Raptor team – the worlds most advanced rocket engine powering Starship’s journey in making humanity multiplanetary. If you’re eager to tackle real-world challenges in propulsion systems, from mechanical design and analysis to manufacturing and testing – this is your opportunity to help build the worlds most powerful rocket engine with an emphasis on efficiency and reusability. Bring your innovative mindset and strong fundamentals in engineering principles to drive the boundaries of what’s possible.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Expect a dynamic role doing what you’re best at. Our team is building high performance flight hardware, a high-volume rocket engine production line, and a propulsion system that can rapidly and reliably power our rockets. Whatever your skill set, you’ll be aligned to the part of the program you’re most effectively able to contribute to.

• Own the design and development of next generation rocket engines, test stands, and production lines.

• Perform hand calculations and FEA to develop, assess, and optimize designs.

• Rapidly iterate on manufacturing processes and development testing in a fast-paced environment.

• Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to ensure hardware integrates with all Raptor systems and supports necessary mission operations.

• Own large business outcomes and experience a rate of personal and professional growth that is unmatched literally anywhere else.

• Get a front row seat to witness an impossible idea manifest in real life. The next few years will be incredibly dynamic as we transition from the challenge of building hardware to actually flying reusable rockets to orbit.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline or physics.

• 1+ years of mechanical and/or fluids engineering experience via project team, research, internships, and/or professional experience.

• Graduating in the spring of 2026, summer of 2026 or Fall of 2026.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Strong ability to use data and analysis to make fast data-driven decisions.

• Ability to perform trade studies and make clear recommendations using first principles and engineering fundamentals even with partial information. Strong understanding of engineering fundamentals.

• Experience working at a nimble engineering organization or in a highly technical position that required a scrappy, entrepreneurial manner to accomplish tasks with tight time or budget constraints.

• Excelled in ultra-competitive environments. You’ve nailed a podium finish in engineering, math, or science competitions, achieved scores in the top percentile of scholastic or standardized tests, or demonstrated other incredible feats of intellectual achievement.

• Experience building hardware or have a passion for contributing to a work product that operates in the real world.

• Succeeded in multiple endeavors at once. Maybe you worked through college, were a student athlete, or demonstrated strong work or academic performance in multiple fields.

• Demonstrated rapid growth. You’ve held successive positions of increasing responsibility within an organization, were able to get yourself up to speed at a heroic pace, and accomplished something meaningfully difficult early in your career.

• Demonstrated resilience and the ability to overcome failure or extreme odds. Many critics would say that our goals are impossible but this isn’t the first time we’ve proven that highly improbable goals like reusable rockets can become possible.

• Success in academics at a rigorous and highly regarded university: minimum GPA 3.5/4.0 or higher, standardized test scores minimum 95th percentile, merit-based scholarship recipient.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Sales Executive - Moveworks - TMT/SI
jobs.description:
The Solution Sales Executive will drive market success for ServiceNow’s Moveworks products. Moveworks is the conversational AI and enterprise search engine behind ServiceNow EmployeeWorks, the AI front door for the enterprise. Employees ask for what they need in Teams, Slack, or a browser, and the work gets done through governed ServiceNow workflows. No portal hunting. No ticket maze. Just answers and action.

Moveworks is now part of ServiceNow Otto, our unified AI experience, and it pairs consumer-grade simplicity with the workflows, data, and governance of the ServiceNow AI Platform. Built in, not bolted on.

This role is for sellers who have lived in both worlds—the scale and structure of enterprise software and the speed and grit of a startup—or who bring transferable muscle from one to the other. You’ll bring deep Moveworks expertise to large enterprise accounts and work shoulder to shoulder with Account Executives, Solution Consultants, partners, and customer success teams to win as one team.

What you get to do in this role:

• Drive new Moveworks pipeline and bookings across a set of enterprise accounts (5,000+ employees), in partnership with the assigned account team
• Build joint account strategies with Account Executives to find where conversational AI and enterprise search create the most value across IT, HR, finance, and beyond
• Drive the Moveworks opportunity with customers as the subject matter expert
• Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CHROs, and employee experience leaders, and help them picture a workplace where employees just ask and the work gets done
• Build business cases that quantify productivity gains, hours given back to employees, and adoption at scale
• Partner with Specialist SCs on demos, technical validation, and roadmap alignment
• Work with partners and global system integrators to expand reach and speed up time to value
• Coach and enable account teams on Moveworks positioning so opportunities surface earlier and move faster
• Forecast accurately and keep deal hygiene sharp, from mutual action plans to clean pipeline data

To be successful in this role you have:

• Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
• 7+ years uncovering and driving complex deals in enterprise software sales organizations
• The ideal candidate brings a mix of enterprise software and startup DNA. You can navigate a large organization and still move through ambiguity with a founder’s urgency.
• Experience as a specialist or solution seller, or a track record of partnering closely with specialists inside a matrixed account team. You sell and win as a team.
• Experience selling AI, employee experience, enterprise search, or IT and HR service delivery solutions is a plus
• A history of high achievement: consistent quota overachievement, President’s Club, top-rep rankings, or similar recognition
• Fluency in a value selling methodology such as MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or Challenger
• Executive presence and the ability to build and sustain C-level relationships
• Proven ability to build business cases for net-new and unbudgeted spend
• Travel required: 30–50%

Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

jobs.title: Assistant to Managing Partner
jobs.description:
About Gersh

Gersh is a leading global entertainment and sports agency, representing a diverse roster of clients across film, television, sports, theater, comedy, branding, publishing, and digital media. As the fastest-growing major agency, Gersh is respected for its hands-on, client-first approach and commitment to driving innovation and success. Following an equity investment from Crestview Partners in 2023 Gersh has advanced its long-term growth plan, acquiring the Digital and Alternative departments of the A3 Agency, and You First – one of the world’s top sports and entertainment agencies. With clients at the heart of every growth decision, Gersh is harnessing strategic insights and decades of experience to strengthen its resources, empowering clients to realize success across all areas of the media landscape.

About the Role

Gersh is seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented Executive Assistant to support a Managing Partner. This role is best suited for an experienced agency assistant who is as passionate about the creative side of the business as they are about providing exceptional executive support. The ideal candidate is an avid reader with strong script coverage and analytical skills, someone who enjoys evaluating material and discussing talent, writers, directors, and emerging projects. Equally important, they will serve as a true extension of the Managing Partner, seamlessly managing day-to-day priorities, anticipating needs, exercising sound judgment, and representing the executive with professionalism and discretion.

Beyond strong organizational abilities, we're looking for someone who is personable, collaborative, and genuinely enjoys building relationships. The right fit will be someone the executive can trust, and work closely alongside, in a demanding, fast-paced environment. This position offers unique exposure to high-level talent representation, deal-making, and strategy, while providing the opportunity to learn directly from an industry leader and interact with top-tier clients, managers, casting executives, publicists, studios, networks, and production companies.

Duties

• Serve as a trusted partner, helping manage the day-to-day operations of a dynamic and high-volume Managing Partner desk.

• Coordinate complex calendars, scheduling, travel arrangements, and expense reporting with precision and efficiency.

• Manage high-volume communications, including phone calls, email correspondence, meeting coordination, and follow-up.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with casting executives, managers, attorneys, publicists, producers, and other industry professionals.

• Prepare, track, and distribute talent submissions and materials for ongoing opportunities.

• Coordinate auditions, meetings, and industry events while ensuring talent and client needs are prioritized.

• Read a high volume of scripts and provide concise and thoughtful analysis.

• Anticipate administrative and business needs, proactively identifying solutions and keeping priorities organized.

• Maintain accurate records, databases, and project tracking systems in a fast-moving environment.

• Act as a key liaison across internal departments and external partners to ensure seamless communication and execution.

What We're Looking For

• Bachelor's degree required.

• Minimum 1 year of full-time experience within the entertainment industry; agency, management company, studio/network experience strongly preferred.

• Previous experience supporting a high-volume desk in a talent representation environment is strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated interest in pursuing a long-term career in talent representation and agency leadership.

• Strong script analysis and coverage skills, with the ability to assess creative material and communicate insightful feedback both written and verbally.

• Passionate about talent and the entertainment business, with a deep knowledge of current film, series, and industry developments, as well as a commitment to tracking new releases, premieres, and emerging voices.

• Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the confidence to interact professionally with clients and industry executives.

• High level of discretion, professionalism, and attention to detail.

• Resourceful, proactive, and solutions-oriented mindset.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

• Ability to remain composed and effective in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

• Commitment to learning, professional growth, and contributing to a collaborative team culture.

Why Join Gersh?

• Direct mentorship and exposure to senior leadership within one of the industry's fastest-growing agencies.

• Opportunity to work alongside some of the most respected professionals in talent representation.

• Meaningful career development path for individuals seeking future agent opportunities.

• Collaborative, entrepreneurial culture that values growth, initiative, and innovation.

• Access to a diverse portfolio of clients and projects spanning film, television, digital media, sports, comedy, and beyond.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer II, Integration
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 



In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 



Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.



Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.



Role Description:

The Mechanical Engineering team at Form is focused on designing the battery cell, module, and full pack system that forms the foundation of our innovative utility-scale multi-day energy storage system. We strive to deliver designs that are optimized for performance, quality, reliability, and cost for high-volume manufacturing at Form Factory.



We’re hiring a hands-on Mechanical Engineer to own the design of components and assemblies within a subsystem on our integration team. This team is critical to Form’s iron-air battery technology and central to the system’s successful implementation. You’ll take well-scoped design problems from concept through prototype, build and verify analytical models, run first-of-a-kind builds, and work closely with systems engineers, manufacturing engineers, and vendors to make everything come together. You’ll work with guidance on architecture and grow toward owning it.



If this sounds like the right position for you, apply now! This opportunity will help shape and scale our multi-day energy storage system, contributing to the growth of a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission, contributing to a sustainable future!



What You’ll Do: 

 - Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field; Bachelor’s with 3+ years of industry experience in mechanical design of equipment

 - Strong understanding of first-principles and experience optimizing designs for manufacturing and cost

 - Experience in a manufacturing environment or with contract manufacturing vendors

 - Experience with thermal, electrical, and mechanical interfaces in a system

 - Sense of urgency and self-driven to hit difficult schedule targets

 - Experience in product development in a fast-moving or early-stage environment (preferred, not required)



What You’ll Bring:

 - Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field; Bachelor's with 1+ years of industry experience in mechanical design of equipment

 - Understanding of first-principles and experience optimizing designs for manufacturing and cost-down.

 - Experience working in a manufacturing environment or with contract manufacturing vendors

 - Demonstrated experience optimizing design, thermal, electrical, and mechanical systems, and interdisciplinary interfaces of systems

 - Sense of urgency and self-driven to hit difficult schedule targets

 - Direct experience in product development within an early-stage environment ramping into production.



Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here. 



When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed. 



To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.




If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.

Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
Environmental Science Associates (ESA) is a 100% employee-owned environmental consulting firm. We plan, design, permit, mitigate, and restore for projects across our communities, infrastructure systems, open spaces, and wildlands. We are 50 years strong in 21 offices across California, the Pacific Northwest, and the Southeastern United States.

Environmental Science Associates (ESA) is seeking an experienced, highly organized, and proactive Office Manager with 3+ years of experience to join our Northern California administrative leadership team. Based in our San Francisco office, this position will play a key role in supporting daily operations across our regional offices, supervising administrative staff, improving processes, and ensuring our teams have the resources and support needed to succeed.

We're looking for a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and brings a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and follow-through. The ideal candidate is a natural problem-solver who can anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and confidently lead a team while maintaining a high standard of service.

Reporting to the Regional Office Manager, this individual will serve as a key operational partner, helping maintain consistency, efficiency, and a positive employee experience throughout the region.

This is a full-time, overtime-exempt role working 5 days a week in the office from our San Francisco ESA Office location.

Who You Are

• Demonstrated experience supervising administrative or office support teams, including coaching, delegation, workload management, and employee development.

• At least three years of administrative supervisory experience, consistent with ESA's Office Manager position requirements.

• Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

• Experience coordinating office operations, internal meetings, employee events, and vendor relationships.

• A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the confidence to work with employees, managers, and senior leadership.

• Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle confidential or sensitive matters professionally.

• Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and comfort learning new administrative and workplace management systems.

• A collaborative leadership style combined with the ability to make decisions, establish expectations, and hold others accountable.

What You Will Do for ESA

Administrative Leadership & Team Development

• Provide day-to-day leadership, supervision, coaching, and support to regional administrative staff.

• Coordinate workloads, assignments, schedules, and office coverage to ensure operational needs are met.

• Establish clear expectations, promote accountability, and support employee development and performance.

• Foster a collaborative, service-oriented team culture that encourages initiative, communication, and continuous improvement.

Office Operations & Process Improvement

• Oversee daily administrative operations, ensuring offices remain organized, efficient, welcoming, and fully supported.

• Develop, document, and improve administrative procedures, workflows, and operational standards across multiple locations.

• Proactively identify operational challenges, recommend solutions, and implement improvements.

• Coordinate with facilities, IT, vendors, and internal stakeholders to resolve issues and maintain business continuity.

• Manage competing priorities, delegate effectively, and ensure assignments are completed accurately and on time.

Meetings, Events & Employee Experience

• Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of internal meetings, employee events, trainings, and regional initiatives.

• Oversee event logistics, including scheduling, vendors, catering, budgets, transportation, room setup, and audiovisual coordination.

• Support employee engagement initiatives that promote collaboration, connection, and a positive workplace culture.

• Ensure a consistent, professional experience for employees, visitors, and business partners.

Financial & Administrative Oversight

• Support office operating budgets, purchasing, expense tracking, invoice processing, and vendor coordination.

• Monitor administrative spending and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and manage costs.

• Maintain accurate operational records, schedules, and project tracking tools.

• Support special projects, office transitions, and regional initiatives as assigned.

Regional Partnership & Operational Support

• Partner closely with the Regional Office Manager to establish priorities, coordinate initiatives, and maintain operational consistency.

• Serve as a primary point of contact for routine administrative matters, independently resolving issues and escalating when appropriate.

• Communicate proactively regarding staffing needs, operational risks, upcoming priorities, and recommended solutions.

• Provide operational leadership and continuity during the Regional Office Manager's absence.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting multiple offices or geographically distributed administrative teams.

• Background in professional services, consulting, corporate operations, or similarly dynamic environments.

• Experience with facilities coordination, office relocations, operational budgets, and process improvement.

• Military leadership, logistics, or administrative operations experience is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

• Success in this role means building a well-coordinated, accountable, and collaborative administrative team while ensuring daily operations run smoothly across the region.

• The selected candidate will participate in a structured 30/60/90-day onboarding and training program to develop a strong understanding of ESA's culture, operations, processes, and team before transitioning into formal supervisory responsibilities.

• We're seeking someone who takes pride in creating order, developing people, solving problems, and making the workplace better for everyone. Someone who doesn't just respond to operational needs but anticipates them, takes initiative, and follows through.

• If you're an experienced administrative leader who enjoys building strong teams, improving operations, and making a meaningful impact, we'd welcome the opportunity to meet you.

What’s Special About Our Team

Our Northern California Administrative Team is a collaborative, high-performing group that takes pride in making things happen. Supporting multiple offices across the region, we're much more than traditional administrative support. We're problem-solvers, organizers, event planners, and trusted partners who help create an exceptional workplace experience for our colleagues.

No two days are quite the same. From coordinating office relocations and workplace improvements to organizing employee celebrations, community outreach initiatives, and large-scale events, our team plays an important role in bringing people together and keeping ESA moving forward.

We embrace ESA's One ESA culture, working across offices and departments to share resources, support one another, and find creative solutions. We value initiative, accountability, open communication, and a willingness to roll up our sleeves when the situation calls for it. We work hard, celebrate our successes, and genuinely enjoy the people we work with.

What makes this opportunity especially exciting is the chance to lead an established, talented team while helping shape the next chapter of our regional operations. You'll have the opportunity to develop people, improve processes, introduce new ideas, and make a meaningful impact on how we support our employees and the important work they do every day.

What’s Special About ESA

Joining ESA means becoming part of a close-knit team of environmental professionals who contribute to outstanding projects, improve environmental stewardship, and advance a more sustainable and resilient future for our communities and wild places.

At ESA, we provide benefits such as medical, dental, and vision insurance (paid at 70% for you AND your family), annual allocations of company share through our ESOP, a 401(k) plan with company match, and paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays, to name a few.

We also provide specific programs whether you want to further your technical expertise, sharpen your business acumen, or help lead the next generation of employee-owners. We want to support you in reaching your career goals through tuition reimbursement, professional development bonuses, and attendance at conferences.

ESA has established multiple pay ranges tailored to the economic factors in the geographies in which ESA staff reside. For this position, the range is approximately as listed, based on our anticipated hiring locations as noted in the above job details. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including but not limited to an individual’s related experience, education, skills, and the city in which the applicant lives.

Who We Are

We are a 100% employee-owned environmental consulting firm who values diversity and inclusion and celebrate the differences that make each of us unique. Our culture is built on mutual respect, recognizing that our variety of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives leads to better solutions, which fosters our continued success for our employee-owners and clients.

jobs.description:
Senior Human Resources Business Partner

Jacksonville, FL

We exist to transform our customers and change lives

RF-SMART is currently seeking an experienced Sr. HR Business Partner for our corporate office in Jacksonville, FL. This role will partner with business leaders to develop and execute HR strategies focused on talent management, organizational effectiveness, employee relations, workforce planning, and team member engagement. This role will also be accountable for programs within the broader HR team.  As a Sr. HR business partner, you will need to understand business priorities and translate them into the highest impact work. You will be a trusted partner that helps business leaders with data-driven recommendations that improve performance, retention, and the overall team member experience.

What You'll Do:

Responsibilities:

• A true hands-on approach as well as the ability to successfully monitor the pulse of the team members to ensure a high level of engagement.

• Coaching and mentoring at the management level.

• Success in creating and driving effective employee relations and retention programs.

Job Summary

Lay out, fit, and fabricate metal components to assemble structural weld forms, such as frames for assembly using knowledge of welding techniques, metallurgy, and engineering requirements.

Key Characteristics

• Read and interpret blueprints, diagrams, and schematics and be able to work from sketches or verbal instructions.
• Perform precision welding in various positions.
• Configure welding machines by selecting correct polarity, setting amperage and adjusting shield gas flow rates based on material thickness and type.

Duties & Responsibilities

• Assists with other departments as needed.
• Works with and coordinates activities with other job classifications.
• Follows safe work practices and all environmental, health and safety policies and procedures.
• Reads and understands shop orders and bill of materials.
• Understands how the tools and materials replenishment system operates.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Able to demonstrate a successful TIG weld.
• Ability to TIG weld stainless.
• Basic mathematics skills.

Education & Experience

Required:

• Experience with TIG welding and ability to complete successful welds on the 6G position interview day.
• High School Diploma/GED

Working Conditions:

• Must be able to perform work with appropriate PPE for welding (welding helmet, gloves, etc.)
• Must be able to don PPE appropriate for working in Engineered Equipment including safety glasses and shoes.
• The majority of the day will be spent standing with some bending and fine motor work appropriate for TIG welding in a metal fabrication shop.
• Ability to operate metal fabrication power and hand tools such for grinding, cutting, finishing, etc. is required.
• Some sitting and computer work is required.
• Some unassisted lifting up to 50 lbs. is required – majority of metal movement assisted with cranes/hoists.

jobs.title: Vice President, Global Scientific Communications, Medical Information, Content and Education
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

The Vice President, Global Scientific Communications, Medical Information, Content and Education will lead scientific narrative, publication strategy, medical content and training, medical education across Revolution Medicines’ portfolio.

This leader will translate complex and evolving evidence into accurate, clear and clinically relevant scientific communications and medical information services. The role will establish an integrated approach across Global, Regional and Country Medical Affairs, ensuring healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers and other relevant stakeholders have access to timely, balanced and evidence-based information throughout the product lifecycle.

As a member of the Global Medical Affairs leadership team, the Vice President will build and lead a high-performing scientific organization, including Global Medical Information, and partner closely with therapeutic area leaders, Clinical Development, Research, Field Medical and Regional and Country Medical Affairs.

The role will work in close partnership with the Vice President, Global Medical Affairs, Engagement, Analytics & Impact, as well as other members of the Global Medical Affairs Leadership Team, connecting scientific content and medical information with stakeholder insights, enabling technology and impact measurement through clearly defined accountabilities.

Global Medical Information Leadership

• Own the global strategy, operating model and delivery of Medical Information services across the portfolio.

• Build and scale Global Medical Information to support geographic expansion, multiple launches and increasing inquiry volume and complexity.

• Oversee timely, accurate, balanced and evidence-based responses to unsolicited inquiries from healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers and other stakeholders.

• Lead the development and maintenance of standard scientific response documents, frequently asked questions and supporting reference resources.

• Establish scientific and service standards for inquiry intake, triage, response, escalation, documentation and quality assurance.

• Define global standards and regional and country responsibilities, enabling local adaptation to language, healthcare context and applicable requirements.

• Oversee medical information service providers and contact centers, including scientific training, service quality, capacity and performance.

• Ensure appropriate processes for identifying and routing adverse events, product complaints and other reportable information to accountable functions.

• Establish medical information readiness for launches, new indications, major data releases and emerging scientific questions.

• Partner with Pharmacovigilance, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Legal and Compliance on processes supporting safe and appropriate information exchange.

Scientific Narrative and Communication Strategy

• Lead the development and evolution of portfolio and asset-level scientific narratives in partnership with therapeutic area leaders and evidence-generating functions.

• Ensure narratives reflect the totality of evidence, unmet medical needs, study limitations and the evolving treatment landscape.

• Translate medical strategy and evidence priorities into integrated scientific communication plans.

• Establish consistent scientific interpretation across publications, medical content and educational materials.

• Advise Global Medical Affairs leadership on communication priorities, emerging evidence and scientific issues requiring clarification.

• Coordinate scientific communication around major data releases and regulatory milestones with the relevant functional owners.

Publication Strategy and Delivery

• Lead global publication strategy and planning in partnership with Clinical Development, Global and Regional Medical Affairs, HEOR, Biostatistics, Research, Translational Science and other evidence-generating functions.

• Oversee the development and delivery of manuscripts, abstracts, posters and scientific presentations.

• Establish publication-specific processes for prioritization, data readiness, authorship, scientific review and approval.

• Confirm that proposed publications are supported by appropriately reviewed data and that unresolved scientific questions are addressed before progression.

• Ensure publications provide balanced interpretation and appropriate context across the body of evidence.

• Manage external author collaboration and publication agency partnerships, preserving scientific independence and transparency.

• Coordinate publication timelines with medical communication and education plans.

Scientific Content Development and Stewardship

• Own the strategy, development and maintenance of core global scientific content across assets, indications and disease areas.

• Oversee scientific platforms, data presentations, disease-state resources, scientific narratives and supporting medical education materials.

• Establish standards for scientific accuracy, evidence traceability, clinical relevance and appropriate presentation of uncertainty.

• Define scientific requirements for content review, updates, version control and retirement.

• Develop modular content that Regional and Country teams can adapt within agreed scientific parameters.

• Integrate Medical Information response resources with the broader scientific content strategy, ensuring consistent evidence interpretation while tailoring materials to the purpose and audience of an inquiry.

• Maintain alignment with Field Medical on the scientific content needed for effective external exchange.

Scientific and Medical Education

• Own medical education strategy, learning objectives, curricula and scientific content informed by identified stakeholder needs.

• Lead the scientific design of company-led educational programs, including selection of topics, formats and faculty expertise.

• Define scientific priorities and needs assessments for independent medical education support, working through the accountable grants function and applicable independent review processes.

• Lead internal scientific curricula and training content in partnership with therapeutic area experts.

• Ensure education addresses disease biology, evidence interpretation, treatment considerations and emerging scientific developments.

• Establish scientific and learning criteria for evaluating educational quality and effectiveness.

Congress Scientific Content

• Lead scientific communication objectives and content priorities for medical congresses.

• Oversee congress-related publications, scientific presentations, educational content and internal scientific briefings.

• Coordinate content readiness with publication timelines, data availability and review requirements.

• Develop scientific preparation materials, including evidence interpretation and anticipated scientific questions.

• Partner with Congress Planning and Execution on delivery requirements, milestones and dependencies.

• Use congress insights supplied by the insights function to refine subsequent scientific content and education.

Scientific Support for Medical Launches

• Define and deliver the scientific narrative, content and education required for medical launches.

• Establish content readiness milestones within the integrated medical launch plan.

• Ensure materials accurately communicate the available evidence and address anticipated scientific information needs.

• Ensure Medical Information launch readiness, including response resources, trained service teams, inquiry escalation pathways and capacity to address anticipated demand.

• Partner with Field Medical, Regional and Country teams on scientific preparation.

• Work with Medical Launch Excellence to identify content dependencies and resolve readiness gaps.

• Update scientific content and education as evidence and stakeholder needs evolve after launch.

Global–Regional–Country Scientific Coordination

• Engage Regional and Country Medical Affairs early in scientific content and education planning.

• Establish core global scientific content and clear parameters for local adaptation.

• Resolve scientific interpretation questions with relevant subject matter experts and accountable medical leaders.

• Incorporate regional and country needs into publication, content and education priorities.

• Partner with the Executive Director, Global Medical Affairs Alignment and Integration on cross-geographic dependencies and issues requiring broader alignment.

Coordination with Engagement, Analytics & Impact

• Use stakeholder needs assessments and synthesized insights from the analytics and engagement functions to inform scientific priorities.

• Define scientific content and learning requirements for digital delivery; partner with the complementary VP on platforms, channels and implementation.

• Provide scientific requirements, expert review and acceptance criteria for AI applications affecting content or education.

• Define the scientific questions and learning outcomes to be assessed; partner with Global Medical Analytics and Insights on measurement design, data collection and analysis.

• Apply findings from engagement and education assessments to improve content quality and relevance.

• Establish joint planning with the complementary VP for initiatives requiring both scientific deliverables and enabling capabilities.

People, Resources and Scientific Governance

• Retain, build and develop a team with expertise in scientific communications, publications, medical education, medical content and training.

• Lead and develop Global Medical Information personnel and oversee service-provider budgets, scientific quality and operational performance.

• Manage functional budgets, capacity and scientific agency partnerships.

• Establish clear accountability for scientific quality and timely delivery.

• Ensure activities follow applicable requirements, company policies and standards for scientific integrity and nonpromotional communication.

• Partner with Global Medical Affairs Effectiveness & Operations on integrated planning, resource processes and operational dependencies.

• Foster a culture of rigorous evidence interpretation, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Required Skills, Experience and Education

• Advanced scientific or clinical degree required; MD, PharmD or PhD preferred.

• >20 years of substantial progressive experience in biotechnology or pharmaceutical Medical Affairs, including senior leadership of scientific communications, publicationsor medical education.

• Experience leading or overseeing Medical Information services, including scientific response development, global service delivery, vendor management and quality governance.

• Demonstrated success developing scientific narratives and integrated communication strategies across multiple assets or indications.

• Strong expertise in clinical evidence interpretation, publication practices and scientific content governance.

• Experience supporting development-stage and marketed products, major data releases and launches.

• Experience collaborating across Global, Regional and Country Medical Affairs.

• Proven ability to build teams, lead through a matrix and manage scientific agency partnerships.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with analytics, engagement and technology leaders.

• Oncology experience required.

Leadership Capabilities

• Scientific credibility and sound judgment.

• Ability to communicate complex evidence clearly while preserving nuance.

• Strategic prioritization and disciplined delivery.

• Strong collaboration and influence across functional boundaries.

• Commitment to scientific integrity and patient-centered communication.

• Ability to develop talent and scale scientific capabilities.

Measures of Success

• Coherent scientific narratives grounded in the totality of evidence.

• Timely, high-quality publications aligned with evidence and medical priorities.

• Accurate, relevant scientific content that can be efficiently adapted across geographies.

• Timely, accurate and relevant medical inquiry responses with consistent service quality across markets.

• Medical Information readiness for launches, new indications and major scientific milestones.

• Inquiry trends that inform content priorities, education and medical decision-making.

• Effective escalation and routing of safety information and product complaints.

• Education that addresses demonstrated needs and achieves defined learning objectives.

• Scientific content and education delivered against agreed congress and launch milestones.

• Clear, effective coordination with engagement, analytics, digital and operational functions.

• Evidence that stakeholder insights and evaluation findings improve scientific communication and education.

jobs.title: Sr.  Technical Talent Partner (Advanced Technology)
jobs.description:
About Us

At Arbor Energy & Resources Corporation ("Arbor Energy"), we’re creating technology to power our lives while protecting the planet that sustains them.  Our advanced power systems deliver clean, reliable baseload electricity with zero operating emissions—modular, fuel-flexible, and engineered for the realities of today’s energy demand. At the core is a supercritical CO₂ turbine with integrated carbon capture, designed to bring carbon-neutral power online quickly at meaningful scale.

Requirements

• Track record of helping an organization scale through periods of meaningful growth and organizational change.

jobs.title: Head of Startups, Developer GTM
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:  SF Bay Area

About Cloudflare

At Cloudflare, our mission is bold yet simple: to help build a better Internet. Our global network handles trillions of requests each month, protecting and accelerating applications without added hardware, software, or code changes. Our Developer Platform, including Workers, Workers AI, R2, KV, Durable Objects, and Pages, empowers developers to build and deploy applications globally, faster than ever before.

About the Team

The Developer GTM organization is driving how we attract, inspire, and grow the next generation of builders. We are redefining what developer acquisition looks like in a world where AI and distributed agents are reshaping the stack. Our mission is to lead the transformation of Cloudflare GTM into a Cloud Platform that has roots and capabilities in application services and cybersecurity. We create new pathways for developers to discover Cloudflare, whether through ecosystem partnerships, high-impact content, or creative field engagement and enablement.

We are builders, storytellers, and connectors united by one goal: to make Cloudflare the best place for developers to build.

The Developer GTM organization partners tightly with Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, RevOps, and Marketing. Developer GTM connects developer activation to durable commercial outcomes: shaping usage into clear proposals, aligning pricing and packaging, enabling the field with repeatable motions, and feeding real-world signals back into Product.

About the Role

Startups are where the next great companies, and the next great Cloudflare accounts, are born. The builders choosing their infrastructure stack today at seed and Series A will be running production workloads at massive scale in three to five years. We need a leader who has lived that journey firsthand.

We are hiring a Head of Startups to own Cloudflare's Developer Platform GTM strategy for the startup segment. Unlike traditional programs-operations roles, which are managed by our dedicated Startup Programs team, this role acts as the strategic GTM leader who sets the vision for how Cloudflare wins with startups, builds deep relationships across the VC and accelerator ecosystem, and drives the commercial trajectory from first developer sign-up through expansion and committed spend.

You will combine your ecosystem fluency with rigorous GTM execution to build repeatable motions, enable the field, and translate startup signals into actionable recommendations for Product and Pricing.

We are looking for someone who has been in the founder's seat. A former CRO or co-founder who has raised venture capital, navigated board dynamics, and understands what startup CTOs and CEOs actually care about when choosing infrastructure. You bring instant credibility with founders and VCs because you have been one. You combine that ecosystem fluency with the GTM rigor to build repeatable motions, enable the field, and translate startup signals into actionable recommendations for Product and Pricing.

What You Will Do

• Define and own the startups GTM strategy. Build the operating model for how Cloudflare acquires, activates, and grows startup accounts, from early-stage free-tier adoption through expansion into committed spend. Set goals, scorecards, and cadences for the segment.

• Build and leverage ecosystem relationships. Develop deep, trust-based relationships with venture capital firms, accelerators, and incubators. Make Cloudflare the default infrastructure recommendation when VCs advise portfolio companies on their stack.

• Lead executive engagement with founders and CTOs. Be the face of Cloudflare's Developer Platform to the startup community. Engage directly with startup founders, CTOs, and heads of engineering to understand their workloads and guide them onto Cloudflare.

• Drive activation, expansion, and commercial structure. Use usage telemetry to identify high-potential startups, find next-best actions and expansion paths, and work with the account team, Deal Desk, and Pricing to structure startup-appropriate commercial agreements as companies grow.

• Lead Cross-Functional Startup Initiatives. Partner closely with Startup Programs, Marketing, and BDR teams to ensure credits, onboarding, campaigns, and event presence are fully aligned with the broader GTM strategy and conversion funnel.

• Enable the field on startup motions. Ship playbooks, talk tracks, deal patterns, and objection handling tailored to startup accounts. Run enablement sessions with Sales leadership and measure adoption and lift.

• Close the loop with Product. Translate what you see in the startup ecosystem into clear, quantified recommendations on positioning, packaging, pricing, limits, and roadmap. Startups are often the earliest signal of where the market is heading. Make sure Product hears it.

• Partner with Marketing and BDR Teams. Drive startup-targeted campaigns, events, and community engagement in coordination with Marketing and BDR. Build Cloudflare's presence at the startup events and communities that matter.

Who You Are

• Direct experience as a Venture-Backed Founder, Co-Founder, CEO, or C-Level GTM Executive (e.g. CRO). You have personally built, scaled, and raised venture capital for a startup. This firsthand experience is a strict requirement for the role.

• Deep fluency in the VC ecosystem: You understand the firms, broad dynamics, and exactly what drives infrastructure decisions in venture-backed companies.

• 10+ years in technology sales or GTM, with significant time in startup and developer-platform ecosystems.

• A track record of converting developer adoption into commercial outcomes. You understand the full journey from free sign-up to enterprise commit.

• Executive presence and credibility with founder and CTO audiences. You speak their language because you have been one.

• Fluent in usage-based and consumption pricing models, as well as startup-stage commercial mechanics: credits, usage ramps, free-tier conversion, and early commit structures.

• Data-driven and analytical. Comfortable with product usage telemetry and Sheets/SQL-level analysis to size opportunities, identify high-potential accounts, and measure impact.

• A builder's mindset: you lead through influence, get cross-functional work done without relying on hierarchy, and thrive in fast-moving environments with ambiguity.

Bonus Points

• Experience with AI-native startups or AI infrastructure workloads such as inference, agents, sandboxed code execution, and globally distributed applications.

• Prior experience building or leading startup ecosystem programs at a developer-platform or cloud company.

• Hands-on familiarity with Cloudflare's Developer Platform.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

• For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $286,000 - 393,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.
