jobs.title: IT Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Founded in 2017, Trust & Will is the leading digital estate planning platform, trusted by over one million users. We provide modern, accessible solutions to help families protect their legacies with attorney-approved, legally valid documents tailored to individual state requirements. Our seamless online platform simplifies the estate planning and settlement process, empowering individuals to create wills and trusts while also partnering with financial advisors, attorneys, and institutions to make legacy planning more inclusive and affordable.

About You

We’re looking for a hands-on IT support professional, early in their career, who likes solving problems, helping people, and using AI and automation to make IT run better every week.

• You take ownership. When you see a problem, you fix it and think about how to keep it from coming back.

• You use AI tools every day and look for ways to let agents handle the repetitive parts of the job.

• You’re organized and follow every request through until it’s done.

• You do well in a fast-paced, remote-first company where you’ll work hands-on with a wide range of tools.

• You’re a patient troubleshooter who can explain technical issues in plain language.

• You communicate clearly in writing and work well with people across the company.

• You care about helping people help themselves through self-service, good documentation, and automation.

About the Role

As an IT Support Specialist, you’ll keep our people productive by resolving day-to-day IT issues and running the core processes that keep devices, accounts, and access in good shape. We’ve already invested in tools like Risotto (our AI-powered ITSM platform) and automated many of our workflows, so you’ll be building on a strong foundation rather than starting from scratch. Every role at Trust & Will is highly leveraged on AI agents and agentic systems, and IT is no exception. You’ll use AI tools and agents to triage and resolve tickets, run onboarding and offboarding, and take repetitive admin work off your plate, so your time goes to the problems that need a person. This is an hourly, full-time position with room to grow into systems administration, engineering, and other roles.

Responsibilities

IT Support & Ticket Management

• Serve as a primary point of contact for IT issues, providing tier-1 and tier-2 support.

• Manage and prioritize IT requests in Risotto, our AI-powered ITSM platform, so issues get resolved quickly.

• Help improve Risotto’s AI by flagging gaps, updating answers, and suggesting workflow changes that let it resolve more tickets on its own.

• Respond with a high sense of urgency and friendly customer service.

Endpoint Deployment & Management

• Set up, enroll, and support Mac and Windows laptops using Iru (primary) and Intune.

• Apply and maintain standard device configurations, OS updates, and security settings.

• Support our zero-touch deployment process so new laptops arrive ready to use.

• Monitor device health and compliance, and follow up on issues before they affect people.

Onboarding & Offboarding

• Run our automated onboarding and offboarding workflows so new hires have the right access and devices on day one, and departing employees lose access on time.

• Work with People Operations on start dates, departures, and role changes.

• Update the process when needed to accommodate changes.

Identity & Access Management

• Handle Okta administration, including users, groups, app assignments, MFA resets, and SSO troubleshooting.

• Grant and remove access with a least-privilege mindset, and help with access reviews.

• Use automation and AI agents to handle routine access requests where possible.

SaaS Administration

• Handle routine admin for core SaaS tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, 1Password, Notion, and more.

• Track licenses, seats, and renewals, and flag tools that are unused or overlap.

• Spot unapproved tools (shadow IT) and help teams get them reviewed.

Asset Lifecycle Management

• Handle the hardware lifecycle for a remote workforce, including ordering, setup, shipping, tracking, retrieval, and secure disposal.

• Keep the asset inventory accurate, including device assignments, warranty status, and refresh dates.

Network & Office Infrastructure

• Support our Meraki office network (Wi-Fi, switch, and firewall) and escalate larger changes.

• Support conference room AV systems and video conferencing.

• Troubleshoot VPN and connectivity issues for remote employees.

Security & Compliance

• Follow and apply security policies across Google Workspace, Okta, and other tools.

• Support SOC 2 compliance by collecting evidence, keeping IT records current, and helping with audits.

• Spot and escalate unusual access patterns, suspicious activity, and other potential security risks.

Automation & Tooling

• Use AI tools and agents to automate repetitive IT work, from ticket triage to account setup.

• Suggest improvements to IT workflows and tools when you see a better way.

• Build simple scripts and applications as your skills grow.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

• Write and maintain clear, up-to-date articles in our internal IT knowledge base.

• Keep Risotto’s knowledge base current so AI-assisted support stays accurate and helpful.

• Build self-service guides that help employees solve common issues on their own.

Qualifications

• 2–4 years of experience in IT support, help desk, desktop support, or a similar role.

• This is an hourly, full-time role (40 hours per week). Your typical schedule will be Monday through Friday, 7 am to 4 pm PT, including meal and rest breaks. Since you’ll support a team across multiple time zones, your hours may shift from day to day, and flexibility may be needed for urgent issues or busy periods.

• AI by default, not as an afterthought. No ML background required, just a relentless curiosity and a habit of reaching for AI and agents first

• Clear, polite written and verbal communication that makes every support interaction feel effortless and genuinely enjoyable.

• Hands-on experience supporting macOS and Windows users.

• Experience with at least one device management (MDM) tool such as Iru, Jamf, or Intune.

• Experience administering Google Workspace and an identity provider such as Okta, including user setup, groups, MFA, and app access.

• Experience with a ticketing system such as Risotto, Jira Service Management, Freshservice, or Zendesk.

• Working knowledge of networking basics, including Wi-Fi, DNS, DHCP, and VPN.

• Basic understanding of security practices such as MFA, least-privilege access, and device encryption.

• Strong troubleshooting skills and attention to detail, especially with access, devices, and onboarding and offboarding.

• This is a remote-first position available to candidates residing in California (CA). San Diego-area candidates are preferred, as you may occasionally be asked to support IT needs in person at our San Diego office.

Bonus Points

• Experience using AI tools or agents to automate support, ticket triage, or admin work.

• Basic scripting in Bash, Python, or PowerShell, or experience with no-code tools like Okta Workflows.

• Familiarity with SOC 2 or other compliance audits.

• Experience with Meraki or similar networking equipment.

• Experience shipping and tracking hardware for a remote workforce.

• Familiarity with AV and conference room technology.

• Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Security+, Jamf 100, Apple Certified Support Professional, or Google Workspace Administrator.

• Experience at a startup or fast-growing company.

Employee Benefits & Perks:

• Compensation: Salary + Equity Our salary range for this position is $48 - $56 per hour, in addition to compensation we also include an employee equity package as a component of our offer along with other benefits and perks outlined below.

• PTO Flexible time off that you are encouraged to use Generous paid company holidays and breaks throughout the year Monthly friends & family day

• Health and Wellness Benefits Exceptional health benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance - we cover 100% of premiums for employees and dependents on medical coverage Mental health support through Spring Health, plus access to One Medical for primary care and Cleo for family planning and caregiving Financial wellness benefits (unlimited 1:1 sessions with a UBS financial coach and employer-sponsored 401k with up to 4% company match)

• Extra Flexible work schedule + hours Family-friendly work environment. We support the complexity of a remote world with the needs of families Up to $1,000 annually in learning & development reimbursement Optional company-sponsored events and travel throughout the year $500 Work from home stipend + Apple accessories

About Trust & Will:

• We are a remote-first company, giving our employees the flexibility they need to work in an environment that best suits their needs. Our hiring process is also conducted virtually unless otherwise noted. We are a company that was founded in San Diego, CA, and offer a collaborative co-working space that is available for you to use if you'd like but not required. #LI-Remote

• We are proud to be a certified B Corporation, using business as a force for good. We are committed to building a healthy, sustainable, and engaging working environment for all employees, their families, and communities. We publish an annual impact report to outline our positive contributions to our world and set an example for all employers.

• Trust & Will's mission is to help every family leave their legacy through affordable, accessible estate planning. That starts with the people we hire and the ways in which we support the development of their unique talents and capabilities. We are committed to prioritizing ways to make our company and industry more inclusive. This means we must be revolutionary in the way we value diversity to revolutionize our business sector. At Trust & Will, everyone has a seat at the table and space to be their authentic selves because only in a company that is inclusive and diverse can we truly stand in our members' shoes.

California residents have the right to know what information we collect, request a copy, correct inaccuracies, or request deletion (subject to exceptions). To exercise these rights, contact legal@trustandwill.com. For more information, visit our privacy policy.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Field Education & Retail Activation
jobs.description:
ABOUT MURAD

Founded by board-certified dermatologist and pharmacist Dr. Howard Murad, Murad is a dermatologist-developed skincare brand built on the belief that skincare is healthcare. We combine science, innovation and a holistic approach to wellness to help people look, feel and live better.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Field Education & Retail Activation to build Murad's approach for uncovered and extension-market doors across the United States. Reporting to the Senior Director, this role will identify priority opportunities, carry a defined revenue goal, and activate high-potential doors through direct field selling, education, events and freelance deployment.

This is an entrepreneurial, field-based role for a commercially minded leader who can turn market opportunity into measurable growth while building scalable tools and programs for the broader Sales & Education Executive (SEE) organization.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Drive Extension-Market Strategy & Revenue
- Develop and continuously refine the strategy for uncovered doors, prioritizing markets and investments based on revenue potential, door productivity, retailer priorities and return on investment.
- Carry a defined revenue goal and spend approximately 50% of working time in priority doors driving active selling, education, events, coaching and retailer partnership.
- Build door-level activation plans and monitor sales versus goal, sales per hour, post-activation lift and productivity; adjust travel, events and coverage based on results.
- Role model consultative selling, skincare expertise, regimen building and exceptional guest experiences alongside store teams and freelance talent.

Build & Lead the Freelance Program
- Own the freelance lifecycle across expansion markets, including needs assessment, recruiting, selection, onboarding, ongoing education, incentives, coaching, offboarding support and roster maintenance.
- Establish consistent standards for selling, product knowledge, brand storytelling, consumer experience, event execution and professional conduct.
- Own deployment, utilization and productivity; shift resources based on business opportunity and performance.
- Partner with People & Culture, Sales Operations and Finance to support compliant onboarding, accurate records, effective scheduling and disciplined administration.

Develop Education, Sell-Through Tools & Events
- Build scalable selling guides, launch materials, event playbooks, coaching resources and microlearning content for the broader SEE organization.
- Translate field insights, consumer objections, retailer feedback and sales trends into practical tools that improve execution.
- Partner with Global Education, Sales, Retail Marketing, Creative and Product Marketing to ensure tools are accurate, on-brand and commercially relevant.
- Develop and manage an event strategy for priority doors; evaluate event, travel and freelance investments based on business results.

HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED
- Revenue versus goal, year-over-year growth, sales per door and productivity following activation.
- Freelance sales per hour, utilization, retention, roster health and productivity improvement following coaching.
- Event sales versus goal and return on event, travel and freelance investment.
- Adoption and effectiveness of education and sell-through tools across the SEE organization.
- Budget management, reporting accuracy and operational execution.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING
- 8+ years of progressive experience in prestige beauty, skincare, field sales, retail education, events or multi-door retail leadership.
- Proven success carrying revenue goals and driving measurable growth through field selling, education, events or market activation.
- Experience building or leading freelance, field-based or multi-market talent programs.
- Strong analytical judgment and ability to translate door performance, sales trends and investment effectiveness into action.
- Exceptional coaching, communication, presentation and influencing skills.
- Strong program management and operational discipline across markets, calendars, budgets and competing priorities.
- Ability to travel frequently, work occasional evenings and weekends, and maintain a valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

NICE TO HAVE
- Deep skincare knowledge and consultative-selling expertise.
- Experience scaling an extension-market, remote-door or freelance coverage model.
- Experience creating field education, selling tools or event playbooks for national deployment.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

HOW WE WORK

At Murad, how we work matters just as much as what we deliver. Our values guide how we show up for our consumers, our customers and one another:
- Push for Extraordinary

jobs.title: In-House Counsel (Securities & Generalist)
jobs.description:
About Pacaso

Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We've reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle.

Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than $1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees across 40+ destinations in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. We've raised over $300 million in cumulative equity funding, closed the largest real estate Regulation A+ offering of 2025, and reserved the Nasdaq ticker PCSO as we build toward a public listing.

Our work has been featured in The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, Fortune, Forbes, CNBC, Bloomberg, and others.

Recognition

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for both our culture and our category-defining work:

• No. 5, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers (2026) — our second consecutive Top 10 ranking

• Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2025)

• Winner, 2025 Inman Best of Proptech Awards — Consumer Experience & Marketplace Innovation

• Fortune & Great Place To Work Best Workplaces in Real Estate (2024)

• Best Workplace in the Bay Area™ (2023)

• LinkedIn Top Startup (2022) · Glassdoor Best Places to Work, #6 (2022)

In-House Counsel, Securities & Generalist

About the role

Pacaso is hiring an In-House Counsel to lead our SEC reporting and securities compliance, and to be a trusted generalist partner across the business. You will own the legal side of our periodic filings and disclosure process. You will also support the business on a wide range of other legal matters as they come up.

Roughly half your time will go to securities and governance. The other half will be whatever the business needs, from commercial agreements and real estate to employment, marketing and privacy.

This role suits a lawyer with 3 to 5+ years of law firm or in-house experience in securities or capital markets work who now wants breadth, direct business impact and a seat close to decision-makers. You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Investor Relations, Operations and executive leadership.

What you'll do

SEC reporting and securities

• Own the preparation and review of the company's SEC filings, including annual, quarterly and current reports, proxy statements and offering materials.

• Lead the disclosure process with Finance and Accounting.

• Advise on securities law compliance, including offerings, equity issuances and insider trading.

• Stay current on SEC rules and guidance, and update policies and processes as needed.

Public company governance and compliance

• Serve as a primary legal advisor on the company's obligations as an SEC reporting company.

• Support the board and its committees, including meeting materials, minutes and written consents.

• Maintain governance documents and company policies.

• Partner with Finance on disclosure controls and related processes.

• Maintain entity records and good standing across subsidiaries.

Business and general legal support

You will be a true generalist and a day-to-day legal partner to teams across the company, from the front line to the executive team. We need someone who is excited by variety, comfortable learning new areas quickly, and ready to build legal processes as the company grows.

• Draft, negotiate and manage agreements, including vendor, partnership, technology and services contracts.

• Support real estate and property-related matters, including entity structuring, transactions and state-by-state regulatory questions.

• Partner with People on employment matters such as policies, offer and separation agreements, leave and accommodation questions, and wage-and-hour compliance.

• Advise Marketing and Sales on advertising, promotions, disclosures and licensing requirements.

• Support privacy and data protection, including policies, vendor data processing agreements and responses to individual requests.

• Help manage intellectual property, including trademarks, brand protection and software licensing.

• Coordinate with outside counsel on litigation, disputes and regulatory inquiries, and manage their budgets and scope.

• Build scalable legal processes, such as contract templates, intake and approval workflows and playbooks, so the business can move faster with fewer one-off requests.

What you bring

Required

• J.D. from an accredited law school and active bar membership in good standing.

• 3 to 5+ years of experience at a well-regarded law firm or in-house legal team, with substantial securities or capital markets work.

• Hands-on experience drafting or reviewing SEC periodic reports and disclosure documents.

• Working knowledge of federal securities laws and SEC reporting requirements.

• Experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts, at a law firm or in-house.

• Ability to learn unfamiliar areas of law quickly, and to recognize when to escalate or engage outside counsel.

• Sound judgment, clear writing, and the ability to explain legal risk in plain terms to non-lawyers.

• Comfort managing many matters at once with limited supervision.

Preferred

• In-house or secondment experience at a startup or high-growth company.

• Exposure to real estate, employment, privacy or intellectual property matters.

• Experience building templates, playbooks or legal operations processes.

• Comfort working with non-legal teams as a day-to-day business partner.

Compensation

• Around $190,000- we will consider experience and location as variables

• RSU grant

Why You'll Love Working Here

We invest in our Crew the way we invest in our homes — thoughtfully, generously, and with care.

• Competitive base salary and meaningful equity — every Crew member shares in what we're building

• Discretionary time off — take the rest you need, when you need it

• Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family

• Sponsored memberships to One Medical, Peloton, and WellHub for whole-person, modern healthcare

• 401(k) to help you build long-term security

• Paid parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers

• Home office stipend and a monthly internet and cell phone reimbursement to set you up for great remote work

• Quarterly team gatherings and ongoing learning and development investment

Our Commitment

Pacaso is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, ability, and background — including veterans and individuals with disabilities. We believe a Crew as diverse as the owners we serve makes Pacaso stronger, and we're committed to building a workplace where every voice belongs.

• RHIT, RHIA or CCS credentialed

jobs.title: Staff Mission Manager
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

Apex is seeking a Staff Mission Manager to lead complex customer missions through the satellite bus development and delivery lifecycle. In this role, you will serve as a senior customer interface and drive execution across engineering, manufacturing, Supply Chain, Mission Services, and other teams.

This role requires a high degree of autonomy, strong technical judgment, and the ability to navigate complex customer and cross-functional challenges. You will identify risks, drive resolution of critical issues, and align stakeholders around decisions and execution.

As a Staff Mission Manager, you will help shape how Apex manages missions at scale by establishing best practices, mentoring other Mission Managers, and driving improvements to mission execution processes over the lifecycle of commercial and government programs.



Responsibilities:

 - Serve as the senior point of contact for Apex customers, owning communication, alignment, and execution throughout the satellite bus development and delivery lifecycle.

 - Lead complex, high-priority, or strategically important missions, driving cross-functional execution across engineering, manufacturing, Supply Chain, Mission Services, and other teams.

 - Establish and manage integrated mission schedules, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables to ensure customer and business commitments are met.

 - Proactively identify and mitigate mission-level risks, technical challenges, and roadblocks, driving resolution of high-impact issues and escalating effectively when needed.

 - Translate complex technical and programmatic information into clear customer communication and decisions, serving as a trusted escalation point for customer concerns.

 - Drive alignment and decision-making across stakeholders, resolving competing priorities and maintaining execution in ambiguous or rapidly changing environments.

 - Lead improvements to mission management processes, tools, and operating mechanisms while identifying opportunities to improve mission execution across Apex.

 - Mentor and provide guidance to other Mission Managers, helping establish consistent execution standards and raising the overall capability of the Mission Services organization.



Requirements:

 - U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data.

 - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field. Advanced degrees are a plus.

 - 10+ years of experience in technical program, project, mission, or systems management, preferably in the space, aerospace, or defense industry.

 - Active Top Secret or Top Secret/SCI clearance desired, but not required

 - Demonstrated experience independently leading complex, technically sophisticated programs with significant customer, schedule, and execution requirements.

 - Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive execution across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and other functions without direct authority.

 - Strong understanding of satellite technology, spacecraft systems, and the space industry.

 - Demonstrated ability to identify and mitigate program risks, resolve high-impact issues, manage dependencies, and drive decisions in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.

 - Exceptional customer and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to both technical and executive audiences.

 - Demonstrated leadership through influence, including mentoring other program or mission managers and improving mission management processes, tools, and execution standards.

 - PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project management certification is required.

WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.




WHAT WE OFFER FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES:

 - Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

 - Cash bonus eligibility: share in Apex’s success with eligibility for a performance-based cash bonus on top of your salary, rewarding the impact you make

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package:  Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

 - Competitive 401(k) plan: Generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave: Plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel

 - Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks: To keep you fueled throughout the day

Compensation ranges are set by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. A candidate's specific level and base pay are determined case by case and may vary with job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities, and internal equity. Beyond base salary, full-time hires are also eligible for long-term incentives in the form of stock options, along with medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

Apex's work is governed by U.S. export control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). To be eligible for this role, applicants must either (1) qualify as a U.S. Person, meaning a U.S. citizen or national, a lawful permanent resident (green card holder), a refugee admitted under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or an individual granted asylum under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or (2) be able to obtain the required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State, the U.S. Department of Commerce, or another applicable U.S. government agency. jobs.title: Account Manager, Lyft Ads
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft Ads’ vision is to build the largest transportation media network. We leverage media to elevate the transportation experience for our riders while building an exciting and sustainable advertising business. Our advertising opportunities include Lyft in-app homepage and in-ride products, off-platform audience extension retargeting, and IRL experiential executions. Our work is fun, challenging, and rewarding, and we’re looking for someone who’s excited to help grow our partnerships.

As an Account Manager, you’ll report to the West Coast Account Management Lead and serve as a strategic partner to Account Executives on multiple books of advertiser and agency accounts. You’ll own campaigns from pitch through wrap, act as the main day-to-day contact for clients post-sale, and work across Sales, Ad Ops, Product, Data, and other teams to deliver strong results. You’ll also help improve the processes and tools our sales team relies on. We’re looking for someone who loves solving interesting problems, works well with autonomy, and cares deeply about client success and growth.

Responsibilities:

• Pre-sales planning: Partner with Account Executives on RFP responses and media plans, including inventory forecasting, takeover/events calendar checks, and recommending the right mix of products to meet client goals.

• Data hygiene: Keep pitched and booked inventory and campaign data accurate across internal systems and CRMs, and flag gaps or risks early.

• Post-sales execution: Own all post-sale work for your book of business, including contract execution, creative services, and campaign reporting.

• Cross-functional liaison: Act as the point of contact between clients and Ad Operations, Legal, Product, Engineering, and other teams, resolving issues independently and escalating when needed.

• Ad campaign trafficking and optimization: Partner with Ad Operations to manage direct campaigns via internal planning tools and ad server, including ticketing, setup, scheduling, pacing, and full delivery against Insertion Order terms. Proactively recommend optimizations to improve performance.

• Measurement and reporting: Build campaign and wrap reports, turn results into clear insights and next-step recommendations, and lead measurement studies where applicable.

• Billing: Coordinate with Lyft Billing at the end of each billing cycle on campaign totals and make sure invoices are accurate and delivered on time.

• Client relationships: Own day-to-day client and agency relationships post-sale. Lead check-ins and wrap meetings, and partner with the AE to identify renewal and upsell opportunities.

Experience:

• BA/BS degree and 3-5 years of experience in digital advertising account management, media planning, or campaign management.

• Experience managing client and agency relationships directly and owning a book of business.

• Proficient in Google Suite products, particularly Google Sheets and Drive.

• Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.

• Outstanding attention to detail.

• Comfortable managing multiple campaigns across the full ad lifecycle at once, with minimal oversight.

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations for sales teams and clients.

• Self-motivated and proactive in finding new solutions before being asked.

Benefits:

• Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

• Mental health benefits

• Family building benefits

• Child care and pet benefits

• 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future

• In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off

• 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible

• Subsidized commuter benefits

• Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. IT Help Desk Analyst serves as the first point of contact for all IT-related support requests across the organization. In our network heavy environment with complex data volumes, a large physical facility footprint, and a sizable remote workforce, this role delivers fast, friendly and effective technical assistance to keep employees productive and minimize downtime.

• Receives, logs, prioritizes, and resolves help desk tickets via phone, email, chat, Teams, and in-person requests.

jobs.title: Lead Launch Engineer
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

Apex is seeking an experienced, organized, and driven Lead Launch Engineer to join our expanding team. As a company at the forefront of space exploration and satellite technology, Apex is looking for an individual capable of owning complex spacecraft missions and serving as the primary technical liaison between our internal teams and launch providers while also leading launch campaigns. 

The Lead Launch Engineer is responsible for setting up companywide launch integration processes to ensure our vehicles launch reliably, as well as mentoring, tasking, and directing the launch engineering team. This role balances long term strategic mission planning with short term technical execution, split roughly fifty percent management and fifty percent individual contributor work. We are looking for someone who solves complex launch integration challenges with a focus on practicality and scalability, works well across teams, and thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced aerospace environment.



Responsibilities:

 - Manage and coordinate the integration of satellite payloads with various launch vehicles, including propulsion loading and separation system integration.

 - Work closely with launch providers to define mission requirements, interfaces, and integration schedules.

 - Develop and maintain satellite launch plans, procedures, and readiness reviews.

 - Oversee satellite transportation, handling, and pre-launch processing at launch sites.

 - Ensure compatibility between the satellite and launch vehicle, including mechanical, electrical, and environmental interfaces.

 - Support environmental testing (vibration, thermal vacuum, EMI/EMC) to validate satellite launch readiness.

 - Conduct system-level checkouts and troubleshooting during pre-launch and countdown operations.

 - Interface with regulatory agencies to secure launch approvals and compliance with international spaceflight standards.

 - Provide real-time technical support during launch campaigns, including anomaly resolution.

 - Collaborate with internal teams, including mechanical, avionics, and systems engineers, to optimize satellite integration processes.



Requirements:

 - U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data.

 - Bachelor's degree or higher in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

 - At least 7 years of experience in spacecraft/launch vehicle integration, mission integration, or launch operations.

 - Experience working with launch vehicle providers.

 - Previous launch campaign ownership.

 - Hands-on experience with satellite testing, integration, and environmental qualification.

 - Proven track record of managing complex projects with multiple interdependent tasks.



Preferred:

 - Leadership experience in satellite manufacturing or a related industry (aerospace, defense, or high-tech).

 - Experience mentoring or directing an engineering team.

 - Familiarity with AFSPCMAN 91-710 submittal processes.

 - Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other office productivity tools.



#LI-RC1


WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.

 - Cash bonus eligibility: share in Apex’s success with eligibility for a performance-based cash bonus on top of your salary, rewarding the impact you make

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package:  Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

 - Competitive 401(k) plan: Generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

jobs.title: Senior Technical Sourcer, Hardware
jobs.description:
Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler  (MC) is aimed at micro-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex-Amazon SVP and Uber’s first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date.

Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara.

About The Role:

We're looking for a Senior Technical Sourcer, Hardware who is exceptional at the fundamentals: mapping markets quickly, building precise talent pipelines, and getting responses from passive candidates at a high rate. You'll own top-of-funnel sourcing across our most complex technical searches, from robotics software engineers to mechanical engineers and electrical engineers; partnering tightly with recruiters and hiring managers to define what 'great' looks like, then going out and finding it.

We operate in a highly technical, niche talent market where success depends on your ability to build search strategies from first principles, write outreach that earns real replies, and quickly synthesize signals from candidate profiles.

What You’ll Do:

• Track sourcing metrics (outreach volume, response rates, pipeline conversion) and report weekly on pipeline health.

• Use AI tools to accelerate research, draft outreach variations, and identify non-obvious candidate pools.

What You’ll Need:

jobs.title: Research Operations, External Artifacts
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Every time Anthropic releases a model, we publish a system card: a long-form technical document that describes the model's capabilities, safety properties, evaluation results, and the reasoning behind our deployment decisions. System cards are some of the most consequential and widely read documents we produce, and they are one way we hold ourselves publicly accountable for the safety claims we make.

We're hiring a Research Operations Specialist to help own system card production. You'll work embedded with research and safety teams through each launch, coordinating contributions from dozens of researchers, holding the schedule and the open-threads list, and making sure the document ships on time as a single, accurate, internally consistent whole. Along the way you'll do real editorial work: turning results and researcher notes into clear, honest prose and pushing back when an explanation doesn't hold together.

System cards sit within a wider family of external safety artifacts, including risk reports and Responsible Scaling Policy (RSP) updates. Part of this role is keeping the system card consistent with those documents so that Anthropic's public safety story reads as one coherent account rather than several.

This role sits in Research Operations and works closely with Alignment, Safeguards, Frontier Red Team, and capabilities research. The core of the job is part project management, part translation: keeping a complex, many-author, hard-deadline document on track while making frontier safety research legible to researchers, policymakers, journalists, and the public — without sacrificing precision.

Key responsibilities

• Drive system card production end to end — own the timeline, the contributor list, the open-threads tracker, and the definition of done for each launch

• Coordinate dozens of contributors across Alignment, Safeguards, Frontier Red Team, Interpretability, and capabilities research; chase drafts, resolve differences of perspective, seek ground truth, and run final formatting and polish

• Edit, and sometimes write, content; work directly with researchers to turn their results, notes, and plots into clear, scientific, non-marketing prose and maintain Anthropic's voice across sections drafted by many different people

• Guard accuracy and consistency; catch terminology drift, claims that subtly contradict each other, and discrepancies between internal communications and system card drafts

• Keep the system card aligned with related artifacts; track what's being said in risk reports, RSP disclosures, and other safety documentation so the system card stays consistent with them, and flag conflicts early

• Improve the process between launches; build and maintain templates, style guidance, contributor guides, checklists, and reusable section scaffolds so each cycle starts from a stronger baseline

• Pick up other research-adjacent operations and writing, such as internal research summaries, release notes, and documentation that helps research leadership communicate clearly

Minimum qualifications

• Strong project management and execution skills; able to track dozens of open threads to closure during compressed launch periods with many moving parts and many owners

• Demonstrated ability to coordinate and influence without direct authority, building trust while chasing drafts and giving constructive editorial feedback

• Excellent technical writing skills; able to take dense, jargon-heavy source material and produce prose that is precise, honest, and readable by a non-specialist

• Comfort working closely with researchers; able to read an evaluation results table, ask the right clarifying questions, and push back when an explanation doesn't hold together

• Working knowledge of large language models (LLMs) at a conceptual level, including fluency with vocabulary such as pretraining, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), context windows, evals, and red-teaming

• Data communication literacy; able to identify how a chart or table could be made clearer and more accurate

• High integrity and a genuine sense of accountability around producing documents that hold Anthropic publicly responsible for its safety claims

Preferred qualifications

• Familiarity with AI safety, AI policy, alignment research, evaluation methodology, or the RSP landscape beyond baseline LLM knowledge

• Background in science communication, research publishing, or technical journalism

• A track record of shipping long-form technical documents, such as research reports, whitepapers, technical standards, regulatory filings, or science journalism

• Experience with safety, risk, or compliance documentation, such as regulatory submissions, safety cases, security disclosures, or clinical or scientific reporting

• Skill in visual communication and experience shipping polished, on-brand documents

• Light scripting or tooling ability (enough to automate a formatting check or wrangle a spreadsheet)

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$210,000—$260,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Agent Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT NOOKS.AI http://Nooks.ai:

Nooks is an applied AI lab building revenue agents that power some of the fastest growing companies in the world. We build AI agents that operate across the full revenue lifecycle, from account strategy to prospect research and outreach. Building 0→1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals.

Today, over 2000 customers power their revenue growth using Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We've raised over 70M USD from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, and we have more than tripled ARR each year for 3 years running. 



The Role

Nooks builds AI agents that change how sales teams prospect, sell, and close. As an Agent Product Manager, you make those agents work inside our customers’ businesses. You’re on point for each customer engagement you’re staffed on. That runs from the first conversation with their sales leadership to an agent their reps rely on every day, and then on as it takes over more of their workflow.

Some mornings you’ll sit with a CRO and their RevOps team working out where AI can move their numbers. That afternoon, you’ll be configuring, testing, and refining the agent that does it. Here the same person owns the strategy and the build, and that person is you.

What this role isn’t: account management. You won’t carry a quota, handle renewals, or own the commercial relationship. Our AEs and CSMs do that. Your job is making sure the agents deliver: how they’re designed, how they’re built, whether reps actually use them, and what results they drive.

You’ll be one of the first people on a brand-new team, so there’s no playbook yet, and you’ll write it. You’ll make big calls without waiting for sign-off, and you’ll bring in our AI Deployment Strategists, Product, and Engineering teams to move faster.



What you’ll do

 - Run customer engagements start to finish. Take each one from discovery to a live agent to wide use across the team, and own the result.

 - Represent Nooks to senior leaders. Build credibility with VP- and C-level sales and revenue leaders, and help them plan where agents fit in their org. You’ll also lead executive reviews, escalations, and updates.

 - Diagnose, then build. Learn how the customer’s reps and managers actually work, where time and pipeline leak, and how their stack fits together (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft, MCP). Then design and ship agents that fix it, and keep improving them after launch.

 - Grow usage and impact. Track how agents perform once they’re live, get reps using them, and spot the next workflow worth automating.

 - Leave a playbook behind. Package what works into templates and frameworks that make the next deployment faster for everyone.

 - Feed the product. Bring what you learn in the field back to Product and Engineering as sharp, prioritized input that shapes what we build.
   
   

Who you are

 - 2+ years of client-facing work at a top strategy firm. Other great paths: investment banking or PE, founding a startup, or a product, strategy, or forward-deployed role at a fast-growing tech company after consulting.

 - You’d rather build it yourself. Writing the deck isn’t enough; you want to ship the thing.

 - Technically fluent. You’re comfortable with AI tools, can reason about how an agent should be designed, and earn credibility with engineers and execs alike.

 - Senior leaders listen to you. You’ve advised executives at large organizations and become the person they call first.

 - You move fast and want more. You pick things up quickly, compete hard, and reach for scope before it’s handed to you.

 - Unfazed by a blank page. Undefined problems energize you, and you’re happy working out the answer as you build it.
   
   

Bonus points

 - A degree in CS, engineering, or math, or real hands-on building experience

 - An MBA

 - You know how sales and revenue teams operate and the tools they live in

 - You’ve shipped and iterated on AI agents in production

jobs.title: Patient Access Specialist - Part Time - Rotating Days and Evenings
jobs.description:
Shift/Hours: 46 hours every 2 weeks

The Patient Access Specialist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NMHC, adheres to the organizations Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

• Consistently practices Patients First philosophy and adheres to high standards of customer service. This includes setting an example to peers, coworkers, etc. by fostering a team atmosphere.
• Responds to questions and concerns.
• Forwards, directs, and notifies Team Lead or Operations Coordinator of extraordinary issues as necessary.
• Maintains patient confidentiality per HIPAA regulations.
• Provides exceptional customer service to patients which establish a positive first impression of Northwestern Medicine.
• Exceeds all consumer requests and alerts management of issues or concerns that require escalation.
• Correctly identifies and collects patient demographic information in accordance with organization standards.
• Interacts with various hospital departments and physicians offices to effectively schedule and direct patients through the NMHC systems in a patient/customer friendly manner.
• Reaches out to patients to schedule an appointment as defined.
• Performs medical necessity checks as necessary for scheduled services, communicates options to patient if appointment fails.
• Informs patients of any issues with securing the financial account for their encounter.
• Completes out-of-pocket estimations as requested by patients.
• Provides training and education as needed.
• Manages work schedule efficiently, completing tasks and assignments on time.
• Completes other duties assigned by manager.
• Cross-training between various departments will take place to ensure coverage.
• Participates in Quality Assurance reviews to ensure integrity of patient data information.
• Uses effective service recovery skills to solve problems or service breakdowns when they occur.
• Utilizes department and hospital policies and procedures to complete assigned tasks.
• Adheres to all department policies and compliance requirements.
• Avoids putting patient in financial or safety risk.
• Other duties as assigned.

Communication and Collaboration:

• Communicates information to the patient regarding questions about physician referrals, insurance referrals and consultations.
• Collects authorization numbers in appropriate systems as applicable.
• Provides professional and constructive environment for communication across units/departments and resolves operational issues.
• May attend intra/interdepartmental meetings which involve walking within NM Campus.
• Communicates customer satisfaction issues to appropriate individuals.
• Demonstrates teamwork by helping co-workers within and across departments.
• Communicates effectively with others, respects diverse opinions and styles, and acknowledges the assistance and contributions of others.
• Interacts with internal customers to provide excellent support service to staff in departments which provide direct patient care.
• Accommodates all levels of communication ability.

Technology:

• Utilizes multiple online order retrieval systems to verify or print the patients order.
• Verifies insurance eligibility and benefit levels through the use of online tools (NDAS, ASF, etc.) or over the phone as necessary.
• Completes accurate handoff instructions and notes to scheduling staff, by noting appropriately in Epic.
• Demonstrates ability to use all computer applications efficiently and to the capacity needed in this position.
• Runs real time eligibility (RTE) on all patients to verify insurance and follows out of network policies as applicable.
• Sends quality Epic Messages/Telephone encounters that are descriptive and grammatically correct.

Efficiency, Process Improvement, and Business Growth:

• Proactive in preventing issues with patient visit by double checking type of test, preps required, assuring no conflict with other tests, verifying time and location, communicating relevant information, verifying documenting order retrieval in notes for check-in person, ensures there are no duplicate patient records.
• Understands minimum data set required for a complete registration, collects and verifies critical data and updates that information into registration system.
• Understands departmental and individual quality metrics.
• Proactively analyzes account activity, identifies problems, and initiates appropriate actions/resolutions.
• Evaluates procedures and suggests improvements to enhance customer service and operational efficiency.
• Participates in departmental quality improvement activities.
• Provides ideas and suggestions for process improvements within the department.
• Monitors registration and scheduling, including insurance verification to ensure processing within prescribed quality standards.
• Adjusts processes as needed to meet standards.
• Uses organizational and unit/department resources efficiently.
• Acts as a training resource for new staff and a resource for coworkers, sharing process and workflow information.
• Understands that schedule may change to reflect shifting business needs.
• Evolves and learns as healthcare policies change.

EOE including Disabled and Veterans.

Required:

• High School diploma or equivalent.
• 2-3 years customer service or medical office experience.
• Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
• Proficiency in computer data-entry/typing.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in English.
• Basic Computer Skills.
• Ability to type 40 wpm.
• Ability to multi-task.
• Customer service oriented.
• Excellent organizational, time management, analytical, and problem solving skills.

Preferred:

• Additional education.
• Additional language skills.
• Healthcare finance and/or healthcare insurance experience.
• Knowledge and experience in a healthcare setting, especially patient scheduling and/or registration.

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

jobs.title: Expansion Account Executive, Commercial
jobs.description:
ABOUT NOOKS.AI http://Nooks.ai:

Nooks is an applied AI lab building revenue agents that power some of the fastest growing companies in the world. We build AI agents that operate across the full revenue lifecycle, from account strategy to prospect research and outreach. Building 0→1 has never been easier, but selling at the speed of the market remains the last frontier for AI. Our mission is to 10x every seller by automating the busywork so they can focus on what humans do best: closing deals.

Today, over 2000 customers power their revenue growth using Nooks, including Notion, HubSpot, Cursor, and Rippling. We've raised over 70M USD from top VCs like Kleiner Perkins, and we have more than tripled ARR each year for 3 years running. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

Nooks is looking for an Expansion Account Executive to grow our SMB customer base. You’ll help revenue leaders rethink how their teams work, bringing AI agents, intelligence, and sales execution together on one platform.



You’ll own expansion revenue across a book of SMB customers, create demand, and uncover new use cases. You’ll partner closely with Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, and Product to help expand Nooks’ impact across customer revenue organizations.



This role is ideal for a consultative seller who understands how revenue teams operate, creates opportunities through proactive outreach and discovery, and connects workflows to measurable business outcomes.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own expansion revenue across a portfolio of SMB customers, growing Nooks’ footprint across products and teams.

 - Own the full sales cycle, using focused discovery to uncover customer priorities and tailored demos to show how new Nooks use cases support their goals. Lead evaluations and competitive displacements through negotiation and close.

 - Prioritize a large book of accounts using product usage, buying signals, and expansion potential to run targeted outreach to reach GTM leaders beyond your existing users and champions

 - Partner with Customer Success on account health, introductions, and timing so expansion conversations build on the customer’s experience with Nooks.

 - Coordinate internal teams and customer stakeholders to maintain momentum and navigate buying processes.

 - Share customer insights that strengthen our sales motion and inform product development.
   
   


WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 3-4+ years of quota-carrying technology sales experience and a track record of exceeding targets.

 - You’ve built pipeline through proactive outreach, developing champions, and earning access to new teams and senior stakeholders. You can point to opportunities you took from first conversation to close.

 - You’re comfortable managing a large book of accounts and multiple active deals. You know which opportunities to prioritize and consistently follow through on commitments.

 - You ask focused discovery questions, give concise demos, and help buyers see what a change would mean for their team.

 - You work closely with Customer Success and Product Management and share responsibility for customer health and product adoption.

 - You thrive in high-growth environments and are collaborative, resourceful, adaptable, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience selling to Sales and RevOps leaders

 - Experience with competitive displacements and platform consolidation.

 - Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Sandler, Challenger, or a similar sales methodology.

 - Deep AI fluency, particularly in how revenue teams use AI agents in their day-to-day work.




EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

Nooks is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe in providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.  

Nooks does not discriminate in hiring, promotion, compensation, or any other employment practices, and we are committed to ensuring a workplace that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and join our team.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Design Assurance
jobs.location: Alameda, CA; Albuquerque, NM; or Remote in the U.S.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Design Assurance, leads the team responsible for systems engineering and design control processes within the Engineering Design organization. This role establishes, maintains, and continuously improves practical engineering processes that support efficient design execution and configuration management of engineering information.  This role and their team will require strong knowledge of how engineering design work is actually accomplished, to then use that experience to build out practical processes, programs, and be able to partner strongly with system owners in the Power Plant Engineering department to produce controlled design packages, and deal with design issues that come from the end user.

Responsibilities

• Lead the team responsible for: Establishing and maintaining Design Quality Program processes associated with quality assurance (QA) requirements per ANSI 15.8 Overseeing Systems Engineering Processes through the Systems Engineering Manager and team Supporting the preparation and release of approved packages of design information Triaging and coordinating resolution of design-related end-user issues through Field Requests and Engineering Change Requests, in partnership with responsible system owners

• Own the engineering implementation of design control processes covering design planning, inputs, outputs, reviews, verification and validation, transfer to manufacturing or construction, and design changes.

• Align engineering procedures and tools so that requirements management, design inputs, calculations, reviews, configuration control, and document control form a coherent workflow without conflicting ownership or duplicate controls.

• Translate applicable engineering portions of the quality assurance plan and design control commitments into practical procedures, training, and evidence requirements, in coordination with Quality Assurance and other process owners.

• Establish expectations for assessing the impact of proposed design changes on affected requirements, interfaces, analyses, verification activities, and released design information, in coordination with system owners.

• Ensure design review findings, unresolved assumptions, and open technical items are tracked to closure or formally dispositioned before release of affected design information.

• Translate organizational priorities into integrated cross-team plans, priorities, and decision guidance

• Resolve priority conflicts and reallocates resources before delivery is materially affected.

• Own integrated outcomes across teams and resolve gaps or overlaps in accountability and hold Managers accountable for their teams’ outcomes and cross-team commitments to support predictable delivery.

• Anticipate cross-team dependencies and identify capability and capacity gaps before delivery is affected.

• Maintain technical consistency and risk visibility across teams; resolve escalated domain or technical conflicts.

• Ensure material technical decisions receive appropriate technical review and approval by designated authorities.

• Lead or contribute to high-risk cross-team integration efforts, technical decisions, reviews, or delivery recovery efforts where specialized expertise is needed.

• Coach Managers and Leads; hold them accountable for timely, effective people management and consistent leadership practices.

• Maintain succession plans, assess readiness for key roles, and develop 6-12 month capability and capacity plans across teams.

• Standardize effective operating practices across teams while removing unnecessary variation and process barriers.

• Use root-cause and trend information to prevent recurring organizational and compliance issues.

• Create alignment mechanisms across teams/functions and resolves ambiguity, dependencies, and resource constraints.

• Represent broader leadership priorities consistently and closes cross-functional commitments.

• Set consistent leadership expectations across teams and address unhealthy patterns early.

• Balance functional interests with company outcomes and take accountability for difficult decisions.

• Perform administrative tasks as required.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related design discipline.

• 12+ years of relevant engineering experience,

• 6+ years of leadership experience, including managing managers and scaling engineering organizations.

• Experience managing engineering managers or technical leads with accountability for outcomes across multiple teams.

• Demonstrated success in managing complex, multi-disciplinary projects in a regulated environment such as nuclear, aerospace, defense, or medical devices.

• Experience with safety-critical or mission-critical systems and applying graded approaches to quality and associated engineering requirements is required.

• Substantial engineering design experience with complex engineered systems, including responsibility for systems engineering, engineering design control, configuration management, or design verification.

• Experience working with quality assurance requirements, engineering records, corrective actions, and resolving issues at supplier, manufacturing, or construction interfaces.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Knowledge of requirements architecture, traceability, system interfaces, design baselines, verification methods, and the relationship among engineering products across design phases.

• Knowledge of quality program design controls and their practical application to planning, design inputs and outputs, reviews, verification, transfer, and changes.

• Ability to lead managers and senior engineers; develop talent pipelines; foster a culture of accountability and collaboration.

• Ability to evaluate engineering workflows, identify gaps in control or unnecessary administrative burden, and translate quality requirements into processes suited to actual design execution.

• Ability to structure and oversee large, complex technical programs with competing priorities and multiple stakeholders.

• Strong verbal, written, and presentation abilities; capable of conveying complex technical concepts to executives, peers, and external stakeholders.

• Skilled at identifying risks, analyzing tradeoffs, and making data-driven decisions.

• Ability to balance early design iteration with disciplined configuration management and timely verification planning, then increase control as design maturity and commitments require.

• Ability to adapt methods and tools to evolving project needs and technological constraints.

• Ability to manage project schedules, resource allocation, and technical deliverables effectively.

• Excellent communication skills for interfacing with technical teams, regulatory bodies, and external stakeholders.

• Strong systems-thinking mindset with an emphasis on safety, reliability, and maintainability in design.

• Ability to work with highly collaborative team.

• Ability to solve problems quickly and efficiently.

• Prioritizes and ensures safety of one self and others.

• Ability to proactively collect, manage and transfer knowledge.

• Ability to seek different and novel ways to create efficiencies when working on problems, challenges and issues.

Physical Demands

• Ascending or descending ladders, stairs, scaffolding, ramps, scissor lifts, articulated boom lifts and the like

• Moving self in different positions to accomplish tasks in various environments including tight and confined spaces

• Remaining in a stationary position, often standing, or sitting for prolonged periods

• Moving about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another

• Communicating with others to exchange information

Environmental Conditions

• General office environment

• Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned

• High-concentration, demanding and fast-paced

Safety and PPE

• Reading and interpreting hazardous warning signs

• Reporting issues with equipment or unsafe conditions

• Wearing proper PPE, to include face mask, face shields, gloves, safety shoes, etc.

Travel

• Some travel may be required (up to 20%)

Additional Requirements

• Requires overtime and occasionally working weekends with schedule flexibility

• Requires non-standard work-week hours seldom

• Requires seldom extended hours to support launch and critical project timelines

The salary range for this position is $201,200 to $251,500 for employees working onsite at our Alameda, CA headquarters. The range provided in this job posting represents the typical range or starting rate of candidates hired in California. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, the market data for your work location, and a comparison to other employees already in the role.

#LI-Onsite

About our Benefits

We know that we have some of the most talented and dedicated employees, and we believe in rewarding them accordingly. If you work here, full-time employees (excludes interns) expect to have access to the benefits below:

• Competitive compensation packages

• Medical, dental and vision benefits for employees and their dependents

• Paid Vacation

• 401(k) and pre-tax health insurance, dependent care, and commuter benefits (FSA)

Kairos Power is committed to building a diverse workforce that reflects the communities where we do business. Kairos Power is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We actively welcome people of different experiences, abilities, and perspectives.

Kairos Power participates in E-Verify.

Candidates only, no recruiters or agencies please.

To work in this facility, you need to be authorized by the Department of Energy to access Part 810-controlled information. Foreign nationals who are citizens of countries that are not on the Department of Energy’s general authorization list (link below) are not permitted to work in our facility unless the Department of Energy issues an export control license to the company to permit that individual to have access to Part 810-controlled information.
