jobs.title: Supply Chain/Procurement Manager, Malta, NY - Semiconductor
jobs.description:
WORLD WIDE PROFESSIONAL SOLUTIONS is a project solutions organization committed to implementing lean constructions, collaborative contracting, and execution approaches to enable breakthroughs in performance.


World Wide Professional Solutions (WWPS) seeks a Supply Chain / Procurement Manager for our owner's representative team on a long term semiconductor construction project in Malta, NY. The role focuses on procurement for base build infrastructure and critical facility equipment.
Represent the owner's interests in procurement strategy, competitive sourcing, supplier performance, long lead equipment, cost and schedule integration, logistics, and risk management. Work closely with owner leadership, engineering, construction, project controls, contractors, and OEMs.
Primary Responsibilities - Procurement Strategy and Competitive Sourcing
Develop, maintain, and execute procurement plans and package strategies aligned with design releases, construction sequencing, project milestones, budget, and owner procurement requirements.
Lead or coordinate RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, vendor prequalification, bidder communications, bid evaluations, commercial leveling, negotiation support, and award recommendations.
Review procurement scopes, specifications, bill of materials, vendor qualifications, commercial terms, lead times, and completeness of bids with engineering and construction teams.
Support procurement of major base build and infrastructure packages as applicable, including HVAC and air handling, chillers, process utilities, UPW, CDA, exhaust, cleanroom infrastructure, and electrical distribution equipment.
Long Lead Equipment and Schedule Integration
Own accurate procurement registers and long lead equipment trackers showing submittal, approval, fabrication, FAT, shipping, delivery, and installation readiness milestones.
Coordinate with scheduling and project controls teams to integrate procurement activities into the master CPM schedule and identify critical and near critical equipment deliveries.
Expedite vendor engineering deliverables and fabrication progress, verify schedule commitments, and develop recovery plans for delayed or at-risk packages.
Coordinate vendor drawing reviews, technical submittals, inspections, and Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs) with responsible engineering and quality personnel.
Vendor, Contractor, and Stakeholder Management
Serve as the owner's representative point of coordination for procurement matters among contractors, OEMs, suppliers, project controls, engineering, and site leadership.
Lead procurement status meetings, drive timely decisions, document action items, and escalate commercial, technical, and delivery risks early.
Establish supplier performance metrics and scorecards for schedule adherence, quality, responsiveness, cost, and documentation; support corrective action when performance falls short.
Ensure vendor and contractor procurement activities follow approved procedures, delegated authority, contract obligations, and owner expectations.
Logistics, Material Readiness, and Turnover
Coordinate shipping, freight, customs or import requirements when applicable, receiving, offloading, laydown, storage, preservation, and rigging plans with the site team.
Track material receipts, shortages, damage, substitutions, nonconformance, and inventory or invoice discrepancies, and coordinate timely resolutions.
Verify equipment and materials arrive with required documentation, including warranties, manuals, certifications, inspection records, and turnover deliverables.
Cost, Contracts, Reporting, and Risk
Support procurement budgets, commitments, forecasts, cash flow, cost saving opportunities, and change control in coordination with owner project controls.
Evaluate vendor change requests, claims, purchase order adjustments, payment milestones, and invoice issues for scope, commercial accuracy, and schedule impact.
Provide clear procurement dashboards and status reports covering open commitments, long lead items, delivery dates, aging actions, critical risks, and mitigation plans.
Identify supply chain constraints, vendor capacity concerns, escalation exposure, and alternative sourcing opportunities while protecting quality, compliance, and project schedule.
Required Qualifications and Skills
7 to 10+ years of relevant procurement, supply chain, or purchasing experience supporting large capital construction, industrial facilities, EPC/EPCM programs, or complex infrastructure projects.
Demonstrated ownership of competitive bids, purchase order or subcontract administration, supplier negotiations, and long lead engineered equipment packages.
Strong understanding of construction sequencing, CPM schedule integration, project cost controls, forecasting, procurement risk, and change management.
Ability to read and interpret construction specifications, scopes of work, equipment schedules, commercial documents, and vendor submittals.
Advanced Excel and proficiency with Microsoft Office; working knowledge of procurement or project controls systems such as SAP, Oracle, PMWeb, Procore, or Primavera P6.
Strong analytical, organizational, negotiation, written communication, and stakeholder management skills; able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced project setting.
Preferred Experience
Direct procurement experience on semiconductor fabs, cleanroom facilities, or other highly technical advanced manufacturing projects.
Experience with owner representation, EPCM oversight, large mechanical or electrical equipment, process utility infrastructure, supplier expediting, and FAT coordination.
Familiarity with earned value management, contract risk management, international equipment shipments, and construction handoff or commissioning readiness.
Education
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant construction procurement experience will be considered.
Work Environment
Full-time, onsite in Peoria, Arizona, with regular interaction across project teams and periodic construction site visits. Site safety and security requirements apply. Relocation assistance is available.
Why Work for WWPS?
Join WWPS on a long term semiconductor construction project where your procurement decisions directly affect delivery of critical facility infrastructure. Work with experienced engineering and construction teams, solve complex supply chain challenges, and build your career in an environment that values collaboration, ownership, and practical results.
Compensation and Benefits
WWPS offers full medical, dental, vision, life, short-term and long-term disability benefits, plus a company-matched retirement plan. Relocation assistance is available.

jobs.title: Head of Majors, Developer GTM
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:  SF Bay Area

About Cloudflare

At Cloudflare, our mission is bold yet simple: to help build a better Internet. Our global network handles trillions of requests each month, protecting and accelerating applications without added hardware, software, or code changes. Our Developer Platform, including Workers, Workers AI, R2, KV, Durable Objects, and Pages, empowers developers to build and deploy applications globally, faster than ever before.

About the Team

The Developer GTM organization is driving how we attract, inspire, and grow the next generation of builders. We are redefining what developer acquisition looks like in a world where AI and distributed agents are reshaping the stack. Our mission is to lead the transformation of Cloudflare GTM into a Cloud Platform that has roots and capabilities in application services and cybersecurity. We create new pathways for developers to discover Cloudflare, whether through ecosystem partnerships, high-impact content, or creative field engagement and enablement.

We are builders, storytellers, and connectors united by one goal: to make Cloudflare the best place for developers to build.

The Developer GTM organization partners tightly with Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, RevOps, and Marketing. Developer GTM connects developer activation to durable commercial outcomes: shaping usage into clear proposals, aligning pricing and packaging, enabling the field with repeatable motions, and feeding real-world signals back into Product.

About the Role

Majors are Cloudflare's most important accounts, representing the world’s largest technology organizations. These are companies with thousands of engineers, massive production footprints, and infrastructure decisions that move markets. When a major account adopts Cloudflare's Developer Platform at scale, the commercial impact is outsized and durable. Winning here requires a highly strategic, technically fluent GTM leader.

As the Head of Majors, you will own Cloudflare's Developer Platform GTM strategy for our most critical enterprise segment. This is the deepest, most strategic end of the Developer GTM spectrum. Fewer accounts, higher stakes, longer cycles, and more complex stakeholder maps. You will set the strategy for how Cloudflare earns and grows Developer Platform adoption inside these accounts, lead engagement with their most senior technical and commercial leaders, and work with the field to structure deals that match the scale and sophistication of how these companies build.

We are looking for a seasoned enterprise sales leader who brings deep experience selling into or managing relationships and driving revenue within large, complex technology companies. You understand how to navigate organizations with layers of engineering leadership, procurement, security review, and legal. You can build a multi-year account strategy and execute against it with patience and precision. And you bring the developer fluency to engage credibly with CTOs and VPs of Engineering on workload architecture, not just commercial terms.

What You Will Do

• Define the Majors GTM strategy: Build the operating model for how Cloudflare wins, grows, and retains Developer Platform adoption in its largest accounts. Set performance goals, scorecards, and cadences, defining success at both the account and portfolio levels.

• Architect Multi-Year Account Strategies: Build and execute comprehensive Developer Platform plans for priority accounts: defining target workloads, how adoption acceleration paths, competitive positioning, and the commercial path to get there.

Scale-ups are where developer platform bets become durable at scale. The choices they make now about where to run workloads, how to serve users globally, and which platforms to build on will compound. Cloudflare needs to be in the room when those decisions are made.

We are hiring a Head of Scale-ups to own Cloudflare's Developer Platform GTM strategy for the scale-up segment. This role is the strategic GTM leader who sets the vision for how Cloudflare wins with the fastest-growing technology companies in the world, drives executive engagement with their engineering leadership, and builds the commercial trajectory from early adoption through large-scale committed spend. You will identify the highest-potential accounts, lead the engagement strategy, and work with the field to turn usage into lasting commercial relationships.

We are looking for someone who has operated inside or worked closely with high-growth category leaders (e.g. Figma, Notion, Canva, Atlassian, OpenAI, or Anthropic). You understand what it means to scale an engineering organization from Series B/C through enterprise maturity, stand up a platform team, and make infrastructure bets under rapid growth. You bring developer fluency and commercial rigor in equal measure. You can sit with a VP of Engineering and discuss workload architecture in the morning, then work through a multi-year commit structure with Deal Desk in the afternoon.

• Define and execute the scale-ups GTM strategy. Build the operating model for how Cloudflare acquires, activates, and grows scale-up accounts. jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

You will:

• Collaborate and coordinate with teams to develop and implement solutions, in order to advance Waymo's self-driving technology and products.

• Duties include: Define and champion the long-term vision and strategic roadmap for problem area within autonomous vehicle development;

• Analyze autonomous vehicle (AV) behavior across diverse data sources, including realworld driving events and simulated driving scenarios;

• Conduct in-depth root cause analysis of identified issues and collaborate with engineering counterparts to develop and propose effective solutions;

• Negotiate and collaborate with product management counterparts in other organizational units to secure support and resources for new product initiatives and cross-functional projects;

• Develop detailed execution milestones and project plans in conjunction with Technical Program Management (TPM) partners. Establish clear objectives and key results (OKRs) and facilitate regular check-ins to ensure progress and alignment with strategic goals; and

• Develop and maintain a comprehensive long-term product roadmap that directly contributes to Waymo's overarching strategic objectives. Effectively communicate the product vision, strategy, priorities, and potential risks to executive stakeholders and broader organizational teams.

You have: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field and 30 months of experience in the job offered or in a Product Management-related occupation. Position requires:

• 30 months of experience in working on autonomous vehicles, robotics, or products that utilize Machine Learning or AI; 30 months of experience in defining and setting product metrics, and analyzing and visualizing data to drive product decisions; 30 months of experience in managing cross-functional prioritization across multiple high-impact product initiatives; 30 months of experience in developing and communicating comprehensive product vision and roadmap, including market analysis, user needs, and cross-functional input; 30 months of experience in leading cross-team collaboration for scalable product delivery across platforms; 30 months of experience in technical leadership experience driving system architecture and roadmap execution; and 18 months of experience in Perception technologies such as computer vision.

jobs.title: Safety Scientist
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

The Safety Scientist within Global Patient Safety Science is an individual contributor who provides safety science and pharmacovigilance support to all products across the RevMed portfolio, which includes early and late phase development activities. The individual will be responsible for supporting clinical studies, review of clinical trial protocols, supporting updates to IBs, ICFs, and authoring of DSURs. Additional safety related activities will involve medical review of individual case safety reports (ICSRs), safety surveillance of assigned products and active member of cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities include:

• The Safety Scientist will develop and maintain an understanding of the safety profile of the assigned product(s).

• Proactive medical safety surveillance of ongoing clinical trials for identification of safety signals.

• Conduct ongoing safety data reviews; prepare and present summaries to internal stakeholders.

• Medical review of individual case safety reports, routine review of safety data and pertinent scientific literature articles.

• Identify potential clinical safety issues for ongoing clinical trials based on emerging safety data.

• May perform safety reviews of relevant sections of clinical trial protocols, Investigator’s Brochures (including reference safety information), clinical study reports, informed consent forms, DSURs, and other study related documents, as required.

• Supports authoring or otherwise contributes to the preparation of aggregate safety reports and risk management plans (RMPs).

• Conducts signal detection and evaluation activities for assigned products in collaboration with senior Safety Science team member(s) as part of the continuous benefit-risk evaluation throughout the product lifecycle.

• Establish and maintain collaborative working relationships with all key stakeholders (e.g., clinical study teams, study sites, CROs).

• Consistently comply with all governing laws, regulations, RevMed standard operating procedures (SOPs) and other guidelines.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• A relevant postgraduate qualification (e.g., MD, PharmD, PHD/MSc in a Life sciences discipline, or other post-graduate health professional qualifications).

• 1 or more years of drug development experience in the pharmaceutical or related industry.

• Detail-oriented with ability prioritize tasks and function independently as appropriate.

• Strong learning orientation, curiosity, and commitment to science and patients.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Skills:

• Understanding of the scientific aspects of safety, PV (including GVP, GCP), and clinical/patient risk management.

• Exposure to Safety Operations and experience with individual case review.

• Knowledge and/or experience with clinical trial management and data review.

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR



Mercor’s mission is to organize human intelligence for the AI economy. We build the infrastructure that enables frontier AI labs and enterprises to train, evaluate, and improve AI on real-world professional work. More than five million experts have joined our network, and we pay out over $5 million daily for their knowledge and expertise.

We built our training and evaluation infrastructure alongside the world’s leading AI labs. Now, we’re bringing those capabilities to enterprises across industries, enabling them to train, evaluate, and improve AI using their own expertise and standards. Our APEX benchmarks measure how AI performs on economically valuable work, while our enterprise evaluations and post-training capabilities turn those insights into measurable improvements across real-world workflows.

Our work sits at the intersection of frontier AI, human expertise, and real-world application. We’re solving problems few companies have encountered, with the opportunity to influence what the world’s most advanced AI systems become capable of doing. We’re looking for people who bring different perspectives, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and hold themselves to an exceptionally high standard. You’ll have the opportunity to do consequential work alongside talented colleagues who challenge one another, collaborate openly, and share a commitment to excellence.

Mercor is profitable and recently raised a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation. We work in person five days a week in San Francisco, New York, and London.







ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Backend Software Engineer, Infrastructure at Mercor, you'll design and build the core services and platforms that the rest of engineering builds on. You'll work closely with engineers across product, research, and operations to turn hard scaling problems into well-designed, well-tested software.



This is a software engineering role first. You'll spend most of your time designing systems, writing and reviewing code for services, platforms, and tooling that the rest of engineering builds on, ensuring they hold up in production at scale.

We're hiring across Infrastructure: Platform, Developer Platform, Storage and Databases. We team-match after the first screen, so apply even if your background leans toward one area.


WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Design and build multi-tenant platform services that give dozens of teams isolated capacity, routing, quotas, and observability on demand, owned from architecture review through production.

 - Scale the gateway that fronts every model provider we use, so internal teams and products get reliable, fair, cost-aware access to inference without filing a ticket.

 - Build the internal platforms and APIs that product and research engineers rely on every day, and treat them with the same design and testing rigor as customer-facing code.

 - Design data models, storage layers, and workflows on Postgres, MongoDB, and Temporal that hold up at the next 10x, including schema evolution, sharding and partitioning strategies, and migrations.

 - Build developer-facing platform components (sandboxes, job execution, service frameworks) where coding agents are first-class users alongside humans.

 - Write design docs, lead architecture reviews, and set the patterns for how services at Mercor handle concurrency, retries, idempotency, and backpressure.

 - Improve the performance and efficiency of hot paths, and make architectural changes that bend the cost curve.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We care far more about how you reason about systems than which tools you've used. Strong candidates typically have:

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals: you design systems before you build them, write code you're proud of in Python or Go, test it, and review others' code with care.

 - A deep grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency, concurrency, failure modes, backpressure, idempotency, and capacity planning.

 - Experience designing APIs and services used by other engineers, and evolving them without breaking their consumers.

 - Solid experience with relational and/or document databases: data modeling, query performance, and safe migrations.

 - Working familiarity with cloud infrastructure (we're on AWS) and containers. Deep Terraform or Kubernetes expertise is not required; you need to be curious and fast to pick it up.

 - High ownership: you see a gap, write the proposal, ship it, and stand behind it in production.


YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF

 - You're a backend engineer who keeps getting pulled toward the platform layer because that's where the hardest problems are.

 - You've built internal platforms, SDKs, or shared services that other engineers loved using.

 - You've worked on multi-tenant systems, rate limiting and quota systems, API gateways, or LLM/inference serving.

 - You've used databases, message queues, or workflow engines at meaningful scale and understand their tradeoffs from the inside.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building developer experience tooling, such as CI pipelines, build systems, local development environments, or internal CLIs that make engineers faster.

 - Interest in contributing to developer productivity work alongside your core focus: cutting CI time, improving test reliability, or building sandboxes and guardrails for coding agents.


HOW WE WORK

 - Small, senior team with direct access to the Head of Infrastructure and to engineering leadership.

 - In-person five days a week in SF. Infra is a team sport for us.

 - We use AI coding agents heavily and expect you to as well; the interesting work is deciding what they should do, not typing.

 - Weekly on-call rotation with structured handoffs; on-call load is a metric we actively drive down.

Benefits

 - Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

 - Up to $15k Relocation bonus

 - $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

 - Free Equinox membership

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

 - Health, Dental, Vision insurance

jobs.title: Researcher, Cyber Safety Training
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Safety Research at OpenAI is responsible for ensuring our most capable models can be safely deployed in the real world. The Safety Training team develops the research and engineering methods that shape model behavior through post-training, reinforcement learning, evaluation, and deployment feedback.

Our work focuses on making models helpful, reliable, and aligned with safety policies across model types, modalities, and product surfaces. We work across both longer-term safety research and the core post-training work needed to improve production models.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll work directly on the large training runs that shape OpenAI’s frontier models. Your focus will be teaching models to help people do legitimate security work while recognizing when their assistance could enable harm. A model that refuses to help a defender investigate a security issue can fail in a different way from one that helps someone misuse it. You’ll study both kinds of mistakes and use what you learn to improve the next training run.

We’re looking for someone with hands-on machine learning experience who wants to bring security judgment into model training. You might come from cybersecurity and want to go deeper on post-training, or from reinforcement learning and want to build substantial expertise in cybersecurity.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Work with cybersecurity researchers to identify situations where context changes what help a model should give.

 - Design complex and realistic cyber safety evaluations.

 - Research post-training techniques that robustly improves the cyber safety of the frontier models.

 - Work with the core post-training team to bring promising methods into large model runs and verify that the safety improvements hold at scale.

 - Coordinate and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including T&S, legal, policy and other research teams, to ensure that our products meet the highest safety standards.
   
   


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have trained or fine-tuned models yourself and can describe an experiment where you used the results to change how you trained the next model.

 - Bring practical security judgment from industry work, a research project, collaboration with a security team, or capture-the-flag competitions. We also welcome reinforcement learning practitioners motivated to develop that judgment alongside security researchers.

 - Can build and debug the code behind a training experiment, from preparing data to checking whether a change in the results reflects a real change in model behavior.

 - Enjoy working through ambiguous cases with domain experts and translating what you learn into concrete decisions about how a model should respond.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manage
jobs.description:
What we do:
Halcyon is the industry’s first dedicated, adaptive security platform that combines multiple proprietary advanced prevention engines along with AI models focused specifically on stopping ransomware.

Who we are:
Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers.

As a remote-native, completely distributed global team, we recognize great talent can exist anywhere. We invite you to apply to a job you’re interested in and we'll work a plan to meet your needs.

Senior Product Manager, Endpoint
Halcyon | Product | Remote, United States | Travel: 30–40%

The Role

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Product Manager to lead high-impact initiatives across the Halcyon platform.

In this role, you will take ownership of major product areas and drive them from problem definition through launch and post-release optimization. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, partnering closely with engineering, go-to-market teams, and customers to deliver measurable business and customer outcomes. This is a highly visible, customer-facing position suited for a PM who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, making principled tradeoffs, and being accountable for results. Security experience is helpful, but we are primarily looking for an exceptional product manager with strong judgment, execution capability, and customer presence.

What You’ll Do

Own Major Product Initiatives

• Translate company objectives and customer needs into clear product strategies and execution plans.

• Define scope, prioritize effectively, and manage tradeoffs aligned with business goals.

• Drive initiatives from discovery through general availability and iteration.

• Measure and report on outcomes, not just feature delivery.

Lead Customer Engagement

• Engage directly with enterprise customers and prospects to validate problems and solutions.

• Represent the product in roadmap discussions, executive briefings, and deep technical conversations.

• Synthesize structured feedback into actionable product decisions.

Drive Cross-Functional Execution

• Partner closely with engineering to define requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.

• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure successful launches and adoption.

• Identify risks early and proactively drive resolution.

Make High-Quality Decisions

• Prioritize based on customer impact, strategic alignment, and business value.

• Operate effectively in ambiguous or evolving environments.

• Communicate clearly and concisely with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Qualifications

Required

• 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.

• Demonstrated track record of independently leading complex initiatives end-to-end.

• Strong experience engaging directly with enterprise customers.

• Proven ability to ship impactful features with measurable results.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred

• Experience in cybersecurity, infrastructure, or endpoint technologies.

• Experience in startup or high-growth environments.

• Technical fluency sufficient to partner deeply with engineering teams.

About Halcyon

Halcyon builds an advanced anti-ransomware platform that enterprise security teams rely on to stop attacks other tools miss. Our agent runs on our customers endpoints, in production, in some of the largest environments in the world. We move quickly and give people real ownership, which only works because we're deliberate about who we bring on

jobs.title: Global GTM Strategy Lead (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

GLOBAL GTM STRATEGY LEAD (STARLINK)

As the GTM Strategy Lead, you will make Starlink Consumer's global go-to-market organization run as one system. The organization has four regional growth teams (US/Canada, LATAM, Europe, and APAC), and is growing rapidly. This role will own the operating cadence, the market plans, and the cross-region programs that let leadership see where every market stands and let each region get what it needs.

You are the connective tissue between the regional directors & central growth functions (e.g. Monetization, Product, Communications). You will work directly with Consumer Growth leadership around the world. This is a builder's seat: the cadence, the templates, and the market plans are not finished, and you will create them, run them, and make them stick with a group of senior directors who have strong opinions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Run the global GTM operating cadence: the weekly regional growth tracker, market grades and executive review inputs, and monthly and quarterly growth plan reviews; collect, pressure-test, and consolidate regional inputs into one view with owners, dates, and gaps

• Own the quarterly bottoms-up growth plan for the priority markets with the regional directors: market targets, initiative portfolio, weekly phasing, and actuals against plan; ensure every market has a named owner and a dated plan

• Lead cross-region growth programs end to end

• Build the market-planning playbook: how a region sizes a market, selects initiatives, sets a weekly target, and reports; roll it out to new regional teams as they stand up, including Japan/APAC and country business development managers in Europe and LATAM

• Track the global deal pipeline and retail door openings across regions with the regional business operations managers; flag at-risk and overdue items to leadership

• Prepare GTM content for Consumer Growth leadership: regional readouts & strategic projects from leadership

• Partner with Growth and Monetization on pricing and offer rollouts by market, with Product Growth on launch readiness, and with Consumer Communications on in-market campaigns, so regional teams receive one coordinated plan

• Represent regional requirements and constraints back to central teams, and central decisions back to the regions, so decisions are made with the full picture

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree

• 1+ years of cumulative work experience in management consulting, growth strategy, go-to-market planning, or business operations experience

• 1+ years of experience using Excel for data analysis

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 3+ years of experience in go-to-market strategy, business operations, sales operations, or management consulting supporting a multi-region sales or distribution organization

• Strong analytical skills, including building a bottoms-up plan in Excel, reconciling it to finance, and defending the numbers

• Experience building and running an operating cadence (weekly trackers, quarterly plans, executive readouts) across teams that do not report to you

• Experience in consumer hardware, telecommunications, internet service, or retail distribution with physical channels (retail doors, distributors, field sales)

• Experience launching and measuring growth programs such as referral, channel incentives, or partner sign-up flows

• Clear writer and presenter, able to turn multiple regional updates into one page an executive can act on

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and hold them to dates without direct authority over their teams

• Experience working across time zones with teams in LATAM, Europe, and APAC

• Experience in fast-paced, startup-like cultures with a focus on cross-functional coordination and high standards

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to travel up to 25% of the time, domestically and internationally, as needed

• Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed, including coverage across global time zones

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:

Level 1: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00
Level 2: $100,000.00 - $135,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
The Role

As a Senior Technical Recruiter, you'll own hiring for our Research & Development organization from kickoff through offer accept, acting as a true talent partner to engineering and R&D leaders. With substantial independence to shape hiring strategy and raise talent density, you'll run searches with minimal oversight and close talent in a competitive market.

This is a full-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.

What you'll do

• Own full-cycle recruiting for active R&D requisitions across engineering and at least one other function, from senior individual contributors through manager and director-level roles.

• Build a recruiting strategy for each search, evaluate funnel performance at each stage, and refine tactics in response to market feedback and key performance metrics.

• Advise hiring managers on role definition, market trends, and leveling, aligning hiring plans with business goals from kickoff.

• Engage passive and active talent through proactive sourcing and

• Run screens that assess technical depth, product intuition, and leadership skills

• Run your desk on a visible, repeatable system, keeping Greenhouse data clean enough to trust and building playbooks your teammates can reuse.

About You

• You have at least 5 years of full-cycle recruiting experience in-house or in an agency setting, with a proven track record of sourcing and closing senior, hard-to-fill engineering talent.

• You source proactively through LinkedIn Recruiter and alternative channels rather than relying on inbound applicants, holding yourself and your hiring partners to clear cycle times.

• You communicate clearly and without ego, seeking to understand before pushing back.

• You influence leaders through data, insight, and judgment, and can speak fluently to your own metrics—including hires, time-to-fill, pass-through rates, and source mix.

• You're process-driven and comfortable with ambiguity: you hold interviewers accountable to hiring playbooks, pick up unfamiliar technical domains quickly, and own your outcomes and learnings.

• You have hands-on experience with Greenhouse as your primary applicant tracking system (ATS), proficiency with Gem, BrightHire, and LinkedIn Recruiter, and practical experience using AI to increase your effectiveness.

• You are authorized to work in the United States. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring U.S. employment visas for this role.

Bonus points

• You've supported multiple departments within an R&D organization.

Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit.

The Team — Recruiting

The Recruiting team builds the teams that advance Everlaw's mission by connecting exceptional, diverse talent with meaningful work. It partners across the company to define what success looks like, attract strong candidates, and support fair, evidence-based hiring decisions. This work strengthens a scalable, quality-focused hiring engine that raises talent density while delivering a candidate experience worthy of Everlaw's culture.

Total Rewards & Benefits

The expected salary range for this role is $153,000 - $194,000. Final salary depends on factors including the candidate's experience and skills, and the base pay range is subject to change. This role is also eligible for equity and the benefits below.

Health & well-being

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses

• Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness

• Paid parental leave

• Company-sponsored life and disability insurance

Financial rewards

• Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long-term growth

• 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation

Growth & everyday perks

• 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave

• Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company-wide days off) per year

• Annual allocation for learning & development and relevant professional membership dues

• Hybrid work with regular work-from-home days and flexibility for life's logistics

• Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup

• Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company-wide events in our offices

About Everlaw

When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence — emails, documents, chats, files — to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. Everlaw is the litigation and investigation management platform changing that, using AI to turn mountains of messy data into the handful of facts that win or lose a case, compressing weeks of work into hours.

We're the kind of place that's ranked #1 on G2 in our category and named a Great Place to Work™ by our own team. So if you want a front row seat to an industry in transformation, career-defining work you'll be proud to tell people about, and real upside at a company in control of its own destiny, we'd love to get to know you.

At Everlaw, you'll shape how AI re-wires the legal industry, at a category-leading business built on a mission to illuminate the truth.

jobs.title: Materials Research Engineer -- Principal Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is in Western Digital Research, a world-class research laboratory in San Jose, California with ~80 employees.  Research activities in the lab focus on all aspects of information storage, sensors, spintronics, superconducting devices, non-volatile memory, and AI compute architectures. The materials team’s mission is to develop novel materials for emerging technologies. The team is well-equipped with thin film deposition tools and related characterization tools, located in a fully functional cleanroom with the capability to fabricate a wide array of nanoscale devices using novel materials.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Conduct hands-on, experimental research of thin films for emerging technologies such as superconducting qubits, non-volatile memories and novel sensor applications.
• Thin film growth by physical vapor deposition using ultra-high vacuum film deposition tools.
• Characterization of structural, electronic, optical, chemical, magnetic, thermal and mechanical film properties.
• Design of materials for integration into nanoscale devices.
• Collect, analyze, present and report film and device characterization data, results and conclusions.
• Work closely and collaborate within a team of engineers and support staff.

• Ph.D. in materials science and engineering, physics, electrical engineering, or closely related field.
• Expertise with materials and devices in the areas of non-volatile memory technologies, superconducting qubits, oxide semiconductor transistors, or novel magnetic or chemical sensors.
• Strong hands-on experience with UHV film deposition equipment.
• Strong hands-on experience with film characterization instrumentation and techniques such as XRD, XRF, XPS, AFM, and electrical transport as a function of temperature.
• Strong knowledge of nanofabrication and general device design and operation.
• Demonstrated ability to self-direct a research project.
• Strong written and oral communication skills, and the ability to work both independently and in a team environment.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Every ride on Lyft runs on infrastructure. Every match between a rider and a driver, every price, every payment, every map and every arrival estimate depends on platforms that have to be fast, reliable and efficient at a global scale. This role leads the organization that builds and runs those platforms.

Why this role matters

This is one of the most impactful engineering leadership roles at Lyft. You will be accountable for one of Lyft's largest operating investments: the cost of hosting, running and scaling the entire company on a public cloud, including our growing AI infrastructure spend. This role spans the full infrastructure stack, carries one of Lyft’s largest operating budgets, and directly determines how well Lyft’s product works and what it costs to run.

Reporting to Lyft’s Chief Technology Officer, you will lead an organization of approximately 200 engineers, engineering managers and senior technical leaders to efficiently execute on the right goals to drive impact while maintaining a sense of community.

Responsibilities:

You will lead the organization that builds and runs the platforms every Lyft engineer depends on. You’ll guide a team of engineering managers and senior technical leaders, and you’ll be accountable for the reliability, scalability and cost-efficiency of the systems that keep riders and drivers moving.

What you’ll own

• Core hosting infrastructure. The hosting and compute foundation Lyft runs on in the public cloud, including our Kubernetes clusters and container platform, networking, storage, and the core services every product team depends on.

• Data infrastructure. The databases, data stores and foundational data services that keep rider, driver and marketplace data available, durable and fast.

• Developer platform and experience. The internal platforms, tools, libraries, software development kits (SDKs), and build and release systems that determine how quickly and safely every Lyft engineer can ship.

• Mobile and client infrastructure. The shared build, release, testing and client platforms behind Lyft’s Android, iOS and web applications.

• AI and machine learning infrastructure. The compute, serving and platform capabilities that let Lyft’s teams train, deploy and run machine learning and AI workloads, including the capacity, reliability and cost discipline that AI product development requires.

• Observability and reliability. Stats, logging, metrics and tracing across Lyft. A significant operating budget across hosting, cloud and AI spend, including capacity planning, efficiency, unit economics, and the tradeoffs between cost, reliability and speed. jobs.description:
About Lyra Health
Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. About the Role
We are hiring a Director, Security Engineering to lead Lyra Health's security engineering and operations function. Security Engineering is responsible for how Lyra prevents, detects, and responds to security risk across the company.
As Director, Security Engineering, you will set the direction for the function while staying hands-on in both security engineering and day-to-day operations. jobs.title: Deployment Site Intall Buyer, Planner, XFRA
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION  


SPAN IS ENABLING ELECTRIFICATION FOR ALL ⚡




XFRA BY SPAN IS THE FIRST DISTRIBUTED DATA CENTER USING EXISTING INFRASTRUCTURE AND UNDERUTILIZED POWER CAPACITY TO MEET EXPANDING AI COMPUTE DEMAND.





THE ROLE

We are hiring a Site Buyer / Planner / Logistics Coordinator to make sure every XFRA install site has the right material, in the right place, on the right day. You will own the path from install schedule to delivered kit: buying equipment and consumables, planning material against the install calendar, managing node service parts for installed sites, and coordinating shipments to sites and staging locations.

You will sit between Operations, Field Installation, Supply Chain, and Finance. Success means installers and service technicians never wait on parts, inventory stays lean and spend stays inside budget.


RESPONSIBILITIES


BUYING

• Issue and manage purchase orders for site equipment, components, consumables, and tools.

• Source and qualify suppliers; negotiate price, lead time, and delivery terms.

• Track open POs, expedite late orders, and resolve shortages, damages, and returns.

• Keep spend within program budget and flag variances early to Finance.


PLANNING

• Build site-by-site bills of material from install designs and scope.

• Translate the install schedule into a rolling material plan, typically 4–8 weeks out.

• Set and maintain stock levels for staging locations; balance availability against excess inventory.

• Reconcile material issued to sites against what was installed, returned, or scrapped.


LOGISTICS

• Schedule inbound freight and site deliveries, including kitting and staging.

• Coordinate with site contacts on access, delivery windows, and receiving.

• Manage carriers, freight cost, tracking, and proof of delivery.

• Handle reverse logistics for unused, defective, or RMA material.


NODE SERVICE PARTS

• Buy and plan spare and replacement parts for nodes at installed XFRA sites.

• Set stocking levels for node service parts by site or region, using failure rates, install base, and supplier lead times.

• Ship service parts to sites and field technicians quickly, including urgent and next-day orders.

• Manage RMA, repair, and return flows for failed node parts with suppliers and the service team.

• Track node part usage and failures and share trends with Engineering and Service.


REPORTING AND PROCESS

• Maintain accurate records in the ERP / inventory system.

• Report weekly on material readiness, open risks, and spend.

• Improve buying and kitting processes as the program scales.


ABOUT YOU


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 3+ years in purchasing, material planning, or logistics, ideally supporting field installation or construction projects.

• Hands-on experience with an ERP or inventory system (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) and advanced Excel or Google Sheets.

• Track record of managing suppliers and carriers to cost and delivery targets.

• Strong organization across many sites and deadlines at once.

• Clear written and verbal communication with field crews, vendors, and managers.


BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with electrical, solar, battery storage, or EV charging equipment.

• Background in project-based or multi-site rollout programs.

• Experience with service or spare parts planning, RMA, and repair logistics.

• Familiarity with freight modes (LTL, FTL, parcel) and hazmat shipping rules for batteries.

• APICS / ASCM certification (CPIM or CSCP) or similar.

• Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, operations, or business, or equivalent experience.


WORKING CONDITIONS

• Mix of desk work and visits to install sites, warehouses, and staging yards.

• Occasional travel between sites; valid driver’s license required.

• Ability to lift up to 50 lb when receiving or checking material.

• Some early-morning or after-hours coordination around delivery windows.




LIFE AT SPAN

Headquartered in San Francisco’s vibrant SoMa neighborhood, we are an eclectic group of creative thinkers who value open communication, teamwork, and a ‘make it happen’ approach to addressing complex challenges. 

SPAN embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. 

We’re hiring talented individuals who are driven by success and are passionate about shaping the future of renewable energy. If that sounds like you, we’d love for you to consider joining the rapidly growing team at SPAN.



The Perks:

⚡ Competitive compensation + equity grants at a well-funded, venture-backed company

⚡ Comprehensive benefits: 100% employee premiums for base plans on medical, dental, vision with options for additional coverage.  Parental leave up to twenty four (24)  weeks depending on eligibility

⚡ Comfortable, sunny office space located near BART and Caltrain public transit

⚡ Strong focus on team building and company culture: Employee Resource Groups, monthly social events, SPANcakes recognition breakfast, lunch, and learns

⚡ Flexible hours, one holiday per month, and flexible time off

 

Interested in joining our team? Apply today and we’ll be in touch with the next steps!

• Design and implement automation beyond chatbots, including: Agent-assist / "copilot" workflows to reduce manual effort and errors Automated servicing flows (e.g., follow-ups, status updates, issue resolution)

CX Tooling

• Support development of internal tools that increase agent and team efficiency

• Help standardize tooling and workflows across support channels

• Analyze CX performance across channels (chatbot, support, product journeys)

• Identify friction points not captured in support tickets (e.g., drop-offs, dead ends), and work with the Product team to resolve them

• Build and maintain dashboards to track key CX metrics and initiative impact

Cross-functional execution

• Partner with Customer Operations, Product, and Data teams to implement solutions

• Own initiatives end-to-end: problem definition → solution design → launch → measurement

• Translate customer insights and data into actionable improvements

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to operate in ambiguous environments and drive execution

• High ownership, a bias toward action, and a strong growth trajectory

• Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, or Operations teams

Nice to have:

• Exposure to automation, workflows, or AI-driven tools

• Experience building dashboards or working with data tools (SQL, Looker, etc.)

This is where you come in — to help us forge a strong, reliable path forward to the future. Notion is looking for a risk analyst who has a passion for partnering with teams across the organization to envision, plan and enhance Notion's risk management posture.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Mature and scale Notion’s security risk management program, creating practical, and repeatable processes for identifying, assessing, monitoring, and addressing risk.

 - Manage the security risk register, partnering with risk owners to document and prioritize risks, maintain current treatment plans, and track progress through resolution or approved acceptance.

 - Strengthen third-party risk management across the vendor lifecycle, from due diligence and onboarding through continuous monitoring, reassessment, and offboarding.

 - Identify sensitive data exposure risks, assess and improve data loss prevention controls, and drive remediation that protects company and customer data.

 - Collaborate across Security, Engineering, IT, Procurement, Legal, and business teams to develop proportionate controls and move risk treatment plans forward.

 - Develop risk metrics and reporting that give leadership a clear view of the company’s risk posture, emerging concerns, and remediation progress.

 - Identify opportunities to improve and automate risk workflows, making it easier for teams to make informed decisions as Notion scales.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Security risk management: You have experience building or scaling information security risk programs, including work with risk assessments, risk registers, treatment plans, and risk acceptance processes.

 - Technical fluency: You understand security concepts across cloud infrastructure, applications, identity and access, and data protection, and can assess how control gaps translate into business risk.

 - Third-party risk expertise: You have experience evaluating vendor security practices, assessing residual risk, and managing risk throughout the third-party lifecycle.

 - Strategic judgment: You can prioritize competing risks, navigate ambiguity, and recommend pragmatic solutions that balance security, business needs, and operational realities.

 - Cross-functional influence: You build productive relationships with technical and business partners and drive progress without relying on direct authority.

 - Communication and reporting: You translate complex risks into clear, actionable narratives for audiences ranging from engineers and risk owners to senior leadership.

 - Builder mentality: You improve processes and use technology or automation to reduce manual work while maintaining sound oversight.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience or certifications in the governance, risk, or privacy domains.

 - Awareness of ongoing and recent developments across the security risk landscape.

 - Working knowledge of Notion and how AI agents can be used to enhance security programs.
   
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $208,000 - $245,000 per year.

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. jobs.title: Senior Materials Technician
jobs.description:
Department: Construction

Build on your construction materials testing experience as a Senior Materials Technician, with opportunities to grow toward project coordination and laboratory management.

Lumos & Associates offers hands-on mentorship, opportunities to take on greater responsibility, and an environment where experienced technicians can accelerate their professional development.

Compensation: This position offers a highly competitive pay range.

Why This Role at Lumos

• Grow toward project coordination or laboratory management through mentorship and progressively challenging assignments.

• Work alongside experienced professionals who support your technical development and leadership skills.

• Apply your expertise to materials testing that supports quality construction and public infrastructure.

• Share your knowledge with less experienced technicians and help improve laboratory operations.

• Join a company culture that values safety, quality, and professional growth.

About the Role

As a Senior Materials Technician, you will independently perform construction materials testing of soils, aggregates, concrete, and asphalt in laboratory and field settings. You will evaluate test results, interpret project specifications, and maintain accurate documentation while collaborating with project managers, engineers, contractors, and other technicians.

This opportunity is suited to an experienced technician who wants to expand their technical expertise and build toward a leadership role. Through direct mentorship and increasing responsibility, you will develop skills in testing coordination, laboratory operations, quality assurance, and team leadership.

What You Will Do

• Independently perform complex materials testing, observations, and inspections in accordance with established procedures and project requirements.

• Interpret construction plans, specifications, and applicable ASTM and AASHTO test methods.

• Analyze testing data and verify accuracy before communicating or submitting results.

• Prepare accurate field and laboratory reports documenting findings, results, and discrepancies.

• Communicate testing requirements, results, project progress, and delays to project teams, contractors, and clients.

• Perform and document proficiency sample testing and perform laboratory inspections.

• Maintain and calibrate testing equipment to support reliable results.

• Document equipment issues and coordinate repair or replacement needs.

• Guide and mentor less experienced technicians.

• Prioritize assignments and support timely completion of testing and project deliverables.

• Develop skills in coordinating testing schedules, laboratory workflows, and team assignments.

• Follow safe work practices and report hazards, equipment issues, or safety concerns.

• Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We Are Looking For

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or equivalent. Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or a related field preferred.

• A minimum of four years of relevant industry experience or training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Experience independently performing construction materials testing and documenting results.

• Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or a related field preferred.

• Experience mentoring technicians or supporting laboratory operations preferred.

Required Certifications

• OSHA – 10

• Nuclear Density Gauge Operator

Preferred Certifications

• ACI – Field Technician I

• ACI – Lab Technician I (Strength & Aggregate)

• ACI – Aggregate Base

• NAQTC – Sampling/Density

• NAQTC – Aggregate

• NAQTC – Asphalt

Additional ACI certifications and Engineer Intern (E.I.) status are a plus.

Technical and Professional Skills

• Ability to interpret and apply ASTM and AASHTO test methods.

• Strong mathematical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Accurate documentation and clear written and verbal communication.

• Ability to manage multiple assignments and adapt to changing project priorities.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.

• Professional communication with clients, contractors, and project teams.

• Initiative and an interest in developing project coordination, laboratory management, and mentoring skills.

Physical and Travel Requirements

• Ability to work in laboratory and outdoor construction environments in varying weather and terrain.

• Ability to frequently lift, carry, push, pull, or move objects weighing up to 30 pounds and occasionally up to 60 pounds.

• Ability to navigate uneven terrain, carry testing equipment, and perform work involving standing, walking, climbing, bending, and kneeling.

• Flexibility to work the hours needed to meet project deadlines.

• Ability to travel between project sites and the laboratory and operate a company vehicle in accordance with company policy.

• Valid driver’s license and driving record with three or fewer demerit points.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

About Lumos and Associates

Lumos & Associates brings civil engineering, structural engineering, surveying and mapping, geotechnical engineering, materials testing, and construction management under one roof, with offices across Nevada, California, and Idaho. We invest heavily in professional development and operate under five core values: Stay Moving, Dip Down, Own It, Make It Right, and Take Pride.

Benefits Offered to Eligible Full Time Employees

jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager, Analytics & Workforce Planning
jobs.description:
📍 Remote (U.S.-Based) | Optional hybrid in the Bay Area
Reports to: Senior Director, Asynchronous Care
Job Type: Full-time W2

Overview

Midi Health is on a mission to redesign care for women in midlife — and we're growing fast. As our asynchronous operations scale, we need better visibility into how work moves through our inboxes, how our teams perform, and how to deploy our workforce efficiently.

We're looking for a Senior Operations Manager, Analytics & Workforce Planning to build and own the analytical and workforce planning capabilities that power our Async Operations organization.

This person will design and establish the metrics, reporting frameworks, and workforce models that help us understand demand, throughput, productivity, service levels, and cost. You'll turn complex operational data into actionable insights that help leaders make better decisions every day.

You'll work closely with Async Operations leaders to identify what's driving SLA performance, where work is getting stuck, how much capacity we need, and where we can improve productivity or eliminate unnecessary work. You'll independently identify opportunities, develop recommendations, and influence decisions about staffing, workflows, and technology investments.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, operationally minded, and comfortable independently exploring complex datasets. They're excited to use modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, build models, and solve operational problems. They can translate data into clear recommendations that help leaders make better staffing, workflow, and operational decisions.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys building analytical capabilities from the ground up and using data to drive operational change.

The goal: Deliver an excellent patient experience while continuously improving throughput, workforce efficiency, and cost per visit.

You won't just report on how the inbox is performing - you'll help us figure out how to make it perform better.

What you'll do

Operational Analytics & Performance

• Design and own the analytics and reporting framework for Async Operations, providing visibility into volume, throughput, turnaround times, backlogs, productivity, and SLAs.

• Build dashboards, reporting, and recurring analyses that help leaders understand operational performance and take action.

• Establish consistent definitions and measurement frameworks for key inbox metrics across teams and workflows.

• Analyze how work moves through the inbox, including incoming volume, completed work, aging, handoffs, and bottlenecks.

• Independently lead complex analyses to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities, including in areas where existing data or measurement frameworks are incomplete.

• Partner with Operations leaders to translate insights into measurable process and performance improvements.

SLA & Throughput Management

• Develop and own the analytical approach to understanding, monitoring, and improving SLA performance across inbox workflows.

• Identify whether SLA misses are driven by demand, staffing, productivity, routing, workflow design, or technology.

• Analyze throughput and backlog trends to identify where work is accumulating and what interventions will have the greatest impact.

• Develop leading indicators that help teams proactively identify service-level risks before they become problems.

• Measure the impact of operational changes on response times, throughput, quality, and patient experience.

• Recommend and help prioritize operational interventions based on expected impact, feasibility, and resource requirements.

Workforce Planning & Capacity Management

• Design and establish workforce forecasting and capacity planning models that translate expected work volumes into staffing requirements by team, workflow, skill, and time period.

• Own the development of annual, quarterly, monthly, and weekly workforce plans, with visibility into daily capacity needs.

• Account for productivity, scheduling, PTO, training, shrinkage, and other factors that affect available capacity.

• Analyze workforce utilization and productivity to identify opportunities to improve resource allocation.

• Advise Operations leadership on staffing requirements, workforce allocation, cross-training, and capacity shifts to protect SLAs while optimizing cost.

• Lead capacity scenario planning for seasonal demand, holiday coverage, growth, and changes in operational workflows.

Productivity & Cost Optimization

• Develop and own the measurement frameworks for productivity, cost per completed action, and async cost per visit.

• Identify opportunities to increase throughput, reduce unnecessary work, and improve workforce efficiency.

• Analyze variation in productivity across teams, workflows, and work types to understand improvement opportunities.

• Quantify the capacity and financial impact of workflow improvements, staffing changes, and technology investments.

• Partner with Operations and Product to measure the impact of automation, AI, routing improvements, and process redesign.

• Advise Operations leadership on opportunities to reduce cost, improve workforce efficiency, and prioritize operational and technology investments without compromising service levels or quality.

What you will need to succeed

• 7+ years of experience in Operations Analytics, Workforce Planning, Business Operations, Data Analytics, or a related analytical role, including demonstrated ownership of complex analytical or workforce planning initiatives.

• Strong data fluency and ability to independently explore complex datasets, understand data structures and relationships, validate analytical outputs, and draw reliable conclusions.

• AI-first approach to analytics, with demonstrated ability to leverage modern AI tools (e.g., Claude Code) to accelerate data exploration, analysis, modeling, reporting, and problem-solving.

• Advanced analytical and modeling capabilities, including experience designing forecasting, capacity planning, and productivity models from the ground up. ● Experience establishing dashboards, performance reporting, and operational KPI frameworks.

• Deep understanding of workforce management concepts, including staffing requirements, utilization, shrinkage, productivity, and service levels.

• Experience analyzing operational queues, workflows, throughput, and SLA performance. ● Strong business judgment and ability to connect operational metrics to financial outcomes.

• Ability to independently structure ambiguous problems, identify root causes, develop recommendations, and influence operational decisions.

• Experience partnering with Operations, Product, Engineering, and Data teams.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to influence senior stakeholders by translating complex analyses into clear business recommendations.

• Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where data, processes, and systems are still evolving.

• Bias toward action: You don't just identify a problem in the data — you help the team figure out what to do about it.

Bonus: Experience in healthcare operations, customer support, contact centers, or other high-volume service environments.

This is a full-time W2 position. The base salary range is 130K-160K and will depend on experience. Midi pays a competitive base salary, plus equity and benefits.

We will never ask for payment of any kind during the application or hiring process. If you receive any suspicious communication claiming to be from Midi Health, please report it immediately by emailing us at careers@joinmidi.com.

Midi Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our compensation philosophy is based on fair, objective criteria and the impact of the role, regardless of an applicant’s salary history.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

• North Carolina

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Majors Account Executive to join our Enterprise/Field Sales team. In this pivotal role, you will help lead Cloudflare’s strategic customer engagements, securing and expanding platform partnerships across key accounts. The ideal candidate brings strong sales leadership, a deep understanding of enterprise architecture (business, data, applications, technology), and the ability to articulate how Cloudflare integrates into modern cloud operating models.

As a Senior Majors Account Executive, you will position Cloudflare’s Developer Platform, Application Security, SASE/Zero Trust Services, and Network and Content Delivery offerings against incumbents. You will drive predictable sales performance, foster healthy pipeline growth, and deliver on revenue objectives. You will act as a trusted advisor, educating customers and partners on Cloudflare’s evolving product ecosystem and security capabilities. This role involves leveraging executive sponsorship programs, partnering with senior leaders (including CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs), and collaborating with cross-functional teams to navigate and successfully close complex customer opportunities.

Responsibilities

• Strategic Revenue Leadership: Develop and execute account plans to meet and exceed revenue goals by structuring enterprise-grade platform partnerships within key accounts.

• Predictable Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain accurate sales forecasting and proactive pipeline management, sharing insights to support broader sales strategy.

• Enterprise Architecture Alignment: Demonstrate a strong understanding of customer Enterprise Architecture across business, data, applications, and technology pillars, connecting Cloudflare solutions directly to customer business outcomes.

• Clear Communication & Feedback: Connect insights across global departments to deliver clear messaging, provide constructive feedback, and support continuous team growth.

• Long-Term Strategic Vision: Make balanced decisions aligned with long-term organizational value, building trust through open communication and knowledge sharing.

• Goal Setting & Operational Efficiency: Partner with teams to set clear metrics, address operational roadblocks, and improve cross-departmental workflows.

• Collaborative Problem Solving: Proactively identify customer and internal needs, fostering positive change and contributing to continuous team improvement.

• Inclusive Leadership: Champion diverse perspectives to solve complex business challenges and support a supportive, forward-thinking team environment.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Relevant professional experience in technology sales or enterprise consulting; advanced degrees or continuous technical learning are welcomed.
