Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

• Flexible Spending Accounts

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

About the Role

Okta is seeking a Product Marketing Manager to join our Competitive Intelligence (CI) team.

This team is at the forefront of research and analysis in the highly competitive Identity and Access Management (IAM) space. We identify differentiators, develop strategic insights, and create comprehensive competitive assets that enable our field teams and champions to effectively compete and win. We thrive on staying ahead of the market trends, equipping our organization with actionable intelligence, and driving impactful decisions in a rapidly evolving environment.

This role requires travel to our San Francisco, CA or Chicago, IL office for in-person onboarding during the first week of employment. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application, interview process, or onboarding please use this Form to request an accommodation.

As a Product Marketing Manager, Competitive Intelligence, you will:

• Conduct in-depth research and analysis of competitors in the IAM market using publicly available resources, with a strong focus on Microsoft’s IAM products.

• Stay up to date on Microsoft’s IAM and Security product development (e.g. Governance, Permissions Management, Identity Protection, Defender lineup and Sentinel)

• Setting up environments for integration testing to allow us to gain hands-on experience and identify opportunities to simplify our customers' environments.

• Identify competitive differentiators and market trends to inform product strategy, positioning, and identify new threats.

• Collaborate with product management, sales, and marketing teams to ensure alignment on competitive positioning and strategies.

• Support the field with strategic guidance during critical sales cycles by delivering timely and relevant competitive insights.

• Build and maintain competitive assets, such as battlecards, whitepapers, presentations, and playbooks to enable field teams.

• Deliver training for product and field teams covering topics such as strategy, competitor products and market trends.

• Contribute to and help maintain our database of competitor information.

• Contribute to a monthly newsletter that highlights developments and trends in our market.

Qualifications

Must-Haves:

• Proven experience in research, analysis, and building competitive intelligence assets in the IAM space.

• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft IAM products (e.g., Entra ID, Entra External ID, Active Directory, Active Directory Federation Services, Conditional Access, MFA, and Identity Governance).

• Hands-on experience setting up and configuring client devices in Microsoft environments on multiple platforms (Windows, MacOS, ChromeOS, Linux. iOS, and Android) including experience with virtualization.

• Exceptional analytical, written, and verbal communication skills with the ability to distill complex information into actionable insights.

• Ability to work collaboratively across teams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

jobs.title: Engagement Manager, Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR



Mercor’s mission is to organize human intelligence for the AI economy. We build the infrastructure that enables frontier AI labs and enterprises to train, evaluate, and improve AI on real-world professional work. More than five million experts have joined our network, and we pay out over $5 million daily for their knowledge and expertise.

We built our training and evaluation infrastructure alongside the world’s leading AI labs. Now, we’re bringing those capabilities to enterprises across industries, enabling them to train, evaluate, and improve AI using their own expertise and standards. Our APEX benchmarks measure how AI performs on economically valuable work, while our enterprise evaluations and post-training capabilities turn those insights into measurable improvements across real-world workflows.

Our work sits at the intersection of frontier AI, human expertise, and real-world application. We’re solving problems few companies have encountered, with the opportunity to influence what the world’s most advanced AI systems become capable of doing. We’re looking for people who bring different perspectives, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and hold themselves to an exceptionally high standard. You’ll have the opportunity to do consequential work alongside talented colleagues who challenge one another, collaborate openly, and share a commitment to excellence.

Mercor is profitable and recently raised a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation. We work in person five days a week in San Francisco, New York, and London.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Engagement Manager on the Cybersecurity team, you will sell and deliver evaluations and post-training data for security-focused models and agents. Your customers are frontier AI labs, cybersecurity companies building AI into their products, and enterprises adopting AI for security work.



You'll own each account end to end: running technical discovery with security and ML teams, scoping custom evaluation and data programs built with experienced security practitioners, and working with Mercor's product, operations, and engineering teams to deliver them. This role carries a revenue target and plays a key part in growing Mercor's cybersecurity business.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own a portfolio of AI labs, cybersecurity companies, and enterprise security teams, and run the full sales cycle from discovery through signed contract and expansion

 - Run technical discovery to understand where a customer's models fall short on security tasks such as vulnerability detection, secure code review, threat analysis, and incident response

 - Scope and price evaluation and post-training data programs, and design them with security practitioners on Mercor's platform

 - Lead technical demos and pilots, and convert pilot results into longer-term commitments

 - Work with product, operations, and engineering to recruit security experts and deliver on quality and timelines

 - Forecast pipeline and revenue, and bring customer feedback back to Mercor's product and research teams


IDEALLY YOU'D HAVE

 - 4+ years as a sales engineer, solutions engineer, or solutions architect at a cybersecurity company

 - Technical BS or MS in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience); security certifications such as OSCP or CISSP are a plus

 - Hands-on security knowledge across offensive and defensive concepts, common vulnerability classes, and security operations workflows

 - A track record of closing and expanding enterprise deals with technical buyers

 - Understanding of the ML training and evaluation lifecycle, or a strong drive to learn it quickly

 - Excellent written and verbal communication with both technical teams and executives

Benefits: 

 - Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Unlimited paid vacation and sick days

 - Parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

 - Free mental health services

 - $200 monthly wellness reimbursement

 - $1.5K monthly meal stipend

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - Free Equinox membership

 - Up to $15K relocation bonus
   
   

Mercor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Mercor does not discriminate based on actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, related medical conditions and lactation), gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, disability, protected medical condition as defined by California or local law, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, California, or local laws and ordinances. Further, Mercor prohibits discrimination, harassment, and retaliation based on any combination of protected characteristics. jobs.title: Security Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SECURITY OPERATIONS ANALYST

As a Security Operations Analyst, you will combine traditional SPOC operator functions, such as incident monitoring, resource coordination, and alarm surveillance, with analytical work in travel security, open-source intelligence (OSINT), and geospatial analysis for Central Texas. The ideal candidate works well independently and as part of a fast-paced, high-tech team, and turns data into actionable insights that support employee safety worldwide.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Monitor, analyze, and triage global security incidents across all SpaceX sites, with an emphasis on Central Texas, and escalate critical events to security leadership and relevant stakeholders

• Investigate incidents, coordinate on-site response with security personnel and local authorities, and produce accurate, timely incident reports

• Support internal and external investigations using camera and alarm systems (access control, video surveillance, fire alarms), dispatch resources as needed, and document follow-up actions

• Prioritize and process incoming security reports and service requests by radio, phone, and ticketing system, and maintain shift logs and metrics

• Serve as the primary SPOC point of contact for facility-specific security matters and coordinate with operational, management, and administrative teams

• Conduct OSINT research on threats to SpaceX personnel, facilities, and brand reputation

• Serve as a power user and administrator for OSINT platforms (Ontic, NexusXplore, Dataminr), and build and maintain query libraries for current threats, BOLO alerts, and executive protection

• Add analytical insight to operator reports, and train team members on platform best practices and feed management

• Provide up-to-date threat assessments to Central Texas leadership

• Design, develop, and maintain ArcGIS dashboards and geospatial layers that support decision-making for stakeholders

• Serve as ArcGIS platform administrator, and onboard and mentor security personnel on GIS workflows and survey creation in Survey123 Connect

• Update and manage existing geospatial surveys to keep data accurate and operationally relevant

• Compile and analyze security metrics across all sites, and produce location-specific risk assessments and trend reports

• Review video surveillance for internal investigations and stakeholder requests

• Serve as a liaison with analyst groups at external companies and government agencies

• Maintain current knowledge of SPOC roles, SpaceX policies and procedures, contract security requirements, and applicable legal standards

• Perform other duties as assigned by Security leadership

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree; OR 4+ years of security operations, security analysis, law enforcement, or military experience in lieu of a degree

• 1+ years of security experience performing security analysis responsibilities

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience with geospatial analysis software (ArcGIS, QGIS, Google Earth)

• Experience conducting OSINT research to identify threats to personnel, facilities, or information, using a variety of OSINT platforms

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including data analysis and pivot tables in Excel

• Understanding of security systems (access control, video surveillance, and fire systems)

• Experience working with mass communication tools

• Strong analytical, critical thinking, and report writing skills

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to assess, evaluate, and escalate situations for proper resolution

• Ability to prioritize workload by urgency and follow up on open projects and tasks through completion

• Ability to communicate professionally by phone and email with all levels of employees, visitors, and executive management

• Ability to learn, retain, and apply a variety of security concepts, information, and processes

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, team-focused, multi-tasking environment

• Active Secret clearance

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed, including occasional short-notice domestic travel

• Valid driver's license

• Possess or be eligible for a valid state security officer license

• Ability to pass background checks for access to SpaceX facilities on government installations

• Position is subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing

• Must be able to obtain and maintain an active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility. Note that an active clearance may provide the opportunity for you to work on sensitive SpaceX missions

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Base Build Superintendent, Malta, NY - Semiconductor
jobs.description:

This role is ideal for field leaders with experience managing large scale industrial, semiconductor, cleanroom, advanced manufacturing, mission critical, or complex MEP construction environments.
Preferred candidates will have demonstrated success overseeing base build scope, coordinating trade partners, driving safety and schedule performance, and supporting fast moving construction execution in technically complex facilities.
We are prioritizing candidates who can mobilize quickly. Per diem and mobilization packages are available for qualified candidates.
This is an onsite position in Malta, NY. Candidates must be local, open to relocation, or able to support the project onsite through an approved per diem arrangement.
Responsibilities

Lead base build construction execution across large scale semiconductor, cleanroom, industrial, advanced manufacturing, or mission critical project scopes.
Coordinate field activities across CSA, MEP, process utility, cleanroom, and specialty trade partners as needed.
Plan, organize, and supervise multiple phases of construction from field mobilization through construction, commissioning support, turnover, and closeout.
Maintain strong working relationships with internal project teams, subcontractors, trade partners, client representatives, and site stakeholders.

Promote a strong safety culture and continuous improvement mindset across all field activities.

Minimum 7 years of construction experience in large scale industrial, semiconductor, cleanroom, advanced manufacturing, life sciences, mission critical, or complex MEP environments.
Minimum 5 years of superintendent, field leadership, or construction supervision experience.
Base build construction experience strongly preferred.
Semiconductor, microelectronics, cleanroom, fab, subfab, data center, pharmaceutical, battery manufacturing, or advanced manufacturing project experience preferred.
Experience working directly with a general contractor, construction management firm, EPCM firm, or major mechanical, electrical, or specialty subcontractor.
Strong field coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple trades and shifting project priorities.

Ability to work onsite full time in Manassas, VA.
Ability to mobilize quickly strongly preferred.

Associate degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or related field preferred.
Equivalent field leadership experience will be considered in place of degree requirements.
 What We Offer
Opportunity to support a high profile semiconductor construction project in a growing advanced manufacturing market.
Immediate need with strong priority on candidates who can mobilize quickly.
Per-dem and mobilization packages are available for qualified candidates.
Competitive compensation and benefits package.
A field focused culture built on safety, accountability, collaboration, and execution.
This is a full-time position with World Wide Professional Solutions.
We offer excellent benefits including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short term disability, long term disability, and a company match retirement plan.

jobs.title: Regional Implementation Consultant, IDSR in Private Health Facilities
jobs.description:
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.

In partnership with the World Health Organization, Ethiopia’s Federal Ministry of Health (FMoH), and the Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI), Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) has been implementing Strengthening IDSR in Private Health Facilities. The project supports private health facilities to prevent, detect, and respond to public health threats while maintaining essential health services through core interventions of capacity building, longitudinal mentorship, supportive supervision, monitoring of key indicators, and data use to guide tailored interventions at the facility level.

Length of Engagement: 4 months. The contracting and commencement of the assignment are contingent on confirmation and availability of funding.

Level of Effort: Equivalent to FTE

Location: Assigned region of work. The regional consultants will be deployed through the following clustered approach:

• Southwest Ethiopia, Central Ethiopia, Sidama, and South Ethiopia

• Amhara, Tigray, and Afar

• Benishangul-Gumuz, Gambella, and Oromia

• Harari, Dire Dawa, and Somali

RTSL will cover travel costs, provided they are pre-approved by the contract manager and follow RTSL travel guidelines.

Job Structure: Independent Contractor

• Must have a registered business license to operate as a consultant in Ethiopia, or be willing to get one before the contract is signed.

Position Summary

This consultancy will focus on expanding the implementation into additional facilities and strengthening the ongoing implementation of the project in 13 regions. The Consultant will coordinate the selection and assessment of facilities, training of mentors and mentees (facility focal points), and support the execution of regular mentorship to make the facilities ready to safely prevent, detect, and respond to public health emergencies while maintaining essential healthcare services.

Five consultants are planned for this assignment: four regional implementation consultants and one data-management Consultant who will support implementation across all regions. Regional assignments will be confirmed based on project needs, consultant suitability, language and contextual considerations, and feasibility. Any subsequent reassignment to another region or group of facilities will be discussed and mutually agreed with the Consultant. The consultants will work closely with the Principal Manager for Prevent Epidemics and the Epidemic Ready Primary Health Care (ERPHC) Technical Advisor to achieve all deliverables.

Core Tasks and Activities

• Develop concept notes that outline the delivery approach and plans for the specific regions assigned to each Consultant by the ERPHC Technical Advisor.

• Work closely with the assigned regions’ health bureau/regional public health institute and EPHI to identify private facilities to enroll in the project.

• Train assessors on RTSL’s capacity assessment tools and approach, support the data collection process, and analyze each region’s health facility data.

• In collaboration with regional PHI/RHB, support the selection of mentors and mentees and facilitate their training in line with the RTSL training package.

• Support the mentorship process to enable enrolled private health facilities to achieve significant improvement from their respective baseline scores on PHEM and IPC indicators.

• Review the mentorship data submitted by mentors each month and give mentors feedback after each mentorship week so that course correction can be done promptly

• Conduct data-quality spot checks and supportive supervisions at selected facilities, as needed, to verify that mentorship data submitted by mentors matches facility records.

• Organize performance review meetings to track improvements and share lessons learned.

• Support national-level advocacy to strengthen the preparedness and readiness of private health facilities for public health emergencies.

• Perform additional activities within the scope of and relevant to the project as agreed with the ERPHC Technical Advisor. Where project needs may require reassignment to another region or group of facilities, the proposed reassignment will be discussed and mutually agreed with the Consultant, taking into account feasibility and implementation requirements.

Contract Deliverables

• Facility and mentor/mentee selection completed in the assigned region, and mentors and mentees (facility IPC/PHEM focal points) trained according to a phased implementation schedule agreed during onboarding.

• Baseline capacity assessments completed for enrolled facilities, followed by implementation of structured mentorship and collection, analysis, and visualization of mentorship data using RTSL tools.

• Monthly mentorship follow-up completed, including monitoring continuity of mentorship, data submission, and reporting, with feedback provided to mentors as needed.

• Regional engagement and buy-in secured from the respective Regional Public Health Institutes (RPHIs) and/or Regional Health Bureaus (RHBs) to support project implementation and sustainability.

• Endline assessment is completed. Significant improvement gains from baseline are achieved for all facilities in the overall PHEM and IPC scores. A 20% gain is ideal.

• The Independent Contractor will prepare and submit monthly progress reports summarizing implementation progress, mentorship performance, facility improvements, challenges, corrective actions, and next steps.

Contract Management

The Consultant will submit deliverables to the ERPHC Technical Advisor for review and acceptance. The Principal Manager for Prevent Epidemics will manage the contract and approve invoices.

Qualifications

• Advanced degree in public health, environmental health, Infection prevention and control, or health systems strengthening

• 5+ years of experience in IPC and PHEM program implementations. Experience in managing outbreaks is an advantage

• Experience working closely with EPHI and regional counterparts (RHBs/RPHIs)

• Strong organizational and management experience, with excellent communication skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the public health system

• Hands-on experience in PHEM and IPC training facilitation skills

• Experience with mentorship and supportive supervision

• Proficiency in MS Office applications, ODK, PHEM, DHIS2 and Power BI Dashboards

• Willingness and ability to travel to the assigned region or regional cluster and to discuss any subsequent reassignment that may be required based on project needs and feasibility. Estimated travel is 30% to 40%.

• Fluent in English and Amharic

Application Process

Interested candidates should submit their CV and a cover letter detailing their suitability for the role.

RTSL believes its programs are strengthened when they are developed and supported by individuals with diverse life experiences whose understanding of social and cultural issues can help make our work and workforce more inclusive. We encourage applications from and provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, ancestry, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, organ donor status, or status as a veteran. Resolve to Save Lives complies with all applicable US EEO laws.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
The Denver Broncos are one of the most popular franchises in all of sports. Whether judged by the measure of wins and championships, attendance, national television exposure or by the Broncos' reputation locally and throughout the NFL, there are few parallels in the world of professional sports. We are dedicated to being the best team to cheer for, play for, and work for across all of sports. We are looking for employees who are passionate about what they do, have fun doing it, and proud to represent the Denver Broncos Football Club and Empower Field at Mile High.

Job Summary

The Denver Broncos are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Systems Administrator to play a key role in supporting and advancing the technology infrastructure across the organization. This role will help the organization modernize its infrastructure by designing, implementing, and supporting secure, scalable, and resilient cloud solutions while continuing to provide expertise across traditional systems and platforms.

This is a hands-on technical role for someone who can help guide the organization’s transition from a primarily on-premises infrastructure model to a more modern cloud operating environment. The Senior Cloud Systems Administrator will contribute to cloud architecture and design decisions, establish operational standards and best practices, and help migrate applications, data, and workloads to cloud-based platforms.

The ideal candidate combines strong systems administration experience with practical cloud infrastructure expertise and sound architectural judgment. This individual will collaborate closely with Infrastructure, Network, IT Security, Data & Analytics, Enterprise Applications, Football Technology, and other business teams to ensure cloud and infrastructure solutions are secure, reliable, supportable, and aligned with organizational priorities.

This position reports to the IT Support Manager and is based on-site in Englewood, Colorado.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Architecture, Migration, and Modernization

• Design, implement, administer, and support cloud infrastructure and services, with an emphasis on security, scalability, availability, performance, and cost effectiveness

• Help define cloud architecture standards, reference designs, deployment patterns, and operational best practices that support the organization’s continued cloud adoption and maturity

• Partner with technology and business teams to evaluate existing applications, data, and infrastructure workloads and identify opportunities for cloud migration, modernization, or optimization

• Support the planning and execution of workload migrations from on-premises infrastructure to cloud platforms, including applications, data, compute, storage, and supporting services

• Collaborate with Football Analytics, Data & Analytics, and application teams to design and support cloud infrastructure for data processing, business intelligence, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and other compute-intensive workloads

• Evaluate cloud technologies and service providers, provide practical recommendations, and help ensure new solutions align with organizational architecture, security, support, and governance standards

Security, Governance, and Hybrid Operations

• Work closely with the Director of IT Security to develop and implement cloud governance standards, security controls, access models, monitoring requirements, configuration policies, and risk-management practices

• Administer and improve hybrid infrastructure across cloud and on-premises environments, including Windows and Linux servers, virtualization, storage, backup, disaster recovery, identity, and related enterprise technologies

• Contribute to the design and implementation of resilient cloud and hybrid architectures that support business continuity, disaster recovery, monitoring, observability, and operational reliability

• Monitor the health, performance, capacity, availability, security, and cost of cloud resources, and recommend improvements based on operational data and business requirements

• Apply automation, scripting, and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts to improve deployment consistency, reduce manual effort, and strengthen the reliability of cloud and systems operations

• Maintain working knowledge of Microsoft cloud and identity technologies, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, and Intune, to provide continuity and support across the systems administration team

• Provide advanced troubleshooting and escalation support for complex cloud, server, storage, identity, virtualization, and infrastructure-related issues

Collaboration, Documentation, and Continuous Improvement

• Develop and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, configuration standards, operating procedures, and support runbooks for cloud and hybrid infrastructure

• Collaborate with vendors, consultants, and service providers to ensure solutions are implemented effectively and services meet organizational expectations

• Stay current on cloud architecture, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, security, governance, and emerging technology practices

• Other duties as assigned

Minimum Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience

• 7+ years of experience in systems administration, cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, platform operations, or a similar technical role

• Hands-on experience designing, implementing, administering, and supporting infrastructure in cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments

• Strong expertise in at least one major cloud platform, with a broad understanding of cloud architecture principles and services across multiple cloud providers

• Experience supporting cloud adoption or modernization initiatives, including workload assessment, migration planning, infrastructure deployment, and post-migration operations

• Strong understanding of cloud architecture and operational practices, including scalability, resiliency, availability, security, monitoring, disaster recovery, automation, governance, and cost management

• Experience supporting Windows and Linux servers, virtualization platforms, enterprise storage, backup and recovery systems, and related infrastructure technologies

• Working knowledge of cloud networking, identity and access management, role-based access controls, security controls, logging, monitoring, and hybrid connectivity

• Familiarity with infrastructure automation, scripting, and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts using tools and languages such as PowerShell, Python, Terraform, Bicep, or comparable technologies

• Experience with Microsoft cloud and identity technologies, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, and Intune

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose complex issues across cloud and traditional infrastructure environments

• Strong project management, documentation, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and support multiple initiatives

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Ability to work independently, make sound technical decisions, collaborate across teams, and appropriately communicate or escalate risks and issues

• High degree of discretion, integrity, professionalism, and accountability

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience migrating applications, data, compute, storage, or analytics workloads from on-premises infrastructure to cloud platforms

• Experience designing or supporting cloud environments for data analytics, business intelligence, artificial intelligence, machine learning, or high-performance computing workloads

• Experience establishing cloud platform standards, governance controls, account or subscription structures, tagging standards, monitoring practices, and cost-management procedures

• Familiarity with cloud landing zones, cloud financial management practices, DevOps methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment processes

• Cloud or infrastructure certifications from a major cloud platform provider or another recognized industry organization

• Experience supporting high-availability, event-driven, professional sports, entertainment, hospitality, venue, or similarly demanding operational environments

Time Commitment

Ability to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours as needed to support games, events, technology initiatives, maintenance windows, and urgent operational requirements.

Compensation

In accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the expected salary range for this position is $90,000 - $105,000.

Benefits

The Denver Broncos Football Club offers a competitive benefits package to eligible employees. Benefit offerings may include medical, dental, and vision insurance; flexible spending accounts; company-paid life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid parental leave; tickets to Broncos home games; NFL apparel discounts; and other employee perks.

This posting is anticipated to close on December 18th, 2026 at 11:59 PM. Applications may be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the employer reserves the right to close the application window early if a qualified candidate pool is established.

jobs.title: Program Management Intern
jobs.description:
At REGENT, we’re on a mission to revolutionize regional transportation between coastal cities. We're not just building vehicles, we're creating a new category of transportation: the Seaglider. These groundbreaking wing-in-ground-effect craft travel just above the water’s surface, combining the speed of an airplane with the low operating costs of a boat. Capable of 180 miles at 180 mph on today's battery tech (and up to 400 miles with next-gen batteries), Seagliders will unlock fast, affordable, and sustainable coastal transit for passengers and cargo - connecting cities, islands, and communities like never before.

Backed by leading investors and powered by a team of passionate, forward-thinking engineers, builders, and operators, we’re now scaling from a breakthrough prototype to full production - and building the team to make it happen.


ROLE OVERVIEW

REGENT's Paladin test program is where engineering development, vehicle maintenance, and on-water testing all converge, and this internship sits right at the center of it. You'll build and maintain the schedule that the entire program runs on, working directly with the vehicle and the test team rather than tracking progress from behind a desk. This is a DPM-style role in the truest sense: the milestone tracker isn't a document you update once a week, it's something you actively manage so that engineers, maintenance crews, and test leads are always working from the same plan.

You'll join the Engineering & Technology Program Management team, a group that treats planning and tracking as real engineering work, not administrative overhead. Along the way, you'll be taught to see cost and schedule as engineering variables in their own right, a lens that's genuinely valuable whether you're headed toward program leadership or engineering management down the road. 

If you're someone who gets energized by being in the middle of the action, who sees a plan as something to steer rather than observe, and who wants hands-on exposure to how a real flight test program comes together, we'd love to have you on the team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the Master Schedule: You'll build and keep current the milestone tracker that ties together engineering, maintenance, and on-water testing for Paladin. This is a living document you actively manage, not something you dust off weekly.

 - Get Hands-On with Paladin: You'll spend real time with the vehicle and the test team, not just behind a laptop. Being in the mix is how you'll understand what's actually happening on the ground, not just what's on paper.

 - Support Vehicle Maintenance: You'll pitch in on maintenance work between test runs, giving you direct insight into what keeps Paladin flight-ready. That proximity to the vehicle is what makes your tracking actually useful.

 - Know What Complete Really Means: You'll learn to distinguish between a part being ordered, installed, and tested, so your schedule reflects reality rather than optimism. That distinction is what keeps the whole program honest.

 - Keep the Team Aligned: You'll make sure engineering, maintenance, and test ops are working from the same set of assumptions about what's next. When the plan stays current, the whole program moves faster together.

 - Launch Your Own Initiatives: You'll take on program initiatives you can plan, manage, and see through to completion. By the end of your term, you'll be able to point to specific projects you drove start to finish.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Scheduling Tool Fluency: You're comfortable in Smartsheet, MS Project, Jira, or a similar tool. The specific platform matters less than being able to hit the ground organizing the program instead of learning software.

 - Self-Directed Ownership: You can build and maintain a tracker across multiple workstreams without someone feeding you updates. You treat the plan as something to manage proactively, not react to.

 - Mechanical Curiosity: Hands-on experience with engines, hulls, or mechanical systems, whether through marine, automotive, or other tinkering, gives you a head start here. A meaningful part of this role involves real vehicle maintenance support.

 - Technical Grounding: You understand what an engineering or test milestone actually means when it's marked complete. That understanding is what keeps a schedule accurate instead of just looking fine on paper.

 - Comfort Across Contexts: You're just as comfortable updating a tracker as you are standing next to the vehicle with the test team. You don't need the two worlds kept separate.

 - Natural Organizational Instinct: You bring structure to dynamic, fast-moving work without slowing it down. You see a plan as something worth actively shaping.
   
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Collaborative Team Player: You believe that great things happen when teams work together. You communicate effectively and collaborate with engineers, stakeholders, and other cross-functional teams to align on goals and move projects forward. You bring people together, ensuring that everyone is on the same page and moving towards a shared vision.

 - Creative Problem Solver: You thrive on tackling complex challenges and finding innovative solutions. Whether you're resolving installation challenges, debugging elusive electrical issues, or adapting on the fly during integration and test, you bring a practical, inventive mindset to every problem. You don't just patch issues - you improve processes, anticipate downstream impacts, and help turn one-off fixes into scalable solutions that raise the bar for future builds.

 - Adaptable & Agile: In a fast-paced, ever-evolving startup environment, you quickly adapt to changing priorities and requirements. You approach challenges with a calm, resilient mindset, and know how to pivot and adjust your approach as needed, ensuring that progress continues without missing a beat.

 - Innovative Mindset: You're driven by curiosity and a passion for technology. You're passionate about driving continuous improvement, embracing new technologies and methodologies to enhance efficiency, quality, and team performance.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive compensation

 - Housing Stipend available for those temporarily moving to join our team

 - Daily, free catered lunches

 - Learning & professional development opportunities

 - Meaningful projects that make an impact

 - Mentorship & guidance from experienced team members

If you’re ready to take on an exciting challenge, grow with us, and make a lasting impact, we want to hear from you. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, but you see yourself contributing to our mission, we encourage you to apply! We value diverse skillsets and experiences and believe in the potential of passionate individuals to make a big impact.

Equal Opportunity Employer

REGENT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Product Brand Designer on Harvey Creative Studio, you’ll shape how people experience Harvey’s brand, both inside the product and wherever we introduce it to the world. You’re an art director and idea generator who sees the product as a creative canvas: agent identities, empty states, welcome moments, launches, and the small details that make Harvey feel unmistakably Harvey.

You’ll develop concepts that challenge what legal software is expected to look and feel like, then carry them from early ideas through storyboards, visual systems, and finished work. You’ll partner closely with product designers to understand how features work, while bringing a distinct brand point of view to how they’re expressed. You’ll also turn product launches into compelling stories across campaigns, landing pages, and motion.

We’re looking for a brand designer with exceptional taste, bold and disruptive ideas, and the craft to make them real. You understand digital products well enough to design within them, and you know when to push beyond convention to create something memorable, credible, and distinctly Harvey.







WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Storyboarding & Styleframes: Turn product strategy and feature detail into storyboards and styleframes that carry the launch story

 - Abstracted UI: Design abstracted UI that shows how Harvey works without recreating every screen

 - Launch & Marketing Assets: Build marketing assets for launches, landing pages, and events from in-progress product designs

 - Video & Demo Production: Own the storyboard stage of product videos and demos, and keep visuals accurate when features and narratives shift late

 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Bring Product Design, Creative Studio, and Brand partner teams into alignment—communicating proactively, navigating differing perspectives, and making thoughtful calls where product and brand overlap







WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 7+ years across product and brand design, with a portfolio that shows shipped product work next to storyboards, styleframes, or launch assets

 - Exceptional brand craft in composition, typography, color, and visual storytelling, with the ability to distill a complex feature into one clear idea

 - AI prototyping experience to explore and produce creative work, including interactive prototypes built with AI-assisted tools

 - A strong creative point of view and a track record of ideas that challenge convention

 - Understanding of product design skills: interaction design, flows and states, prototyping, and close work with PMs and engineers

 - Hands-on design system experience in Figma, including components, auto layout, and variables

jobs.description:

Reports to: Senior Director, Asynchronous Care
Job Type: Full-time W2

Overview

Midi Health is on a mission to redesign care for women in midlife - and we're growing fast. As our asynchronous operations scale, we need to ensure our Medical and Practice Assistants have the training, tools, and feedback they need to consistently deliver high-quality work.

We're looking for a Senior Operations Manager, Performance & Enablement to build and own the programs that help our frontline teams perform at their best.

This person will design, establish, and own the performance measurement, operational QA, and training programs that support Medical and Practice Assistants across Async Operations. You'll set consistent standards across teams, build scalable systems for evaluating frontline execution, and give Managers the tools and insights they need to identify gaps, coach effectively, and drive measurable performance improvements.

This role goes beyond traditional quality assurance or training. You'll connect performance data, quality findings, and frontline observations to diagnose complex performance challenges, distinguish between individual execution and broader operational issues, and develop targeted interventions that lead to sustained improvement.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience in frontline quality, performance management, and training, with strong analytical judgment and a track record of building scalable programs. They're comfortable operating independently, influencing leaders across teams, and using modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, develop resources, and improve how frontline teams work.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who enjoys building programs from the ground up and turning performance insights into meaningful operational improvements.

The goal: Build a consistently high-performing MA workforce that delivers accurate, timely, and high-quality patient support at scale.

You won't just measure frontline performance — you'll build the systems that help our teams continuously improve.

What you'll do

MA Quality & Performance

• Design and own a scalable framework for evaluating MA performance consistently across Async Operations.

• Establish performance measurement standards and reporting that give Managers actionable visibility into individual and team performance.

• Bring together quality, productivity, and adherence metrics to create a comprehensive view of frontline performance.

• Design and maintain operational QA scorecards, evaluation rubrics, sampling methodologies, and reporting frameworks.

• Establish consistent approaches for evaluating whether MAs follow established workflows, SOPs, and service standards accurately and effectively.

• Define and measure performance across accuracy, completeness, responsiveness, communication, resolution, and process adherence.

• Lead calibration processes across teams to ensure quality standards are interpreted and applied consistently.

• Identify high performers, recurring performance gaps, and opportunities for targeted coaching and development.

• Equip Managers with actionable performance insights, coaching frameworks, and resources to drive accountability and improvement.

• Own the effectiveness of performance measurement and QA programs, continuously refining them based on operational results and frontline feedback.

Training & Frontline Enablement

• Design, establish, and own scalable onboarding and continuous-learning programs for Medical and Practice Assistants across Async Operations.

• Develop training strategies, curricula, onboarding materials, job aids, and ongoing learning resources that support consistent frontline execution.

• Identify recurring knowledge and skill gaps through quality reviews, performance data, and frontline observations.

• Translate performance gaps into targeted training, retraining, and reinforcement programs.

• Establish processes to keep training materials current as workflows, SOPs, tools, and expectations evolve.

• Partner with subject-matter experts to ensure training reflects established operational and clinical standards.

• Develop tools and resources that enable Managers to reinforce expectations and coach their teams effectively.

• Build mechanisms for ongoing learning, knowledge retention, and skill development beyond initial onboarding.

• Define measures of training effectiveness and continuously improve programs based on their impact on frontline quality, consistency, and performance.

Performance Insights & Continuous Improvement

• Independently analyze complex quality and performance trends to identify recurring execution gaps, root causes, and improvement opportunities.

• Identify patterns across quality reviews, patient feedback, repeat contacts, escalations, and operational performance.

• Distinguish between problems caused by knowledge gaps, individual execution, unclear processes, or system limitations, and recommend appropriate interventions. ● Partner with Operations Managers to establish coaching, training, and performance improvement priorities based on data and frontline observations.

• Identify systemic workflow and technology issues affecting frontline execution and translate findings into actionable recommendations for the appropriate owners. ● Ensure operational changes are reflected in training, quality measurement, and performance expectations.

• Establish feedback loops between frontline teams, Managers, and operational leaders to drive continuous improvement.

• Measure the effectiveness of coaching, training, and performance interventions, refining approaches to achieve sustained improvements.

• Advise Async Operations leadership on frontline performance trends, emerging risks, and opportunities to improve consistency, efficiency, and patient experience.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Serve as a strategic partner to Async Operations Managers, providing the performance frameworks, insights, and enablement resources needed to lead high-performing teams. ● Collaborate with Analytics & Workforce Planning to align performance reporting, productivity measurement, and operational insights.

• Partner with Operations, Systems Operations, and Product to ensure workflow and technology changes are incorporated into frontline training and performance expectations.

• Work with Clinical leadership and Clinical Quality to ensure training and evaluation reflect approved clinical protocols and escalation standards.

• Influence performance and enablement priorities across teams, establishing consistent standards while adapting programs to the needs of different workflows.

• Communicate complex performance findings and recommendations clearly to operational leaders, helping translate insights into measurable improvements.

What you will need to succeed

• 7+ years of experience in Operations, Quality Assurance, Training & Enablement, Performance Management, or a related field, including demonstrated experience designing and scaling frontline performance or training programs.

• Deep expertise in frontline quality assurance, performance measurement, coaching frameworks, and operational accountability.

• Experience designing and implementing QA scorecards, evaluation rubrics, sampling methodologies, calibration processes, and performance reporting.

• Demonstrated success building scalable onboarding, training, and continuous-learning programs for operational teams.

• Strong analytical judgment and data fluency, with the ability to independently evaluate complex performance trends, identify root causes, and develop actionable recommendations.

• Comfort leveraging modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, develop training resources, evaluate performance trends, and improve operational processes.

• Experience establishing performance standards and measurement frameworks across multiple teams or workflows.

• Ability to distinguish between individual performance gaps, training needs, process problems, and system limitations.

• Strong business judgment and ability to connect frontline performance to operational efficiency, service levels, and patient experience.

• Experience influencing frontline Managers and operational leaders to drive improvements without directly managing their employees.

• Strong program management skills, with demonstrated ability to independently design, implement, and continuously improve complex operational programs.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to translate complex expectations and performance findings into clear, actionable training and coaching resources.

• Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where workflows, tools, and organizational needs are evolving.

• Bias toward action: You don't just identify performance gaps — you build the tools, training, and feedback mechanisms that help teams improve.

Bonus: Experience in healthcare operations, medical practices, customer support, or other high-volume service environments.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

• New York, NY | New Jersey | Connecticut

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Majors Account Executive to join our Enterprise/Field Sales team. In this pivotal role, you will help lead Cloudflare’s strategic customer engagements, securing and expanding platform partnerships across key accounts. The ideal candidate brings strong sales leadership, a deep understanding of enterprise architecture (business, data, applications, technology), and the ability to articulate how Cloudflare integrates into modern cloud operating models.

As a Senior Majors Account Executive, you will position Cloudflare’s Developer Platform, Application Security, SASE/Zero Trust Services, and Network and Content Delivery offerings against incumbents. You will drive predictable sales performance, foster healthy pipeline growth, and deliver on revenue objectives. You will act as a trusted advisor, educating customers and partners on Cloudflare’s evolving product ecosystem and security capabilities. This role involves leveraging executive sponsorship programs, partnering with senior leaders (including CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs), and collaborating with cross-functional teams to navigate and successfully close complex customer opportunities.

Responsibilities

• Strategic Revenue Leadership: Develop and execute account plans to meet and exceed revenue goals by structuring enterprise-grade platform partnerships within key accounts.

• Predictable Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain accurate sales forecasting and proactive pipeline management, sharing insights to support broader sales strategy.

• Enterprise Architecture Alignment: Demonstrate a strong understanding of customer Enterprise Architecture across business, data, applications, and technology pillars, connecting Cloudflare solutions directly to customer business outcomes.

• Executive & C-Suite Engagement: Manage complex customer engagements across multiple business units, building strong relationships with executive sponsors and C-level stakeholders.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with cross-functional teams—including Product Managers and executive leadership—to advance strategic deals and resolve operational friction.

• Digital Transformation Guidance: Serve as a key advisor on digital transformation, helping customers navigate market shifts and position Cloudflare as a core strategic partner.

• Clear Communication & Feedback: Connect insights across global departments to deliver clear messaging, provide constructive feedback, and support continuous team growth.

• Long-Term Strategic Vision: Make balanced decisions aligned with long-term organizational value, building trust through open communication and knowledge sharing.

• Goal Setting & Operational Efficiency: Partner with teams to set clear metrics, address operational roadblocks, and improve cross-departmental workflows.

• Collaborative Problem Solving: Proactively identify customer and internal needs, fostering positive change and contributing to continuous team improvement.

• Inclusive Leadership: Champion diverse perspectives to solve complex business challenges and support a supportive, forward-thinking team environment.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Demonstrated track record of success in B2B enterprise sales, closing multi-year, complex technology agreements demonstrating a track record of consistently exceeding quota and closing transformative platform deals.

• Deep understanding of enterprise cloud platforms, network security, and modern IT architecture.

• Proven capability to align solutions with customer Enterprise Architecture (Business, Data, Applications, Technology) and enterprise business models mapping Cloudflare solutions to complex business models and modern cloud operating environments.

• Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and managing executive sponsorship initiatives.

• Strong collaborative skills with experience working alongside cross-functional leadership teams.

• Familiarity with digital transformation trends and the ability to translate market insights into customer solutions.

• Strong presentation, negotiation, and written communication skills across technical and business audiences.

• Thoughtful decision-making approach focused on sustainable, long-term business success.

• Experience setting clear performance indicators and facilitating cross-team alignment.

• Proficiency with enterprise sales tools and methodologies (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, MEDDPICC, or similar frameworks).

• Relevant professional experience in technology sales or enterprise consulting; advanced degrees or continuous technical learning are welcomed.

• Willingness to travel as needed to foster strong customer and internal team relationships.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

• For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $360,000- $400,000 (base/variable)

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

Financial Benefits

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

Time Off

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

OUR TEAM'S VISION:

At Illumio, our engineering team thrives on visionary leadership, customer-centric innovation, and relentless execution. We tackle the most critical and complex challenge in modern cybersecurity: stopping malicious actors and containing cyber threats before lateral movement turns an attack into a widespread business catastrophe.

As an engineer here, you will design, build, and optimize massively scalable distributed systems that power the future of zero trust, segmentation, and automated breach containment. Working across a high-performance stack—from operating system internals to highly available multi-cloud scaling and immersive data visualizations—you will solve complex networking, massive real-time telemetry processing challenges.

If you are eager to conquer deep systems-level problems, build fault-tolerant software at a massive scale, and create a safer digital future for the world’s largest enterprises, join our mission and engineer the defense systems of tomorrow.




YOUR IMPACT:

As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will contribute to building scalable, performant, and intuitive user-facing applications while partnering across engineering, product, and design to deliver seamless end-to-end experiences. You will own features through the full development lifecycle—from design and implementation to deployment and operational excellence while helping shape the future of Illumio’s user experience and platform capabilities.

 - Design, develop, and deliver full-stack features across frontend and backend systems, taking ownership from concept through production deployment

 - Build scalable and responsive web applications using modern frontend frameworks and distributed backend services

 - Contribute to architecture decisions, including frontend infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, build systems, and application design patterns

 - Own end-to-end quality, including unit, functional, and integration testing, ensuring robust and resilient software delivery

 - Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Design, and backend teams to refine requirements and deliver high-impact features

 - Optimize user workflows and application performance, ensuring accessibility, responsiveness, and usability across platforms

 - Develop and integrate APIs and services to enable seamless communication across distributed systems

 - Monitor application performance, define metrics, and proactively identify and resolve production issues

 - Continuously improve code quality, maintainability, and developer experience through best practices and tooling

 - 3–5+ years of professional experience in full-stack or UI-focused software engineering

 - Strong frontend experience with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3

 - Experience building backend services and APIs using Node.js, TypeScript, or similar technologies

 - Solid understanding of RESTful API design and distributed system communication patterns

 - Experience with modern build systems, CI/CD pipelines, and frontend tooling

 - Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and collaborative development workflows

 - Understanding of performance optimization, browser rendering, and debugging techniques

 - Knowledge of testing frameworks and best practices across frontend and backend layers

 - Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (Master’s preferred)




BONUS POINTS:

 - Experience building microservices or service-oriented architectures

 - Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.0+) and inclusive design practices

 - Experience with frontend performance monitoring and metrics (e.g., INP, latency optimization)

 - Exposure to large-scale SaaS platforms or cybersecurity products

 - Experience working closely with design systems and component libraries

jobs.title: Farming Rotational Associate (Edinburg, TX)
jobs.description:

Wonderful Citrus has launched its Farming Rotational Program in Edinburg, Texas. This one-year program offers hands-on experience across multiple departments within Farming, providing participants with a well-rounded understanding of agricultural operations. The program is designed to develop the skills and knowledge needed to pursue a supervisory career in agriculture, with the potential for full-time employment upon completion, based on business needs.

• Rotate through all areas of the Farming division, including but not limited to Nursery Operation, Shops, Pest Control, Spray Operations, General Cultural Farming.

jobs.title: Director, Development Data Strategy & Analytics
jobs.description:
At Rowan Digital Infrastructure, we are transforming data center delivery for speed and scale. Our mission is to deliver best-in-class data center solutions to hyperscale customers who share our commitment to sustainability, and to do so with an unwavering focus on efficiency, quality, and flexibility.  Our data center solutions are tailored to our customers’ needs and delivered by our exceptional end-to-end team. Rowan is assembling a strategic portfolio of data center sites in Tier 1 markets across the United States at various stages of development, and we’re looking for incredible and passionate people to help us advance our company and our commitment to building a more sustainable future.   



Rowan is backed by Quinbrook, a leading investor in the energy transition, and Blackstone, the world’s largest alternative asset manager.  

 

Ready to join us in transforming the future of data centers and sustainability? Apply now to explore exciting career opportunities at Rowan Digital Infrastructure and be a part of our mission to revolutionize data center delivery.  

 

Role Summary

Rowan Digital Infrastructure is seeking a Director, Development Data Strategy & Analytics to define and deliver the data strategy for the Development organization. This leader will turn Development priorities into a practical roadmap and own the data models, definitions, pipelines, reporting, and AI-enabled decision support that give stakeholder teams across Development a consistent, trusted view of the development lifecycle.



This is a hands-on leadership role combining data strategy, architecture, and delivery. The Director will build the data foundation in close partnership with IT, which owns enterprise applications, identity and access, security, and vendor management, and will coordinate with other functional leaders across the company so that tools, data, and hiring are shared rather than duplicated. Success means trusted information, less manual reporting and rework, and tools employees use to manage project progress, risks, and commitments.



Travel: Ability to travel up to 30% for project site visits and company gatherings.

Location: Denver, CO or Seattle, WA (3-day hybrid in-office role)

Compensation: $180K - $215K (Offers Bonus)



Essential Responsibilities

 - Set data strategy and drive results. Translate Development’s priorities into a data strategy, prioritized roadmap, delivery milestones, and resource plans. Lead requirements discovery, pilots, training, and adoption; measure reporting effort, rework, data quality, and usage to guide improvements and demonstrate business value

 - Build and lead the team. Hire, coach, and develop a focused team of data engineering, analytics, and business intelligence talent, in line with the company’s approved headcount and organizational plan. Set clear ownership, review practices, and delivery expectations

 - Design and implement the Development data foundation. Define the data architecture, models, and transformation logic that bring Rowan’s source systems together for analysis. Evaluate tools and build-versus-buy options, and contribute hands-on engineering with maintainable development practices

 - Ensure trusted data. Establish data ownership, shared definitions, validation, lineage, reconciliation, and freshness standards. Preserve source history and publish validated data. Monitor data quality and cost visibility, and agree on support expectations and escalation paths for the data products delivered

 - Deliver reporting and decision support. Partner with stakeholder teams across Development to provide consistent views of pipeline health, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and obligations. Reduce manual consolidation for business reviews and board and investor materials

 - Develop AI and automation use cases for Development. Identify and deliver high-value uses of approved AI tools to search company information, answer questions from validated data, draft material for review, and automate routine workflows. Establish responsible-use practices, including permissions, traceable sources, evaluation, and human review

 - Partner across the company. Work closely with IT, which owns enterprise applications, security, and access, and with other functional leaders to align on standards, reuse existing tools and data, and avoid duplicated systems and effort



Education Skills and Experience

 - Bachelor’s degree in computer information technology, computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

 - 10+ years of technical software development experience, including 3+ years of people management experience leading technical teams. Experience building and scaling a technical team from the ground up, including recruiting, developing talent, and establishing team practices

 - Experience translating complex business needs into architecture and a delivery roadmap, coordinating across technical and nontechnical teams, and owning implementation through adoption and ongoing operation

 - Strong hands-on knowledge of SQL, Python, data modeling, relational databases, data warehouses, and reliable data pipelines, with the ability to review code, evaluate designs, and troubleshoot data issues

 - Experience with cloud data architecture, preferably AWS, including services such as S3 and Redshift and orchestration or processing tools such as Airflow and Spark. Comparable cloud experience is relevant. Experience working within an enterprise IT organization’s security, identity, and access standards

 - Experience with the software development lifecycle for data work, including version control, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD. Experience establishing data validation, governance, and access policies in partnership with IT. Familiarity with AI or machine learning platforms and the controls needed to use business data responsibly

 - Clear communication, sound prioritization, practical change management, and a collaborative approach to working across departments and with IT



Nice to Have

 - Experience in data center infrastructure, capacity planning, energy, construction, or another complex physical infrastructure environment is strongly preferred

 - Sustainability analytics and customer reporting experience are valuable

 - Experience working at a cloud provider or partnering with scientists to translate research, models, or analytical requirements into production data and software systems

Fueled by Excellence & Collaboration

At Rowan, we are a distributed team united by a common mission to transform data center delivery. Across our two offices, we offer a hybrid work environment supported by teamwork, technology, and in-office gathering time to help you be successful. We are headquartered in downtown Denver, Colorado and have an office in Seattle, Washington. Our team of talented and passionate individuals is spread out across the U.S.



Here to support you

At Rowan, we want to make sure you can do great work. We offer competitive benefits focused on helping you be and achieve your best.

 - Hybrid working environment

 - Team building and educational opportunities

 - Generous benefits package including robust health benefits and a 401(k)-company contribution

 - Unlimited PTO

 - RTD ECO pass or parking reimbursement

 - Competitive compensation, bonus, and an incentive plan

 - Relocating for this role? We offer relocation assistance on a case-by-case basis to help make your transition smooth



Equal Opportunity Employer

Rowan Digital is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and celebrate diversity in all aspects of our workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. We strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.
