jobs.title: Security Protective Operations Center Operator (Night Shift)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SECURITY PROTECTIVE OPERATIONS CENTER OPERATOR (NIGHT SHIFT)

SpaceX is looking for experienced operators for its SpaceX Protective Operations Center (SPOC), its global 24/7 monitoring and incident response coordination center. The selected candidate will be a dedicated security professional with a demonstrated ability to work both independently and as a member of a team in a fast-paced high-tech environment. As a SPOC Operator, you will coordinate day-to-day and incident response logistics, while providing support to security officers. SPOC operators will also act as a point-of-contact for matters relating to each area facility and, as such, must coordinate closely with all operational, management, and administrative sections for area office. Areas of responsibility include: event/incident monitoring, camera/security alarm monitoring, video review, dispatching, coordinating allocation of resources, and incident response management and communications.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Investigate incidents thoroughly, coordinate information gathering with responding security personnel, and create accurate and timely incident reports

• Notifying and coordinating with onsite first responders, stake holders and local law enforcement during any incident/emergency

• Monitor, analyze, and report on daily global incidents that may impact SpaceX employees or offices, and escalate accordingly to security management, and subsequently to other key stake holders within the company

• Responsible for monitoring access control alarms, video surveillance equipment, fire alarm systems, and dispatching resources to investigate any anomalous alarms and activity with security personnel, uniformed security officers, and other departments as appropriate

• Prioritize and process all incoming security reports and requests via radio, phone, and support ticket, and track all associated shift activity accordingly

• Identify and communicate critical incidents or events according to established notification procedures including senior leadership, internal stakeholders and external partners as appropriate, and coordinate incident response logistics, provide direction and response instructions to uniformed security forces, and create accurate and timely incident reports

• Assist with video surveillance system reviews for key stake holders and internal investigations

• Ensure thorough and current understanding of security operations center roles and responsibilities, applicable SpaceX policies/procedures, contract security policies/procedures and all applicable security work instructions

• Maintain a positive, professional environment in full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies/procedures and act to ensure all SpaceX personnel understand and comply with all applicable security work instructions

• Perform additional duties as assigned or required by Security Leadership or SpaceX management

• Active monitoring and over watch of the Hawthorne headquarters and of satellite offices and facilities

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 2+ years of experience as a global security operations center (GSOC) operator or corporate security role; or 2+ years of law enforcement or military experience

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor’s degree

• Ability to communicate professionally and effectively via telephone and email and interact with all levels of employees and visitors

• Strong focus on attention to detail

• Work well in a fast-paced and multi-tasking team focused environment

• Learn, retain, and apply a variety of security related concepts, information and processes

• Understanding of security systems (access control, video surveillance, and fire systems)

• Ability to prioritize workload based on urgency; appropriately delegate and oversee tasks, and communicate to a range of audiences including to executive management

• Perform continuous follow-up on pending/open projects and tasks through completion

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills

• Experience working closely with mass communication tools

• Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, specifically data analysis and use of pivot tables using Excel

• Ability to assess, evaluate, and effectively escalate situations for proper resolution

• Active secret security clearance

• Experience with geospatial analysis software (ArcGIS, QGIS, Google Earth)

• Proficiency conducting open source intelligence (OSINT) research to identify threats to personnel, facilities, or information

• Superior report writing skills

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to work the following shift: Night shift: (5PM - 5AM)

• Availability to work any schedule needed, including, but not limited to: overtime, nights, weekends and rotating schedules

• Position is subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol testing

• Ability to pass Air Force background checks for Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg

• Valid driver’s license

• Possess or be eligible for a valid state security officer license

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Business Data Manager
jobs.description:
Western Digital is expanding its Supply Chain Transformation organization to establish a scalable business data management capability. We are seeking a Business Data Manager to define the business ownership, standards, health measures and remediation accountability needed for reliable orchestration, analytics, automation and decision-making across the end-to-end Supply Chain.

You will map data domains and ownership, identify critical data elements, define practical quality standards and coordinate issue resolution across functions, working in close partnership with Business Process Owners, Data Stewards and IT teams. As the capability matures, you will help scale consistent governance practices across the end-to-end Supply Chain.

What You’ll Do

• Lead business data management and governance for critical Supply Chain transformation initiatives
• Define and maintain the inventory of Supply Chain data domains, critical data objects, key attributes, business definitions and systems of record.
• Map accountable data owners and stewards; establish clear decision rights, stewardship expectations, review cadences and escalation paths.
• Define business data standards and quality rules for completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, validity and fitness for business use.
• Establish data-health scorecards and measures that make trends, material risks and remediation needs visible to business and transformation leadership.
• Coordinate root-cause analysis, prioritization and resolution of cross-functional data issues based on business impact and decision criticality.
• Partner with functional Business Process Owners and the Business Process Architect so process, capability and solution designs include explicit data requirements, ownership and controls.
• Partner with IT Data Governance, architecture and engineering teams on technical data models, lineage, integration, platforms, automation and monitoring while preserving clear business ownership of meaning and quality.
• Define and govern master, reference and transactional data requirements across planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, fulfillment, product and related functions.
• Improve Product and BOM data governance by clarifying distributed ownership, lifecycle responsibilities, planning-data needs and cross-functional handoffs.
• Ensure data requirements and quality controls support Kinaxis testing, validation, optimization, go-live readiness and sustained planning operations.
• Enable decision-ready data for analytics, Command Center use cases, automation and AI by defining business context, acceptable quality thresholds and responsible-use requirements.
• Develop reusable governance methods, templates, issue-management routines and stewardship practices that can scale across Supply Chain domains.
• Promote proactive data ownership and prevention, helping shift the organization from reactive cleanup to sustainable data management.

Required qualifications

• Significant experience in supply chain, operations, data management, data governance, master data, analytics or a closely related field.
• Practical understanding of Supply Chain data used across planning, product, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics or fulfillment processes.
• Demonstrated experience establishing data ownership, stewardship, business definitions, critical data elements, data-quality rules or issue-resolution governance.
• Experience partnering across business functions and IT to translate business data needs into governed, technology-enabled solutions.
• Ability to analyze complex data-quality problems, distinguish symptoms from root causes and lead cross-functional remediation.
• Strong facilitation, stakeholder leadership and executive communication skills, including the ability to clarify accountability across distributed organizations.
• Experience supporting a major business transformation, enterprise application implementation, analytics program or data-governance initiative.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience in a global, vertically integrated manufacturing, semiconductor or high-technology environment.
• Experience with Kinaxis Maestro or another advanced planning system, ERP, PLM, manufacturing systems or connected data platforms.
• Experience governing product, item, BOM, demand, supply, capacity, supplier, inventory, logistics or reference data.
• Familiarity with business glossaries, data catalogs, lineage, master data management and data-quality monitoring.
• Experience enabling Command Centers, Control Towers, operational analytics, automation or AI use cases with governed Supply Chain data.
• Relevant credential or formal training in data governance, data management, analytics, supply chain or process improvement.

jobs.title: Medical Science Liaison
jobs.description:
Alumis Inc. is a precision medicines company with the mission to transform the lives of patients with autoimmune diseases. Even with treatment innovations of the last two decades, many patients with immunologic conditions continue to suffer - our goal is to fundamentally change the outcomes for these patients.

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a strategic, field-based, scientific expert focused on developing and maintaining collaborative relationships with Dermatology key opinion leaders (KOLs) and other healthcare professionals (HCPs). The MSL will engage with HCPs to support trial enrollment, educate on disease states and clinical trial outcomes, and inform internal strategy by gathering insights and representing the voice of KOLs and HCPs. MSLs strive to optimize patient care through KOL engagement and collaboration.

• Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with KOLs in the Dermatology community.

• Utilize systems to strategically map, identify, profile and prioritize thought leaders in line with the medical strategy

• Effectively develop and manage your assigned geography with an entrepreneurial approach

• Attend and report on assigned medical conferences

• Collaborate with KOLs on medical affairs initiatives including publications, advisory boards, medical education opportunities, training, and speaker development

• Serve as scientific resource to external disease experts and internal stakeholders

• Support the medical community with up-to-date medical information, robust disease expertise, and product information

• Maintain effective and appropriate communication among internal stakeholders while maintaining full compliance with relevant requirements

• Support commercial activities where appropriate

Qualifications:

Requirements

• Advanced degree in scientific, clinical, or medical-related discipline (PharmD, PhD, MSN, DNP, PA-C, MPH, etc).

• At least 3 years of experience in MSL role, and must include experience as a Dermatology MSL. Launch, pre-launch, psoriasis, and/or Rheumatology experience is a plus

• Must have well-established networks and active relationships with KOLs in Dermatology and in the territory.

• Candidate must understand compliance considerations and demonstrate ability to work compliantly

• Ability and willingness to travel ~50%. Required travel to medical meetings, team meetings, and other group meetings (will require some weekends). This may vary depending on business needs

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Excellent interpersonal and engagement skills

• Energetically embraces responsibilities, demonstrates ability to achieve goals

• Demonstrates strong initiative as a flexible and proactive

• Ability to thrive in ambiguous situations

• Solution-oriented approach

• Exhibits excellent time management and ability to prioritize

• Demonstrated ability to work independently

• Experience in a start-up environment is a plus

This position is primarily remote.

The salary range for this position is $195,000 USD to 235,000 USD annually. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on the Company’s compensation practices degree and background. Level depends on experience.

Alumis compensation packages include generous stock option grants for all employees as well as an annual bonus program.

Other benefits include:

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

As a Senior Security Engineer, you will be responsible for safeguarding Planet’s applications, systems, and data. In this role, you will identify and address security vulnerabilities across products, partner with stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle, and drive security architecture reviews to prevent security risks before they emerge. You will also conduct hands-on security assessments, perform code reviews, and collaborate directly with developers to fix vulnerabilities.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

• Designs, develops, and implements security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats.

• Performs threat modeling and risk assessments to uncover potential threats early and implement preventative strategies.

• Executes penetration testing using security tools such as Burp Suite, Wireshark, Zeek, Nmap, and Drozer.

• Manages vulnerability lifecycles by evaluating application risks and assisting engineering teams with remediation.

• Spearheads security incident response efforts through thorough investigation, prompt remediation, and comprehensive post-incident documentation.

• Triages security events across multiple data sources to maintain robust system defenses.

• Drives security processes and architecture standards to support the overall success and reliability of Planet's products.

What You Bring:

• 6+ years of professional experience in a security-focused role.

• Bachelor's degree in an Engineering discipline with a focus in Information Security, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience working with cloud computing platforms like GCP and AWS.

• Knowledge of Operating systems internals, UNIX, and TCP/IP fundamentals.

• Familiarity with OWASP top 10 web vulnerabilities and mitigation techniques.

• Written and oral communication skills with an ability to articulate complex security concepts to cross-functional partners.

What Makes You Stand Out:

• Experience leading complex security projects across multi-disciplinary teams.

• Advanced security certifications or specialized training in cloud security and threat mitigation.

jobs.title: Senior Majors Account Executive - Michigan
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

• Michigan

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Majors Account Executive to join our Enterprise/Field Sales team. In this pivotal role, you will help lead Cloudflare’s strategic customer engagements, securing and expanding platform partnerships across key accounts. The ideal candidate brings strong sales leadership, a deep understanding of enterprise architecture (business, data, applications, technology), and the ability to articulate how Cloudflare integrates into modern cloud operating models.

As a Senior Majors Account Executive, you will position Cloudflare’s Developer Platform, Application Security, SASE/Zero Trust Services, and Network and Content Delivery offerings against incumbents. You will drive predictable sales performance, foster healthy pipeline growth, and deliver on revenue objectives. You will act as a trusted advisor, educating customers and partners on Cloudflare’s evolving product ecosystem and security capabilities. This role involves leveraging executive sponsorship programs, partnering with senior leaders (including CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs), and collaborating with cross-functional teams to navigate and successfully close complex customer opportunities.

Responsibilities

• Strategic Revenue Leadership: Develop and execute account plans to meet and exceed revenue goals by structuring enterprise-grade platform partnerships within key accounts.

• Predictable Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain accurate sales forecasting and proactive pipeline management, sharing insights to support broader sales strategy.

• Enterprise Architecture Alignment: Demonstrate a strong understanding of customer Enterprise Architecture across business, data, applications, and technology pillars, connecting Cloudflare solutions directly to customer business outcomes.

• Executive & C-Suite Engagement: Manage complex customer engagements across multiple business units, building strong relationships with executive sponsors and C-level stakeholders.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with cross-functional teams—including Product Managers and executive leadership—to advance strategic deals and resolve operational friction.

• Digital Transformation Guidance: Serve as a key advisor on digital transformation, helping customers navigate market shifts and position Cloudflare as a core strategic partner.

• Clear Communication & Feedback: Connect insights across global departments to deliver clear messaging, provide constructive feedback, and support continuous team growth.

• Long-Term Strategic Vision: Make balanced decisions aligned with long-term organizational value, building trust through open communication and knowledge sharing.

• Goal Setting & Operational Efficiency: Partner with teams to set clear metrics, address operational roadblocks, and improve cross-departmental workflows.

• Collaborative Problem Solving: Proactively identify customer and internal needs, fostering positive change and contributing to continuous team improvement.

• Inclusive Leadership: Champion diverse perspectives to solve complex business challenges and support a supportive, forward-thinking team environment.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Demonstrated track record of success in B2B enterprise sales, closing multi-year, complex technology agreements demonstrating a track record of consistently exceeding quota and closing transformative platform deals.

• Deep understanding of enterprise cloud platforms, network security, and modern IT architecture.

• Proven capability to align solutions with customer Enterprise Architecture (Business, Data, Applications, Technology) and enterprise business models mapping Cloudflare solutions to complex business models and modern cloud operating environments.

• Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and managing executive sponsorship initiatives.

• Strong collaborative skills with experience working alongside cross-functional leadership teams.

• Familiarity with digital transformation trends and the ability to translate market insights into customer solutions.

• Strong presentation, negotiation, and written communication skills across technical and business audiences.

• Thoughtful decision-making approach focused on sustainable, long-term business success.

• Experience setting clear performance indicators and facilitating cross-team alignment.

• Proficiency with enterprise sales tools and methodologies (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, MEDDPICC, or similar frameworks).

• Relevant professional experience in technology sales or enterprise consulting; advanced degrees or continuous technical learning are welcomed.

• Willingness to travel as needed to foster strong customer and internal team relationships.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Quality Intern
jobs.description:
At REGENT, we’re on a mission to revolutionize regional transportation between coastal cities. We're not just building vehicles, we're creating a new category of transportation: the Seaglider. These groundbreaking wing-in-ground-effect craft travel just above the water’s surface, combining the speed of an airplane with the low operating costs of a boat. Capable of 180 miles at 180 mph on today's battery tech (and up to 400 miles with next-gen batteries), Seagliders will unlock fast, affordable, and sustainable coastal transit for passengers and cargo - connecting cities, islands, and communities like never before.

Backed by leading investors and powered by a team of passionate, forward-thinking engineers, builders, and operators, we’re now scaling from a breakthrough prototype to full production - and building the team to make it happen.


ROLE OVERVIEW

Right now, Quality and Manufacturing at our Vineyard facility each keep their own calibration records for the measuring tools used to build and certify Seagliders. Tools could be used past their calibration due date without anyone catching it, and the measurement evidence behind our certification work is weaker than it should be. As we ramp up build volume next year, untangling divergent systems only gets harder, which is exactly why we want to get this right now, while the problem is still solvable from the ground up.

As our Quality Intern, you'll take full ownership of designing and building that solution. You'll dig into engineering drawings to understand what level of precision each tool actually needs to protect, merge mismatched sets of records into a single trustworthy register and due-date schedule in ION, and spend real time on the shop floor talking with technicians to understand how tools are actually tracked and used day to day; this is critical. You'll be joining the Manufacturing & Supply Chain team at a moment when the systems you help build will directly shape how reliably we can scale production. If you're the kind of person who gets energized by turning scattered, high-stakes information into something clean, trustworthy, and lasting — and who wants real ownership of a project from first audit to final presentation — we'd love to have you on the team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Audit the Current State: You'll track down and catalog every measuring tool in use across Quality and Manufacturing, building a clear picture of what exists today and where the two teams' records diverge.

 - Build the Unified Register: You'll merge two previously disconnected sets of calibration records into a single, standardized register in ION that both teams can rely on and maintain going forward.

 - Define the Due-Date Schedule: Using engineering drawings and tolerance requirements, you'll determine which tools need calibrating, how often, and build the schedule that keeps everyone ahead of due dates.

 - Get Hands-On With Technicians: You'll spend real time on the shop floor, talking directly with Quality and Manufacturing staff to understand how tools are actually used and tracked, not just how the paperwork says they should be.

 - Catch What the Spreadsheets Miss: You'll dig into mismatched IDs, conflicting intervals, and missing due dates, making judgment calls about what belongs in the final system.

 - Align Two Teams on One Process: You'll work with both Quality and Manufacturing to get everyone bought into a single shared process, rather than two teams quietly working around each other.

 - Present Your Finished System: At the end of your term, you'll present the completed calibration register and schedule directly to Quality and Manufacturing leadership, along with documentation the team will keep using after you're gone.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Comfort With Engineering Drawings: You can read a drawing and understand tolerances well enough to reason about which tools need calibration and how tightly — not just copy an existing list.

 - Sharp Spreadsheet Skills: You're accurate and efficient working across large sets of data, since merging two record systems and catching inconsistencies is fundamentally spreadsheet work.

 - Meticulous Attention to Records: You understand that a wrong serial number or due date isn't a small mistake — it's the difference between a tool being trustworthy and a tool being used out of calibration unnoticed.

 - Ease on the Shop Floor: You're comfortable walking up to technicians, asking questions, and helping two groups find common ground on how something should actually work.

 - Hands-On Tool Experience: Any direct experience with measuring tools helps you recognize tool types quickly and understand what calibration is really protecting.

 - Familiarity With Quality Standards: Exposure to ISO 9001 or ISO/IEC 17025 gives you a useful head start on what a compliant register needs to capture, like traceability and intervals.

 - Basic Scripting a Plus: Some Python or SQL could help you automate comparisons between the two tool lists, though spreadsheets can get the job done too.
   
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Collaborative Team Player: You believe that great things happen when teams work together. You communicate effectively and collaborate with engineers, stakeholders, and other cross-functional teams to align on goals and move projects forward. You bring people together, ensuring that everyone is on the same page and moving towards a shared vision.

 - Creative Problem Solver: You thrive on tackling complex challenges and finding innovative solutions. Whether you're resolving installation challenges, debugging elusive electrical issues, or adapting on the fly during integration and test, you bring a practical, inventive mindset to every problem. You don't just patch issues - you improve processes, anticipate downstream impacts, and help turn one-off fixes into scalable solutions that raise the bar for future builds.

 - Adaptable & Agile: In a fast-paced, ever-evolving startup environment, you quickly adapt to changing priorities and requirements. You approach challenges with a calm, resilient mindset, and know how to pivot and adjust your approach as needed, ensuring that progress continues without missing a beat.

 - Innovative Mindset: You're driven by curiosity and a passion for technology. You're passionate about driving continuous improvement, embracing new technologies and methodologies to enhance efficiency, quality, and team performance.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive compensation

 - Housing Stipend available for those temporarily moving to join our team

 - Daily, free catered lunches

 - Learning & professional development opportunities

 - Meaningful projects that make an impact

 - Mentorship & guidance from experienced team members

If you’re ready to take on an exciting challenge, grow with us, and make a lasting impact, we want to hear from you. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, but you see yourself contributing to our mission, we encourage you to apply! We value diverse skillsets and experiences and believe in the potential of passionate individuals to make a big impact.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Primary Function of Position

At Intuitive, the needs of our customers are a key driver in our approach to service innovation. Within Global Services Product Management, we build deep understanding of customer needs by working closely with them to assess strengths and opportunities. We incorporate these insights into our Global Service offerings, capabilities, and digital service solutions.

The Senior Product Manager, Global Service Offerings will play a role in Global Services innovation by defining and executing Global Service offering strategy, pricing, portfolio alignment, market research, performance analytics, and commercialization. This role will focus on the day-to-day execution and evolution of our global service offering strategy, ensuring offerings deliver measurable value for customers while supporting company growth objectives. This role will partner across regions and functions—working with Service Operations, Sales, Marketing, Contracts, Finance, and Product—to design, launch, and optimize service offerings that align with customer needs, improve outcomes, and complement our medical device portfolio.

This is a high-visibility role and directly influences recurring revenue, customer satisfaction, and the long-term success of our service business. The Senior Product Manager will develop solution roadmaps and continuously iterate on those roadmaps based on user feedback, emerging customer and service team needs, and business objectives.

Responsibilities for this role include both upstream and downstream activities. Upstream, the Senior Product Manager will create proposals to enhance or develop new service capabilities, draft business cases to support those proposals, and define requirements for delivery. Downstream, they will consult on end-user training curriculum and marketing opportunities as a subject matter expert on the customer experience and program services.

The Senior Product Manager will have an understanding of the Global Services technology, Intuitive products, and associated capabilities. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to goals set forth by Global Services Leadership and product business units.

Essential Job Duties

• Manage the lifecycle of global service contract offerings—from design and pricing to launch, performance monitoring, and retirement.

• Develop business cases to support service solution proposals that demonstrate the desirability, viability, and feasibility for the proposed solution. Use proposals to secure support and funding from relevant stakeholders and leadership.
• Define value propositions that are simple, differentiated, and complementary to our medical device and digital solutions portfolio.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Systems Engineering team owns the infrastructure that keeps a global firm running around the clock: cloud (primarily AWS), Microsoft 365, Windows Server, identity platforms (Entra ID, Active Directory), and enterprise email flow. We are in the middle of a deliberate shift from click-ops to modern engineering practice: infrastructure as code, version control, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, least-privilege identity, and AI-assisted workflows.

We're hiring a Senior Systems Engineer to help drive that shift. You'll operate and harden the current stack while actively replacing manual processes with automation and repeatable, auditable automation. We're looking for a DevOps/SRE mindset: someone who sees a manual runbook and wants to turn it into code, sets technical standards for the team, and uses AI to move fast, but safely. As a senior member of the team you will lead projects from design through delivery, and help the engineers around you grow.

About GLG / Gerson Lehrman Group

GLG’s platform connects business to expertise for smarter, faster decisions. Our clients rely on GLG’s 700,000+ member-experts and 2,300 employees around the globe to provide 24/7 insight and exceptional service within a rigorous compliance framework. Visit https://glginsights.com

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the design and delivery of infrastructure projects across AWS, Microsoft 365, and Windows Server, with reliability, security, and least privilege as defaults.

• Own identity and access engineering across Entra ID, Active Directory / Domain Controllers, including provisioning, governance, and least-privilege models on-prem and in the cloud.

• Own and improve enterprise email flow: Exchange Online, our secure email gateway, and email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) across first- and third-party sending platforms.

• Evaluate inherited architecture and legacy tooling, ask why it works the way it does, and propose better approaches, backed by pros, cons, and migration trade-offs.

• Drive the move to infrastructure as code: build and maintain declarative infrastructure so environments are version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and reproducible.

• Keep infrastructure and automation under version control (Git), and work in a pull-request review and CI/CD workflow.

• Support and extend our cloud footprint across AWS and Azure, including networking, identity, and workload migration.

• Act as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues, take part in incident response for a 24/7 business spanning the globe, then write the postmortems and deploy fixes to prevent recurrence.

• Set and uphold technical standards through design and code review, and document decisions clearly enough that others can pick up the work.

• Mentor less experienced engineers and help raise the bar on security, reliability, documentation, and repeatability.

• Use AI to troubleshoot, script, document, and design faster, and share what works with the team.

Qualifications

• 7+ years in systems / infrastructure / DevOps / SRE / engineering, with a track record of owning production systems.

• A DevOps/SRE mindset: you reach for automation and repeatable process over manual, one-off work, and can speak to click-ops you've replaced with code.

• Proven ability to lead projects independently, mentor other engineers, and influence technical direction.

• Strong scripting and automation skills (PowerShell and Bash required; Python, JavaScript or similar are a plus).

• Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, OpenTofu, etc.), and fluency working in Git with pull-request-based review.

• Strong working knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem: Microsoft 365 and Windows Server.

• Deep experience with identity platforms and identity security: Entra ID and Active Directory required; an identity governance tool is a plus.

• Familiarity with enterprise email flow: Exchange Online, secure email gateways, and email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).

• Proven cloud experience in AWS and/or Azure, including networking, identity, and core services.

• Networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN, firewalls).

• A security-first, least-privilege mindset.

• Proven experience leveraging AI solutions to develop production systems and/or development workflow enhancements.

• Clear communicator who collaborates well across a distributed team.

• Based on a 8–5 ET schedule, but realistic about infrastructure work: occasional after-hours or weekend maintenance windows and releases, a shared on-call rotation, and some flexibility to coordinate across Indian, European, Asian, and US time zones.

Nice to Have

• Relevant certifications (AWS, Azure, Microsoft).

• CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, or similar).

• Containers and orchestration (Docker, AWS ECS).

• Monitoring and observability tooling.

Why This Role

You'll be part of modernizing how a global firm runs its infrastructure, with a real mandate and support to replace manual work with engineering. If you want to build automation, grow your DevOps/SRE skills, and push the frontier of AI-assisted operations rather than maintain the status quo, this is a place to do it. We invest in a learning, collaborative culture, and this role has room to grow.

What We Offer:

Benefits: All U.S. GLGers also have access to benefits such as:

• Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage effective on your first day of employment

• Flexible paid time off. No pre-determined limits on vacation time, plus 10 company holidays

• 401(k) and Roth 401(k) plans with an employer match (subject to annual limits & vesting)

• Tuition reimbursement program for eligible courses including language skills courses

• Paid parental leave, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement

• Free wellbeing support with the Calm app, Maven and EAP, and free long-term therapy & counselling assistance through Pathways

• Other work perks and benefits available based on final job location

Compensation: GLG is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Actual compensation is based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. Certain roles may also be eligible for incentive compensation.

The anticipated hiring base salary range for this role is:

$88,000—$135,000 USD

About GLG / Gerson Lehrman Group

GLG is the world’s leading platform for trusted human expertise. We connect global decision-makers—from hedge fund managers and private equity partners to strategy leaders at Fortune 500s—with the specific, authoritative voices required to answer their most critical questions.

At GLG, you are an extension of our clients' core teams. You will work at the intersection of industries and global markets, navigating high-stakes challenges across the full spectrum of their strategic initiatives. Operating within the industry’s most trusted research environment, you’ll help our clients capture the nuanced perspectives that drive smarter, faster business outcomes.

We are a global team of pragmatic problem-solvers who mirror the intensity of the markets we serve. If you are driven by intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action, join us in reinventing the industry we invented.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Mid-Market Contractor
jobs.description:
About SewerAI Corporation

SewerAI is transforming underground infrastructure management through AI-powered inspection and risk analysis. Our platform helps contractors, engineering firms, and utilities unlock valuable insights from sewer inspection data—turning hours of manual video review into actionable intelligence in minutes. After doubling our customer base over the past year, we’re now entering an exciting phase of accelerated growth.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Contractors have been underserved by technology and saddled with the same old tools. For a contractor, SewerAI means faster time to payment, scalability of operations, and reduced rework.

And we’re not stopping at inspection data management. SewerAI is building the platform that will let a contractor run their business more effectively with AI.



THE ROLE

Own a full-cycle sales motion across mid-sized contractors and field-operations companies in your region— the firms whose crews inspect, clean, and maintain underground infrastructure for municipalities and utilities. You build the pipeline, run discovery, demo the platform, make the business case, negotiate, and close — then expand the account. Bigger deals than our velocity segment, a real buying group of owners, operations leaders, and crews, and a motion that rewards pace and ownership.

You’ll be given current accounts to grow in partnership with your Account Manager, and you’ll have SDR support to build new-logo pipeline. A Solutions Engineer is available to you for pre-sales, and our Strategic Contractor Team Lead supports you on deal strategy, coaching, and pipeline review.

You prospect and you close. You carry the number, and the close-or-pass call is yours.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - A regional book. A territory of contractor and field-operations accounts — a base of current accounts to grow, plus new logos.

 - The full cycle. Strategic prospecting, discovery, platform demo, business case, negotiation, close, and growth within existing accounts — from adding crews and trucks to adopting new products.

 - A quarterly quota. Hit and beat quarterly bookings targets by winning new accounts and expanding current ones. 

 - Growth with your AM. You own pricing, expansion, and the forecast on your accounts, and work hand in hand with your Account Manager, who owns adoption and renewal.

 - Your support team. SDR support to build pipeline, a Solutions Engineer for pre-sales, and a Strategic Contractor Team Lead for coaching.

 - The buying group. Multi-thread across ownership, operations, and the field crews who will live in theproduct.

 - Clean pipeline. Disciplined CRM hygiene and forecasts you can stand behind.



WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Must-haves

 - 3+ years of full-cycle B2B sales to field-operations companies or contractors — construction, infrastructure services, utility services, or a related field-based business — ideally software or technology.

 - A track record of driving the process from plan to close and hitting quarterly targets.

 - Strong discovery, negotiation, and the ability to earn the trust of both business owners and the operations leaders and crews who run the work.

 - The ability to get fluent quickly in PACP, NASSCO, and CCTV inspection workflows and the SewerAI platform (AutoCode, PIONEER, Risk & Rehab) — enough to run credible discovery with a contractor’s owner or operations manager.

 - Comfort in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with the CRM discipline to match.



Nice-to-haves

 - Experience in the wastewater market — sewer, stormwater, or water infrastructure.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Civil Engineering, or a related field.

 - Territory planning, conference follow-up, and named-account multi-threading.



Really nice-to-haves

 - Hands-on experience with CCTV inspection software and hardware — including the field-to-office workflow from camera truck to finished deliverable.



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

 - Health & wellness — comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus basic life and 401(k).

 - Meaningful equity — share in the company’s long-term success.

 - Remote-first & flexible — remote and hybrid friendly, with flexible hours.

 - Learning & development — an annual budget for courses, books, and conferences.

 - Unlimited PTO — take the time you need to recharge and bring your best self to work.

 - A team that’s been there — mission-driven people who genuinely care about the work and the people who do it underground.
   
   

COMPENSATION

 - On-target earnings of $200,000, split 50/50 between base salary and commission ($100,000 base + $100,000 variable), with uncapped commission and accelerators above quota. Plus full benefits, and remote-first flexibility.

Pay transparency: The posted on-target earnings reflect base plus expected commission at target. Actual compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Serviceability
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

This role will report to the Director of Product Management, Global Services. The Product Manager for Serviceability plays a key role in Global Services Solutions by supporting design for serviceability (DFS) strategy and delivering service user requirements for Intuitive products. Initially, this role will support Da Vinci 5 and other products upstream. Over time, the products supported by this role may change, aligned to critical priorities. This individual will assess service needs, gather internal and customer feedback, identify unmet opportunities, and prioritize opportunities and improvements to design for serviceability. The individual will support design for serviceability for both current products and new product development.

Essential Job Duties

• Operate as the Product Manager for DFS strategy and service user requirements for new product and sustaining development to ensure efficient, scalable, and customer-centric methods for installing, configuring, diagnosing, troubleshooting, monitoring, repairing, maintaining, and upgrading software and hardware.
• Leverage analytics and financial evaluation to assess serviceability opportunities and prioritize focus across the evolving product portfolio and global customer base
• Develop DFS business cases that demonstrate desirability, viability, feasibility, and ROI for the proposed solution. Partner with leadership to secure support and funding from relevant stakeholders and leadership.
• Partner cross-functionally with Services PMO, Services and platform Product Management, Product Support Engineering, Product Development Engineering, Product Performance Engineering, Global Services stakeholders, and other technical experts to develop business cases that support serviceability requirements and inform upstream design decisions
• Engage with Service teams to gather, prioritize, and act on design for serviceability feedback
• Develop serviceability roadmaps that support planned serviceability requirements and advance design for serviceability strategy
• Develop service user requirements aligned to product development timelines
• Manage/maintain formal service user requirements documentation and approvals
• Partner with fellow Product Managers for Serviceability to ensure requirements are aligned with strategic and operational performance goals
• Build understanding of the value of Global Services and the impact of upstream product decisions on service delivery excellence and scalability
• Contribute to customer and service research, including voice of customer and voice of service inputs, to inform service user requirements
• Participate in field rides, job shadowing, conferences, and other activities to maintain domain expertise and awareness of customer needs and service opportunities

Required Skills and Experience

• Minimum 5 years professional experience in medical device, biomedical engineering, field service, product management, quality engineering, product support engineering, product engineering, or equivalent role
• Experience with product management, continuous improvement initiatives, Lean/Six Sigma, or equivalent
• Experience building business cases, using qualitative and quantitative data, to secure funding, resources, or project/program support
• Experience investigating and defining complex problems prior to solution development
• Experience with market research, voice of customer feedback, voice of service feedback, or equivalent
• Formal or informal leadership of cross-functional teams to implement/launch key initiatives
• Critical thinking skills, attention to detail, and experience with data-driven decision making
• Ability to develop and present impactful presentations for cross-functional audiences (internal and external), director/VP-level leadership, and global stakeholders
• Ability to build relationships and partner closely with key stakeholders
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Results orientation with ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives and deadlines
• Self-directed with awareness to proactively seek advice when needed
• Strong knowledge of the MS Office product suite

• Strong track record of leading strategic initiatives from concept through to completion; contributes to budget, resource and financial planning for projects / program

Required Education and Training

• Minimum Bachelor’s degree in a related field required

• None

• MBA preferred

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

We are a small, dynamic team focused on building intelligent cloud-managed Intercom systems. Intercom is our second newest major product line and is off to the best start of any product in Verkada’s history. Our Intercom allows customers to receive calls from anywhere - at their desk or on their phone - with rich video and 2-way audio.  And we have a lot more to build.

jobs.title: Material Program Manager, XFRA
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION  


SPAN IS ENABLING ELECTRIFICATION FOR ALL ⚡




XFRA BY SPAN IS THE FIRST DISTRIBUTED DATA CENTER USING EXISTING INFRASTRUCTURE AND UNDERUTILIZED POWER CAPACITY TO MEET EXPANDING AI COMPUTE DEMAND.





THE ROLE

As part of the XFRA Operations team, the Material Program Manager owns material readiness for every XFRA build, from engineering builds through production ramp. You will own the clear-to-build (CTB), turn build and deployment plans into a material plan, run risk releases, and hold suppliers to their delivery commitments so the factory and deployment teams have every part when they need it. You will work closely with engineering, the factory, sourcing, finance, and deployment teams, and report to the Head of XFRA Operations. This role is based in the Bay Area, with some travel to supplier and deployment sites.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the clear-to-build for each build: track every part against demand, surface shortages early, and drive recovery plans to closure

 - Translate the build plan and deployment schedule into a material plan, and keep it current as engineering changes, demand, and supplier commitments move

 - Prepare and run risk releases, including costed BOMs, long-lead buys, liability exposure, and approvals across engineering, operations, and finance

 - Run delivery schedule reviews with key suppliers and integration partners, hold them to committed dates, and escalate when they slip

 - Release POs against the material plan and manage expedites, pull-ins, and push-outs

 - Own inbound material visibility through receipt, partnering with inventory and logistics on receiving, kitting, and cycle counts

 - Publish the daily operations status update and the weekly CTB review for leadership

 - Partner with the EPM on build calendars and engineering changes, managing material cut-in and excess for each ECO

 - Build the long-range supply plan that supports scaling from hundreds of units to thousands per year

 - Set up the trackers and processes (CTB, BOM management, PO and receipt tracking) the team will run on as volume grows


POTENTIAL PROJECTS

 - Take over the CTB for the future builds and turn it into a living tool that shows PO release risk and dependencies

 - Build the 2027 supply plan against approved unit volume, including long-lead and supplier capacity commitments

 - Move build and material tracking from spreadsheets into a system that holds up at production volume


ABOUT YOU

Required Qualifications

 - 5+ years in material program management, supply and demand planning, or NPI supply chain at a hardware company

 - Direct ownership of CTB and material readiness for builds from prototype through production ramp

 - Strong working knowledge of BOMs, lead times, MRP logic, and costed BOMs, including preparing risk buys or risk releases

 - Advanced spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets or Excel) and experience building trackers that other teams rely on

 - Experience managing suppliers and contract manufacturers to schedule commitments

 - Clear written and verbal communication, including presenting status and tradeoffs to senior leadership

 - Comfortable building structure in an early-stage, fast-moving program

Bonus Qualifications

 - Experience at a high-volume hardware or consumer electronics company with a formal MPM / EPM / OPM structure

 - Data center, server, networking, or power electronics hardware experience

 - Experience with ERP and procurement tools (NetSuite, Zip, or similar)

 - Experience scaling a supply chain from NPI into mass production




LIFE AT SPAN

Headquartered in San Francisco’s vibrant SoMa neighborhood, we are an eclectic group of creative thinkers who value open communication, teamwork, and a ‘make it happen’ approach to addressing complex challenges. 

SPAN embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. 

We’re hiring talented individuals who are driven by success and are passionate about shaping the future of renewable energy. If that sounds like you, we’d love for you to consider joining the rapidly growing team at SPAN.



The Perks:

⚡ Competitive compensation + equity grants at a well-funded, venture-backed company

⚡ Comprehensive benefits: 100% employee premiums for base plans on medical, dental, vision with options for additional coverage.  Parental leave up to twenty four (24)  weeks depending on eligibility

⚡ Comfortable, sunny office space located near BART and Caltrain public transit

⚡ Strong focus on team building and company culture: Employee Resource Groups, monthly social events, SPANcakes recognition breakfast, lunch, and learns

⚡ Flexible hours, one holiday per month, and flexible time off

 

Interested in joining our team? Apply today and we’ll be in touch with the next steps!

jobs.title: Systems Engineer, EW
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Systems Engineer to join our Electronic Warfare (EW) team supporting various Electronic Support Measures (ESM) and Electronic Attack (EA) / Electronic Counter Measures (ECM) Systems. This is an exciting role which provides an opportunity to work across the full product life cycle, from concept to deployment.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 4+ years of hands on systems engineering experience

• Experience with system design, development and test of ESM and EA / ECM in one or more of the following ground-based or aerial EW domains: Counter-Radar Counter-UAS Counter-Comms (Wireless protocols: Bluetooth, 3G/4G/5G, Wi-Fi, etc) Counter-PNT Counter-RCIED

• Experience with embedded devices and Software Defined Radios (SDRs).

• Experience with system requirements creation, requirement traceability, and requirement verification and validation.

• Experience coordinating across disciplines to ensure system requirements and design are properly and thoroughly defined, implemented, and validated.

• Experience leading program teams through systems engineering reviews and owning related CDRLs including System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR), and Critical Design Review (CDR).

• Excellent technical writing skill with experience in writing white papers, proposals, trade studies, test plans, test procedures, and test reports.

• Skilled at explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Excellent at balancing multiple projects at any given time.

• Enthusiastic about both working with a team and executing work individually.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret/Top Secret security clearance.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience in SIL (System in Lab) design, setup and automation.

• Familiarity with RF systems and RF test equipment including multimeters, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and vector network analyzers.

• Experience with system level RF cascade analysis, co-site analysis, and mission modeling.

• Experience with mission modeling tools like AFSIM and STK.

• Flight Test experience and flight test data analysis.

• Experience in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), including the use of modelling tools (e.g. Cameo)

• Experience in integrating Firmware and Software builds on prototype and production grade hardware.

BENEFITS

• Platinum Benefits: We offer top tier platinum coverage (medical, dental, vision, life) and cover 100 percent of the premiums for you.

• 16 Weeks paid parental leave for all caregivers.

• Family planning: We’re proud to offer comprehensive family planning support. Fertility planning and treatment, adoption support, gestational carrier support and fertility preservation are all included.

• Unlimited Provisions: From breakfast to dinner, our kitchen team has you covered with healthy meals and snacks at every office.

• Commuter benefits depending on region.

• Relocation assistance.

• Unlimited and Incentivized Time Off.

US Salary Range

$147,000—$196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Global Product Owner- Customer Service
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:

The Global Customer Service Product Owner maximizes the business value, adoption, usability, and performance of the technology platforms and processes that support global service operations.

Serving as the conduit between global teams, operations, and IT, this role translates customer service business strategy and operational needs into a scalable roadmap for Salesforce Service Cloud (SF360), SAP S/4HANA, telephony platforms, AI-enabled solutions, and other Customer Service applications.

The Product Owner defines the product vision, manages and prioritizes the backlog, drives roadmap execution, and ensures solutions deliver measurable results in customer experience, operational efficiency, compliance, data integrity, and revenue enablement.

The Product Owner collaborates with Customer Service, Planning, Logistics, Finance, Quality, Compliance, Post Market Surveillance, and IT to set priorities, guide solution design, resolve tradeoffs, and align technology investments with strategic business goals.

This role manages the full lifecycle of supported products, from strategy and roadmap development through backlog prioritization, release planning, adoption, change management, operational support, and continuous improvement.

Note: This is a business product ownership position, not an IT delivery role.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Product Strategy and Roadmap

• Define and maintain the global product vision and strategy for Customer Service platforms.
• Develop and manage multi-year product roadmaps aligned with business objectives and Customer Service transformation initiatives.
• Evaluate opportunities based on their potential to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, compliance, scalability, and revenue outcomes.
• Balance business priorities, user experience, technical debt, platform sustainability, and regulatory requirements.

Process Transformation and Innovation

• Lead process-discovery workshops and future-state design initiatives.
• Identify automation, AI, and digital transformation opportunities across Customer Service operations.
• Drive global standardization and harmonization of Customer Service processes.
• Support Lifecycle Revenue Management (LRM) and future-state service operating models.

Backlog and Prioritization

• Own and manage the global Customer Service technology enhancement requests
• Prioritize enhancements, defects, and strategic initiatives based on business value and organizational objectives.
• Evaluate competing stakeholder requests and make final business prioritization decisions based on overall enterprise value.
• Define clear product requirements, user stories, business outcomes, and acceptance criteria.

Delivery and Solution Governance

• Serve as the primary business decision-maker throughout delivery cycles.
• Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and release planning.
• Review and approve business requirements, functional designs, and user stories.
• Clarify requirements and business intent for IT and delivery teams.
• Partner with Business Analysts and Solution Architects to ensure solutions align with the product vision, business objectives, platform standards, and enterprise architecture principles.
• Accept or reject completed work against defined acceptance criteria.

Stakeholder Leadership and Communication

• Influence cross-functional teams.
• Build alignment across Customer Service, Finance, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Quality, and IT.
• Present roadmap updates, investment recommendations, risks, and business outcomes to senior leadership.
• Act as the primary escalation point for business prioritization decisions related to supported platforms.

Performance and Continuous Improvement

• Monitor solution performance, adoption metrics, incident trends, and user feedback.
• Lead root-cause analysis for recurring issues.
• Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve data quality, and streamline business processes.
• Develop success metrics and KPI frameworks to measure business outcomes.

Customer and User Experience

• Represent the Voice of the Customer and Voice of the User throughout the product lifecycle.
• Improve user experience, workflow efficiency, and service effectiveness.
• Establish feedback loops with global Customer Service teams.
• Lead change management and user adoption activities.
• Partner with training teams and business leaders to support successful adoption of new capabilities.

Skill/Job Requirements

Minimum requirements in order to adequately perform the responsibilities of this position are as follows:

• Education:B.S. or higher in Computer Science, Business Management, Project Management or related field preferredNon-technical degree with equivalent complex experience acceptable

Experience and Skills

Professional Experience

• 8+ years of experience supporting Customer Service, Order Management, CRM, ERP, or Customer Experience platforms.
• 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Lead, or in an equivalent business systems ownership role.
• Experience supporting global organizations and operating models.
• Experience working in a regulated industry; medical device experience is preferred.

Product and Delivery Leadership

• Demonstrated experience owning product strategy, business roadmaps, and backlog prioritization.
• Experience leading Agile delivery teams and participating in Scrum ceremonies.
• Demonstrated ability to influence leaders and drive cross-functional alignment without direct authority.

Business Process Expertise

• Deep understanding of Order Management, Customer Service operations, complaint handling, returns, exchanges (RMA/AEX), and contact center processes.
• Strong understanding of customer experience, digital transformation, automation, and AI-enabled business solutions.

Technology Experience

• Strong experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA, and broader Customer Service technology ecosystems.
• Experience supporting telephony and contact center technologies.

Analytics and Performance Management

• Strong data-driven decision-making skills, supported by reporting and analytics platforms.
• Experience defining KPIs, adoption metrics, ROI measures, and success criteria.

Communication and Stakeholder Management

• Excellent executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

jobs.description:
About the role

Muon is seeking a part-time Co-Op Harness Designer to join our electrical engineering team, intended for students in the surrounding area. Working under the mentorship of current harness designers, you will specify connectors, crimps, wire types, and harness build instructions. You will also need to be flexible and incorporate feedback from the AIT team to improve designs for spacecraft integration and testing. This role involves working simultaneously across multiple missions and projects while partnering with various engineers, designers, and technicians.

This is a hybrid role that requires regular on-site collaboration with our engineering team.

Responsibilities

• Create harness drawings, BOMs and maintain system diagrams

• Specify connector and crimp part numbers in accordance with system design

• Gather feedback from AIT, EE and Mechanical for initial designs and improvements

• Work with electrical engineering to ensure compliance with signal integrity, grounding, and shielding requirements

• Release documentation into PLM with ECO/DCO

• Answer vendor questions on harness builds and feedback quality issues

• As required assist in house technicians with harness builds and questions

Qualifications

• Attention to detail, strong reading comprehension and a desire for ownership

• Some experience creating harness drawings or electrical schematics in any software (school projects, clubs, or personal builds count)

• Basic familiarity with, or willingness to learn, how harnesses are built from scratch.

• Excited to work in a fast-paced environment with new challenges each week

Nice-to-have Skills

• While not a daily requirement, hands-on intuition helps inform strip lengths, crimper settings, splicing techniques, heatshrink selection, and torque values.

• Familiarity with NASA-STD-8739.4 and IPC-A-620

• Basic scripting skills in Python, Bash, etc.

• History with using electrical test equipment, such as power supplies and electric loads

• Experience with harness test either at the vendor level or in house

• Certification in relevant build/rework standards

• Experience with low outgassing material selection

Pay range

Bachelor's $40/hour

PhD $50/hour

Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale.
