jobs.title: Indirect Procurement Coordinator
jobs.description:
ABOUT RADIANT

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based company building the world's only mass-produced, transportable nuclear microreactors. The U.S. grid is under growing strain, with power demand accelerating, driving higher utility costs, rising carbon emissions, and interconnection backlogs. Radiant has a solution, transportable, on-site power. Our first reactor, Kaleidos, is 1 megawatt: small enough to be factory-built, transported by land, sea, or air, and deployed wherever power is needed. 1 MW can power 1000 homes for five years. Ship it back and we refuel for a 20 year operating life. We made energy a product that can be used for critical infrastructure like military bases, data centers, hospitals, and remote sites, as well as the commercial main street businesses that keep America running.  Founded in 2020, Radiant is under contract to deliver power to the U.S. Army, Navy and Air Force and has signed pre-order agreements with Equinix, with deployments beginning in 2028.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Radiant is looking for an Indirect Procurement Associate to support sourcing and procurement of indirect goods and services — Facilities, IT, Professional Services, MRO, consumables, and R&D collaborations. This is a hands-on role for someone with strong technical instincts who wants to build skills in supplier evaluation, negotiation, and contract support. You'll work alongside Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Production, and will be paired with more senior procurement staff to develop your commercial and negotiation skill set.

Responsibilities & Duties

 - Support sourcing efforts for indirect categories (IT, Professional Services, MRO, consumables, R&D collaborations) by gathering technical requirements and evaluating supplier capability against Radiant's engineering needs.

 - Assist with drafting and reviewing SOWs, NDAs, and PO terms; help prepare negotiation positions for MSAs and licensing agreements under guidance from senior staff.

 - Help manage facilities/MRO procurement tasks — coordinating with vendors on maintenance, repairs, equipment, and small lab build-out needs.

 - Track purchase orders through the procure-to-pay cycle, flagging delays or technical mismatches early.

 - Act as a day-to-day point of contact for select, lower-complexity suppliers, escalating high-stakes commercial matters to senior procurement staff.

 - Contribute technical judgment to cost and quality trade-off discussions.

 - Help identify supply chain risks from an engineering/technical perspective (e.g., part obsolescence, service quality issues).

 - Support process documentation and improvement efforts.

Required Qualifications & Skills

 - Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering (or closely related engineering field) strongly preferred, Supply Chain or similar degrees considered

 - 1–3 years of relevant experience; prior procurement/sourcing experience is a plus but not required.

 - Strong technical/mechanical aptitude and genuine interest in the commercial side of engineering (supplier selection, cost trade-offs, contracts).

 - Good analytical and organizational skills; comfortable learning negotiation and contract fundamentals on the job.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills.

 - Comfortable with ERP/MRP systems and standard office software (or willing to learn quickly).

 - Occasional travel to supplier locations (up to 20%).

Desired Qualifications

 - Exposure to Facilities, MRO, IT, or Professional Services sourcing.

 - Coursework or interest in quality systems (ISO 9001, AS9100).

 - Interest in the energy/nuclear sector.

Additional Requirements

 - Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary.

 - Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ.


BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.

 - Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.

 - One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.

 - Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.

 - Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.

 - Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.

 - 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.

 - Nuclear Engineering Certificate Program: 100% covered educational program with Penn State University, for eligible employees, to rapidly upscale into nuclear.

 - Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.

 - Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.

 - Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.

 - Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.



Total Compensation and Benefits
Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiant’s full-time new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant.

jobs.title: Data Engineer (EDW)
jobs.description:
Our AI & Automation department transforms complex data into intelligent, scalable solutions. Operating across an expansive technical landscape, the team builds robust infrastructure that supports regulatory compliance and drives process efficiency. By leveraging advanced cloud technologies and machine learning, the department maintains data integrity while exploring new ways to optimize performance across our global platforms.

In this role, you'll help build and maintain data pipelines that move data from our data lake into a new cloud-based Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW). With the core architecture and data models established, you'll focus on developing and enhancing pipelines that load fact and dimension tables, while contributing to automation and data quality improvements alongside talented teammates.

The listed salary for this position is $90,000-$120,000 annually.

• Strong SQL skills, with experience developing efficient and maintainable queries for analytical and data warehouse use cases
• Practical experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Google BigQuery, alongside building, maintaining, and troubleshooting data pipelines using Apache Airflow or similar tools
• Proven ability to load, transform, and model data for cloud-based data warehouses, including fact and dimension tables, with exposure to dbt or Dataform
• Solid understanding of data engineering principles, including data quality, testing, monitoring, performance, and reliability
• Demonstrated experience using Git for source control and collaborating in a shared repository with multiple developers
• Applied understanding of CI/CD processes, peer reviews, and development standards for controlled testing and deployment
• Background working in an agile environment, contributing to technical discussions, planning, and delivery
• Aptitude for using AI tools responsibly to support development activities, including code generation, refinement, troubleshooting, and documentation

• Develop, maintain, and enhance reliable data pipelines that ingest data from the data lake into the cloud-based Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW)
• Build and support the loading of fact and dimension tables, applying established architecture, data models, and development standards
• Write efficient SQL and transformation logic while applying best practices for data quality, testing, performance, monitoring, error handling, and reliability
• Work collaboratively in a shared source-controlled repository with a team of developers, contributing to peer reviews, CI/CD processes, and the controlled deployment of data solutions
• Investigate and resolve pipeline and data quality issues, contributing to automation, technical documentation, and continuous EDW improvements
• Collaborate with engineers, analysts, and stakeholders in an agile environment, using AI tools responsibly to support development, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution design

jobs.title: Buildings & Grounds Maintenance Mechanic
jobs.description:
SUMMARY:

The Buildings & Grounds Maintenance Mechanic performs hands-on maintenance, repair, and upkeep of company buildings and grounds. Reporting to the Facilities Supervisor, this position completes preventive and corrective maintenance on building systems and structures, maintains landscaping and exterior areas, responds to service requests, and helps keep the site safe, clean, functional, and ready to support operations. The mechanic follows safe-work practices, documents work accurately, and supports the facilities team across all shifts as needed

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Perform preventive, routine, and corrective maintenance on buildings, offices, warehouses, restrooms, breakrooms, and other facility areas.
• Repair and maintain building components, including roofs, walls, ceilings, floors, doors, windows, hardware, fixtures, and furnishings.
• Troubleshoot and perform basic repairs on plumbing, lighting, electrical fixtures, HVAC components, and other facility systems within the scope of training and authorization.
• Perform carpentry, painting, drywall, concrete, welding, and general construction tasks as needed to maintain or improve facilities.
• Maintain site grounds, including mowing, trimming, pruning, weed control, landscaping, irrigation systems, and general exterior appearance.
• Maintain parking areas, walkways, fencing, gates, drainage, signage, and exterior lighting; remove debris and address trip hazards.
• Operate and perform basic maintenance on grounds and maintenance equipment, including mowers, trimmers, blowers, power tools, lifts, and utility vehicles.
• Complete assigned work orders and preventive maintenance tasks; accurately document work performed, parts used, and time spent.
• Conduct routine inspections of buildings and grounds; identify and report hazards, deficiencies, and needed repairs to the Facilities Supervisor.
• Follow company safety policies and applicable OSHA requirements, including lockout/tagout, fall protection, confined space entry, hot work, and personal protective equipment.
• Respond to facility emergencies, service requests; set up temporary controls and assist with restoring safe operations.
• Support contractors and vendors on site as directed, including providing access, escorting, and verifying completed work.
• Keep tools, equipment, shop, and work areas clean, organized, and in safe working condition; notify the supervisor of needed parts and supplies.
• Assist with facility projects, shutdowns, audits, and site improvements in coordination with Operations, Safety, Quality, and other departments.
• Perform other duties and support special projects as assigned.

Qualifications:

• Education: High school diploma or equivalent preferred. Technical or vocational training in building maintenance, construction trades, landscaping, or a related field is a plus.
• Experience: Three or more years of building maintenance, groundskeeping, or general facility maintenance experience in a commercial, industrial, or agricultural setting.
• Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations: Valid driver’s license preferred. Forklift, aerial/scissor lift, pesticide applicator, or trade certifications are a plus. Must complete company-required training and maintain any certifications required for assigned duties.
• Professional Skills: Working knowledge of general building maintenance, basic plumbing and electrical repairs, carpentry, painting, and groundskeeping practices. Ability to safely use hand tools, power tools, and grounds equipment. Ability to read work orders, equipment manuals, and written procedures; follow instructions; work independently or as part of a team; and communicate clearly with supervisors and coworkers. Experience with work-order or computerized maintenance management systems is preferred.
• Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the associate is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands, reach, climb ladders, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and crawl. The associate must be able to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds; use required personal protective equipment and safely access rooftops, elevated areas, and confined spaces. Specific vision abilities include close, distance, color, peripheral, and depth perception and the ability to adjust focus. Respirator use and fitness testing may be required based on assigned work.
• Working Conditions: Work is performed primarily outdoors and in warehouse, industrial, rooftop, and building areas. jobs.title: Senior Majors Account Executive - Atlanta
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

• Atlanta, Georgia

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Majors Account Executive to join our Enterprise/Field Sales team. In this pivotal role, you will help lead Cloudflare’s strategic customer engagements, securing and expanding platform partnerships across key accounts. The ideal candidate brings strong sales leadership, a deep understanding of enterprise architecture (business, data, applications, technology), and the ability to articulate how Cloudflare integrates into modern cloud operating models.

As a Senior Majors Account Executive, you will position Cloudflare’s Developer Platform, Application Security, SASE/Zero Trust Services, and Network and Content Delivery offerings against incumbents. You will drive predictable sales performance, foster healthy pipeline growth, and deliver on revenue objectives. You will act as a trusted advisor, educating customers and partners on Cloudflare’s evolving product ecosystem and security capabilities. This role involves leveraging executive sponsorship programs, partnering with senior leaders (including CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs), and collaborating with cross-functional teams to navigate and successfully close complex customer opportunities.

Responsibilities

• Strategic Revenue Leadership: Develop and execute account plans to meet and exceed revenue goals by structuring enterprise-grade platform partnerships within key accounts.

• Predictable Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain accurate sales forecasting and proactive pipeline management, sharing insights to support broader sales strategy.

• Enterprise Architecture Alignment: Demonstrate a strong understanding of customer Enterprise Architecture across business, data, applications, and technology pillars, connecting Cloudflare solutions directly to customer business outcomes.

• Executive & C-Suite Engagement: Manage complex customer engagements across multiple business units, building strong relationships with executive sponsors and C-level stakeholders.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with cross-functional teams—including Product Managers and executive leadership—to advance strategic deals and resolve operational friction.

• Digital Transformation Guidance: Serve as a key advisor on digital transformation, helping customers navigate market shifts and position Cloudflare as a core strategic partner.

• Clear Communication & Feedback: Connect insights across global departments to deliver clear messaging, provide constructive feedback, and support continuous team growth.

• Long-Term Strategic Vision: Make balanced decisions aligned with long-term organizational value, building trust through open communication and knowledge sharing.

• Goal Setting & Operational Efficiency: Partner with teams to set clear metrics, address operational roadblocks, and improve cross-departmental workflows.

• Collaborative Problem Solving: Proactively identify customer and internal needs, fostering positive change and contributing to continuous team improvement.

• Inclusive Leadership: Champion diverse perspectives to solve complex business challenges and support a supportive, forward-thinking team environment.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Demonstrated track record of success in B2B enterprise sales, closing multi-year, complex technology agreements demonstrating a track record of consistently exceeding quota and closing transformative platform deals.

• Deep understanding of enterprise cloud platforms, network security, and modern IT architecture.

• Proven capability to align solutions with customer Enterprise Architecture (Business, Data, Applications, Technology) and enterprise business models mapping Cloudflare solutions to complex business models and modern cloud operating environments.

• Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and managing executive sponsorship initiatives.

• Strong collaborative skills with experience working alongside cross-functional leadership teams.

• Familiarity with digital transformation trends and the ability to translate market insights into customer solutions.

• Strong presentation, negotiation, and written communication skills across technical and business audiences.

• Thoughtful decision-making approach focused on sustainable, long-term business success.

• Experience setting clear performance indicators and facilitating cross-team alignment.

• Proficiency with enterprise sales tools and methodologies (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, MEDDPICC, or similar frameworks).

• Relevant professional experience in technology sales or enterprise consulting; advanced degrees or continuous technical learning are welcomed.

• Willingness to travel as needed to foster strong customer and internal team relationships.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Thermal and Fluid Systems
jobs.description:
What we’re building

The marine industry supports recreation, global commerce, and national defense, yet it runs on technology that hasn’t meaningfully changed in fifty years. Until now.

Arc is on a mission to electrify the marine industry. We’re rethinking powertrains, software, and vessel design from first principles, and we’re already executing. We started with recreational boats to develop and harden our core technology, and we’re now scaling production of our flagship model, with new models on the horizon. We’re also extending our platform to commercial applications, starting with tugs, ferries, and defense, backed by years’ worth of signed contracts and a pipeline that spans every vessel type on the water.

The technology is proven, the momentum is building, and the opportunity is enormous. The marine industry is going electric, and Arc is building the platform that powers it.

Who we’re looking for

We're looking for someone fired up by the mission and ready to build. You'll thrive here if you move fast, take ownership, and care about the details.

This is a full-time, on-site role at our Los Angeles headquarters. You'll report to the Senior Manager, Commercial Systems.

What You'll Do

• Owning thermal and fluid systems across the vessel, including cooling loops, pumps, plumbing, bilge, and ventilation, from specification through design, validation, and production

• Defining system requirements and leading design reviews, making tradeoffs across performance, weight, cost, and manufacturability

• Running structural and thermal analysis to size and validate components before they get built

• Leading hull-to-machinery integration with naval architects, including packaging, weight and LCG, foundation loads, and appendage interfaces

• Partnering with electrical and controls engineers to integrate Arc’s powertrain into the vessel

• Releasing drawings, GD&T, BOMs, and specifications, and driving DFM/DFA with manufacturing and supply chain

• Leading test plans on the bench, at the dock, and on the water, root-causing failures, and driving fixes into production

• Supporting the design of marine propulsion and drivetrain systems, including shafting, couplings, mounts, seals, bearings, and steering hardware

• Driving USCG and ABS compliance and leading supplier evaluations for critical marine hardware

• Mentoring engineers and setting the technical bar for the team

• Up to 15% travel

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Marine, Ocean, or Aerospace Engineering, Naval Architecture, or a related engineering discipline

• 5+ years of industry experience designing and releasing mechanical systems for production, ideally thermal, fluid, or structural systems on vessels or vehicles

• Proven ownership of designs through build, test, and iteration rather than handing them off at release

• Strong structural, thermal, and fluid analysis skills, including FEA and hand calculations (e.g., pump sizing and pressure drop)

• Expert in 3D CAD (NX, SolidWorks, or CATIA) and GD&T, with strong command of PDM/PLM workflows

• Able to lead technical decisions and defend them with data

• Comfortable working hands-on in the shop and on the water, including occasional sea trials

• Able to lift, push, and pull 50 lbs

• This position may require access to information controlled under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Applicants must be a “U.S. person” as defined by ITAR (22 CFR §120.62), i.e., a U.S. citizen, U.S. national, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual (asylee or refugee).

Bonus Qualifications

• Experience designing marine cooling, bilge, ventilation, or other vessel systems, ideally on commercial vessels

• Familiarity with USCG and ABS rules

• Experience with electric or hybrid marine propulsion

• Professional Engineer (PE) license, ideally in Mechanical: Thermal and Fluid Systems or Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering

• Engineering leadership or mentorship experience

• Passion for taking a vessel from a blank sheet to on-water validation

• Comfortable working at a fast but sustainable pace

• Enthusiasm for boating and the water

At Arc, we encourage diversity and consider all qualified applicants equally for employment, regardless of background, identity, or status. You’re always welcome to reach out even if you don’t meet many of these qualifications. Passion and aptitude make up for a lot.

What we offer

The base salary for this role is P3: $150,000  P4: $185,000 annually,

Highly competitive equity grants are included with full time offers. As well as semi-annual bonuses tied to your impact, not just your tenure.

Additionally, Arc offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

• Healthcare benefits — 99% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision

• Parental leave — 14 weeks fully paid for birthing and non-birthing parents

• Generous time off — Highly competitive PTO with an opportunity to earn more time with tenure

• Income protection — Life and disability insurance for all employees

• Retirement savings — Traditional and Roth 401(k) access

• Water fund — $500 for you to spend each year to get out on the water, however you choose

• Professional development — $500 annual reimbursement for professional development and a monthly AI stipend

• Safety Support- Annual reimbursement for PPE, ergonomic equipment and anything that ensures we keep our crew safe

• Captain training — Training and access to take Arc boats out with friends and family

• Office perks — Daily lunches, snacks, and good coffee while onsite

• Relocation assistance — Available depending on role eligibility.

Our values

We move with urgency and build with care. We value these five things above all else:

• Ownership over both your work and the company’s success

• Empathy for colleagues and for customers

• Humility in problem solving and collaboration

• Pragmatism for navigating ambiguity quickly and sensibly

• Inclusion of different backgrounds, opinions, cultures, and perspectives.

We want people who share and embody these values. It is vital that our values align - we’d be happy to elaborate on any or all of these during the interview process.

jobs.description:
Innovate with purpose

At BILL, we believe in empowering the businesses that drive our economy. By replacing outdated financial processes with innovative tools, we help businesses—from startups to established brands—make smarter decisions and gain control of their operations. And we don’t stop there: we’re creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters.

Working here means you become part of a vision-driven team that’s ready to tackle challenges and build cutting-edge solutions. We value purpose, drive, and curiosity—and we thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. We're remote-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. BILLders collaborate to deliver real impact for businesses that need more time in their busy weeks.

BILL builds high performing teams and we seek to hire the best talent for every role. We're committed to building a workplace that fosters inclusion and diverse perspectives, valuing each person’s unique skills and experiences. We’d love to hear from you—you might be just what we’re looking for, whether in this role or another.

✨ Let’s give businesses more time for what matters.

Make your impact at a leading Fintech Company

As a Staff Applied AI Engineer within our BizTech organization, you'll design, develop, and deploy applications, AI agents, and intelligent automations that improve how our business teams operate, including HR, Legal, Sales, Customer Experience, and Finance. Your focus area may change as business priorities evolve.

This is a hands-on software engineering role. We're looking for someone who uses AI as a fundamental part of how they build software, from requirements and architecture through development, testing, and deployment.

You'll work closely with business stakeholders to translate complex problems into production-ready solutions, integrating with our existing enterprise systems while maintaining strong engineering, security, and governance standards.

Success isn't measured by how many agents or applications you build. It's measured by the business outcomes those solutions deliver.

In this role, you will:

• Design, build, deploy, and maintain AI-powered applications, human-in-the-loop agents, and workflow automations supporting multiple business functions.

• Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot to accelerate the software development lifecycle.

• Partner directly with stakeholders across HR, Legal, Sales, Customer Experience, Finance, and other business functions to identify opportunities to eliminate manual work, reduce process friction, and improve employee experiences.

• Build full-stack applications, APIs, integrations, and backend services connecting CRM, Oracle Fusion, NetSuite, and other enterprise applications.

• Develop solutions for areas such as employee services, onboarding, knowledge management, contract workflows, customer support, sales and finance processes, document processing, and operational reporting.

• Embed AI directly into business workflows rather than relying on disconnected tools and manual processes.

• Rapidly prototype solutions, validate them with stakeholders, and deploy successful implementations into production.

• Implement automated testing, AI evaluation suites, monitoring, logging, cost and latency tracking, and appropriate human oversight for AI-powered workflows.

• Follow enterprise security, privacy, data governance, and architecture standards, particularly when handling confidential employee, legal, customer, and financial information.

• Design for AI-specific risks, including prompt injection, data leakage, and over-permissioned agents, with least-privilege access and audit trails.

• Establish reusable components, development patterns, and documentation for enterprise AI delivery, and coach other engineers on using them.

• Provide technical leadership for BizTech AI delivery by setting architecture direction and mentoring other engineers.

• Support AI-enabled workflows in production, including rollout, user training, documentation, and ongoing change management with the business teams you serve.

• Measure delivered outcomes, including efficiency improvements, adoption, quality, and operational cost reduction.

We'd love to chat if you have:

• Strong software engineering experience with a demonstrated ability to design and deliver production applications.

• Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or comparable modern programming languages.

• Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and agentic development environments as part of your daily engineering workflow.

• Experience building applications using LLM APIs, AI agents, tool calling, or intelligent workflow automation.

• Experience developing REST APIs, integrations, and cloud-based services.

• Solid understanding of software architecture, authentication, database design, CI/CD, and automated testing.

• Familiarity with secure software development, access controls, and handling sensitive enterprise data.

• Understanding of AI-specific security risks, such as prompt injection, data leakage, and agent permissioning, and how to evaluate and monitor LLM-based systems in production.

• Ability to work independently, gather requirements, translate ambiguous problems into working solutions with minimal direction, and take ownership from concept through production.

• Track record of technical leadership, including setting architecture direction, influencing across teams without direct authority, and mentoring other engineers.

• Clear written and verbal communication, and the judgment to work with technical and business stakeholders and turn their needs into measurable results.

Preferred:

• Experience with enterprise business systems such as HR, contract lifecycle management, CRM (Salesforce), finance (such as Oracle Fusion or NetSuite), customer support, or enterprise content management platforms.

• Experience developing solutions using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent orchestration, or AI evaluation frameworks, using tooling such as agent frameworks, vector databases, and LLM evaluation tools.

• Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns and workflow automation platforms.

• Experience delivering AI applications in environments with strict security, privacy, audit, and compliance requirements.

• A track record of shipping production systems end to end with agentic development tools, with measurable gains in delivery speed.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

SUMMARY OF POSITION

The engineer provides airline flight operations support with all the necessary data for the pilots and airline flight operation engineers to operate safely and efficiently the Airbus aircraft (validation on request).

He or she ensures flight crew operational documentation updates on all Airbus programs and is in direct contact with customers to support them (validation on request).

He or she contributes to defining the relevant Flight Operations and Training standards and documentation (validation on request).

Duties & Responsibilities

This position is responsible for flight operations support activities including, but not limited to:

• Conducting Technical studies on a set of ATA systems (with regular system modifications), especially liaising with Engineering and Support domains (validation on request),
• Creating or modifying the Operational documentation for the use of pilots (FCOM, AFM, FCTM, MMEL/CDL, QRH), Ops Engineering (APD & WBM) or Cabin Crew (CCOM) either for continuous improvement or new system embodiment (validation on request),
• Defining normal or abnormal procedures for the flight/cabin crew in coordination with other stakeholders,
• Preparing supporting dossier to Airworthiness Authorities (EASA, FAA) under the supervision of a CVE/DAE to justify approved manual change (MMEL/AFM/WBM),
• Studying MMEL dispatch conditions or any deviations to permit the maximum flexibility for operators,
• Reporting to Safety Representative/SMS Officer any potential Safety Systemic issue,
• Evaluating impacts of Mod / SB on his or her dedicated domain,
• Supporting operators, liaising with Engineering support, including answering operator queries on technical subjects about flight operations (validation on request),
• Participating in the development of new tools for flight operations continuous improvement.
• Monitoring of configuration change, and simplification of configuration and creating new content in case of a new combination.

If the engineer is in Performance or Weight & Balance team, his or her main tasks and accountabilities also include:

• Conducting software validation on Airbus performance and weight & balance tools.
• Creating and delivering Trim Sheet Package and the supporting documents to the operator.
• Creating and delivering performance and documentation loads as part of EFB data production activity.
• Support NAVBLUE services (e.g manual customization).
• Other duties reasonably determined from time to time by the Company

Additional responsibility:

• Supporting junior FOE in validating their peripheral activities to serve the technical content of the operational documentation and in validating their answer to operators queries on technical subjects about flight operations.

Personal & Interpersonal Skills

• Versatile person with proven ability to work in changing environments under time pressure
• Capacity to organize and prioritize tasks in a team spirit working environment
• Communication skills (written, verbal) and customer-focused personality; experience is a plus
• Language skills: English Negotiation Level.

Qualification & Professional skills

• Bachelor degree in aeronautical engineering or equivalent
• Sound knowledge and understanding of aircraft systems (function, in service and architecture) and flight physics, or ability to quickly learn and understand
• Knowledge of airline operations, or practical aviation experience, or flight operations experience is advantageous,

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Title: Associate Practice Manager

Company: Oak Street Health

Role Description:

The purpose of an Associate Practice Manager at Oak Street Health is to lead and manage operations at a single primary care clinic location in accordance with company values and standards.

Associate Practice Managers supervise clinical and non-clinical team members, support operational initiatives, drive their team towards achieving patient satisfaction and clinical outcomes measured via a variety of metrics, and generally ensure the clinic is running smoothly and in a timely manner on a daily basis.

Core Responsibilities:

Staff Management and Development

• Hire, train, supervise, coach, mentor and manage a multi-disciplinary team of 15+
• Ensure the center is a Great Place to Work and our teams are engaged and thriving; build a culture of engagement and demonstrate the Values and Service Behaviors at all times

Clinic Operations

• Ensure clinic operations are running smoothly and safely on a daily basis, including ensuring there is adequate staffing each day, arranging coverage for any call-offs or scheduled PTO and ensuring that all Standard Operating Procedures are followed
• Ensure that we are providing an Unmatched Patient Experience and provide service recovery as needed
• Drive results for patients in Oak Street Health's care model by ensuring that standard meetings, huddles and best practices for preventive care are being followed. Support the clinical and service team in achieving a variety of patient experience, clinical outcomes and team member experience metrics
• Lead the implementation of in-clinic operational initiatives, including training the team on new initiatives and workflows
• Ensure our patient scheduling processes are executed efficiently
• Oversee our clinical and community areas, including handling any building-related issues in partnership with our Facilities team; serve as the point of contact for our alarm monitoring company, who may contact you if the alarm is tripped after hours.

Leadership and Community Engagement

• Partner with the Center Medical Director and Associate Outreach Manager to lead the center as a triad and make collaborative decisions that support the best interests of the patients and team and drive profitability for the center

Other duties as assigned

Business Manager

As a Business Analysis Manager at Capital One, you will apply your strategic and analytical skills to major company challenges. You'll team with world-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact the bottom line. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

General Responsibilities:

• Strategic leadership: Develop business strategies that will drive growth, profitability, and competitive success for Capital One in the face of shifting consumer and regulatory demands
• Leadership: May manage and develop 1-2 analysts. Coaching and mentoring associates with a goal of developing and retaining talent at Capital One
• Product: Develop and implement new product and pricing strategies for various lending products; lead product level modeling/analytics
• Marketing: Lead direct-to-consumer marketing efforts for select products, and strategic intent for products distributed through the retail channel. Build targeted insights to inform the design and development of new customer experiences, as well as breakthrough technology and concepts designed to deliver on new go-to-market strategies
• Credit Risk: Drive step-change improvements in credit performance by connecting drivers of future consumer credit trends to historical behavior, creating risk models, and testing hypotheses using rigorous monitoring and analysis
• Execution: Manage and sequence delivery of business intent, build business requirements and execute against the product strategy. Oversee multiple projects and programs concurrently
• Partnership: Work closely with colleagues across Capital One including: IT, Sales, Operations, Finance and others to drive improvement in quality, volume, service, and profitability
• Strategic & analytic orientation: A proven track record of decision making and problem solving based on analytics. Conceptual thinking skills must be complemented by a strong quantitative orientation, given that a large part of the business is based on rigorous analytic marketing & credit risk management
• Strong business judgment, leadership and integrity: He/she should be a tenacious decision maker, able to bring a healthy, aggressive, yet responsible approach to business
• Solid people leadership experience: Ability to build and leverage the capabilities of a high-performing team, as well as business partners across the enterprise. He/she should foster innovation, drive critical decisions, hold business partners accountable, and be able to consistently deliver results
• Strong executive communication skills: Impeccable written and oral communication credentials, coupled with strategic influencing skills and the ability to drive agreement through intellect, interpersonal and negotiation skills

Meet the Team

We are the Data Center Network Services team within Cisco IT that supports network services for Cisco Engineering and business functions worldwide. Our mission is simple – build the network of the future that is adaptable and agile on Cisco’s networking solutions. Cisco IT networks are deployed, monitored, and managed with a DevOps approach to support rapid application changes. We invest in transformative technologies that enable us to deliver services in a fast and reliable manner.

The team culture is collaborative and fun, where thinking creatively and tinkering on new ideas are encouraged.

Your Impact

You will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying network solutions for Data Center networks. You have strong interpersonal skills and are comfortable collaborating with fellow engineers, cross-functional engineering teams, and internal clients. You will create and implement innovative, high-quality capabilities to provide our clients with the best possible experience.

Minimum Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field with 2+ years of experience in Data Center networking, cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML fabrics.
• Solid technical foundation in Cisco Data Center Networking technologies, including Nexus, ACI, VPC, VXLAN, BGP, EVPN, Routing & Switching, Local/Global Load Balancers, and Firewalls.
• Experience handling incidents, problem, and change management processes and familiarity with DevOps principles, Agile practices, and software engineering concepts (e.g., reading/understanding code).
• Hands-on experience developing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation workflows using Terraform and Ansible.
• 1–2+ years of programming or scripting experience (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) with a solid grasp of software fundamentals, standard data structures, and Git version control.
• Familiarity with networking requirements for GPU clusters, high-performance computing (HPC) environments, and hardware/software lifecycle management.
• Experience implementing or utilizing observability, monitoring, and telemetry tools for network health and performance tracking.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and partner effectively with cross-functional engineering teams to troubleshoot issues.

Preferred Qualifications

• Understanding Build & Release Operations, DevOps principles, and Agile practices with a focus on quality-driven development.
• Familiarity with Unix/Linux environments and domain knowledge of contemporary network technologies, network management, and protocols.
• Experience with application/platform instrumentation, measurement, log data processing, monitoring, and tools such as JIRA, GIT, and Jenkins.
• Cisco certifications (CCNA or CCNP) and experience managing Cisco Nexus Dashboard, APIC, Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller, and VXLAN-based networks including troubleshooting.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Personal Banker Northside Miami FL
jobs.description:
Why Wells Fargo:

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. Living the Well Life means you’re supported in life, not just work. It means having robust benefits, competitive compensation, and programs designed to help you find work-life balance and well-being. You’ll be rewarded for investing in your community, celebrated for being your authentic self, and empowered to grow. And we’re recognized for it – Wells Fargo once again ranked in the top five on the 2026 LinkedIn Top Companies list of best workplaces “to grow your career” in the U.S. Join us!

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking an Associate Personal Banker (SAFE) to join our National Branch Network. In this frontline role, you will build relationships with customers by supporting everyday banking needs through in‑branch interactions, scheduled conversations, and proactive outreach. You will learn about customers’ goals and connect them to the right banking products, services, and digital tools to help them manage their finances with confidence.

You will support account openings, service requests, and credit applications while working closely with branch teammates to deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience. Success is driven by strong relationship building, sound judgment, and the ability to balance service with growth.

As a member of a leading financial institution, this role provides a strong foundation for long-term career growth and mobility, supported by Wells Fargo’s training and coaching.

In this role you will:

• Build lasting customer relationships through proactive, meaningful conversations that support financial well-being and deepen engagement
• Lead discovery-driven conversations to understand customer needs and connect them with relevant banking products, services, and solutions
• Drive branch growth by identifying opportunities, promoting solutions, and making appropriate referrals to meet customer and business goals
• Support everyday banking needs, including new account openings, service requests, and credit applications
• Perform cash handling and teller line activities, accurately processing transactions while maintaining compliance and operational standards
• Demonstrate comfort using and adopting digital tools and technologies to enhance the customer experience and support evolving banking needs
• Deliver accurate, compliant service while exercising sound judgement within defined risk controls
• Collaborate with branch teammates to coordinate seamless handoffs to licensed bankers or other specialists, ensuring customers are connected to the right expertise

Required Qualifications:

• 6+ months of interacting with customers experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:

• Prior experience in financial services or a highly regulated, customer-facing role, demonstrating comfort with structured processes, accuracy, and service expectations
• Experience building trust-based customer relationships through active listening, follow-up, and consistent engagement
• Comfort initiating outreach (calls, emails, or other channels) to strengthen relationships and identify opportunities to support customer needs
• Demonstrated comfort with digital tools and technology, with the ability to quickly learn new systems and confidently guide customers in adopting capabilities that enhance their banking experience
• Ability to identify customer needs and connect them to appropriate solutions, including referrals when additional expertise is needed
• Proven ability to collaborate with teammates and partners to resolve needs and deliver a seamless customer experience
• Demonstrated ability to follow policies and regulations while identifying and escalating risk concerns

Job Expectations:

• Ability to work a schedule that will include Saturdays

jobs.title: Software Engineer – India ComSec (NCCS)
jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/25/2026

This is a hybrid role in Raleigh, North Carolina. (RTP)

Meet the Team

You will be a member of the Global Certification Team (GCT), which consists of experts from the ComSec team, Defense Programs team, CC team, FIPS team, and IPv6 team. You'll have the opportunity to architect, design, develop, and test some of the world's newest and most popular systems.

Your Impact

As a Junior Engineer on the India ComSec team, you will help bring Cisco products through National Centre for Communication Security (NCCS) “India Comsec” certification. You will build and maintain test environments, implement security and network test procedures, collect and organize evidence, analyze findings, and partner with Cisco engineering business units and accredited test labs. You will also use automation frameworks and responsible AI-assisted engineering tools to improve repeatability, documentation quality, and program visibility. You will work independently and as part of a team, managing multiple priorities while developing expertise across networking, cybersecurity, and product certification.

• Maintain and manage the lab infrastructure that supports India ComSec certification activities.

• Build test networks, including the configuration, installation, and setup of routers, switches, wireless products, and supporting systems.

• Implement internal readiness and certification testing against applicable security requirements, recording clear and reproducible results.

• Collect, organize, and review technical evidence and certification documentation; maintain test records, trackers, and status updates.

• Triage test findings and coordinate with engineering business units and accredited labs to reproduce issues, gather technical recommendations, and support resolution.
• Perform remote testing with accredited test centers, with travel up to 10% of the time.
• Research, design, develop, and document technical solutions and repeatable procedures using scripting, automation, and responsible AI-assisted tools.

Minimum Qualifications

• Experience working with Cisco products.

• Working knowledge of IP routing protocols and switching technologies (e.g., LAN/WAN, STP, OSPF, BGP, VRRP/HSRP, IPv4, IPv6).
• Ability to build test networks, including configuration and setup of routers, switches, wireless controllers or firewalls.
• Understanding of security concepts and frameworks: SSHv2, PKI, IPSec, TLS, AAA, Zero Trust, NIST 800-53.
• Community college or higher education in Information Technology/Systems, Computer Science, or engineering, or a similar background, or 4 years additional work experience in a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience supporting product security certification, compliance testing, or regulated laboratory testing; familiarity with NCCS/ITSAR/Comsec, FIPS 140, Common Criteria, NIST guidance, or related security standards.

• CCNA, CCNP Enterprise, CCNP Security, CyberOps Associate, or a comparable networking or cybersecurity certification.

• Familiarity with APIs and data models (REST, NETCONF/RESTCONF, YANG, JSON/YAML), and Git.

• Familiarity with Linux or Windows administration and virtualized lab environments used to host test tools and supporting services.

• Familiarity with AI-assisted tooling and responsible, secure AI usage; ability to document environments with Visio, draw.io, or diagrams-as-code.

• Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills; detail oriented, self-motivated, strong time management, and able to work independently and in a team.

S&TO

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

About Services Strategy & Operations
The Services Strategy & Operations team supports Global Services & Delivery (GS&D) by translating strategic priorities into execution, implementation, and measurable outcomes.

The team improves service and operating models, leads strategic and operational initiatives, and strengthens collaboration across business units including Client Services, Conferences and Executive Services. It connects people, processes, data, and technology to improve client value, retention, effectiveness, and business performance.

Working across a highly matrixed organization, the team builds trusted partnerships, influences stakeholders without formal authority, and brings structure and momentum to complex initiatives.

About the role
We are seeking a Director, Services Strategy & Operations to help GS&D execute its highest-priority strategic and operational initiatives.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact leadership role for an individual who can move confidently between strategic thinking and hands-on execution. You will take business priorities and ideas, shape them into practical plans, align stakeholders, and drive delivery through to measurable outcomes.

The role will support one of three primary areas—Client Services, Gartner Conferences, or Gartner Executive Services—with the specific focus aligned to the successful candidate’s experience, capabilities, and business needs.

The talent pool and assessment process will be shared across these opportunities, with candidates matched to the role where they can make the greatest impact. You will partner with senior leaders and teams across a range of functions to improve how Gartner delivers value to clients and operates at scale.

• Translate strategic priorities into clear execution plans, milestones, ownership, and success measures.

jobs.title: Travelling Wind Farm Field Service Technician
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Reporting to the Service Director, the Travelling Wind Farm Service Technician provides critical operational support across our national fleet. This role is pivotal in maintaining site performance, offering on-site technical leadership, and driving rapid troubleshooting of complex electrical assets. You will serve as a support interface between site management, internal engineering teams, and our clients to ensure maximum turbine availability and fleet optimization. This role will require you to travel frequently to our different wind farm sites.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:

• Interpret the requirements of GEV manuals, specifications, bulletins and complete assigned tasks in accordance with GEV work instructions.
• Perform and ensure the proper maintenance and fault finding of assets.
• Act as the site HVOA Delegate when required.
• Nominated as the High Voltage operating Authority delegate for the site when required.
• Perform high voltage switching operations according to site procedures as required.
• Have a working knowledge of electrical installation requirements
• Ensure all work is performed in accordance with the above documents and to the organisation’s SWMS, LOTO, associated EHS & QA/QC policies/procedures.
• Drive a positive reporting culture by identifying errors, violations, incidents or problems immediately using GEV systems.
• Maintain a working knowledge of the Registered Electrical Contractor (REC) responsibilities.
• Supervise electrical installation/maintenance work when required.
• Maintain reports using GEV’s various software management tools and databases.
• Report errors, violations, incidents or problems immediately using GEV reporting systems.
• Submit enquiries to Engineering to ensure technical issues are resolved.
• Work closely with and answer questions from Management, Engineering, Sourcing and Service Teams as required.
• Uphold and maintain Quality Control, by making conformance or non-conformance decisions upon completion of tasks and inspections.
• Form part of an on-call roster to work weekends and nights if required or as directed by management.
• Champion Safety by being familiar with and following all EHS policies, and procedures applicable to the job and cooperating with GEV investigations and EHS audits.

Qualifications and Experience:

• As a minimum, hold a registered Workers License Electrical (A-Grade or equivalent).
• Demonstrate previous experience in the Onshore Wind sector or similar heavy industry (Five years Minimum) would be highly regarded.
• Be nominated as the Electrical Supervisor in accordance with the Registered Electrical Contactors license and hold the position as the Nominated Qualified Supervisor - Electrical on behalf of the company.
• Understanding of basic AC/DC electrical circuits and ability to T/S and conduct circuit analysis (24VDC, 166VDC, 120, 230, 400, 575, 690VAC);
• Demonstrate previous experience in High Voltage switching and operations.
• Have a current High Voltage operating certificate or the ability to gain one.
• Proficient in fault finding electrical and hydraulic equipment.
• Trained to an intermediate level in computer skills.
• Must have the ability to climb wind turbines and complete physically demanding tasks at heights.
• Experience working in remote locations and autonomously.
• Must be willing to travel >65% of the year.

Desired Characteristics:

• HRWL including Dogging, Rigging (Advanced), Forklift, EWP.
• CSE
• GWO Advanced

As GE Vernova is a global organization, working across different time zones, and monitoring, reading and responding to contact outside normal working hours can be expected.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

jobs.title: Senior Test & Evaluation Engineer (Flight/Mission/System Test)
jobs.description:
Senior Test & Evaluation Engineer (Flight/Mission/System Test)

Company:

The Boeing Company

Boeing Test and Evaluation (BT&E) is looking for a Senior Test & Evaluation Engineer (Flight/Mission/System Test) to join our Bombers team at Edwards Air Force Base (AFB), CA.

This position supports developmental ground and flight testing the B-52 Stratofortress programs. The Boeing Company supports multiple platforms at Edwards AFB in conjunction with 419th Flight Test Squadron, Global Power Bomber Combined Test Force (CTF), working directly with government and industry partners to improve the warfighting capabilities of the United States Air Force. This position will focus on test planning, test execution, problem identification and resolution, data collection and analysis, and customer interaction in a fast-paced team environment.

Edwards AFB is the home of the 412th Test Wing and the 2nd largest Air Force base. The Test Wing oversees base day-to-day operations and provides support for over 10,000 military, federal, civilian, and contract personnel assigned to a 481-square mile installation. The 412th Test Wing plans, conducts, analyzes, and reports on all flight and ground testing of aircraft, weapons systems, software and components as well as modeling and simulation for the U.S. Air Force. There are three core components for this mission: flying operations, maintenance, and engineering.

Position Responsibilities Include:

• Develops and documents standardized test methods and processes to ensure repeatability and productivity
• Leads the development of test procedures
• Applies lessons learned to the improvement of test procedures
• Designs calibration system/test fixtures. Develops data processing tools and algorithms
• Generates calibration procedures and software
• Guides others in the design of test hardware, software and systems to achieve test requirements
• Oversees debriefing of the test team. Leads the analysis, processing and formatting of data to customer requirements
• Approves test data prior to delivery to customer
• Formulates expectations for test data based on historical data
• Performs functions as required to ensure calibration system readiness and data validity
• Trains others
• Works under minimal direction

• Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology (including Manufacturing Technology), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement
• This position requires an active Secret U.S. Security Clearance. (A U.S. Security Clearance that has been active in the past 24 months is considered active.)
• Experience supporting a military flight test program
• 5+ years of experience with flight test, flight operations, or system test
• 5+ years of experience in complex test planning, development, and execution
• 3+ years of experienced as a Test Conductor, Test Director and Lead Verification Engineer

jobs.description:
Struct & Payload Design Engineer

Company:

The Boeing Company

The H-47 Chinook Airframes team is seeking an Associate Structural & Payload Design Engr to join our team in Ridley Park PA. The selected candidate will have a statement of work that spans the product lifecycle: conceptualizing new designs, creating and releasing detailed engineering for both new customer platform variants as well as current in production variants, supporting factory production and suppliers with engineering updates. Your work will include the need to interface with other members of H-47 engineering, stress, mechanical systems, electrical systems, production engineering, management, and technical staff to define and implement engineering solutions.

Position Responsibilities:

• Assists to develop, integrate and document structural and interior payload system requirements to establish the system design.
• Develops, maintains and modifies basic structural and interior payload system and component designs, using 3-D Computer Aided Design tools and/or other design methods, to provide product definition to other engineering groups, production operations, suppliers and external customers throughout the product lifecycle. Performs tests to validate and verify systems and components meet requirements and specifications.

At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

SUMMARY
Directs the activities of the Machine Support group. Responsible for maintaining production schedules and ensuring that quality standards are adhered to by the group.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

LEADERSHIP AND MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES

Recruitment and Retention:
·         Recruit, interview and hire Process Engineers, Industrial Techs, WAVE Techs, and Machine Support Techs
·         Communicate criteria to recruiters for Process Engineers, Industrial Techs, WAVE Techs, and Machine Support Techs candidates.
·         Coach machine support department staff in the interviewing/hiring process.
·         Monitor team member turnover; identify key factors that can be improved; make improvements.

Employee and Team Development:
·         Identify individual and team strengths and development needs on an ongoing basis.
·         Create and/or validate training curriculum in area of responsibility.
·         Coach and mentor tooling department staff to deliver excellence to every internal and external customer.
·         Create and manage succession plans for the machine shop function.

Performance Management:
·         Establish clear measurable goals and objectives by which to determine individual and team results (i.e. operational metrics, results against project timelines, training documentation, attendance records, knowledge of operational roles and responsibilities, personal development goals).
·         Solicit ongoing feedback from Workcell Manager (WCM), Business Unit Manager (BUM), peers and team member on the PE team member’s contribution to the workcell. Provide ongoing coaching and counseling to team member based on feedback.
·         Express pride in staff and encourage them to feel good about their accomplishments.
·         Perform team member evaluations professionally and on time.
·         Drive individuals and the team to continuously improve in key operational metrics and the achievement of the organizational goals.
·         Coordinate activities of large teams and keep them focused in times of crises.
·         Ensure recognition and rewards are managed fairly and consistently in area of responsibility.

Communication:
·         Provide communication forum for the exchange of ideas and information with the department.
·         Organize verbal and written ideas clearly and use an appropriate business style.
·         Ask questions; encourage input from team members.
·         Assess communication style of individual team members and adapt own communication style accordingly.

TECHNICAL MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES

·         Oversees the maintenance management program including repair parts, preventative maintenance, feeder maintenance, and the support equipment maintenance program
·         Plans the activities of the technical staff
·         Develops and maintains all department reports/records
·         Supervises the planning and execution of line moves and builds
·         Schedules equipment vendors for installation, repair and updates of equipment
·         Assure that procedures and work instructions are efficient and not redundant.
·         Offer new ideas and suggestions for improvement. Identify and implement new practices and processes that are “best in field.”
·         Demonstrate a commitment to customer service; anticipate, meet, and exceed expectations by solving problems quickly and effectively; making customer issues a priority.
·         Lead by example; “walk the talk.”
·         Utilize Jabil’s Advanced Engineering group to ensure useful support to Jabil South.
·         Establish new measurement systems if/where possible.
·         Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.
Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering preferred; and three years experience in maintenance management; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Hands-on experience and knowledge of Surface Mount Technologies (SMT) and Thru-hole equipment/gear, process optimization, Statistical Process Control, Design for Manufacturability, Design for Test, Demand Flow Technology (line balancing), and Design of Experiment methodologies. Knowledge of engineering disciplines including chemistry, mechanical, electrical, and industrial as it pertains to surface mount and final assembly.

jobs.title: Sr. Layout Engineer
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As a Layout Engineer in the DRAM Design & Engineer Group, (DDEG) you will translate schematics into manufacturable layouts that meet design intent, process rules, and schedule commitments for advanced DRAM.  You’ll partner with Development, Process Integration, and CAD teams on floorplanning, implementing, and verifying custom digital, memory, and analog circuits. You will also help improve methods, automation, and documentation for others.    You will play a crucial role in developing layouts for critical custom, memory, analog, or standard cell circuits, ensuring predictable, on‑time delivery of memory designs. Agentic AI

Responsibilities:

• Design and Development: Create layout designs for critical circuits, ensuring compliance with process rules and schematic intent. Work closely with Design, Process, and CAD engineers to deliver solutions from floorplan through final design.
• Layout Verification: Perform verification tasks such as LVS (Layout vs. Schematic), DRC (Design Rule Check), and quality checks. Continuously improve verification tools and methodologies to ensure high‑quality layouts.
• Methods, Automation & Documentation: Tackle ambiguous problems; prototype solutions without a playbook; then codify them into guides/SOPs and share with the team. Contribute scripts (e.g., SKILL/Python) and layout method improvements to advance automation and drive measurable productivity gains. Integrate automated layout solutions to shape the future of layout design.
• On‑Time Delivery: Coordinate with global partners to meet predictable schedules and support tapeout/mask generation processes. Deliver block‑level layouts within specified timelines while maintaining quality standards.
• Project Management: Lead layout planning for assigned blocks or sub‑projects; coordinate priorities, provide guidance to other engineers, and ensure schedule alignment. Mentor team members on layout techniques, verification protocols, and tool usage.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree, or equivalent experience, in Electrical Engineering (or related) and 5+ years of experience in semiconductor custom/memory/analog layout experience with demonstrated block/project leadership, to include mentoring and schedule management, or a Masters degree in Electrical Engineering and 4+ years of the above experience.
• Solid working knowledge of CMOS Circuit Design and VLSI
• Experience crafting the custom physical layout of circuits
• Strong experience using Cadence Virtuoso
• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, working with ambiguity with high attention to detail and quality
• A self-motivated, hard-working team player who enjoys working with others.
• Good communication and documentation skills
• Desire to drive innovation into the future Memory generation within a multifaceted work environment.

What Sets You Apart:

• Knowledge of layout synthesis and place and route techniques
• Proven track record to lead others to meet milestones
• Experience with LVS and DRC tools such as Calibre
• Use AI-Enabled tools to assist in layout floor planning, place and route
• Standard cell construction and analog layout techniques
• An innovative approach that is open to improving upon any of our processes or products.

jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...
