Are you a seasoned product leader with minimum of 8+ years of Product Management experience who thrives on solving complex business challenges at massive scale? Join Walmart's Merchandising & Supply Chain Product organization to define strategy, build AI-powered products, and drive innovation across one of the world's largest retail ecosystems, impacting millions of customers, suppliers, and associates every day.

Role summary: As a Staff Product Manager within Walmart’s Merchandising and Supply Chain Product organization, you will define and drive product strategy for some of the most complex systems in retail, helping improve how merchandise moves from suppliers through Walmart’s operations and ultimately to customers.

We are hiring multiple Staff Product Managers across areas including Supplier & Sourcing; Assortment & Space; Forecasting; Inventory & Replenishment; Fulfillment; Transportation; Delivery; and Returns. You will own strategy and roadmaps for complex products and capabilities while partnering across business, product, engineering, design and data science to simplify experiences, improve decision-making, and build scalable solutions. This role requires system-level thinking, deep customer and business understanding, strong cross-functional influence, and disciplined execution from discovery through value realization.

One application. Multiple opportunities. Candidates may be considered for multiple Staff Product Manager openings across our Merchandising and Supply Chain Product organization based on their experience, strengths, and interests.

About the Team:
Walmart’s Merchandising and Supply Chain Product teams build technology that supports how we select, source, plan, move, fulfill, and deliver merchandise at Walmart scale. Our teams work across the lifecycle of merchandise, from enabling suppliers and merchants to make better decisions, to forecasting demand and positioning inventory, to improving fulfillment, transportation, delivery, and returns. We bring together product, engineering, data science, design, and business expertise to solve complex retail problems and create simpler, more effective experiences for our customers, associates, merchants, and suppliers.

We are also exploring how advances in AI, machine learning and optimization can improve decision-making, streamline complex workflows, and unlock new experiences across merchandising and supply chain.

Depending on your experience, you could work across:

• Supplier & Sourcing: Improving the tools and experiences that help suppliers and merchants collaborate and make sourcing and commercial decisions.
• Assortment & Space: Helping merchants determine what to sell and how to tailor assortments and space to customer and market needs.
• Forecasting: Building capabilities that help anticipate customer demand and improve planning.
• Inventory & Replenishment: Helping ensure inventory is positioned where and when it is needed.
• Fulfillment: Building products that improve how customer demand is fulfilled across Walmart’s network.
• Transportation: Developing capabilities that improve how merchandise moves through the supply chain.
• Delivery: Creating products that make customer delivery faster, more reliable, and more convenient.
• Returns: Improving the returns experience for customers and associates while helping the business make better decisions about returned inventory.

What you'll do:

• Own product strategy and roadmaps for complex products and platforms, driving outcomes from discovery through launch, adoption, and scale.
• Develop a deep understanding of customers and users, including suppliers, merchants, associates, and consumers, to identify pain points and high-value opportunities.
• Think at a system level, understanding how decisions in one area can affect other parts of merchandising and supply chain.
• Translate complex business problems into scalable products, clear requirements, prioritization frameworks, and phased delivery plans.
• Simplify workflows and experiences, helping users move more seamlessly from insight to decision to action.
• Apply data, AI, machine learning, and optimization where they can improve decision-making and create better user experiences.
• Partner across product, engineering, design, data science, operations, and business teams to align priorities and drive execution.
• Define and measure success through clear customer, operational, and business outcomes.
• Use experimentation, research, feedback, and performance data to continuously improve products and experiences.
• Build for scale, developing capabilities that can support Walmart’s complex businesses, channels, and markets.
• Lead through influence, bringing clarity to ambiguity, navigating tradeoffs, and aligning stakeholders around a shared product direction.
• Raise the product management bar, mentoring other product managers and strengthening product practices across the organization.

Our hubs: Walmart is a global company with offices across the United States and around the world. Our global headquarters is in Bentonville, Arkansas, with primary hubs in the San Francisco Bay area and New York/New Jersey.

Walmart's Last Mile Delivery organization is looking for a Senior Manager, Operations to help lead our Digital Identity team, where innovation, operational excellence, and adaptability are essential to success.

In this role, you'll lead a team responsible for driving identity verification operations that help protect our delivery ecosystem while supporting a seamless experience for drivers. You'll navigate an evolving landscape of operational challenges and emerging fraud risks, using data to uncover opportunities, solve problems, and build scalable solutions.

Success in this role requires more than managing day-to-day operations. You'll develop talent, build high-performing teams, and partner across the business to turn ambiguity into action. If you're energized by solving problems, developing people, and making a measurable impact in a rapidly growing and evolving business, this is an opportunity to help shape the future of Last Mile Delivery at Walmart.

What You'll Do

• Build and inspire a high-performing team: Lead, coach, and develop associates by setting clear expectations, identifying skill and knowledge gaps, and creating opportunities for growth. Build a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and strong execution.

• Turn data into solutions: Go beyond reporting metrics to uncover the root causes of operational challenges. Translate complex data and business trends into actionable insights, develop solutions, and measure their impact on business performance.

• Lead through ambiguity and change: Navigate the fast-moving Last Mile Delivery environment with confidence and adaptability. Establish priorities, make informed decisions with incomplete information, and guide your team through evolving business needs while maintaining operational excellence.

• Drive operational improvements that scale: Identify inefficiencies, anticipate challenges, and implement innovative solutions that improve accuracy, streamline identity verification processes, reduce costs, and strengthen operational performance.

• Lead complex initiatives from strategy to execution: Build and oversee operational workstreams, establish milestones, align resources, and drive successful implementations. Remove roadblocks, monitor results, and adjust strategies to deliver meaningful business outcomes.

• Influence and collaborate across the business: Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Driver Experience, Product, and other stakeholders to solve complex challenges, align priorities, and deliver secure, efficient identity verification solutions.

• A problem-solving mindset grounded in data: The ability to interpret data, recognize patterns, identify root causes, and translate insights into practical solutions that drive measurable improvements. Deep technical expertise isn't required, but curiosity and analytical thinking are essential.

• Confidence navigating ambiguity: A track record of delivering results in fast-paced, evolving environments where priorities shift, challenges emerge, and solutions aren't always clearly defined.

• Strong operational leadership: Experience building, improving, and scaling operational processes, leading complex initiatives, and holding teams accountable for outcomes.

• A bias for action and continuous improvement: The ability to move from identifying a problem to implementing a solution, challenging existing processes, and finding better ways to deliver results.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Operations - Knowledge Management
jobs.location: (USA) Upstream Building AR Bentonville Home Office
jobs.description:
Position Summary...

The Senior Manager, Knowledge Management leads the strategy, architecture, governance, and transformation of knowledge across Marketplace Seller Support and Risk Operations. This leader will build a globally scalable, AI-enabled knowledge ecosystem that delivers accurate, actionable information to associates and systems at the point of work.

Responsible for knowledge content, technology, operational performance, and team leadership, the Senior Manager will establish executive partnerships, documentation accountability, and measurable standards for quality, speed, and adoption. The role will modernize how knowledge is created, maintained, retrieved, and applied, enabling more consistent decisions, stronger associate performance, and better seller experiences.

What you'll do...

Knowledge Strategy & Governance

• Define and execute a global knowledge management strategy, operating model, and roadmap across Seller Support and Risk Operations.

• Establish governance frameworks, content ownership, decision rights, documentation standards, and service-level agreements with business stakeholders.

• Partner directly with Risk, Seller Support, Policy, Product, and Technology leaders to anticipate changes, resolve dependencies, and ensure knowledge readiness for business initiatives.

• Proactively identify conflicting policies, inconsistent guidance, and knowledge gaps, driving resolution with accountable business owners.

Knowledge Architecture & Content Operations

• Own the end-to-end lifecycle of knowledge articles and reference materials, including development, validation, publishing, maintenance, and retirement.

• Establish and optimize taxonomy, metadata, categorization, information architecture, and content relationships to improve discoverability, reuse, and accuracy.

• Lead knowledge inventory rationalization, content cleanup, SME validation, and migration to a modern knowledge management platform.

• Establish efficient intake, approval, and publishing workflows that support rapid business changes without compromising quality.

• Develop accessible, audience-centered knowledge experiences, including visual summaries and other formats that improve comprehension and awareness.

Knowledge Technology & AI Enablement

• Lead the selection, implementation, integration, and ongoing optimization of a modern, AI-native knowledge management system.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to embed trusted, permission-aware knowledge into associate workflows and AI-assisted support.

• Establish standards for knowledge retrieval, source reliability, version control, access permissions, and AI-generated answer quality.

• Identify opportunities to automate content maintenance, approval routing, publishing, and knowledge distribution.

• Ensure knowledge architecture supports both human associates and AI systems while maintaining appropriate governance and controls.

Global Scalability & Regionalization

• Establish a global knowledge operating model that balances consistent standards with country-specific policies, languages, regulatory requirements, and operational practices.

• Define governance for regional content variations, translation, localization, and role-based access across internal teams and BPO partners.

• Partner with regional leaders to ensure knowledge remains accurate, relevant, and accessible as Marketplace expands into new countries.

Knowledge Intelligence & Business Impact

• Establish KPIs and reporting for knowledge quality, search effectiveness, article helpfulness, change cycle time, adoption, and productivity.

• Use content analytics, associate feedback, search behavior, and operational data to identify knowledge gaps, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.

• Surface knowledge-related risks and insights to business leaders, including contradictory guidance, unclear procedures, and documentation gaps.

• Connect knowledge effectiveness to operational outcomes, including associate proficiency, case handling efficiency, quality, and seller experience.

People Leadership & Operational Excellence

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of knowledge professionals, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and development pathways.

• Assess team capabilities, capacity, and organizational design to improve productivity and support a scalable operating model.

• Leverage AI, automation, and process improvements to reduce administrative effort, eliminate rework, and increase speed and quality.

• Establish strong cross-functional ways of working with Instructional Design, Facilitation, Program Management, and Communication & Engagement while maintaining clear ownership of knowledge deliverables.

What You'll Bring

• Demonstrated experience leading knowledge management, content strategy, knowledge operations, or related enterprise functions.

• Strong expertise in knowledge architecture, taxonomy, metadata, content governance, and enterprise knowledge management platforms.

• Experience building or transforming knowledge ecosystems, including platform implementation, migration, and operational optimization.

• Understanding of AI-powered knowledge retrieval, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and the requirements for accurate, governed AI-assisted answers.

• Proven ability to establish executive partnerships, influence cross-functional decisions, and drive accountability across business functions.

• Experience leading and developing teams, managing performance, and optimizing resources and capacity.

• Strong analytical skills with experience defining KPIs, measuring effectiveness, and connecting knowledge performance to business outcomes.

• Ability to lead through ambiguity, balance strategic transformation with operational execution, and deliver at speed without compromising quality.

• Experience supporting global service operations, contact centers, multilingual environments, or BPO partnerships preferred.

What Success Looks Like

A globally scalable Knowledge Management function with a trusted source of truth, clear governance, measurable performance, and efficient content operations. Associates can find and apply accurate information when they need it, business leaders have visibility into knowledge gaps and risks, and AI-enabled systems can reliably consume governed knowledge to improve operational performance and the seller experience.

jobs.title: Summer 2027 Corporate Intern: APD Automation Engineer
jobs.location: (USA) Together Building AR Bentonville Home Office
jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...

The Internship:

The Walmart Automated Pick and Delivery (APD) Internship is an 11-week program held during the summer of 2027. It is open to undergraduate students graduating between December 2027 and August 2028. This paid internship will prepare associates for a career with Walmart APD. Interns will work on meaningful projects, network with industry experts, and develop their skills while having an enriching summer experience.

About Automated Pickup & Delivery (APD):
Automated Pickup & Delivery (APD) centers are Walmart’s automated grocery fulfillment facilities that combine robotics, software systems, and in-store operations to fulfill online grocery orders at scale. These systems sit at the intersection of physical automation, software platforms, and store operations, and are a critical part of Walmart’s long-term eCommerce and grocery strategy. APDs are designed to:

• Increase daily order throughput per store

• Improve labor productivity (Units Per Labor Hour – UPLH)

• Deliver reliable, fast pickup experiences for customers

Role Summary:
The APD Engineering Intern (Undergraduate) will work on real-world automation and fulfillment problems that directly impact throughput, labor efficiency, system availability, and customer experience. Interns will join one of several APD engineering-focused teams and contribute to projects that improve how automation is designed, deployed, operated, and scaled across Walmart stores. This role is ideal for undergraduate engineers who want hands-on experience working on large-scale, real-world systems where software, hardware, and operations intersect.

What You’ll Learn:

• How automated fulfillment systems operate end-to-end in live retail environments

• How engineering decisions affect cost, productivity, and customer experience

• How data, simulation, and experimentation drive operational improvements

• How cross-functional teams (engineering, product, operations) work together to scale automation

Team Options & Focus Areas
Interns will be aligned to one primary team, based on interest and business need:

1. Process Engineering
Focus: Operational processes and labor efficiency
This team defines how store associates and automation work together day-to-day. You’ll help:

• Analyze operational workflows and identify bottlenecks

• Improve throughput and labor productivity (UPLH)

• Evaluate process changes and their impact on capacity and efficiency

Example problems:

• How should work be sequenced to maximize throughput?

• Where does labor time get lost during peak volume?

2. Integration & Implementation
Focus: Operations readiness and launch, construction and design, and successful automation adoption
This team manages the end to end construction and launch and ensures stores are fully prepared to operate automation. You’ll help:

• Support site launch planning and track key readiness milestones

• Analyze operational data to identify workflow and throughput issues

• Review site layouts and identify gaps between system design and real-world store usage

• Develop tools, documentation, or feedback loops to improve adoption and address issues

Example problems:

• What causes stores to struggle after automation go-live?

• How can we reduce ramp-up time and operational errors?

• What causes certain sites to perform below others in key acceptance metrics?

3. Stability & Scalability
Focus: Automation reliability, availability, and customer impact

This team ensures automation is available 98%+ of the time, minimizing customer disruption. You’ll help:

• Analyze downtime, failure modes, and recovery processes

• Identify patterns that reduce automation availability

• Propose improvements to monitoring, response, or system design

Example problems:

• What causes automation downtime and how do we prevent it?

• How do we design systems that scale without increasing failure risk?

Sample Intern Projects (Across Teams)

• Analyze a specific APD workflow and assess its impact on:

• Throughput

• Labor efficiency

• System availability

• Build a data-backed recommendation to improve a process, design, or operational outcome

• Support a pilot or site review by summarizing performance, risks, and improvement opportunities

• Use simulation, analysis, or structured problem-solving to evaluate tradeoffs

Qualifications:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Electrical, Computer, Systems, or related field)

• Expected graduation date between December 2027 and May 2028

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Interest in automation, robotics, operations, or large-scale systems

• Comfortable working with data (Excel/Sheets required; coding or simulation tools a plus)

• Clear written and verbal communication skills

Success Metrics

• Ability to understand and explain complex systems

• Quality of analysis and clarity of recommendations

• Demonstrated impact on throughput, efficiency, reliability, or design outcomes

• Learning velocity and ability to operate in ambiguous environments

jobs.description:
Executive Partner, CFO Advisory

About Gartner

Gartner is the world's leading research and advisory company, helping business leaders across every major industry make faster, smarter decisions and achieve their most critical priorities. Gartner's CFO & Finance Executive Programs provide finance leaders with objective insight, expert guidance, and a powerful peer network to accelerate business performance and transformation.

About the Role

Gartner is seeking accomplished current and former Chief Financial Officers from publicly traded organizations with at least $1 billion in annual revenue to join our CFO Executive Partner team.

As an Executive Partner, you will serve as a trusted advisor to a portfolio of CFOs and senior finance executives, helping them navigate complex business challenges, advance strategic priorities, and improve organizational performance. Leveraging your executive leadership experience, you will engage as a peer counselor, coach, and thought partner while helping clients maximize the value of Gartner's research, insights, and advisory resources.

This role provides a unique opportunity to remain engaged with senior business leaders, influence the future of the finance function, and share your expertise across multiple industries while enjoying the flexibility of a fully remote position.

What You'll Do

Trusted Advisor to CFOs

• Serve as a strategic advisor to a portfolio of senior finance executives and CFOs.
• Conduct regular executive consultations focused on leadership effectiveness, organizational transformation, financial performance, and strategic execution.
• Help CFOs identify priorities, evaluate challenges, and develop practical action plans to achieve business outcomes.
• Share insights, best practices, and lessons learned from your own executive leadership experience.

Executive Engagement & Thought Leadership

• Facilitate executive workshops, peer discussions, and leadership sessions for CFO members.
• Lead discussions and executive roundtables at Gartner conferences and client events.
• Foster executive networking and knowledge sharing among senior finance leaders.
• Contribute to the development and delivery of CFO-focused thought leadership and research initiatives.

• Current or former Chief Financial Officer experience within a publicly traded company generating at least $1 billion in annual revenue.
• Demonstrated success leading enterprise finance organizations through growth, transformation, restructuring, digital modernization, M&A activity, capital allocation decisions, or operational performance improvement.

Location & Travel

• Candidates may reside anywhere within the continental United States.

Why Executive Leaders Join Gartner

Many Executive Partners join Gartner after distinguished operating careers because they want to continue making an impact while engaging with some of the world's most senior finance leaders. The role offers the opportunity to:

• Influence and advise CFOs across diverse industries.
• Remain connected to the most important trends shaping the future of finance.

• Collaborate with an elite network of former and current business leaders.
• Enjoy flexibility while continuing to operate at the highest levels of executive leadership.

Executive Partners are full-time Gartner employees with full benefits.  The role can be based anywhere in the continental United States.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Analysis Oversight Statistical Programming Lead
jobs.description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

Clinical Data Science (CDS) is a business unit within Development whose mission is to achieve regulatory approval and successful marketing of new therapies through a reproducible, transparent, efficient, and validated approach to study design, data acquisition, analysis, and interpretation. Our pursuit is to deliver on unmet medical needs by introducing therapies for life-threatening diseases. Within CDS, we strive to reach this goal through excellence in data management, analytical methods, and advanced programmatic approaches to gain insights from a wide range of data assets.

To achieve the commitments of our clinical portfolio, CDS has been developing an agile and sustainable resource model that leverages external partnerships to form a strong alliance with internal Gilead roles. Together, these teams will deliver statistical programming outputs that meet study analysis needs and requirements. The Analysis Oversight Statistical Programming (AOSP) Lead is essential to these partnerships. As a member of the Study Management Team (SMT), the AOSP Lead works closely with the study team to determine the statistical programming requirements, understand study milestones and programming dependencies, and leads the development of the programming outputs.

The Analysis Oversight Statistical Programming Lead is accountable for the development of Analysis Data Model (ADaM) and Table, Figure, and Listing (TFL) deliverables, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and compliance with regulatory and quality standards. This role will progressively review vendor performance metrics in governance meetings to monitor trends and address any challenges, risks, and/or bottlenecks encountered by the study programming team.

The position requires a strong acumen in statistical analysis, focused on achieving high-quality outputs that support clinical results. In addition, the candidate will need to perform quality management, coach and mentor programming colleagues, and provide statistical guidance as it relates to specifics of the study and general processes and statistical program education. The candidate will need to closely monitor the quality and timeliness of clinical trial programming deliverables, provide process guidance, support creation and maintenance of onboarding materials, and direct prioritization and coordination of study related deliverables.

Key Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

• Exhibits strong statistical & programming knowledge & expertise to influence key decisions on statistical programming outputs and provide guidance to statistical programmers.
• Attends SMT Meetings, providing functional input on programming related activities and potential risks.
• Reviews and approves statistical programming requirements (e.g. ADaM Mapping Specifications).
• Communicates SMT decisions, discussions, and action items to statistical programmers.
• Reviews and approves key study documents.
• Helps statistical programmers understand critical study documents.
• Reviews statistical programming timelines and negotiates with study team if needed.
• Participates in internal and external audits and identifies areas of opportunity to refine and simplify procedural steps.
• Analyse vendor performance through assessment of Key Performance and Quality Indicators (e.g. KPI, KQI), metrics, and results.
• Participates as needed in vendor governance discussions to address any performance related risks and/or concerns.
• Ensures adequate statistical programming resourcing for study milestones.
• Assigns tasks to statistical programmers based on experience and ability.
• Closely monitors and tracks study statistical programming activities within task management system.
• Maintains regular communications on study statistical programming milestone activities with appropriate study team members and stakeholders.
• Influences and supports data and submission standards, templates, etc.
• Performs quality checks to ensure deliverables are complete, accurate, and comply with Gilead and CDISC standards.Ensures programming activities are executed in correct order.Ensures validation documentation, folder locking, and TMF requirements are observed.
• Surfaces the need for new or updated standards to improve efficiency and uniformity across TA or Indication level objects.
• Provides prioritization decisions and coaching to fellow onboarding staff as needed to advance their knowledge on Gilead processes and statistical programs & methods.
• Ensures the programming team identifies data issues and enters accordingly into the Data Issue Log. In addition, ensures all issues and observations noted on the issue log have been resolved prior to final production release.
• Holds analysis team meetings with Biostatisticians.
• Serves as the point-of-contact with vendors, and liaisons with other functions.
• Requests the locking and archiving of study folders.

Minimum Required Education and Years of Experience

• Bachelor's Degree and Eight Years’ Experience OR Masters' Degree and Five Years’ Experience
• Minimum 4 years leading studies in Virology, Oncology, or Inflammation Therapeutic Area

Preferred Qualifications:

• Mature statistical knowledge and expertise in the development of ADaM and TFLs and dependent tasks/activities.
• Proven track record in delivering high quality statistical programming datasets and outputs.
• Ability to collaborate and work effectively with global team members and build strong relationships.
• Expertise working in global teams, across various time-zones to achieve clinical trial milestones.
• Remains current and has deep knowledge of GCP, ICH guidelines, and regulatory requirements, specifically as it relates to quality oversight, quality assurance, and risk management.
• Ability to problem-solve using data-driven approaches to help determine the best path forward.
• Excellent customer-focus with proven track-record in building relationships through superlative communication and writing skills.
• Superior skills in coaching and mentoring staff of varying skillsets and respectful of cultural differences especially communication styles.
• Results-oriented and able to work closely with others through great collaboration to resolve challenges, bottlenecks, or risks.
• Ability to motivate large diverse teams to achieve a common set of goals.
• Strong experience in data analysis and demonstrated critical thinking skills.
• Strong programming experience in non-compartmental Pharmacokinetics (PK) analysis for various study designs.
• Oversee and guide the development of statistical programs for TQT, cQT, pharmacokinetics (PK), and pharmacodynamics (PD) analysis, ensuring adherence to study protocols and regulatory submissions.
• Able to lead and mentor effective cross functional teams and keep programming team promptly informed of all study activities.

jobs.title: Computer Systems Engineer – Space Payload Emulators – (Experienced or Lead)
jobs.description:
Computer Systems Engineer – Space Payload Emulators – (Experienced or Lead)

Company:

The Boeing Company

Boeing Defense, Space, & Security (BDS) is seeking Computer Systems Engineer – Space Payload Emulators to join the team located in El Segundo, California.

As a Computer Systems Engineer, you will support the development and integration of space payload emulators in El Segundo, CA. In support of Boeing Defense Systems next-generation space programs, this role focuses on hands-on hardware/software development for embedded systems (Xilinx SoC/FPGA) and front-end UI/UX control interfaces.

This position is tailored for an engineer who thrives in a hands-on lab environment, working side-by-side with multidisciplinary teams (hardware, firmware, software, and test engineers) to bring up hardware, integrate software/logic, and build intuitive emulator interfaces.

Position Responsibilities:

Embedded Software & FPGA Platform Integration

• Develop, configure, and maintain embedded software and firmware on Xilinx SoC platforms (Zynq UltraScale+, Versal).
• Implement and debug Processing System to Programmable Logic (PS/PL) interfaces, AXI interconnects, and memory maps.
• Develop and validate Board Support Packages (BSP), PetaLinux/embedded Linux distributions, device drivers, and low-level communication interfaces (PCIe, Ethernet, SPI, I2C, UART).
• Lead hands-on board bring-up, hardware/software integration, and system-level debugging in a lab environment using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers.

Front-End GUI & Operator Interface Development

• Design and implement responsive, reliable front-end graphical user interfaces (GUIs) using Java or modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, Angular, or JavaFX/Electron).
• Build control dashboards, telemetry displays, and command interfaces for payload emulation testbeds and operational teams.
• Integrate UI applications with embedded back-end services, APIs, and hardware endpoints for real-time monitoring and control.

Multidisciplinary Lab Collaboration & Hardware/Software Integration

• Partner closely with FPGA logic designers, hardware engineers, and systems testers in a collaborative lab environment to diagnose issues and validate end-to-end emulator functionality.
• Drive rapid prototyping, root-cause troubleshooting, and iterative testing on lab benches and test fixtures.
• Provide technical leadership during hardware/software co-design and integration milestones.

Software Quality & Workflow Optimization

• Utilize Xilinx toolchains (Vivado, Vitis, PetaLinux, SDK) for software build pipelines, profiling, and debugging.
• Follow modern software engineering practices, including code reviews, documentation, and version control using Git/GitLab.

This position is expected to be 100% onsite.  The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at the listed location.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):

• This position requires an active U.S. Secret Security Clearance (U.S. Citizenship Required). (A U.S. Security Clearance that has been active in the past 24 months is considered active)
• Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering (with a focus in Electrical, Mechanical or Aeronautical), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement

As a Customer Service Associate, you combine top-notch customer service skills with genuine care for people to help customers feel comfortable while shopping at Lowe's. This is an excellent role for those who want to engage with customers and help them solve their home improvement challenges.

How We Support You

Whether you need a part-time position or a place to plant yourself and grow, Lowe's is ready to support your goals. As a Lowe's associate, you'll gain access to many benefits beyond competitive pay and flexible schedules.

• Make your well-being a priority with multiple top-tier health insurance options.
• Explore educational opportunities with Lowe's tuition assistance program.
• Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k) and optional Employee Stock Purchase Program.
• Gain extra savings with a 10% Associate Discount.
• Learn new trade skills with our Track to the Trades program.

For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit https://talent.lowes.com/us/en/benefits.

Your Day at Lowe's

As a Customer Service Associate, you will welcome customers to Lowe's and help them find the right products and services for their home improvement needs. You will interact with customers throughout the day, help them find and select products, occasionally load merchandise, and ensure all customer needs are met.

While you will spend most of your time listening to customers, answering questions, and organizing merchandise, your daily responsibilities may vary by department.

Customer Service Associates work in one of the following departments, based on hiring needs and skillsets: Appliances, Cabinets, Flooring, Live Nursery, Inside Garden, Hardware, Tools, Millwork, Building Materials, Plumbing, Electrical, Paint, Home Décor, Tool Rental, or Pro Services.

Key Responsibilities

• Welcome customers to Lowe's, answer questions, and deliver friendly and professional customer service.
• Assist customers with locating and handling merchandise
• Down stock merchandise by looking for empty areas on shelves and replenishing supplies
• Process orders and deliveries accurately so customers receive merchandise as expected and on time
• Cross-functionally train in other areas of the store to help deliver the best customer service
• Prepare merchandise in your department based on customer needs (e.g., tint and mix paint, cut and thread pipe, cut and bundle wood, cut drywall, cut blinds)
• Guide customers through shopping or checkout
• Complete other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications

• 6 Months Experience using a computer, including inputting, accessing, modifying, or outputting information
• 6 Months Experience using common retail technology, such as smart phones and tablets
• Reading, writing, and performing basic arithmetic (addition and subtraction)
• Able to perform duties that may require prolonged standing, sitting, and other activities necessary to perform job duties
• Minimally lift 25lbs unassisted or over 25lbs with or without an accommodation

Preferred Qualifications

• 6 months of Retail and/or customer service experience
• Bi-lingual skills
• Certification in trade related to department (e.g., hardware, kitchen, plumbing, electrical, lawn and garden, and lumber/building materials)

Lowe's commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well. To better equip our stores and serve our communities, we strongly encourage bilingual, military, and veteran talent to apply and join our team.

Travel Requirements

This role does not require regular travel; however, this role may need to travel occasionally to meetings, training, or to support neighboring stores.

Working Conditions

Environmental factors vary by location. You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions. Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible. You may be exposed to constant or intermittent noises in addition to moving or shaking objects and equipment.

Lifting methods vary based on role, weight, and volume. Associates must follow guidelines, limiting single lifts to 75 pounds. Team lifts are used minimally starting at 75 pounds or when needed. Powered equipment should be used as required, with proper training or assistance from a trained coworker.

About Lowe’s

Lowe’s Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 50 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.

jobs.title: DRAM Design Tech Layout Engineer
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As a DRAM Design Tech Layout Engineer within the DRAM Design & Technology Engineering Group at Micron Technology, Inc. your responsibility  will be translating schematics into layout used for the creation of fabrication reticules. Your role includes fulfilling all engineering and process related criteria required for an assigned Dram product.  You will coordinate and prioritize logistics and resource allocations to meet scheduled breakthroughs, and proactively develop methodologies for issue resolution. In this role you will work with Design and other engineering groups to apply multiple layout techniques for the design and verification of digital and analog circuits. You will be encouraged to understand various circuit develop protocols, different fab processes, mask generation techniques, and tapeout processes and procedures.

Responsibilities:

• Responsible for Design and development of IP layouts used in DRAM chips.
• Perform layout verification like LVS/DRC/EM, quality check and documentation.
• Responsible for on-time delivery of block-level layouts with acceptable quality.
• Demonstrate leadership skill in planning, area/time estimation, scheduling, delegation and execution to meet project schedule/breakthroughs in multiple project environment.
• Guide and lead developing team members in their execution of Sub block-level layouts & review their work.
• Contribute to effective project-management.
• Plan and detail your layout, communicating material for global teams to review
• Effectively connect with engineering teams in India, Japan, the US, and other international groups to ensure the success of the layout project.

Minimum Qualifications:

• BSEE or equivalent with 2+ years of experience in layout designs in advanced CMOS process.
• Must be capable of performing IP layout development and physical verification activities for complex builds as per provided specifications.
• Demonstrate expertise in layout area and routing optimization, design rules.
• Good understanding of layout fundamentals i.e. Electro-migration, coupling, crosstalk, IR-drop, parasitic analysis, matching, shielding, etc.
• Adequate knowledge of schematics to optimally collaborate with circuit designer and CAD team.
• Understanding layout effects on the circuit such as speed, capacitance, power and area etc.,
• Excellent in problem-solving skills in solving area, power, performance and physical verification of custom layout.
• Experience with Cadence tools including Virtuoso schematic editor Virtuoso layout L, XL & Verification tools like Mentor Calibre- Proficient in Device Matching, Parasitic Analysis, and Isolation Techniques.
• Should have leadership qualities and able to do multi-tasking as the need arises.
• Ability to work in a team environment and capable of guiding and providing technical support to fellow team members!

Preferred Qualifications:

• Self-motivated, hardworking, goal-oriented and excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• AI usage (Leveraging AI, Generative AI, AI-Enabled)

As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future.  We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget.  Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave.  Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays.  For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on micron.com/careers/benefits.

Micron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

To learn about your right to work click here.

For US Sites Only: To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact Micron’s People Organization at  hrsupport_na@micron.com or 1-800-336-8918 (select option #3)

jobs.title: Branch Manager - West 29th Street
jobs.location: Hialeah, FL - West 29th Street Branch (Miami, FL)
jobs.description:
Thank you for your interest in a career at Regions. At Regions, we believe associates deserve more than just a job. We believe in offering performance-driven individuals a place where they can build a career --- a place to expect more opportunities. If you are focused on results, dedicated to quality, strength and integrity, and possess the drive to succeed, then we are your employer of choice.

Regions is dedicated to taking appropriate steps to safeguard and protect private and personally identifiable information you submit. The information that you submit will be collected and reviewed by associates, consultants, and vendors of Regions in order to evaluate your qualifications and experience for job opportunities and will not be used for marketing purposes, sold, or shared outside of Regions unless required by law. Such information will be stored in accordance with regulatory requirements and in conjunction with Regions’ Retention Schedule for a minimum of three years. You may review, modify, or update your information by visiting and logging into the careers section of the system.

Job Description:

At Regions, the Branch Manager is responsible for maintaining an engaged, operationally sound, and high performing team dedicated to improving the financial wellness of our customers. This position acts as a player and coach, oversees branch operations, directly manages associate performance, and provides guidance as needed to ensure associates are helping customers reach their financial goals by understanding and meeting customer needs. Branch Managers are expected to drive branch performance results through strong individual sales performance in addition to ensuring the team meets and exceeds branch sales, quality, and service goals while maintaining an operationally efficient and compliant branch.

Regions' mission is to make life better for our customers and communities, and we are looking for candidates committed to fostering customer relationships, identifying needs and creating a path to achieving financial goals. The successful candidate should be individually driven and competitive, as well as motivated to work as a team to achieve a common goal. This requires a candidate that is motivated by a fast paced and energetic environment, with the ability to provide personalized customer service.

Primary Responsibilities

• Leads a small to moderate sized team of branch associates responsible for impacting new revenue generation through identifying customer needs and providing appropriate guidance and perspective about Regions solutions
• Conducts outside sales efforts commensurate with market opportunity to generate new business clients while also maintaining and expanding existing consumer and business banking relationships
• Educates associates, customers, and surrounding community about best practices to achieve and maintain financial wellness in addition to emerging bank technology and digital solutions such as mobile, online and ATM offerings, all designed to make banking easier
• Coaches and develops branch associates through execution of iConnect - the Region's Sales, Service and Coaching process, with some guidance from assigned mentor, senior level managers and internal support partners
• Provides consistent and timely coaching and guidance to associates to assist with strengthening their product knowledge and identifying customer needs
• Educates and advises customers on Regions Consumer and Business products and services, including all loan and deposit types in addition to assisting with annuities and life insurance
• Ensures a consistent optimal customer experience, including handling customer’s transactional needs as needed. This may include sharing responsibility for greeting customers and processing transactions to ensure customers bank when, where, and how they want
• Resolves escalated customer and associate issues and provides counseling to associates as needed with some guidance and direction from senior leadership and Human Resources
• Manages recruiting and selection process for assigned branch
• Maintains relationships with Line of Business partners and refers customers to an internal team of experts when additional complex financial goals and needs are recognized
• Follows all bank policies, processes, procedures, and internal audit requirements and adheres to applicable laws and regulations, including completing individual duties specific to the role of Branch Manager, and ensures all associates in the branch complete their delegated operational risk management duties as assigned; as a member of the branch team, ensures sound banking practices, including managing, identifying, and reporting operational risks

This position is exempt from timekeeping requirements under the Fair Labor Standards Act and is not eligible for overtime pay.

This position is incentive eligible.

This position requires registration with the Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry (NMLS). Please refer to https://fedregistry.nationwidelicensingsystem.org for more information.

Requirements

• High School Diploma or GED
• Three (3) years of Financial Services, sales, or sales management experience
• Expected to obtain an active Life Insurance License within first twelve (12) months and maintain continuing education for licensing requirements
• Ability to work on Saturday as needed

Preferences

• College degree
• Life Insurance License
• Supervisory experience within the Financial Services industry
• Six (6) years of banking and/or lending experience
• Six (6) years of relationship-based client consultation experience

Skills and Competencies

• Ability to exhibit mastery of key advice, guidance, and education concepts
• Ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
• Ability to provide effective feedback and guidance
• Excellent communication and customer service skills
• Excellent leadership and problem-solving skills

This position may be filled at a higher level depending on the candidate's qualifications and experience level.

Full time

jobs.title: Retail Sales Associate
jobs.location: 575 Beal PKWY NW, Fort Walton Beach, Florida
jobs.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing...

As a full-time Verizon Retail Sales Associate, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career with a team focused on unlocking your full potential and sales success within one of our retail stores. Here's what you can expect:

• Generate retail sales by using your passion for cutting-edge technology, and exceptional customer service to expand the Verizon network.
• Learn and uncover customers' needs by creating connections and asking the right questions.
• Position product insights and solution recommendations to provide customers with a complete top-down sales solution.
• Close sales by using phenomenal communication skills to fulfill customer needs with simple and intuitive tech solutions.
• Continuously develop yourself through ongoing training and up-skill in operational functions across merchandising and inventory.
• Potential to grow your customer base by placing outbound calls and sending text messages to current Verizon customers who are interested in our products and services.
• Opportunities to engage with the community outside of the store to expand your loyal customer base, including at off-site Verizon sponsored events.

We’re hiring immediately! This isn't your typical entry-level retail position. Whether you're just starting out or have years of sales experience, you can earn $16.00 to $21.00 per hour in base pay, plus up to $18,000 a year in individual-based commissions if you hit all your sales goals. Planning to go above and beyond? With our commission program, the opportunities are unlimited for employees who exceed their sales goals. Top performers could make an extra $14,500 or more in individual-based commissions, giving you the chance to earn a total of $65,000+ to $75,500+ annually. Compensation varies by geography, hours worked, and performance.

Our comprehensive benefits (starting day one) and perks are designed to help you move forward in your career and in your life outside of Verizon. From health and well-being benefits to investment in your education and career, we've got you covered!

• Best in class medical, dental, and vision
• Verizon 401(k) plan with matching contributions up to 6% of eligible participant contributions to the plan, qualified student loan repayments, or a combination of both
• Sales recognition programs that have, in the past, awarded top performers with all inclusive travel to domestic and international destinations, gifts, and other incentives
• Five weeks of paid time off (vacation, holidays, personal days)
• 8 weeks of paid parental leave for eligible new parents (when paired with short-term disability, this benefit may provide up to 16 weeks of paid time off for the birthing parent)
• Up to $8K per year in tuition assistance
• Discounts up to 50% off on Verizon products and services
• Additional employee discounts on attractions, automotive, travel and more.

This position is a great way to jumpstart your career! Too good to be true? Hear from our Verizon Retail team members on what it's like to be part of a team that invests in you. From our in-person new hire experience and award-winning training programs to our culture of learning and amazing benefits, you’ll be able to apply your skills while elevating your career.

What we’re looking for...

You’ll need to have:

• High school diploma or GED.
• One or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.
• Willingness to work evenings, weekends, and holidays (you'll know your schedule four weeks in advance).
• Openness to pick up additional shifts and earn more income, typically during the summer months, November through December, and/or during peak vacation periods.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

• Experience working in a commission-based environment.
• Demonstrated sales experience communicating with customers to find solutions.
• Customer service experience.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

After you apply…

You may be required to take an assessment. It takes about 19 minutes to complete. If you’re selected to move forward, one of our recruiters will reach out to tell you more about the role and answer your questions.

Where you’ll be working

In this worksite-based role, you'll work onsite at a defined location(s).

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits and Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more.

jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...

**Immigration Sponsorship is NOT available for this role. All Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship. This is a full-time onsite role based in Sunnyvale, California; remote and hybrid options are NOT available.**

Are you a seasoned product leader with minimum of 8+ years of Product Management experience who thrives on solving complex business challenges at massive scale? Join Walmart's Merchandising & Supply Chain Product organization to define strategy, build AI-powered products, and drive innovation across one of the world's largest retail ecosystems, impacting millions of customers, suppliers, and associates every day.

Role summary:
As a Staff Product Manager within Walmart’s Merchandising and Supply Chain Product organization, you will define and drive product strategy for some of the most complex systems in retail, helping improve how merchandise moves from suppliers through Walmart’s operations and ultimately to customers.

We are hiring multiple Staff Product Managers across areas including Supplier & Sourcing; Assortment & Space; Forecasting; Inventory & Replenishment; Fulfillment; Transportation; Delivery; and Returns. You will own strategy and roadmaps for complex products and capabilities while partnering across business, product, engineering, design and data science to simplify experiences, improve decision-making, and build scalable solutions. This role requires system-level thinking, deep customer and business understanding, strong cross-functional influence, and disciplined execution from discovery through value realization.

One application. Multiple opportunities. Candidates may be considered for multiple Staff Product Manager openings across our Merchandising and Supply Chain Product organization based on their experience, strengths, and interests.

About the Team:
Walmart’s Merchandising and Supply Chain Product teams build technology that supports how we select, source, plan, move, fulfill, and deliver merchandise at Walmart scale. Our teams work across the lifecycle of merchandise, from enabling suppliers and merchants to make better decisions, to forecasting demand and positioning inventory, to improving fulfillment, transportation, delivery, and returns. We bring together product, engineering, data science, design, and business expertise to solve complex retail problems and create simpler, more effective experiences for our customers, associates, merchants, and suppliers.

We are also exploring how advances in AI, machine learning and optimization can improve decision-making, streamline complex workflows, and unlock new experiences across merchandising and supply chain.

Depending on your experience, you could work across:

• Supplier & Sourcing: Improving the tools and experiences that help suppliers and merchants collaborate and make sourcing and commercial decisions.
• Assortment & Space: Helping merchants determine what to sell and how to tailor assortments and space to customer and market needs.
• Forecasting: Building capabilities that help anticipate customer demand and improve planning.
• Inventory & Replenishment: Helping ensure inventory is positioned where and when it is needed.
• Fulfillment: Building products that improve how customer demand is fulfilled across Walmart’s network.
• Transportation: Developing capabilities that improve how merchandise moves through the supply chain.
• Delivery: Creating products that make customer delivery faster, more reliable, and more convenient.
• Returns: Improving the returns experience for customers and associates while helping the business make better decisions about returned inventory.

What you'll do:

• Own product strategy and roadmaps for complex products and platforms, driving outcomes from discovery through launch, adoption, and scale.
• Develop a deep understanding of customers and users, including suppliers, merchants, associates, and consumers, to identify pain points and high-value opportunities.
• Think at a system level, understanding how decisions in one area can affect other parts of merchandising and supply chain.
• Translate complex business problems into scalable products, clear requirements, prioritization frameworks, and phased delivery plans.
• Simplify workflows and experiences, helping users move more seamlessly from insight to decision to action.
• Apply data, AI, machine learning, and optimization where they can improve decision-making and create better user experiences.
• Partner across product, engineering, design, data science, operations, and business teams to align priorities and drive execution.
• Define and measure success through clear customer, operational, and business outcomes.
• Use experimentation, research, feedback, and performance data to continuously improve products and experiences.
• Build for scale, developing capabilities that can support Walmart’s complex businesses, channels, and markets.
• Lead through influence, bringing clarity to ambiguity, navigating tradeoffs, and aligning stakeholders around a shared product direction.
• Raise the product management bar, mentoring other product managers and strengthening product practices across the organization.

About Walmart Global Tech:
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. Walmart’s culture is a competitive advantage, and it’s fostered by being together. Working together in person allows us to collaborate, align quickly and innovate with greater speed.  We use our campuses to create purposeful connection rooted in deepening understanding and investing in the development of our associates.

Our hubs: Walmart is a global company with offices across the United States and around the world. Our global headquarters is in Bentonville, Arkansas, with primary hubs in the San Francisco Bay area and New York/New Jersey.

Benefits:
Benefits: Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include 401(k) match, stock purchase plan, paid maternity and parental leave, PTO, multiple health plans, and much more.

Equal Opportunity Employer:
Walmart, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers, and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting, and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas, and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

The Walmart Last Mile Delivery Internship is an 11-week paid internship program designed to provide students with hands-on experience solving meaningful business problems at scale. Interns will work on high-impact projects, collaborate with cross-functional teams and senior leaders, network with industry experts, and develop skills while experiencing Walmart’s Home Office in Northwest Arkansas.

As part of the Last Mile Delivery team, the intern will have the opportunity to help shape the next generation of platform stability and change management for Spark Driver—using AI, automation, data, and new ways of working to identify and prevent issues before they impact drivers.

About Last Mile Delivery

Walmart Last Mile Delivery is responsible for building and operating the capabilities that connect customers with their orders during the final stage of the delivery journey.

A critical part of this ecosystem is Spark Driver, Walmart’s platform connecting independent drivers with delivery opportunities. Providing a reliable driver experience requires coordination across product, engineering, operations, analytics, communications, and support teams to ensure that new capabilities are tested effectively, launched safely, monitored in real time, and quickly improved when issues arise.

The Driver Experience organization works across this ecosystem to identify friction, improve platform reliability, and create a more seamless experience for drivers at scale.

What you'll do...

Role Summary

The Last Mile Delivery Intern will support the Next-Gen Rewards, Loyalty & Engagement Ecosystem ("Perks Orbit"), a strategic initiative focused on reimagining how Spark recognizes, rewards, and engages drivers.

Today, loyalty programs often rely on traditional tier-based structures. This project will explore how Spark's rewards ecosystem can evolve into a more dynamic and modular platform—a flexible "perks orbit" of incentives, benefits, recognition, partnerships, and experiences that can adapt to different driver needs and behaviors.

The intern will help define a future-state rewards and engagement strategy that considers how rewards should evolve across driver lifecycle stages, behaviors, needs, and segments. The work will also explore how rewards, communications, and engagement moments can operate cohesively to strengthen driver loyalty, encourage desired behaviors, and improve long-term engagement and retention.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous strategic problems, understanding customer or user behavior, using data to develop insights, and translating those insights into practical product and business recommendations.

What You’ll Learn

• How a large-scale gig delivery platform attracts, engages, and retains drivers

• How loyalty and rewards programs can influence user behavior and engagement

• How customer and driver insights are translated into product and business strategies

• How segmentation, lifecycle management, and personalization can create differentiated experiences

• How product, operations, analytics, marketing, communications, and strategy teams collaborate to launch new experiences

• How strategic concepts are tested, prioritized, and translated into an actionable roadmap

• Collaboration-first working style with the ability to work across multiple functions

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Salary:

$29.00 - $39.60

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As a Process Technician, you'll be responsible for preparing wafers for experimentation, operating reactors to perform thin film processes, and using scanning electron microscopes for analyses and imaging. You'll record process conditions and experimental observations, perform routine maintenance procedures, and evaluate wafers and thin films. Process Technicians are tasked with preparing cross-section samples for analysis, identifying patterns of interest in imaging, and operating laboratory process equipment and instrumentation. Your expertise in troubleshooting, equipment maintenance, and process optimization drives higher levels of productivity, quality, and efficiency in our manufacturing processes.

Role Responsibilities:

• Prepare wafers for experimentation to include cleaning and preparation of reactors
• Evaluate performance of process systems
• Prepare cross-section samples for scanning electron microscope (SEM) analysis; optimize sample prep procedure and conditions and identify cut location based on pattern instructions
• Operate reactors to perform thin film processes, under limited supervision
• Operate scanning electron microscope for cross-section and top-view, critical dimension (CD), or energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) analysis and imaging
• Identify all patterns of interest in imaging and understand image quality requirements and sample/beam interaction to determine optimized condition
• Record process conditions and experimental observations
• Understand basic scanning electron microscope (SEM) principles
• Responsible for multiple technology products
• Perform scanning electron microscope (SEM) system software alignment functions and routine maintenance procedures including flash and plasma clean
• Evaluate wafers and thin films; prepare graphs and tables summarizing results
• Interface with requestors, understand detail requirements, and communicate on results; monitor Wafer In Process and maintain throughput
• Check performance of process system; order equipment and supplies, and coordinate with vendors and purchasing. Coordinate instrument repair and maintenance
• Perform routine shut down procedure and set up equipment for experiments

Minimum Qualifications:

• Technical Diploma
• 2-4 years of experience

Physical Requirements:

This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

Role Summary:
The Principal Data Scientist will lead the development and deployment of advanced machine learning models and machine learning solutions to address complex business challenges. The Marketplace Data Science team at Walmart Global Tech drives innovation in global commerce by supporting a rapidly expanding eCommerce platform. The team empowers thousands of sellers to efficiently manage digital storefronts, optimizing product listings, pricing, and inventory. They deliver seamless pre- and post-order experiences through intelligent, resilient systems. Utilizing real-time data and integrating with partner platforms across Walmart’s ecosystem, the team ensures exceptional customer experiences. Focused on scalable, reliable solutions, they collaborate across functions to advance technology roadmaps and support sustained business growth.

• Lead feature engineering, exploratory data analysis, and model evaluation to optimize performance and robustness.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable data science strategies and measurable outcomes.

• Mentor team members on advanced modeling techniques, data visualization, and best practices.

• Drive continuous improvement by integrating emerging machine learning trends and automation tools.

• PhD in Computer Science or related field and 10 years of relevant data science experience or master's degree in related field and 12 years of relevant data science experience.

• Demonstrable experience of architecting large scale ML systems.

• Deep knowledge of and extensive experience in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, and reinforcement learning to develop advanced analytical models.

• Proven experience working with state-of-the-art agentic, Gen AI, supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms on real-world problems, preferably in ecommerce domain.

• Proficiency in Python programming and AWS SageMaker for scalable model development and deployment.

• Ability to translate business requirements into data-driven strategies and measurable outcomes.

• Proven leadership skills in mentoring and guiding technical teams toward innovative solutions.

• Effective communication skills to present insights and influence stakeholders.

jobs.title: People Operations and Compliance Lead
jobs.description:
About Wing:

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing’s fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

About the Role:

Wing is looking for a People Operations & People Compliance Lead to join our People Team. This role is hybrid based in Palo Alto, CA. Our People Team is a small, nimble force with outsized impact across the organization. As Wing scales, we serve as a strategic partner for the business—helping build the culture, talent layer, organizational design and dynamic environment where exceptional talent can thrive, innovate, and propel our next chapter of growth.

What You’ll Do:

• Strategic Leadership & Cross-Functional Governance

• Own the multi-year roadmap and team-level results for People Operations and People Compliance.

• Partner across the People Team and the business to proactively identify roadblocks and resolve complex workforce and regulatory dependencies.

• Guide, mentor, and develop team members, fostering a culture of high accountability, psychological safety, adaptability, user-focus, and operational excellence.

• Employee Lifecycle & Scalable People Operations

• Design and optimize a seamless, automated employee lifecycle experience.

• Manage and scale global immigration and mobility operations (e.g., H-1B, TN, PERM/green card sponsorships).

• Standardize cross-team operating procedures, self-service documentation on the Wing internal Portal, and escalation frameworks to resolve complex employee inquiries with empathy and precision.

• People Systems, Data Infrastructure & Automation

• Drive the architecture, integration, and data integrity of Wing’s People and Compliance tech stack, including Workday, ServiceNow, Air Maestro (aviation training/certification records), and internal data tables .

• Leverage workforce analytics, dashboards, and automation tools to surface actionable insights for senior leadership, eliminate single points of failure, and continuously improve operational return on effort.

• Aviation & Employment Compliance

• Oversee Wing’s DOT/FAA Drug and Alcohol Testing Program, FCRA and FAA/DOT background check adjudications for safety-sensitive roles.

• Lead statutory and federal/state compliance reporting and internal audits, including FAA regulatory audits, DOT/FAA Annual MIS reporting, EEO-1, California Pay Data Reporting, ERISA Form 5500, and multi-state/international labor law compliance.

• Govern end-to-end extended workforce compliance.

What You’ll Need:

• 12+ years of relevant experience in People Operations, People Compliance, Employment/Aviation Regulatory Compliance, or HR Systems & Operations plus 2+ years of people management experience.

• Proven experience scaling, operationalizing, or commercializing People Operations and Compliance programs in a high-growth technology, aviation, logistics, or heavily regulated operational environment.

• Deep domain expertise in U.S. federal, state, and local employment laws (FCRA, EEO-1, FLSA, ADA, leave/wage-and-hour laws) and regulated workforce compliance programs (such as DOT/FAA drug and alcohol testing, safety-sensitive credentialing, and background adjudications) .

• Hands-on systems and data proficiency across enterprise HRIS and compliance platforms (e.g., Workday, Greenhouse, Air Maestro, ServiceNow) and advanced data analysis in Google Sheets / Excel (experience with SQL or workflow automation is a plus).

• Demonstrated executive presence and influence, with a track record of using data-driven storytelling to align leaders around pragmatic, long-term solutions keeping the user at the center.

jobs.description:
