VERG Brooklyn is seeking an Overnight Veterinary Assistant to join our Emergency Room (ER) team in Brooklyn, NY. You’ll work alongside emergency veterinarians, veterinary technicians, and specialty teams at our 24/7 emergency and specialty hospital.

You’ll gather patient histories from clients, safely restrain patients during exams and procedures, and assist veterinarians and technicians with diagnostics, sample collection, and treatments. • Continuing Education and Career Growth — Veterinary assistants receive a continuing education allowance and have access to training to build their clinical skills.

Ideal Candidate

• At least one year of experience in a veterinary hospital.

• Available to work overnight shifts, including weekends and some holidays.

• Comfortable handling and safely restraining patients.

• Stays calm under pressure, pays attention to detail, and adapts as priorities change.

• Communicates clearly and compassionately with clients and teammates.

jobs.title: Director, Health and Medical
jobs.description:
About the role:

Curri is seeking a Director, Health and Medical to build its healthcare vertical from the ground up and serve as the face of Curri Health in the market. Curri has proven the value of vertical-specific directors and runs the strongest delivery network in the country, but it does not yet have a dedicated presence with national distributors, IDNs, or med device manufacturers. This role is being hired to open those doors through existing executive relationships, land Curri’s first marquee healthcare customers and partnerships, and set the go-to-market strategy for the vertical. Success means Curri is a trusted logistics partner to multiple IDNs within the first year.

What you will do:

 - Source and close $5M+ deals with national distributors, IDNs, and med device OEMs, running 12 to 18 month sales cycles from first executive meeting to signed contract.

 - Build the partnership motion with enterprise distribution partners that lands health systems indirectly, and lead Curri through the GPO contracting process.

 - Deliver the vertical’s go-to-market plan, including a named target account list with mapped executive sponsors and bear and bull revenue ramps by quarter.

 - Navigate complex buying environments across Supply Chain, Procurement, Clinical Operations, Pharmacy, Biomed, Finance, and Value Analysis committees, positioning Curri as a reliable, compliant partner for time-sensitive and patient-impacting deliveries.

 - Design delivery programs for healthcare customers and translate their compliance requirements (chain of custody, HIPAA, bloodborne pathogen training) into clear inputs for Product and Operations.

 - Represent Curri Health at nearly a dozen industry conferences a year, building brand and pipeline in a market where reputation drives access.

What you need to have:

 - 10+ years selling in healthcare supply chain, distribution, or logistics, with direct experience selling into health systems, medical distributors, manufacturers, or life sciences organizations.

 - A proven net-new hunting record, including personally sourcing and closing $5M+ deals rather than only growing inherited accounts or managing channel relationships.

 - Executive relationships at distributors, IDNs, or OEMs who will take your call today, and a reputation in the healthcare supply chain space that opens doors on its own.

 - Strong executive presence and a consultative selling style, with the ability to earn trust at the C-suite in risk-averse organizations where logistics reliability affects patient care.

 - The polish and judgment to set direction for a new vertical, turning an open mandate into a focused account strategy and pipeline without a playbook to inherit.

Bonus points for:

 - Having built a new vertical or business line from 0 to 1, taking an existing product into a market where it had no presence.

 - Deep operational knowledge of medical distribution or health system supply chain workflows, including manufacturer direct-to-facility models.

 - A track record of landing large national accounts that expanded across many locations or regions.

 - Experience selling in a SaaS and logistics hybrid model.



The base salary range for this role is $150,000–$250,000, plus commission and equity. Where an offer lands in that range depends on the industry knowledge, skills, qualifications, and depth of experience.

Who are we?

We are Curri, and our mission is to build the network and software that move the world’s goods with speed, intelligence, and trust. Curri provides on-demand, last-mile logistics for construction and adjacent industries with our nationwide fleet of cars, trucks, and flatbeds.
Founded in 2018 and part of the YC S19 Batch, we’re solving the massive inefficiencies that exist in the construction industry. Our headquarters are in Ventura, CA. Learn more at curri.com http://curri.com.



Curri is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. jobs.title: Senior Software Enigneer
jobs.description:
About Megaport
We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.
 
Our Team Culture
We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
 
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.


The Role
Megaport is building a serverless edge compute platform that runs customer workloads as isolated microVMs on bare metal in our own facilities, directly inside the customer's private network. This role owns the control plane: everything from the customer's terminal to the Kubernetes API. You will be the engineer who makes the platform deployable, highly available across regions, and operable in production.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend - AI Native
jobs.description:
Innovate with purpose

At BILL, we believe in empowering the businesses that drive our economy. By replacing outdated financial processes with innovative tools, we help businesses—from startups to established brands—make smarter decisions and gain control of their operations. And we don’t stop there: we’re creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters.

Working here means you become part of a vision-driven team that’s ready to tackle challenges and build cutting-edge solutions. We value purpose, drive, and curiosity—and we thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. We're remote-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. BILLders collaborate to deliver real impact for businesses that need more time in their busy weeks.

BILL builds high performing teams and we seek to hire the best talent for every role. We're committed to building a workplace that fosters inclusion and diverse perspectives, valuing each person’s unique skills and experiences. We’d love to hear from you—you might be just what we’re looking for, whether in this role or another.

✨ Let’s give businesses more time for what matters.

Make your impact at a leading Fintech Company

BILL's accounts payable, accounts receivable and accountant products move money for hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses. We are rebuilding the backend behind these products so that every capability is built once, in a clean API, and is available to web, mobile, developer APIs and AI agents on the same day.

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you will rebuild core AP and AR services. You will design the domain models and API contracts, migrate behavior out of legacy code, and use AI coding agents as a core part of how you work. This is a hands-on product engineering role in a domain where correctness matters: the code you ship decides whether a payment is approved, scheduled and sent.

In this role you will:

• Rebuild core AP and AR backend capabilities (bills, invoices, payments, approvals, vendors and customers) as well-bounded services with consistent, well-documented APIs.

• Build each capability once, headless. Move business rules out of the UI and legacy code paths into the service layer, and expose it through our federated GraphQL API for web, mobile and AI agents, and through REST for developers and partners. A capability is done when it is ready for all of them, not when it works in the web UI.

• Apply and help shape BILL's API standards: common types defined once across REST, GraphQL and events, consistent list APIs, business operations as explicit actions with server-owned status, idempotent writes for anything that moves money, and errors a developer or an AI agent can act on. Enforce them in code, not in review, with contract tests, schema checks and linters in CI.

• Work AI-first across the whole software lifecycle, from design through production, as described in the next section.

• Migrate live, high-volume financial workflows and their APIs without breaking customers or consumers: parity tests, staged rollouts, dual writes, backfills, reconciliation and rollback paths for data; additive changes, expand-and-contract and deprecation windows for contracts.

• Make APIs usable by AI agents as well as people: self-describing schemas with documentation an LLM can read, responses that return related data in one call instead of many, and AI tools that are a thin layer over the same queries and mutations that web, mobile and internal clients use.

• Own reliability for what you build: observability, on-call readiness, performance and data integrity.

• Raise the bar for the engineers around you through design reviews, code reviews and mentoring.

How you will work: AI-first across the lifecycle

AI-first here means rethinking how the work gets done across the whole software lifecycle, from design through production, not running the old process faster. We judge it by what ships and the difference it makes for customers. You stay accountable for quality, design and production outcomes, whoever or whatever wrote the code. You will:

• Inception and design: use agents to explore legacy code and data and map existing business rules and edge cases, then go straight to a working proof of concept in place of a research spike. Design discussion happens over running code, and design docs and decision records capture what was decided.

• Partnering across teams: use AI to learn other teams' services, contracts and conventions before asking for their time, and bring frontend, product and platform partners a draft API contract or working prototype to react to.

• Build and test: break work into well-specified, verifiable tasks that agents can execute, with contract tests, parity tests against legacy behavior and deterministic checks as guardrails.

• Code review: use agents for first-pass review against team standards, so human review time goes to design, risk and data integrity.

• Deployment: automate release readiness, migration steps, staged rollouts and rollback checks.

• Production monitoring: use agents to watch dashboards, logs and alerts, triage incidents, find root cause, and turn what you learn into tests and standards.

• Reusable skills and agents: codify architecture patterns, service scaffolds, API standards, migration recipes and review checklists as skills, agents and templates that other engineers and their agents use by default. Keep team conventions in the repo where agents can read them, fold review feedback back into these skills so the same comment is never needed twice, and treat them as products with owners and versions.

• Shared AI infrastructure: build on BILL's shared AI platform and tooling instead of one-off solutions, and contribute skills, tool integrations and improvements back so every team benefits.

We’d love to chat if you have:

• 8+ years of professional backend engineering experience building and operating distributed systems in production.

• Strong Java (or another JVM language) and relational database skills, with experience designing services around clear domain boundaries.

• Deep API design experience in both GraphQL and REST: schema and resource modeling, pagination and filtering, idempotency, error design, versioning and backward compatibility. Federated GraphQL experience (entity ownership, schema checks, moving fields between subgraphs) is a strong plus.

• A track record of leading a rebuild or migration of a production system off a monolith or legacy platform, end to end.

• Hands-on, daily use of AI coding agents (for example Claude Code or Cursor) to ship production code, with good judgment about when agent output can be trusted and how to verify it. Examples of using AI beyond code generation, in design, review, testing, release or production operations, with measurable impact on delivery or quality.

• Experience building reusable agent assets (skills, context files, custom agents, tool integrations) that other engineers adopted, ideally on a shared internal AI platform you contributed back to.

• A record of production impact at scale: software that serves a large user base or moves significant money and has run reliably over time. We care more about what you shipped and how it held up than about the list of tools you used.

• Experience with event-driven architecture and with choosing between synchronous and asynchronous integration.

• Experience building in a correctness-critical domain where data integrity, idempotency and auditability are requirements.

• Experience running services on AWS with strong testing, observability and incident practices.

• For Senior Staff (P5): experience setting backend technical direction across several teams and landing it.

• Nice to have: experience in payments, accounts payable or receivable, or accounting systems, and experience exposing APIs as tools for AI agents (for example through MCP).

Our ranges for each role and job level are based on a variety of factors including candidate experience, expertise, and geographic location and may vary from the amounts listed below. The role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, flexible spending & health savings account, paid holidays, paid time off, and other company benefits. The estimated salary  ranges noted below roles in the specific  geographic zones

Zone 1:  San Francisco Bay Area CA (includes HQ), New York City, Seattle, Los Angeles County

$208,500—$250,000 USD

Zone 2:  CA (Non San Francisco Bay Area and Los Angeles County), Austin TX, Massachusetts

$187,700—$225,000 USD

Zone 3:  Utah (includes Utah office), Dallas TX, Houston TX, Florida, North Carolina, Illinois, Colorado, Arizona, Georgia, Oregon, Pennsylvania

$177,200—$212,500 USD

What’s in it for you?

Redefining how businesses automate their work is a fast-paced, exciting, and fun environment. But we also have benefits and perks to ensure the magic isn’t only experienced by our customers, but by our employees as well.

Here is a preview of some of the amazing benefits here at BILL:

• BILL covers the majority of your medical, dental, and vision premiums, and that includes your dependents.

• HSA & FSA accounts

• Life Insurnace, Long & Short-term disability coverage

• Mental Wellbeing & Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• 10 company holidays, 2 floating holidays and flexible time off

• Employee Stock Purchase Program with employee discounts

• Employee recognition and referral programs

• and much more

Don’t believe us? Check out our culture, benefits, and teams on our career site, LinkedIn Life, or YouTube pages.

BILL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe our best ideas come from the unique stories, perspectives, and experiences of our team members. We welcome people of all backgrounds, abilities, and identities to bring their authentic selves and contribute to our culture.

We are committed to a transparent, inclusive hiring process that reflects our values. If you need accommodations at any stage, please contact interviewaccommodations@hq.bill.com. To ensure a fair evaluation, our Candidate Integrity Policy prohibits the use of unapproved external assistance, including generative AI, during live interviews or assessments. Doing so will result in a review and potential disqualification.

You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

• Treat every patient and person like they matter—because they do! You keep people and pets together and stay by their side through tests, treatments, and everything in between

jobs.title: Base Labs Research Scientist - RL Environments
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.



ABOUT BASE LABS

Base Labs is Baseten’s research lab, working to advance and democratize open-source intelligence. We publish our research, methods, and results so others can inspect, reproduce, and build on them. Baseten’s training and inference infrastructure gives us a place to test ideas at scale, while our work with companies deploying models keeps us close to the problems those models need to solve.



THE ROLE

Models learn from the environments we give them. If a reward is easier to exploit than a task is to solve, a model can learn the shortcut. If a task measures the wrong capability, a higher score tells us little about progress. Building good environments requires decisions about what to teach, how to measure it, and how to establish whether it transfers.

As a Research Scientist at Base Labs specializing in RL environments, you will create open environments and study how models learn from them. You will design tasks and rewards, develop methods for generating and calibrating environments at scale, and run the training experiments needed to understand their effects.

There is substantial reinforcement learning research in this work. We want to understand how task diversity affects generalization, how curricula should change as models improve, and which reward structures produce reliable learning. Your findings will inform both the environments we release and the broader lab’s training research.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Identify capabilities and failure modes worth studying, informed by real model use. These may include software development, tool use, scientific reasoning, and following complex instructions.

 - Design task distributions, interactions, rewards, and verifiers together. Establish that tasks are solvable and that success depends on the intended capability. Investigate shortcuts, ambiguous instructions, and weaknesses in grading.

 - Build methods that scale environment creation without weakening the quality standard. Study how to generate diverse tasks, calibrate difficulty, and detect defects before they spread through a large training pool.

 - Run RL experiments to measure learning and transfer. Compare curricula, task mixtures, and reward designs; investigate failed runs and unexpected behavior; test whether improvements hold on unseen tasks.

 - Develop evaluation methods that distinguish capability differences from sampling noise, grader errors, or artifacts of the agent’s tools and execution setup. Preserve the evidence needed to reproduce and challenge your conclusions.

 - Work with safety researchers on environments that reveal reward hacking and misalignment, and test ways to teach more reliable behavior.

 - Release environments, datasets, training recipes, and research findings that other teams can use. Make their assumptions, limitations, and measured effects clear.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

We look for evidence that you can choose a useful research question, design an informative experiment, implement it, and reason carefully about the result.

You should bring depth in a relevant area such as reinforcement learning, model evaluation, agent systems, synthetic data, or experimental methodology. You should be comfortable writing the code needed to build environments, run experiments, and inspect failures in detail. Experience with LLM training is valuable, as is experience building something that other researchers use.

Your evidence might be a paper, an open-source project or a strong experimental investigation. We also welcome exceptional people from adjacent fields. A PhD or a previous Research Scientist title is not required.



WORKING HERE

We are hiring across levels, with scope matched to experience. You will work closely with research engineers, applied researchers, and the wider Base Labs team. Senior hires will help establish research directions and mentor others. Everyone will contribute to the environments, methods, and published evidence on which the program grows.



BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

 - (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

 - Flexible PTO policy

 - Paid parental leave

 - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

 - (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

 - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

As a trusted leader in the broader Data Science org, you will define and drive the Data Science strategy, vision, and roadmap for Lyft EU, while ensuring that the team has all the necessary tools and infrastructure to perform their work. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Full Stack (Core Admin)
jobs.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

Benchling is on a mission to accelerate the pace of life sciences research and development. To do that, we build a suite of tools that scientists use daily to solve humanity's most pressing problems. The tools we build must be optimized to make scientists more efficient in their work, across a broad spectrum of research, development, and manufacturing tasks.



This role is an opportunity to join Core Admin, a foundational Platform team at Benchling. This team is responsible for the core functionality that controls how users authenticate with our product, what they are authorized to access, and how Benchling's features are licensed.



As a Software Engineer on this team, you will build new features and tools that help users unlock the full potential of the Benchling application. You will also work closely with other Platform and Application teams across Benchling, helping them leverage these core services to ship value in their respective product areas. You will have an opportunity to ship quality code at a high velocity, while prioritizing enterprise grade security and compliance.

 - You'll work across our full stack, tackling challenges from the front-end UI to our back-end architecture.

 - You'll be a key partner to product and design, collaborating to transform ideas into thoughtful, high-quality features for our users.

 - You'll do more than just ship code—you'll help us build a better engineering organization by improving our tools, processes, and helping us hire great people

 - You're product-minded, driven to ship, and always consider the customer and business impact of your work.

 - You are a natural problem-solver who thrives on feedback and continuous improvement.

 - You're excited by the challenge of building Enterprise SaaS for the life sciences industry and are eager to learn about the domain.

jobs.title: Product Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril is seeking a Product Data Engineer to join our Configuration Management team. As a Product Data Engineer you will work closely with the leaders of critical Anduril programs to manage a highly dynamic and fast-paced design, engineering, and manufacturing environment. The Product Data Engineer will have a massive impact on capturing and defining the baseline for a program’s requirements, design, testing, manufacturing, and sustainment data structures (requirements baseline, EBOM, MBOM, SOM, BOP).

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Be a partner to Product and Program teams by:

• Working with Anduril system, design, and manufacturing engineers to generate, populate and submit configuration item change requests.

• Preparing critical analyses to support change requests while maintaining configuration integrity and traceability (item dependency analyses, test analyses, effectivity plans, inventory disposition analyses etc.)

• Supporting the execution and implementation of change notices across system engineering, design engineering, manufacturing engineering, and supply chain domains.

• Identifying and executing continuous improvement opportunities by building data-driven perspectives of the full product configuration landscape.

• Be the leader of critical configuration management activities and forums by:

• Supporting configuration managers in managing critical program technical forums (Test Review Board, Change Control Board etc.).

• Working with program teams to prepare for critical technical forums (the Change Review Board, the Change Control Board) including preparing of business cases, test data, effectivity plans, inventory disposition plans, etc.

• Documenting and distributing conclusions, decisions emerging from configuration management forums.

• Conduct periodic product configuration record audits by:

• Supporting configuration management reviews and audits, including FCA/PCA and providing direction before, during and after the events to prevent or resolve issues.

• Reconciling released bills of materials against baseline bills of materials by confirming all variances have signed-off change notices.

• Reconciling product as-built-records against released bills of materials by confirming all variances have quality deviations.

• Identifying, analyzing resolving non-conformances; finding and resolving root-causing failure modes.

• Be an expert resource for the Product Teams for Engineering Release and Change Management processes and standards by:

• Using Teamcenter software to manage Engineering changes, including part revisions, EBOM/MBOM/SBOM updates, documentation modifications, and associated workflows.

• Providing guidance and support to Engineering teams in configuring the Engineering, Manufacturing, and Service Bills of Materials (EBOM, MBOM, SBOM)

• Supporting Configuration Managers and Engineers in defining and maintaining configurable product data sets (i.e., 150% BOMs, product variant dictionaries and schema).

• Being a Teamcenter super-user and able to train product team users on workflows.

• Be part of the team defining the future of digital engineering at Anduril by:

• Partnering with engineering teams to set requirements and identify improvement opportunities in existing ways of working by creating tools or enhancing existing workflows.

• Building an end-to-end digital thread that maintains an accurate product definition, system by system, from the definition of requirements to the as maintained record.

• Identifying and piloting opportunities to leverage Anduril’s AI capabilities tools to unlock increased speed, accuracy, and efficiency within Anduril’s configuration management activities.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 3+ years of configuration analysis or equivalent experience.

• 3+ years of demonstrated experience working in high complexity and high-rate production environments (aerospace, automotive, security systems, medical devices, nuclear).

• Familiar with configuration management principles and practices (EIA649/C, MIL-HDBK-61B).

• Experience with product lifecycle management (PLM) and/or data management toolsets for configuration management of complex products

• Possess high attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills – you must have an ability to synthesize complex quantitative data into clear decision statements.

• BA/BS degree.

• Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and contribute to our inclusive culture.

• Is able to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Proven experience in aerospace industry.

• Proficient in technical writing of processes and procedures.

• Experience with Teamcenter, Teamcenter Requirements, Teamcenter Quality, Confluence & JIRA.

• Certification in CM2 or equivalent configuration management certification.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Search Infra - Elasticsearch
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role:

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search Infra team.  This globally-distributed team of experienced engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This is a principle software engineering role that entails using your vast knowledge in this space in order to define, direct, and build the next generation of Elasticsearch capabilities. This role provides technical vision and direction for Elasticsearch’s core search infrastructure, including indexing, retrieval, and relevance, and requires deep expertise in search internals and cross-team collaboration.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.

What You Will Be Doing:

As a full-time Elasticsearch contributor, you will define, lead, and contribute to the evolution of core search and indexing capabilities. You’ll research advances in search infrastructure, data structures, and retrieval algorithms to ensure we’re building the most efficient and powerful foundations for our users. You’ll work closely with our partners and product teams to understand their needs and help shape the long-term technical vision for search at Elastic. You’ll bring your past experience with large-scale search systems to drive an innovative roadmap for Elasticsearch’s indexing, query execution, and relevance layers. Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. jobs.title: Litigation Paralegal
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About the Role

Be the first. Verkada’s fast-growing Legal team is hiring its first dedicated Litigation Paralegal, and you’ll have the chance to shape the role from day one. You’ll support our Litigation and Employment teams on disputes of every size and in all phases, including overseeing intake, conducting internal investigations, and handling the escalating stages of litigation from early case preparation and discovery through resolution.

You won’t just keep matters moving: You’ll build the processes, playbooks, and systems that keep our litigation docket organized as Verkada scales, and you’ll see the impact of your work right away. You’ll partner daily with in-house counsel and operations, and you’ll join a team of one to support an incredible group of lawyers.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Radar Reinvented.

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Echodyne is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to join our fast-growing team.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Echodyne is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to join our Product Engineering team. This role is responsible for sustaining the electrical assemblies and ensuring the long-term performance, reliability, manufacturability, and supportability of Echodyne’s fielded and in-production radar products.

In this role, you will partner closely with Product Engineering peers and collaborate with Design Engineering, Component Engineering, Manufacturing, Test, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to investigate issues, resolve defects, and implement durable design improvements across the product lifecycle.

Echodyne builds compact solid-state true beam-steering radars that integrate advanced analog, mixed-signal, digital, power, and embedded subsystems. Sustaining these products requires deep circuit-level expertise, disciplined root-cause analysis, and strong ownership of product health in production and in the field.

The Senior Electrical Engineer serves as a technical authority for EE sustaining efforts across multiple radar product lines. You will own investigations into EE subassembly and end-assembly defects, drive corrective and preventative actions, develop and verify design updates, and guide production support activities that maintain product quality and yield.

You will work in a matrixed environment, supporting multiple programs and collaborating with cross-functional teams, while maintaining strong alignment with the Product Engineering organization and its mission to ensure every released design remains robust and supportable throughout its life.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop, verify, and document sustaining design updates driven by reliability, yield, component lifecycle, or manufacturability needs

• Evaluate components, material and supplier alternates and support qualification of replacements for EOL or supply-chain risk mitigation

• Develop ECO packages, sustaining documentation, and release artifacts

• Lead root-cause investigations, failure analysis, and corrective/preventative actions for analog and mixed-signal circuits and subsystems

• Develop design verification test plan and execution method

• Perform advanced debugging and characterization of mixed-signal PCB assemblies in lab and production environments

• Partner with Manufacturing and Test teams to improve test coverage, debug flows, and production yield

REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

• Background in analog and mixed-signal circuit theory and hands-on circuit analysis

• Ability to interpret schematics and guide circuit-level design changes with an understanding of system-level interactions

• Working knowledge of power integrity, signal integrity, and mixed-signal layout considerations

• Understanding of low-speed and mixed-signal interfaces such as SPI, I2C, GPIO, and clocking architectures

• Familiarity with DFx practices including DFM, DFA, and DFT for manufacturable electronics

• Experience collaborating in a cross-functional hardware development and production environment

• Experience leading RCA and CAPA efforts for production or fielded hardware

• Experience debugging and sustaining PCB assemblies that include analog, digital, power, and programmable devices

• Experience troubleshooting circuits using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, DMMs, and related lab equipment

DESIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE
(Looking for one or more as a complement to the core skills)

• Familiarity with SPICE simulation for analysis of existing or modified circuits

• Scientific scripting or data analysis skills using Python or MATLAB

• Familiarity with efficient use of AI tooling

QUALIFICATIONS

• BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or related field

• 5 or more years of hands-on experience with analog and mixed-signal printed circuit assemblies, including debugging, verification, and production support

• Eligibility to handle export-controlled information (ITAR/EAR)

Echodyne’s technology is export controlled by the U.S. Government and we must evaluate an applicant’s eligibility to handle export-controlled information or obtain required Government authorizations.  Therefore, we will ask you as part of the application process to identify whether you are a U.S. Citizen or green card holder, or have asylum/refugee status in the U.S.

WHAT WE OFFER

This is an exempt role.

The expected annual salary range for this role is

$137,196—$205,382 USD

If your skills generally align but not perfectly, please apply anyway. There may be another role that’s a great fit for you!

jobs.title: Embedded Linux Software Engineer, XFRA
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION  


SPAN IS ENABLING ELECTRIFICATION FOR ALL ⚡




XFRA BY SPAN IS THE FIRST DISTRIBUTED DATA CENTER USING EXISTING INFRASTRUCTURE AND UNDERUTILIZED POWER CAPACITY TO MEET EXPANDING AI COMPUTE DEMAND.




THE PRODUCT

XFRA is a new business inside SPAN. We are leveraging SPAN's smart panel and digital power controls to enable distributed AI inference compute infrastructure: GPU compute nodes deployed into residential, commercial, and industrial sites, orchestrated as a single fleet. It is a genuine v0 product. We now need to build a team to stand up a manufacturing and deployment process for XFRA, develop a production-grade node management and orchestration layer, and continue growing revenue by selling compute and AI services. For more details, check out our website and whitepaper: https://www.xfra.ai/



THE ROLE

XFRA is a small, fast-moving team building a new product from nothing. We are looking for a Linux Software Engineer to build and own all software that runs on an XFRA node: the software image on our GPU servers, the node controller that connects those servers to the thermal and electrical systems around them, and the node-side interfaces that our orchestration layer and our customers use to run AI workloads on the hardware. Over time, your software will manage hundreds of thousands of nodes, representing many gigawatts of cutting-edge distributed AI compute capacity.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the XFRA node software image end to end: kernel, drivers, package and repository pinning, system services, and a reproducible, version-controlled build

 - Release node images on a regular cadence through our cloud deployment path, designed so a failed update degrades gracefully rather than bricking a node hours from the nearest engineer

 - Build and own the node controller: sensor and actuator interfaces, local control loops, and its telemetry contract with the cloud

 - Integrate nodes with SPAN panels so workload can be curtailed, shifted, or offloaded in response to energy events and site power limits

 - Build the node-side API that the orchestration layer talks to, and the interface customers use to schedule and run AI workloads on the hardware

 - Document what you build: architecture, interfaces, and operational procedures
   


ABOUT YOU


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 4+ years building and shipping production systems software on Linux

 - Deep Linux internals: kernel configuration and drivers, boot and init, systemd, filesystems, networking

 - Experience building and releasing a Linux image or firmware for fielded hardware, including a remote update mechanism that is safe to run unattended

 - Strong grasp of at least one of C, Rust, or C++, as well as Python

 - Hands-on hardware integration: sensors, actuators, buses, and debugging across the software/hardware boundary with a scope, logic analyzer, and a datasheet

 - Real operational experience owning remote systems nobody can physically touch, including participating in the team on-call rotation


BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Prior experience as a founding or early engineer, or taking a 0-to-1 product from nothing to production

 - You use AI tooling heavily and deliberately to increase your own output

 - OS build systems and the CI around them: Yocto, Buildroot, Debian/Ubuntu packaging

 - A/B update systems such as OSTree, Mender, RAUC, or SWUpdate

 - Server platform bring-up: BMC and out-of-band management, UEFI/BIOS configuration, PXE or netboot provisioning

 - Thermal or power control systems, control-loop design, or liquid cooling

 - Energy, electrical, or power-electronics systems; industrial protocols such as Modbus, CAN, or RS485

 - GPU or AI inference infrastructure: NVIDIA driver and CUDA bring-up, multi-GPU systems, GPU partitioning, GPU-aware container runtimes

 - Host and platform security: intrusion detection, integrity measurement, hardening, secrets handling on hardware you do not physically control

 - Telemetry pipelines and pub/sub messaging (MQTT or similar) from remote devices




LIFE AT SPAN

Headquartered in San Francisco’s vibrant SoMa neighborhood, we are an eclectic group of creative thinkers who value open communication, teamwork, and a ‘make it happen’ approach to addressing complex challenges. 

SPAN embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. 

We’re hiring talented individuals who are driven by success and are passionate about shaping the future of renewable energy. If that sounds like you, we’d love for you to consider joining the rapidly growing team at SPAN.



The Perks:

⚡ Competitive compensation + equity grants at a well-funded, venture-backed company

⚡ Comprehensive benefits: 100% employee premiums for base plans on medical, dental, vision with options for additional coverage.  Parental leave up to twenty four (24)  weeks depending on eligibility

⚡ Comfortable, sunny office space located near BART and Caltrain public transit

⚡ Strong focus on team building and company culture: Employee Resource Groups, monthly social events, SPANcakes recognition breakfast, lunch, and learns

⚡ Flexible hours, one holiday per month, and flexible time off

 

Interested in joining our team? Apply today and we’ll be in touch with the next steps!

jobs.title: Staff Growth Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT POSHMARK


Poshmark is the leading fashion marketplace where style comes alive through discovery, self-expression, and human connection. Powered by a vibrant community of 165 million members, Poshmark brings real people and taste to shopping through a social experience shaped by shared discovery. Buying and selling fashion feels simple, joyful, and personal, while every item tells its own story. Poshmark empowers sellers to grow meaningful businesses, keeps fashion in circulation longer, and gives shoppers access to unique and trusted finds, from everyday pieces to one-of-a-kind vintage and luxury.

 



Poshmark is seeking a Staff Growth Product Manager to drive high-impact, data-informed growth across the marketplace. This role will initially focus on new user onboarding and early lifecycle experiences, with the opportunity to expand into broader growth opportunities over time, including engagement, retention, and monetization.



You will be responsible for identifying and scaling the highest leverage growth opportunities across the user journey. This includes optimizing first touch experiences, accelerating activation, and improving long-term retention. Over time, you will flex across surfaces and problems as priorities evolve.



This role is for a builder who thrives in ambiguity, brings strong analytical rigor, and takes full ownership of outcomes from problem definition through execution.




RESPONSIBILITIES:



 - Own and improve key growth funnels across the user lifecycle, with an initial focus on new user onboarding and early activation for buyers and sellers

 - Identify and prioritize high-impact growth opportunities using quantitative analysis, user research, and experimentation

 - Lead a high-velocity experimentation program across onboarding, discovery, engagement, and retention surfaces

 - Design and analyze experiments with strong statistical rigor, and translate results into clear product decisions and roadmap direction

 - Conduct and synthesize user research to understand motivations, behaviors, and drop-off drivers across the funnel

 - Apply principles of customer psychology, habit formation, and behavioral economics to inform product design and optimization

 - Define and maintain core growth metrics, dashboards, and KPI frameworks to ensure visibility and alignment across teams

 - Partner closely with design, engineering, data, and marketing to deliver high-quality, scalable growth initiatives

 - Communicate strategy, insights, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership with a focus on business impact

 - Communicate roadmap strategy, experiment results, and investment trade-offs to senior leadership with precise business impact framing, clear assumptions, and well-reasoned recommendations.



6-Month Accomplishments:

 - Audit the new user journey for buyers and sellers, identifying key friction points and opportunities through data and research

 - Establish a clear activation framework, including key metrics, instrumentation, and shared dashboards

 - Launch and iterate on experiments targeting the highest impact onboarding and activation gaps

 - Define activation milestones and outline a roadmap to reduce time to value



12+ Month Accomplishments:



 - Deliver measurable improvements in key growth metrics, including activation, retention, and engagement across the user lifecycle

 - Expand ownership beyond onboarding to additional growth surfaces such as discovery, re-engagement, and monetization

 - Establish a consistent experimentation engine with a strong pipeline of ideas and documented learnings

 - Improve time to key user actions such as first listing, first purchase, and first offer

 - Develop and socialize a growth playbook including frameworks, metrics, and best practices adopted across the organization




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



 - 6–10 years of experience in product management, with a significant portion dedicated to growth-specific functions.

 - Proven track record of driving product-led growth in a consumer or marketplace environment

 - Strong analytical skills with experience in experimentation, funnel analysis, and data-driven decision making

 - Ability to operate across a wide range of problem spaces, from onboarding to retention and beyond

 - Experience applying user research and behavioral insights to product design

 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and senior leadership

 - High ownership mindset with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments

As a Visual Merchandiser, you contribute to an inspiring, elevated, and consistent customer experience by implementing visual standards and commercial excellence. You will also use your trend and competitor awareness to provide colleagues with the correct information, coach, upskill and develop the store team to contribute to a great customer experience.

Customer Sales & Profit

jobs.description:
About Stitch Fix, Inc.

Stitch Fix (NASDAQ: SFIX) Stitch Fix is redefining retail by combining human creativity with advanced data science and Generative AI. As we build the future of personalized shopping, we’re equally committed to building yours.  We believe in investing in our team as much as our technology. Join us to be a trendsetter in the industry and help us redefine what’s possible for our clients, while we help you reach your full potential.

About the Role

The Logistics Algorithms team helps put the right inventory in the right places at the right times so clients can discover the styles they love. As a Data Scientist, you’ll partner with teams across Stitch Fix to improve how inventory is matched to client demand and how orders are sourced and fulfilled, supporting the client experience, business efficiency, and unit margin.

Responsibilities:

• Design, implement, and validate data science solutions that improve how available inventory is matched to client demand and how orders are sourced and fulfilled.

• Apply simulation, optimization, predictive modeling, and A/B testing to evaluate tradeoffs and guide business decisions.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Merchandise Planning to translate business challenges into analytical questions and actionable recommendations.

• Build reusable tools, analyses, and dashboards that help partners understand inventory and fulfillment performance and make informed decisions.

• Identify opportunities and independently drive solutions, collaborating with the broader Algorithms organization to deliver measurable business impact.

How AI and tools show up in your day-to-day work.

• Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, analysis, and experimentation, while validating outputs and maintaining high standards for code and documentation.

• Work with Python, SQL, machine learning libraries, and visualization tools to analyze data, develop solutions, and share insights.

• Learn and apply new tools and technologies that improve how the team solves problems and delivers results.

About You

This is what you’ll need to succeed in this role from day 1.

Requirements:

• Proficiency in Python and experience with libraries such as scikit-learn and statsmodels, including explainable predictive methods.

• Experience using SQL to analyze large datasets and generate insights.

• Understanding of statistical principles and the ability to apply them to data and experimental results.

• Ability to communicate findings and actionable recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Matplotlib, Seaborn, or Looker.

• Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools and sound judgment in validating outputs.

• A thoughtful approach to complexity and prioritization, with the ability to make decisions about where to invest time for the greatest impact.

• Curiosity, collaboration, and the ability to independently move work forward while balancing multiple workstreams.

Nice to Have:

• Experience applying data science to inventory, order management, logistics, or fulfillment challenges.

• Familiarity with simulation or optimization techniques to support business decisions.

You’ll love working at Stitch Fix because you will…

• Fuse human creativity and styling expertise to redefine personalized retail.

• Set a high bar for our craft and drive measurable impact across fashion, tech, and data science.

• Actively leverage AI and modern tech to evolve how work gets done.

• Lead with innovation, think boldly, and aren't afraid to challenge conventional retail norms.

• Win together in a collaborative, low-ego environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated.

• Be client obsessed by putting our customers at the heart of every decision to deliver unmatched personalization and trust.

• Support our team with competitive compensation packages, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful career growth.

jobs.title: Data Center Systems Architect
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION  


SPAN IS ENABLING ELECTRIFICATION FOR ALL ⚡




XFRA BY SPAN IS THE FIRST DISTRIBUTED DATA CENTER USING EXISTING INFRASTRUCTURE AND UNDERUTILIZED POWER CAPACITY TO MEET EXPANDING AI COMPUTE DEMAND.



 - Decarbonization is the process to reduce or remove greenhouse gas emissions, especially carbon dioxide, from entering our atmosphere.

 - Electrification is the process of replacing fossil fuel appliances that run on gas or oil with all-electric upgrades for a cleaner way to power our lives.
   
   


AT SPAN, WE BELIEVE IN:

 - Enabling homes and vehicles powered by clean energy

 - Making electrification upgrades possible

 - Building more resilient homes with reliable backup

 - Designing a flexible and distributed electrical grid





THE ROLE

You will own the system-level architecture of XFRA nodes—compact, outdoor or indoor miniature data centers that integrate high-density GPU compute, power delivery, liquid cooling, and fail-safe controls into a single deployable package. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will define how power, compute, cooling, and mechanical systems work together, produce the reference designs and schematics that guide detailed engineering, and drive the architecture from first-principles concept through production and subsequent generations. The work spans residential-scale nodes and larger commercial deployments and requires close collaboration with electrical, mechanical, thermal, firmware, and operations teams.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Architect complete miniature data-center nodes from first principles. Define the integrated layout and interfaces for power distribution, GPU compute, liquid cooling loops, heat rejection, and controls so the system meets performance, reliability, serviceability, and size constraints.

 - Design liquid-cooling architectures for servers, including coolant distribution units (CDUs), pump selection and placement, cold-plate or manifold arrangements, and heat-rejection paths (heat pumps or chillers). Specify flow, pressure, temperature, and redundancy requirements.

 - Own thermal and coolant distribution design. Produce the rack- or enclosure-level space allocation, cooling distribution topology, and piping/manifold schemes that keep compute within thermal limits under worst-case ambient and load conditions.

 - Create and maintain system schematics, block diagrams, and interface control documents that capture power, cooling, and fail-safe interlocks. Use these as the single source of truth for detailed design teams and contract manufacturers.

 - Define fail-safe behaviors for power, cooling, and environmental faults. Specify sensor placement, interlocks, graceful degradation, and recovery paths so an unattended node remains safe and recoverable.

 - Lead technical projects from early feasibility and 0-1 architecture through design validation and into production, then drive the architectural changes required for the next generation.

 - Work with electrical, mechanical, thermal, and firmware engineers to close system-level issues; translate architecture decisions into requirements that can be implemented and tested.

 - Support vendor selection and technical qualification for pumps, CDUs, heat exchangers, power components, and related subsystems.




ABOUT YOU 


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - First-principles approach to system architecture—able to reason from power, thermal, fluid, and reliability constraints rather than scaling existing data-center reference designs.

 - Experience as technical project lead on hardware systems that moved from concept to production, with ownership of architectural decisions and cross-team issue closure.

 - Track record building a product from 0-1 and then driving at least one subsequent generation, including the architectural and interface changes required.

 - Hands-on design of liquid-cooled server or high-density compute systems, including coolant loops, pumps, and heat rejection.

 - Practical experience integrating power, compute, cooling, chilling/heat-pump, and pump subsystems into a coherent system.

 - Demonstrated ability to architect miniature or edge-scale data centers (not only traditional raised-floor facilities), including rack- or enclosure-level space planning and cooling distribution.

 - Experience with thermal design and CDU/coolant distribution architecture.

 - Ability to produce clear system schematics, block diagrams, and interface definitions that engineering and manufacturing teams can execute against.

 - Design of fail-safe systems, including sensor strategies, interlocks, and degraded-mode behavior for unattended or remote equipment.


BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Broader systems experience that spans electrical, thermal, and mechanical domains.

 - Familiarity with electrical utility interfaces, service entrance requirements, or interconnection rules relevant to distributed sites.

 - Project-management ownership on multi-discipline hardware programs.

 - Established practices for technical vendor management and subsystem qualification.

 - Demonstrated effectiveness in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and willingness to push architectural boundaries when requirements are still forming.




LIFE AT SPAN

Headquartered in San Francisco’s vibrant SoMa neighborhood, we are an eclectic group of creative thinkers who value open communication, teamwork, and a ‘make it happen’ approach to addressing complex challenges. 

SPAN embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. 

We’re hiring talented individuals who are driven by success and are passionate about shaping the future of renewable energy. If that sounds like you, we’d love for you to consider joining the rapidly growing team at SPAN.



The Perks:

jobs.title: Staff/ Sr. Staff Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Lightmatter is leading the revolution in AI data center infrastructure, enabling the next giant leaps in human progress. The company invented the world’s first 3D-stacked photonics engine, Passage™, capable of connecting thousands to millions of processors at the speed of light in extreme-scale data centers for the most advanced AI and HPC workloads.

Lightmatter raised $400 million in its Series D round, reaching a valuation of $4.4 billion. We will continue to accelerate the development of data center photonics and grow every department at Lightmatter!

If you're passionate about tackling complex challenges, making an impact, and being an expert in your craft, join our team of brilliant scientists, engineers, and accomplished industry leaders.

Lightmatter is (re)inventing the future of computing with light!

About this Role

The Product Engineer role is pivotal to Lightmatter’s mission, sitting at the center of product delivery and operational excellence. This position offers a unique opportunity for end-to-end ownership, where you will define the product engineering landscape from the ground up and drive the strategic direction for our hardware portfolio. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams (design, foundry, assembly, process integration, packaging, test, validation, reliability) to optimize manufacturing flows, improve yield and quality, and reduce costs. The role’s focus areas include: optimizing Yield & Quality, implementing DFx principles and managing the product from initial silicon to high-volume manufacturing (HVM). The core responsibilities are specifically centered on optimizing manufacturing flows, yield Improvement, driving assembly and process integration readiness, and Test Point Optimization. Given the nature of our products, you will work extensively with silicon photonics and optical components, including high-speed electrical and optical interfaces.

Responsibilities

• Strategic Ownership: Own the product’s success by managing yield and quality indicators from first silicon to high-volume manufacturing (HVM).

• Manufacturing Excellence: Define manufacturing and test strategies, including DFx implementation, test hardware specs, and test program creation guidance for photonic and optoelectronic devices.

• DFx Leadership: Drive DFx requirements into design from architecture through tape-out for chips, boards, assembly and process integration and final module. Feed back learnings from assembly, test, and reliability into design.

• Yield & Cost Optimization: Drive continuous improvement in quality, yield, and cost by reducing test time, eliminating test sockets, closing test holes (DPM reduction), and increasing yield through root cause analysis with cross-functional teams (design, fab, assembly, packaging, firmware, software, data engineering). Apply these efforts to photonic integrated circuits (PICs), optical coupling and alignment, assembly-induced yield loss (e.g., warpage, stress, misalignment, and contamination), and optical component yield loss mechanisms.

• Hands on leadership: Debug test, yield, assembly, process, and power/performance issues, including optical loss, coupling efficiency, wavelength and thermal sensitivities, assembly process excursions, and high-speed electrical/optical signal degradation.

• Guiding Light: Lead multi-disciplinary teams (Design, Foundry, Assembly, Process Integration, Packaging, Supply Chain, etc.) to resolve product issues and continuously improve team tools and methods.

Qualifications

• Master’s in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Material Science, Optics/Photonics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

• A minimum of 5+ years experience in semiconductor industry as a product engineer, with a cumulative of 12 years of relative industry experience

• Background in silicon photonics, photonics, or optical components, including a working understanding of photonic device physics and optical test fundamentals.

• Experience developing and applying DFx strategy (DFT, DFM, DFA, DFR), including driving design changes based on manufacturing, assembly, and test data

• Familiarity with advanced electronic and photonic packaging flows.

• Experience partnering with OSATs to develop manufacturing assembly and test flows for CMOS or Optical transceiver products

• Understanding of reliability and qualification considerations for optical components and assembled packages

• Excellent communication skills with ability to present complex technical information clearly and concisely

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior company leadership and partner with vendors and customers

• Familiarity with statistical analysis & data acquisition tools such as JMP, Snowflake

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with high-speed (e.g., 56G/112G/224G SerDes or equivalent) electrical and/or optical interfaces, including test, characterization, and debug

• Hands-on experience with optical test equipment and instrumentation, such as optical spectrum analyzers, tunable lasers, optical power meters, optical probers, and fiber alignment or coupling systems

• Experience partnering with an OSAT to develop manufacturing assembly and test flows for Co-Packaged Optics technology from

• Familiarity with ATE Test area equipment and methodology

• Experience with optical transceiver or optical interconnect products (e.g., pluggable modules, optical engines, or CPO) from development through volume production

• Programming or scripting: Python, C, Java, Ruby, SQL, or shell scripting.

Talkdesk® is a global cloud contact center leader for customer-obsessed companies. Our cloud-native, AI-powered Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platform automates customer journeys and coordinates human-AI workforces to deliver exceptional customer experiences. We are a fast-moving, innovative organization pushing the boundaries of customer experience automation, agentic AI, and enterprise-grade generative AI applications.

At Talkdesk, we believe that when you bring your best to us, we’ll bring out the best in you. You will work on cutting-edge AI technologies that are actively redefining how global enterprise companies interact with their customers. We provide the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, and an inclusive, highly collaborative environment where your contributions have a direct, visible impact.

Role Overview

The Senior Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is a high-impact customer facing strategy and technical leadership role sitting at the critical intersection of people management, technical strategy, and customer excellence. In this role, you will build, lead, and scale a world-class team of Forward Deployed Engineers embedded directly within Talkdesk’s most strategic customer environments.

You are not managing from the sidelines; you are part customer C level consultant, part technical strategist, part program architect, and part cross-functional connector. You will ensure that our most complex customer deployments are executed with exceptional quality while engineering repeatable solutions that turn field insights into out-of-the-box Talkdesk product capabilities.

1. Team Leadership & Talent Enablement

• Build & Scale: Recruit, hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of senior Forward Deployed Engineers and AI practitioners.

• Career Development: Own team performance, setting clear objectives (OKRs), providing continuous feedback, conducting performance reviews, and guiding career growth along software engineering ladders.

• Onboarding & Enablement: Partner with Talent Enablement to standardize the integration path and training curriculum for incoming technical roles to streamline the ramp-up process.

2. Delivery & Execution Excellence

• Deployment Ownership: Oversee the end-to-end delivery of complex customer deployments, from early technical discovery and scoping through system integration and production launch.

• Quality Assurance: Set high-engineering standards, defining reference architectures, API and integration strategies, and production readiness criteria for generative AI and CCaaS solutions.

• Risk & Escalation Management: Serve as the senior escalation point for customer technical concerns, delivery risks, and complex configuration friction, resolving blockers with composure.

• Playbook Development: Formulate, document, and share engineering playbooks, standardized configuration patterns, and best practices to enable repeatable and scalable customer execution.

3. Product-Field Feedback Loop

• Product Hardening: Drive the mechanism that converts field telemetry, configuration patterns, and recurring customer friction into structured feature briefs for Product Management and Core Engineering.

• Strategic Reusability: Ensure that client-specific work compounds into reusable solution patterns, platform primitives, and out-of-the-box product capabilities, rather than one-off custom delivery.

• Roadmap Influence: Collaborate closely with Product, R&D, and GTM teams, acting as the primary voice of the field to help inform and shape the core product roadmap.

4. Strategic Stakeholder & Commercial Engagement

• Executive Partnerships: Build and maintain high-trust relationships with senior customer engineering teams and executive stakeholders (C-level, VP, CIO/CDO), acting as a trusted AI transformation advisor.

• Internal Alignment: Lead a team of AI Deployment Strategists (ADS)and Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE), align with the Solution Engineers (SE), Customer Success Managers (CSMs), and Product Managers teams to align delivery capabilities with strategic business objectives.

• Commercial Drive: Maintain a strong commercial instinct to understand how technical architecture decisions map to Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), containment goals, and customer retention.

Qualifications & Experience

• Professional Experience: 10+ years of experience in software engineering, technical consulting, professional services, or customer-embedded engineering environments.

• Leadership Experience: 5+ years of experience directly managing and leading high-performing technical teams of software, integration, or AI deployment engineers.

• AI & Cloud Stack Fluency: Deep familiarity with cloud-native stacks (AWS, GCP, or Azure), microservices, API integrations, and continuous integration/delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.

• Enterprise Delivery: Proven track record of architecting, configuring, and deploying complex software systems or generative AI/LLM solutions (e.g., RAG, agentic workflows, LLM observability) in enterprise-grade production environments.

• CCaaS Domain Expertise: Strong understanding of Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) architecture, telephony routing, speech-to-text (STT) pipelines, or contact center workflows is highly preferred.
