About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

At Life360, the Marketing team is a highly valued contributor to the business. From creating demand to converting that demand to expanding our relationships with members, the Marketing team is at the forefront of telling the Life360 story and how it can help make everyday family life better. We prioritize bold thinking, principled risks and entrepreneurial thinking. And, we give our marketers the freedom and autonomy to make the decisions they feel are best for the brand and the business. It's an exciting time to be on the Life360 global Marketing team!

About the Job

Reporting to the VP of Integrated Marketing, the Senior Director of Integrated Marketing turns strategy into in-market execution across consumer acquisition, creating demand in the US and in our international priority markets, including (but not limited to) the UK, Australia, Canada and Germany, with additional markets coming online each year. You will partner closely with the Senior Director of Performance Marketing to close the funnel — your work creates the demand, theirs accelerates and converts it, and the two only work as one motion.

You will lead a small but mighty team and a set of agency partners across brand/demand creation media, influencer partnerships,and  sports marketing across both the App and Verticals business units. You own the day-to-day: the plans, the budgets, the channel mix, the campaign calendars and the reporting that tells us what is working.

The international scope is the part that makes this role different. Each market is at a different stage, with varying points of brand awareness and subscription maturity. Ensuring we are right sizing the strategy to the market stage and delivering flawless execution is key.

You will partner deeply with marketing leaders across creative and social, product marketing, journey marketing, comms and with functional teams outside marketing (data science and analytics, design, finance) and product/eng teams (subscription growth, devices). Your performance connects directly to the company's key goals — brand, free user growth, and financial — and this is a high visibility role.

The US-based salary range for this position is $171,000 to $266,000. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You'll Do

• Build and run bold, distinct consumer marketing campaigns that stand out and help cement Life360 as the #1 app for making everyday family life better.

• Own integrated plans across the US, UK, AU, CA and DE — deciding what scales globally, what gets localized, and what a single market needs built for it. Driving towards company goals of MAU and QNR.

• Translate a global brief into market-level media plans, flighting and budgets, working with regional agency partners and in-market teams on local nuance: media landscape, competitive set, cultural context, language and regulatory requirements.

• Deeply understand how each marketing channel and lever connects to our key brand and business metrics, and enact the strategies and tactics that generate greater returns from our investment in them.

• Ensure cohesion and orchestration across channels and surfaces, both those managed within and those managed outside of your team.

• Partner with brand and creative leadership on strong connectivity of messaging, creative excellence, and adherence to brand guidelines and ambition — including creative adaptation and localization for international markets.

• Partner with business group leaders so Integrated Marketing activity reflects their broader vision and priorities.

• Own the marketing budget day to day across markets: buildww the plans, track pacing, reallocate as performance dictates, and serve as the VP's right hand on forecast and performance.

• Partner with Finance and Analytics leadership on performance reporting and actionable insight, with measurement that holds up at both a global and a market level. Run the forums where those insights get shared with leadership and other vested constituents.

• Lead, coach and grow a high performing team working across time zones, and hold agency partners to a high standard.

What We're Looking For

• 15+ years of successful experience in full funnel marketing, ideally with 4+ years in the app marketing space (ideally).

• Experience running marketing across multiple countries — ideally some combination of the US, UK, Australia, Canada and Germany.

• Deep knowledge of and experience with brand and demand creation strategies and tactics, and comfortable communicating with senior leaders how creating demand drives business growth.

• Deep belief in the value of long-term brand building as a complement to more short-term oriented marketing methods, goals and techniques.

• Consumer subscription experience strongly preferred. Freemium model experience is highly beneficial.

• Strong understanding of marketing insights and analytics methodologies and tools, from attribution to marketing mix and econometric modeling and beyond — including the practical realities of measuring smaller markets with less data.

• A strong people leader who builds trust, develops talent, and holds a high bar with care and empathy.

• Experience managing agency partners, including regional or local-market agencies.

• Exceptional cross-functional collaborator who can work effectively across time zones.

• Stellar communicator. Can distill complex stories down and communicate persuasively in both written and verbal modalities.

• While data-informed, embraces the grayscale nature of marketing and complements empiricism with judgment and intuition.

Our Benefits

• Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)

• Paid parental leave

• 401(k) plan with company matching program

• Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being

• Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns

• Learning & Development programs

• Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment

• Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers

AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

• Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.

• Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.

• Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.

• High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Belonging

Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway.

jobs.location: Austin, Texas, United States; Bozeman, Montana, United States; Denver, Colorado, United States; Kalispell, Montana, United States; Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States; Missoula, Montana, United States; Portland, Oregon, United States; Salt Lake City, Utah, United States; Seattle, Washington, United States
jobs.description:
ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking a talented Senior Android Engineer who will contribute to meaningful, real-world outcomes that have a lasting impact for customers and the Offroad business. This role is critical to delivering best-in-class mobile experiences for overlanders and trail riders, leveraging the Android platform to bring mapping, GPS, and outdoor discovery features directly to our users’ fingertips. As a Senior Android Engineer, you will own major components of the Android app, drive technical decisions, and collaborate cross-functionally to ship impactful features. This position is ideal for an engineer who thrives on solving complex problems with a collaborative team, cares deeply about the user experience, and can influence both the technical direction and team culture. This role will report to the Offroad Engineering Manager.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

• Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of complex features in the Android Offroad application.

• Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and QA to deliver intuitive, performant, and reliable user experiences.

• Mentor and support junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance.

• Influence architectural direction for the Android app, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and performance.

• Participate in technical discussions and make high-judgment decisions with long-term business impact.

• Proactively identify opportunities for innovation and process improvement within the mobile platform.

• Actively contribute to the hiring process by upholding a high bar for technical and cultural fit.

• Collaborate effectively with other team members in verbal and written communication.

• Integrate AI-driven experimentation into daily workflows, applying sound judgment and validation.

• Look for opportunities to embed AI as a repeatable co-pilot in daily workflows by integrating experimentation into real work, and continuously refining its use with sound judgment and validation.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

• 8+ years of experience is required.

• Expert in Kotlin and the Android ecosystem, with demonstrated experience shipping production Android apps at scale.

• Strong grasp of Android frameworks (Jetpack Compose, Android Views, etc.) and architectural patterns.

• Experience designing and debugging asynchronous, multi-threaded applications (e.g., Kotlin Coroutines).

• Proven ability to design and implement scalable mobile systems that integrate with backend APIs.

• Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, and their performance tradeoffs in production environments ￼.

• Ability to operate independently on end-to-end workstreams, from concept through delivery.

• Demonstrated ability to facilitate technical discussions and build consensus across cross-functional teams.

• Proven track record of mentoring and elevating engineering standards.

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, unit/UI testing frameworks, and monitoring tools for mobile applications (e.g., Firebase Crashlytics).

• Passion for exploring emerging technologies, including the practical application of AI.

• A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values.

• Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.

• Ability to travel quarterly for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

• Experience working with mapping software or apps

• Experience with Analytics, client events

• Comfort working in a consumer-facing app with a large user base

• Ability to work effectively with a distributed team

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX is a distributed company with employees across the U.S. We have physical offices in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration.

We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members.

At this time, we are NOT able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia (D.C.), Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, we are open to considering candidates ranging in two levels (level II and level III). Spanning these levels, applicants can expect to make between $146,000 to $182,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based on experience, skills, certifications, and education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and a potential annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

• Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth

• Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan

• Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents

• 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%

• Company-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks

• Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle

• Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays

PERFORMANCE ESSENTIALS

In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem-solving, essential for our computer-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at PC@onxmaps.com.

Position open until filled.

#LI-Remote

At onX, we believe that unique perspectives make us stronger. By bringing together people with different experiences, ideas, and viewpoints, we fuel innovation and move closer to our mission of awakening the adventurer in everyone. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fairness not only in hiring, but also in development, compensation, and promotion. Our goal is to build an inclusive community where every team member can show up authentically and thrive. Together, we win as one team. Come join us!

onX Maps will never ask for credit card or SSN details during the initial application process. For your digital safety, apply only through our legitimate website at onXmaps.com or directly via our LinkedIn page.

onX does not sell any Personal Information, but we may transfer employment related records to our service providers or third parties that provide business services to onX or as required by law. For more information, see our Privacy Policy.

As part of our interview process, your conversation may be recorded for documentation purposes to allow interviewers to focus fully on the discussion. Recordings are confidential and accessible only to authorized personnel. Please note, onX respects all applicable laws regarding recording consent, and you will have an opportunity to opt-out if preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

Senior Manager, Performance Marketing

Overview

PagerDuty is seeking a strategic, data-driven Senior Manager of Performance Marketing to own PagerDuty's paid media function across Enterprise and Commercial segments. You will set the multi-year paid media strategy, own the full paid budget and its pipeline contribution, and build and lead a team of performance marketing managers and specialists. You will work closely with marketing and sales leadership to set pipeline targets and decide where paid investment goes. You will report to the Director of Integrated Marketing.

How you'll impact our vision

• Define and own the paid media strategy and annual plan across Enterprise and Commercial segments, tied to company pipeline and revenue goals.

• Own the full paid media budget, from the investment strategy to allocation and tracking, and be accountable for pipeline contribution and return on spend.

• Define the KPI framework and goals in partnership Revenue Marketing leadership to balance volume metrics (MQLs, pipeline, opportunities, trials, PQLs) with efficiency metrics (cost per opportunity, CAC, pipeline ROI).

• Set the measurement and reporting approach for paid media to share key insights, results and recommendations with cross functional stakeholders and marketing and sales leadership.

• Lead the performance marketing team, developing and coaching program managers and specialists in daily operations and career development.

• Decide which new channels and capabilities to invest in and lead adoption of AI and automation in media buying, creative and optimization.

• Co-own pipeline goals with the Campaigns team and Sales leadership, making sure paid media supports our marketing and sales plays and priority accounts.

• Lead relationships with agencies and media platforms, including agency selection and contract negotiation, and partner with Brand, Analytics, Marketing Operations and Regional Marketing to drive alignment and performance.

What you bring

• 8+ years of experience in performance marketing, demand generation or growth marketing, with demonstrated success in B2B marketing.

• 3+ years of people management experience, including managing and building or scaling a team.

• Deep expertise across paid media platforms and channels, including paid search, paid social, display, native and programmatic, with the judgment to set channel strategy and coach managers on execution.

• Experience owning paid media budgets across channels and regions, with a track record of making and defending investment decisions based on pipeline and revenue impact.

• Experience building attribution and program measurement, and presenting performance and investment recommendations to executive leadership.

• Experience leading global or multi-region paid media programs.

• Experience with marketing automation platforms (Marketo preferred), CRM systems (Salesforce), and analytics/attribution tools (Tableau).

• Experience with account-based and intent platforms such as Demandbase or 6sense.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience leading paid media for both product-led growth and sales-led motions in a B2B SaaS company.

• Experience scaling paid media at a public or high-growth company.

• Experience partnering directly with Sales and Finance leadership on pipeline planning.

Salary Range:  $114,000 to $172,700

Hesitant to apply?

We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for job alerts!

Where we work

PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we cannot employ candidates residing in:

Location restrictions:
Australia: Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia
Canada: Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon
United States: Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming
Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.

How we work

Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.

People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.

What we offer

As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our benefits site.

Your package may include:

• Competitive salary

• Comprehensive benefits package

• Flexible work arrangements

• Company equity*

• ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)*

• Retirement or pension plan*

• Generous paid vacation time

• Paid holidays and sick leave

• Dutonian Wellness Days & HibernationDuty - companywide paid days off in addition to PTO

• Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)*

• Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year

• Company-wide hack weeks

• Mental wellness programs

*Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure

About PagerDuty

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always-on digital experiences to modern businesses

PagerDuty is Great Place to Work-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2.

Go behind-the-scenes on our careers site and @pagerduty on Instagram.

Additional Information

PagerDuty is an equal opportunity employer. PagerDuty does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or disability status. Your privacy is important to us. By submitting an application, you confirm that you have read and understand PagerDuty's Privacy Policy.

PagerDuty is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. Should you require accommodation, please email accommodation@pagerduty.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

PagerDuty uses the E-Verify employment verification program.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed AI Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
We are building the future of customer experience at talkdesk, and the Forward Deployed team is a critical group which leads the design and implementation of AI Agent based Automated solutions for many industry verticals. As an AI Deployment Strategist, you operate as a "founding builder" and trusted advisor . Your mission is to understand a customer's business operations from first principles, design custom AI/agentic solutions, and guide customers through the complete transition from experimental AI pilots to durable, production-ready system rollouts .

We are looking for a high-agency individual to join our team as a founding AI Deployment Strategist. Unlike traditional software delivery, deploying generative AI fundamentally mutates operational workflows and alters decision-making rights. Your mission will be to act as a trusted consultant and AI thought leader for our most strategic customers, understand their business from first principles, and deploy cutting-edge AI agents that deliver undeniable value. You will build and optimize the AI architecture and act as the single-threaded owner of business realization, executive alignment, and change management.

You will operate at the intersection of strategy, sales, consulting, and hands-on engineering. This role requires the ability to lead executive-level workshops, design transformative AI solutions, and then roll up your sleeves to bring them to life. If you thrive in ambiguity, take extreme ownership, and are passionate about building what's next, this is the team for you.

What You'll Do:

• Own the AI Lifecycle: Lead end-to-end customer engagements, from initial discovery and strategic scoping to hands-on deployment, value realization, and executive readout.

• Be a Strategic Consultant & Thought Leader: Act as the primary technical advisor and consultant for our customers. Lead workshops, cut through the industry hype to guide their AI strategy, and build trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders by connecting technical capabilities to tangible business outcomes.

• Design & Build AI Agents: Work directly with customers to design, build, and iteratively refine conversational AI agents or agentic workflows to resolve problems more autonomously

• Develop the Playbook: You are building our deployment motion from the ground up. You will be responsible for creating and refining the playbooks, best practices, and processes that will scale our AI program.

• Drive Business Impact: Identify and prioritize high-impact use cases that generate clear, decision-ready signals tied to business value. Your success is measured by the outcomes you deliver for our customers and the growth you drive for Talkdesk.

• Shape the Product: Act as the voice of the customer, providing a tight feedback loop to our Product and Engineering teams to help shape the future of our AI platform.

What We're Looking For:

• 3+ years of experience in an AI based forward deployment, customer-facing, technical role such as Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, Customer Success, or Product Management.

• 3+ years of software development experience with experience in JavaScript, API integrations, Python and other AI/ML tools. Experience working with Cloud services and stack such as AWS and/Or Azure.

• Consultative AI Expertise: A consultative approach and the ability to act as an AI thought leader—educating customers on market trends, best practices, and the transformative potential of agentic AI.

• A proven track record of taking ownership over complex, ambiguous projects and delivering measurable results in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong technical aptitude with hands-on experience deploying AI, automation, or enterprise SaaS solutions. Direct experience developing with AI agents, LLMs, and related frameworks is a must.

• Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to command a room, articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences, and drive alignment.

• A "seller mindset" with commercial instincts; you are comfortable engaging in deal conversations and are motivated by driving customer value and expansion.

• High-agency and a "first principles" approach to problem-solving. You can see what needs to be done and have the bias for action to do it without being asked.

Bonus Points:

• 5+ Years in Technical consulting experience leading scaled implementations with ability to dive deep and implement technically complex solutions individually.

• Experience in a high-growth startup environment.

• Background in product management, conversation design, or a forward-deployed engineering role.

• Familiarity with contact center operations or CRM platforms.

Pay Range (OTE Pay):   $220k - $275k

Other Types of Pay: Based on level and role the employee may be eligible for long term incentives in the form of equity and short term incentives of either bonus or commission.

Health Insurance: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Retirement Benefits: 401(k) plan

Paid Time Off: Talkdesk offers an uncapped paid time off program for exempt employees and an accrual-based program for non-exempt employees; both are subject to manager approval and consistent with business needs.

Paid Holidays: Talkdesk offers 14 paid holidays each year.

jobs.title: Director, Data Center Market Intelligence
jobs.description:
Please Note:

To provide the best candidate experience amidst our high application volumes, each candidate is limited to 10 applications across all open jobs within a 6-month period.

Advancing the World’s Technology Together

Our technology solutions power the tools you use every day--including smartphones, electric vehicles, hyperscale data centers, IoT devices, and so much more. Here, you’ll have an opportunity to be part of a global leader whose innovative designs are pushing the boundaries of what’s possible and powering the future.

We believe innovation and growth are driven by an inclusive culture and a diverse workforce. We’re dedicated to empowering people to be their true selves. Together, we’re building a better tomorrow for our employees, customers, partners, and communities.

What You’ll Do

AI is changing data center infrastructure faster than any cycle before it, and memory is at the center of that change. As Director of Data Center Market Intelligence, reporting to the Sr. Director of Market Intelligence, you will lead the team that turns data center market dynamics into clear, reliable memory demand signals for DRAM, HBM and NAND/eSSD. You will be leadership's go-to source for weekly market sensing, build trusted relationships across the data center ecosystem, and work across Product Marketing, Sales, Product Planning and global headquarters teams. Your analysis will shape how Samsung plans products, supply, pricing and customer engagement, so we capture more market share and grow revenue.

Weekly Market Sensing and Leadership Reporting (core responsibility)

• Own the weekly market intelligence report for leadership. Every week, deliver a clear, decision-ready summary of what changed in the data center and AI infrastructure market and what it means for Samsung DRAM, HBM and NAND.

• Monitor industry news, company announcements, analyst and research reports, earnings commentary, and insights from customer and ecosystem meetings every day. Filter the noise and flag what matters.

• Distill each week's most important developments into a few key agendas. For each one, explain what happened, why it matters, the expected impact on memory demand, pricing or share, and the recommended actions or things to watch.

• Send same-day alerts and short briefs when major market events happen (e.g., large capex revisions, new AI cluster or data center announcements, export control changes, competitor qualification wins, or shifts in AI financing and credit conditions).

• Summarize key takeaways from internal and external meetings, conferences and customer engagements, and share them with leadership and relevant teams quickly and consistently.

• Build monthly and quarterly strategic reports that connect weekly signals into larger trends and update the demand outlook and its scenarios.

• Run a consistent, high-quality reporting rhythm that leadership can rely on, using AI-enabled tools to scale coverage without losing analytical depth.

Data Center Memory Demand Model

• Own and strengthen Samsung's data center memory demand model so that business planning and leadership use it as the trusted source for decisions.

• Link the market to memory from the top down: hyperscaler, cloud, neocloud and AI lab capex → spend split across compute, network and facilities → AI accelerator and server shipments → memory per system (DRAM GB per server, HBM GB per accelerator, SSD TB per server) → bit demand and revenue opportunity for Samsung.

• Model AI and non-AI infrastructure separately: AI training and inference clusters, general-purpose compute, and storage servers. Track how the mix shifts over time and by region.

• Reconcile the top-down view with bottom-up inputs (customer forecasts, sales pipeline, design wins and qualification status) to catch double-ordering, inventory build-up and gaps between forecast and reality.

• Build in real-world constraints: data center power availability and grid connection timelines, gigawatt-scale campus build-outs, advanced packaging capacity (e.g., CoWoS), HBM qualification timing, liquid cooling adoption, export controls and tariffs, customer inventory levels, and the financing environment for AI infrastructure (including neocloud and hyperscaler credit conditions).

• Run bull, base and bear scenarios. Backtest forecasts against actual results and report accuracy so confidence in the model keeps growing.

• Track each new release of third-party data center models (e.g., the monthly major Analysts’ Datacenter Model). Explain what changed from the previous version by hyperscaler, AI lab, neocloud and region, and what each change means for Samsung.

AI and Non-AI Infrastructure Analysis

• Track how AI systems are evolving: merchant GPUs, custom chips (e.g., TPU, Trainium, MTIA and other custom chip programs), rack-scale systems and AI networking. Assess what each shift means for memory content and product mix.

• Assess technology shifts that change memory demand per system, including HBM generation transitions (HBM3E → HBM4/4E) and custom HBM base dies, high-capacity DDR5 RDIMM and MRDIMM, LPDDR/SOCAMM in servers, CXL memory expansion, high-capacity QLC eSSD for AI data pipelines, and inference memory (KV cache) moving into storage.

• Analyze the economics of AI labs and cloud providers (revenue growth, compute spend, utilization, and inference vs. training demand) to judge how durable AI infrastructure investment is.

• Lead teardown analysis of servers, accelerators, boards and SSDs to confirm memory content, configurations, bill-of-materials cost and competitor positioning.

Quarterly Earnings and Capex Intelligence

• Lead Samsung's quarterly analysis of earnings calls, filings and guidance for key hyperscale and cloud customers (e.g., Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, Oracle), neoclouds, server OEMs and ODMs (e.g., Dell, HPE, Supermicro, Quanta, Wiwynn, Foxconn), and chip customers (e.g., NVIDIA, AMD, Broadcom, Marvell, Intel).

• Turn their revenue, cloud growth, capex, and guidance changes into memory bit and revenue impact for Samsung DRAM, HBM and NAND. Publish post-earnings briefs within days of each call.

• Track early indicators: capex guidance revisions, ODM monthly revenues, data center construction and power pipelines, accelerator supply chain signals, and memory contract pricing trends.

• Monitor memory competitors (capacity additions, technology roadmaps, qualification wins, pricing and financial results) to judge supply-demand balance, pricing direction and share opportunities.

Executive Communication and Cross-Functional Leadership

• Present key findings, market outlooks and recommendations to senior leaders, global internal customers and headquarters teams. Turn complex, data-heavy analysis into clear, decision-ready insights.

jobs.title: Operations Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Support Operations team is responsible for keeping Anduril's deployed fleet of autonomous robots and software products available to the people using them. We are the company's incident response and containment function for deployed systems. Our work lands as deficiency reports and general inquiries from customers, field teams, and automated alerting. We take those signals, assess urgency, work the problem down to an affected system, and exercise steps to restore capability. Our work is captured in case records and associated to known populations to support trend definition, and the recurring patterns we surface provide the raw material for Voice of the Customer (VOC) Product Operations focused on engineering out recurrence. This team is a crucial component of customer and mission success, and plays a critical role in how Anduril continues to deliver cutting-edge capability to the United States and its allies.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Support Operations Specialist, Tier 1 to join our rapidly growing team in Santa Ana, CA. In this role, you will be the first point of contact in the Product Operations chain for Anduril's deployed systems, working a single flat queue of reports from across the company's breadth of programs and products. You will own each case from intake through containment or, when applicable, a clean escalation handover: characterizing and triaging the report signal, tracing incident details and telemetry data to an affected system, establishing priority against the governing service level agreement, and containing the issue by executing documented procedures through remote on-system and guided customer actions. The uptime commitments behind these systems are aggressive, with many missions demanding immediate and effective response when a failure occurs. This will require structured troubleshooting at the interface of hardware, software, and networking, working comfort with the Linux command line and SSH, and the ability to explain a technical problem clearly to a non-engineer customer in writing and by phone. If you are someone who is cool under pressure, extremely detail oriented, focused above all on the customer's experience, disciplined enough to execute a documented sequence exactly, and adaptable enough to recognize when the documentation does not match the system in front of you and find the right next step, then this role is for you. If you are interested in a technical career path with a high level of impact, broad exposure to the capabilities Anduril delivers, and insight into how fielded systems actually fail (and what it takes to recover them), Anduril is interested in speaking with you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own the First Response: Triage every inbound report, acknowledge receipt to the reporter, and confirm what activity is underway against their case.

• Set Priority Against the SLA: Establish case priority against the governing program service level agreement, and keep the clock visible rather than discovering a breach after it happens.

• Narrow It to a System: Perform the analysis that takes a case from a customer's description to the affected system or systems, and, when required, go back to the customer for the detail the report is missing.

• Contain Known Failures: Execute documented steps in sequence from product documentation to contain known failure modes, both by remote action on cloud-connected systems and by directing a customer through steps on systems we cannot reach ourselves. Interpret and extrapolate from documented steps when they do not capture the exact state of the system, and pivot to additional documentation when required.

• Keep the Record Straight: Maintain a detailed record of the case, actions taken, and progress made through closure.

• Make the Escalation Call: Decide when Tier 1 capability has been exhausted, or when an incident is too novel to contain or characterize with the documentation and tools available, and hand it over with a record of the work already done to mitigate redundant cycles.

• Elevate Business Risk: Interpret program service level agreements and make the risk characterization call to elevate a report that is potentially damaging to the business, separate from the priority the agreement itself produces.

• Chase Your Escalations: Monitor and actively pursue updates on cases escalated beyond Tier 1, rather than waiting for Tier 2 or engineering to report back.

• Improve the Runbook: Propose runbook revisions for Tier 2 to validate and incorporate, and flag the cases where no documented path existed at all.

• Hold the Coverage: Work a 4x10 shift pattern alongside your team to keep continuous coverage on the queue.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Working comfort with the Linux command line and remote sessions over SSH, or clear aptitude to get there quickly

• Strong aptitude for structured troubleshooting at the interface of hardware, software, and networking

• Ability to work all shifts, overtime and weekends as needed. Position works a 4x10 shift pattern; shifts are subject to change, we have multiple shifts, including late afternoons/nights

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

• This position is based in Santa Ana, CA and requires being onsite - remote work not considered

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in a STEM field, or equivalent hands-on technical experience. Computer science, robotics, or information technology are a plus

• One or more years in a technical support, help desk, network operations, or field service role, including time on a shift rotation

• Hands-on experience with the Linux command line interface and SSH against remote or embedded systems

• One or more years in any of: government agency, military, defense, technology, or manufacturing

• Prior experience supporting complex hardware systems, networks, and related technologies. Military assets are a plus

• Familiarity with Salesforce or another case management system, and with observability tooling such as Grafana, Datadog, or Groundcover

• Exposure to a formal deficiency reporting or failure mode process

US Hourly Range

$36.06—$48.08 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America’s drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. You will take extreme ownership of the product and the process in parallel, maturing motor designs for manufacturability while simultaneously developing the lines that build them. At Komodo Health, our mission is to reduce the global burden of disease. And we believe that smarter use of data is essential to this mission. jobs.description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Global Accounts Payable & Expense Operations Analyst - Contingent Worker

Position Summary

The Accounts Payable & Expense Operations Analyst is responsible for supporting end-to-end Accounts Payable (AP), Travel & Expense (T&E),operations while serving as the functional subject matter expert for enterprise financial systems. This role combines operational excellence with systems expertise to ensure accurate invoice processing, employee expense reimbursements, supplier management, corporate card administration, payment operations, and enterprise application support.

The position partners closely with Finance, Procurement, Treasury, Tax, Human Resources, Payroll, IT, external vendors, and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) providers to ensure efficient, compliant, and reliable financial operations across a global organization. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, customer-focused, and experienced in supporting enterprise applications including Coupa  Invoicing, Coupa Supplier Information Management (SIM), SAP Concur, SAP S/4HANA, OpenText Vendor Invoice Management (VIM), and related financial systems.

Routine AP and Expense transactional operations are primarily performed by the BPO provider. This role oversees BPO service delivery, monitors operational performance and controls, supports the resolution of escalated issues, and drives process and system improvements. The Analyst may also directly perform selected operational activities to support exceptions, escalations, transitions, business continuity, or other operational requirements.

Work Arrangement: Hybrid (2–3 days per week in the office based on business and team requirements).

Key Responsibilities

Depending on business needs and the defined operating model, the responsibilities below may be fulfilled through oversight of the BPO provider, direct execution by the Analyst, or a combination of both. Accounts Payable & Supplier Operations

• Process supplier invoices accurately using Coupa Invoicing, SAP S/4HANA, OpenText VIM, and related applications.

• Process Relish invoices and ensure timely and accurate payment processing.

• Manage supplier onboarding, registration, maintenance, and vendor master records through Coupa Supplier Information Management (SIM).

• Review, validate, and resolve invoice discrepancies, exceptions, and workflow issues.

• Perform vendor account reconciliations and resolve outstanding balances.

• Process and monitor supplier payments while ensuring compliance with company policies and financial controls.

• Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to Accounts Payable.

• Ensure compliance with SOX, audit requirements, tax regulations, and internal controls.

Expense & Corporate Card Operations

• Serve as the primary escalation point for complex employee expense reimbursement and corporate card issues outside the scope of the BPO provider.

• Administer Corporate Card programs across multiple regions, including account setup, maintenance, credit limit requests, delinquency monitoring, employee terminations, dormant account reviews, and dispute resolution.

• Investigate reimbursement issues, duplicate payments, rejected payment files, payment exceptions, and policy violations.

• Validate reimbursement payment batches and reconcile payment files prior to processing.

• Partner with Treasury, Payroll, HR, Procurement, Finance, Tax, and external vendors to resolve operational issues.

• Escalate significant financial, operational, or compliance risks to leadership.

Enterprise Systems & Functional Support

• Provide functional support for SAP Concur, Coupa, SAP S/4HANA, OpenText VIM, and related enterprise applications.

• Investigate and resolve application issues including: Employee provisioning failures ERP interface failures SAP IDoc processing issues Corporate Card feed failures Expense application and mobile issues Enterprise integration failures

• Analyze system dependencies, determine business impact, identify root causes, and coordinate resolution with IT and software vendors.

• Support production issue validation and act as the functional liaison between Finance and IT.

Testing, Projects & Continuous Improvement

• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing, system upgrades, releases, implementations, and application enhancements.

• Develop test plans, document defects, validate fixes, and coordinate production readiness.

• Identify opportunities for automation, process improvements, and operational efficiencies across Accounts Payable and Expense functions.

• Participate in Finance transformation initiatives, Procure-to-Pay projects, and cross-functional business initiatives.

• Prepare operational reports and analyze performance metrics.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

• Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), business process documentation, workflows, and system documentation.

• Create employee communications, FAQs, training materials, and job aids.

• Support knowledge transfer, cross-training, and business continuity planning.

• Maintain documentation repositories and ensure information remains current and accurate.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Procurement, Finance, HR, Payroll, Treasury, Tax, Legal, IT, and external vendors to resolve operational issues.

• Support supplier, employee, and stakeholder inquiries with a customer-focused approach.

• Promote collaboration across global teams while maintaining strong internal controls and operational excellence.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• Five or more years of relevant experience across one or more of the following areas: Accounts Payable, Travel & Expense, Finance Operations.

• Hands-on experience administering or providing functional support for at least two of the following system or comparable enterprise financial platforms:

* Coupa Invoicing

• * Coupa Supplier Information Management (SIM)

* SAP S/4 HANA

* OpenText Vendor Invoice Management (VIM)

• Experience maintaining Vendor Master data.

• Strong understanding of Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Accounts Payable, Expense Management, and Corporate Card processes.

• Experience supporting enterprise financial systems, interfaces, and integrations.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office skills.

• Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced global environment.

• Ability to work in a hybrid environment (2–3 days per week in the office).

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting global shared services organizations.

• Experience with SAP IDoc processing and enterprise integrations.

• Knowledge of European VAT regulations and SAP Concur VAT functionality.

• Experience with OCR technologies and invoice automation solutions.

• Experience supporting Finance system implementations, upgrades, and digital transformation initiatives.

• Knowledge of SOX compliance, audit controls, and financial governance.

• Experience collaborating with Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) providers.

Key Competencies

• Attention to detail and accuracy

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills

• Enterprise systems aptitude

• Customer service orientation

• Financial controls and compliance mindset

• Cross-functional collaboration

• Project coordination

• Process improvement and continuous learning

• Time management and prioritization

• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills

• Integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality

jobs.title: MLOps / DevOps Engineer – AI Infrastructure
jobs.description:
MLOPS / DEVOPS ENGINEER – AI INFRASTRUCTURE

The DevOps Engineer is responsible for supporting and improving cloud and ML/AI infrastructure, automating deployments, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines to ensure efficient, secure, and scalable development workflows. This role plays a crucial part in infrastructure automation, monitoring, and cloud security while collaborating with Software and ML Engineers, Product support, QA, and Security teams.
As a key member of the DevOps team, the DevOps Engineer helps manage cloud environments, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), ensuring high availability and compliance with security best practices.


In this role, you’ll get to:

Cloud Infrastructure, Security & Reliability

 - Support and maintain scalable, highly available, and secure cloud infrastructure in accordance with company policies and standards.

 - Provision and manage cloud resources using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Terragrunt, CloudFormation).

 - Implement cloud security best practices, including IAM/role-based access controls, encryption, vulnerability management, and secure infrastructure configurations.

 - Support containerized environments and orchestration platforms.

 - Apply DevSecOps principles across infrastructure and deployment workflows.

 - Participate in disaster recovery planning, testing, and recovery activities.

CI/CD, Automation & Deployment

 - Maintain and optimize CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI/CD and Jenkins, supporting application and ML model deployments.

 - Improve deployment reliability and support zero-downtime deployment strategies.

 - Automate configuration management, infrastructure provisioning, and routine operational processes.

 - Troubleshoot deployment and pipeline issues and implement improvements to prevent recurrence.

 - Develop scripts and automation to reduce manual work and improve engineering efficiency.

AI & Agentic Infrastructure

 - Help design, deploy, operate, and secure infrastructure supporting AI and agentic products, including MCP, agents, integrations, internal tooling, and customer-facing use cases.

 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools, coding copilots, and AI-driven troubleshooting to improve DevOps productivity and reduce repetitive operational work.

 - Evaluate and adopt practical AI-enabled workflows that improve infrastructure management, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency.

MLOps & ML Platform Infrastructure

 - Operate and scale ML platform infrastructure, including Databricks and Sagemaker clusters, jobs compute, ML pipelines, and Model Serving endpoints.

 - Manage production model-serving infrastructure, including compute capacity, provisioned throughput, and autoscaling for high-throughput inference workloads.

 - Maintain infrastructure-level monitoring for model drift, data quality, inference performance, and serving health, while partnering with ML Engineering on model evaluation, quality thresholds, and model correctness.

 - Partner with ML Engineering to support reliable CI/CD and production deployment of ML models.

Observability, Incident Response & Engineering Collaboration

 - Maintain monitoring, logging, metrics, and alerting solutions using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Coralogix, and CloudWatch.

 - Support incident response and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for infrastructure and deployment-related issues.

 - Improve system observability through effective log aggregation, metrics collection, monitoring, and alerting.

 - Partner with Software Engineers, ML Engineers, QA, and Software Engineers in Test to improve deployment workflows and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

 - Collaborate with IT Security to maintain secure cloud operations and infrastructure policies.

 - Respond to engineering and Product Support requests in a timely manner and provide technical infrastructure support when needed.

 - Maintain accurate internal technical and operational documentation.

 - Collaborate effectively with international teams across multiple time zones



Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

 - 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or a similar infrastructure-focused role.

 - 2+ years of hands-on experience supporting production ML/AI infrastructure, including model serving, training pipelines, and model monitoring.

 - 2+ Hands-on experience with Databricks (clusters, jobs, ML pipelines, Model Serving) and/or AWS SageMaker (endpoints, inference, model deployment, provisioned throughput, autoscaling) in a production environment.

 - 2+ years of hands-on experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, SQS, API Gateway, or similar services.

 - 2+ years of experience working with containerized environments and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes and Amazon EKS.

 - Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI/CD or Jenkins.

 - Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Terragrunt, CloudFormation, or similar technologies.

 - Strong Linux system administration and troubleshooting skills.

 - Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including routing, load balancing, network security, and related concepts.

 - Scripting experience with Python, Bash, or similar languages to automate infrastructure and operational tasks.

Nice to have:

 - Experience with Google Cloud, particularly for candidates who have worked across multi-cloud environments.

 - Familiarity with Helm and service mesh technologies such as Istio, Linkerd, Traefik, or similar tools.

 - Experience designing serverless and event-driven architectures (beyond basic usage) using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and SQS.

 - Exposure to cloud and infrastructure security practices, including vulnerability management and tools such as Nessus, Prowler, Trivy, or firewalls.

 - Knowledge of security standards, compliance requirements, and cloud security best practices.

 - Experience with observability, log analysis, and monitoring platforms such as Coralogix, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar solutions.

 - FinOps experience, including cloud cost monitoring, optimization, and accountability practices.

 - Experience with API gateway or API management platforms such as Kong or Apigee.

 - Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve engineering workflows, automation, troubleshooting, or agentic use cases.
